"use client";

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { produce } from "immer";
import { defaultAnim, type Caption, type CaptionStyle, type Project, type RippleMode } from "@/schema";
import { applyEdit, heuristicSync, mergeCaptions, parseLyrics, splitCaption, tokenizeLine } from "@/align-engine";
import { applyPreset } from "@/render-engine";
import { mirrorProject } from "@/lib/idb";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";

const HISTORY_LIMIT = 100;

interface HistoryState {
  past: Project[];
  future: Project[];
}

interface StudioState {
  project: Project;
  selectedIds: string[];
  playhead: number;
  playing: boolean;
  loop: boolean;
  volume: number;
  zoom: number;
  leftOpen: boolean;
  rightOpen: boolean;
  bottomOpen: boolean;
  leftWidth: number;
  rightWidth: number;
  bottomHeight: number;
  toast: { id: number; text: string } | null;
  dirty: boolean;
  saving: boolean;
}

export interface StudioApi extends StudioState {
  canUndo: boolean;
  canRedo: boolean;
  _openLyricsModal?: () => void;
  _openResyncModal?: () => void;
  openLyricsModal: () => void;
  openResyncModal: () => void;
  setProject: (project: Project, record?: boolean) => void;
  commit: (recipe: (draft: Project) => void, label?: string) => void;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
  select: (ids: string[], additive?: boolean) => void;
  setPlayhead: (t: number) => void;
  setPlaying: (v: boolean) => void;
  setLoop: (v: boolean) => void;
  setVolume: (v: number) => void;
  setZoom: (v: number) => void;
  setRippleMode: (mode: RippleMode) => void;
  updateStyle: (patch: Partial<CaptionStyle>, scope: "default" | "selected") => void;
  applyStylePreset: (id: string) => void;
  resizeCaption: (id: string, edge: "in" | "out", nextSec: number) => void;
  moveCaption: (id: string, nextStart: number) => void;
  rollCaption: (leftId: string, nextBoundary: number) => void;
  relinkCaption: (id: string, startSec: number) => void;
  splitAtPlayhead: () => void;
  mergeSelected: () => void;
  deleteSelected: () => void;
  duplicateSelected: () => void;
  nudge: (frames: number) => void;
  updateCaptionText: (id: string, text: string) => void;
  updateCaptionTiming: (id: string, startSec: number, endSec: number) => void;
  addCaption: (text?: string, startSec?: number, endSec?: number) => void;
  replaceLyrics: (rawLyrics: string) => void;
  setPanel: (which: "left" | "right" | "bottom", open: boolean) => void;
  setPanelSize: (which: "left" | "right" | "bottom", size: number) => void;
  notify: (text: string) => void;
  markSaved: () => void;
}

const StudioContext = createContext<StudioApi | null>(null);

export function StudioProvider({ initial, children }: { initial: Project; children: ReactNode }) {
  const [project, setProjectState] = useState<Project>(initial);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [playhead, setPlayhead] = useState(0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [loop, setLoop] = useState(false);
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(0.9);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [leftOpen, setLeftOpen] = useState(true);
  const [rightOpen, setRightOpen] = useState(true);
  const [bottomOpen, setBottomOpen] = useState(true);
  const [leftWidth, setLeftWidth] = useState(300);
  const [rightWidth, setRightWidth] = useState(330);
  const [bottomHeight, setBottomHeight] = useState(230);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ id: number; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const history = useRef<HistoryState>({ past: [], future: [] });
  const [histSizes, setHistSizes] = useState({ past: 0, future: 0 });
  const toastId = useRef(0);

  const notify = useCallback((text: string) => {
    toastId.current += 1;
    setToast({ id: toastId.current, text });
  }, []);

  const pushHistory = useCallback((prev: Project) => {
    history.current = {
      past: [...history.current.past.slice(-(HISTORY_LIMIT - 1)), prev],
      future: [],
    };
    setHistSizes({ past: history.current.past.length, future: 0 });
  }, []);

  const setProject = useCallback(
    (next: Project, record = true) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        if (record) pushHistory(prev);
        const updated = { ...next, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        void mirrorProject(updated.id, updated, updated.updatedAt);
        return updated;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [pushHistory],
  );

  const commit = useCallback(
    (recipe: (draft: Project) => void) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          recipe(draft);
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [pushHistory],
  );

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    const prev = history.current.past.pop();
    if (!prev) return;
    setProjectState((curr) => {
      history.current.future.push(curr);
      setHistSizes({ past: history.current.past.length, future: history.current.future.length });
      return prev;
    });
    setDirty(true);
  }, []);

  const redo = useCallback(() => {
    const nxt = history.current.future.pop();
    if (!nxt) return;
    setProjectState((curr) => {
      history.current.past.push(curr);
      setHistSizes({ past: history.current.past.length, future: history.current.future.length });
      return nxt;
    });
    setDirty(true);
  }, []);

  const select = useCallback((ids: string[], additive = false) => {
    setSelectedIds((curr) => (additive ? Array.from(new Set([...curr, ...ids])) : ids));
  }, []);

  const applyCaptions = useCallback(
    (captions: Caption[], message?: string) => {
      commit((draft) => {
        draft.captions = captions;
      });
      if (message) notify(message);
    },
    [commit, notify],
  );

  const resizeCaption = useCallback(
    (id: string, edge: "in" | "out", nextSec: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: prev.settings.rippleMode, durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "resize", id, edge, nextSec },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        if (result.message) notify(result.message);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory, notify],
  );

  const moveCaption = useCallback(
    (id: string, nextStart: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: prev.settings.rippleMode, durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "move", id, nextStart },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        if (result.message) notify(result.message);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory, notify],
  );

  const rollCaption = useCallback(
    (leftId: string, nextBoundary: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: "roll", durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "roll", leftId, nextBoundary },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        if (result.message) notify(result.message);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory, notify],
  );

  const relinkCaption = useCallback(
    (id: string, startSec: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: "relink", durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "relink", target: { captionId: id, startSec } },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory],
  );

  const api = useMemo<StudioApi>(
    () => ({
      project,
      selectedIds,
      playhead,
      playing,
      loop,
      volume,
      zoom,
      leftOpen,
      rightOpen,
      bottomOpen,
      leftWidth,
      rightWidth,
      bottomHeight,
      toast,
      dirty,
      saving,
      canUndo: histSizes.past > 0,
      canRedo: histSizes.future > 0,
      setProject,
      commit,
      undo,
      redo,
      select,
      setPlayhead,
      setPlaying,
      setLoop,
      setVolume,
      setZoom,
      setRippleMode: (mode) => commit((d) => { d.settings.rippleMode = mode; }),
      updateStyle: (patch, scope) => {
        commit((d) => {
          if (scope === "default") Object.assign(d.defaultStyle, patch);
          else {
            for (const id of selectedIds) {
              const cap = d.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
              if (cap) cap.styleOverride = { ...(cap.styleOverride ?? {}), ...patch };
            }
          }
        });
      },
      applyStylePreset: (id) => setProject(applyPreset(project, id)),
      resizeCaption,
      moveCaption,
      rollCaption,
      relinkCaption,
      splitAtPlayhead: () => {
        const id = selectedIds[0];
        if (!id) return;
        applyCaptions(splitCaption(project.captions, id, playhead));
      },
      mergeSelected: () => applyCaptions(mergeCaptions(project.captions, selectedIds)),
      deleteSelected: () => {
        applyCaptions(project.captions.filter((c) => !selectedIds.includes(c.id)).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, index: i })));
        setSelectedIds([]);
      },
      duplicateSelected: () => {
        const copies = project.captions
          .filter((c) => selectedIds.includes(c.id))
          .map((c) => ({
            ...c,
            id: `${c.id}_copy_${Date.now()}`,
            startSec: c.endSec + 0.04,
            endSec: c.endSec + 0.04 + (c.endSec - c.startSec),
            words: c.words.map((w) => ({
              ...w,
              startSec: w.startSec + (c.endSec - c.startSec) + 0.04,
              endSec: w.endSec + (c.endSec - c.startSec) + 0.04,
            })),
          }));
        applyCaptions([...project.captions, ...copies].sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, index: i })));
      },
      nudge: (frames) => {
        const delta = frames / (project.meta.fps || 30);
        const id = selectedIds[0];
        if (!id) return;
        const cap = project.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
        if (!cap) return;
        moveCaption(id, cap.startSec + delta);
      },
      updateCaptionText: (id, text) => {
        commit((d) => {
          const cap = d.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
          if (cap) {
            cap.text = text;
            const words = tokenizeLine(text);
            const span = Math.max(0.04, cap.endSec - cap.startSec);
            const wspan = span / Math.max(1, words.length);
            cap.words = words.map((t, i) => ({
              text: t.raw,
              startSec: cap.startSec + i * wspan,
              endSec: cap.startSec + (i + 1) * wspan,
              confidence: 0.8,
            }));
          }
        });
      },
      updateCaptionTiming: (id, startSec, endSec) => {
        commit((d) => {
          const cap = d.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
          if (cap) {
            const start = Math.max(0, Math.min(startSec, endSec - 0.05));
            const end = Math.min(d.meta.durationSec > 0 ? d.meta.durationSec : 9999, Math.max(endSec, start + 0.05));
            cap.startSec = start;
            cap.endSec = end;
            const span = end - start;
            const wspan = span / Math.max(1, cap.words.length);
            cap.words = cap.words.map((w, i) => ({
              ...w,
              startSec: start + i * wspan,
              endSec: start + (i + 1) * wspan,
            }));
          }
        });
      },
      addCaption: (text = "New lyric line", startSec, endSec) => {
        const start = startSec !== undefined ? startSec : playhead;
        const duration = project.meta.durationSec > 0 ? project.meta.durationSec : 60;
        const end = endSec !== undefined ? endSec : Math.min(duration, start + 2.5);
        const words = tokenizeLine(text);
        const wspan = Math.max(0.05, (end - start) / Math.max(1, words.length));
        const newCap: Caption = {
          id: createId("cap"),
          index: project.captions.length,
          text,
          startSec: start,
          endSec: Math.max(start + 0.1, end),
          words: words.map((t, i) => ({
            text: t.raw,
            startSec: start + i * wspan,
            endSec: start + (i + 1) * wspan,
            confidence: 0.8,
          })),
          animation: {
            in: defaultAnim("fade"),
            out: defaultAnim("fade"),
            highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
          },
          confidence: 0.8,
          instrumental: false,
          locked: false,
        };
        applyCaptions([...project.captions, newCap].sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, index: i })));
        setSelectedIds([newCap.id]);
      },
      replaceLyrics: (rawLyrics: string) => {
        const parsed = parseLyrics(rawLyrics);
        const vocalLines = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
        if (vocalLines.length === 0) {
          notify("No lyric lines found in sheet.");
          return;
        }
        commit((d) => {
          const existingVocal = d.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental);
          if (existingVocal.length === vocalLines.length) {
            // Preserving existing line boundaries and timestamps
            let vIdx = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < d.captions.length; i++) {
              const cap = d.captions[i]!;
              if (cap.instrumental) continue;
              const newL = vocalLines[vIdx]!;
              vIdx++;
              cap.text = newL.text;
              const words = tokenizeLine(newL.text);
              const span = Math.max(0.04, cap.endSec - cap.startSec);
              const wspan = span / Math.max(1, words.length);
              cap.words = words.map((t, wi) => ({
                text: t.raw,
                startSec: cap.startSec + wi * wspan,
                endSec: cap.startSec + (wi + 1) * wspan,
                confidence: cap.confidence ?? 0.8,
              }));
            }
            if (parsed.title && (!d.meta.title || d.meta.title === "Midnight Atlas")) d.meta.title = parsed.title;
            if (parsed.artist && (!d.meta.artist || d.meta.artist === "Northline")) d.meta.artist = parsed.artist;
            return;
          }

          // Line count changed -> full re-sync
          const dur = d.meta.durationSec > 0 ? d.meta.durationSec : Math.max(30, vocalLines.length * 3.6);
          const synced = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, dur);
          if (parsed.title) d.meta.title = parsed.title;
          else if (d.meta.title === "Midnight Atlas" || !d.meta.title) {
            d.meta.title = vocalLines[0]?.text.slice(0, 32) || "Custom Lyrics";
          }
          if (parsed.artist) d.meta.artist = parsed.artist;
          else if (d.meta.artist === "Northline") {
            d.meta.artist = "";
          }
          d.captions = synced.captions;
        });
        setPlayhead(0);
        setSelectedIds(project.captions[0] ? [project.captions[0].id] : []);
        notify(`Updated lyrics sheet.`);
      },
      setPanel: (which, open) => {
        if (which === "left") setLeftOpen(open);
        if (which === "right") setRightOpen(open);
        if (which === "bottom") setBottomOpen(open);
      },
      setPanelSize: (which, size) => {
        if (which === "left") setLeftWidth(size);
        if (which === "right") setRightWidth(size);
        if (which === "bottom") setBottomHeight(size);
      },
      notify,
      markSaved: () => {
        setDirty(false);
        setSaving(false);
      },
      _openLyricsModal: undefined,
      _openResyncModal: undefined,
      openLyricsModal: () => {
        if (api._openLyricsModal) api._openLyricsModal();
      },
      openResyncModal: () => {
        if (api._openResyncModal) api._openResyncModal();
      },
    }),
    [
      project,
      selectedIds,
      playhead,
      playing,
      loop,
      volume,
      zoom,
      leftOpen,
      rightOpen,
      bottomOpen,
      leftWidth,
      rightWidth,
      bottomHeight,
      toast,
      dirty,
      saving,
      histSizes,
      setProject,
      commit,
      undo,
      redo,
      select,
      resizeCaption,
      moveCaption,
      rollCaption,
      relinkCaption,
      applyCaptions,
      notify,
    ],
  );

  return <StudioContext.Provider value={api}>{children}</StudioContext.Provider>;
}

export function useStudio(): StudioApi {
  const ctx = useContext(StudioContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useStudio must be used within StudioProvider");
  return ctx;
}

import { PreviewCanvas } from "./preview-canvas";
import { Timeline } from "./timeline";
import { Inspector } from "./inspector";
import { formatTimecode } from "@/lib/time";

const ART: Record<string, string> = {
  "seven-clouds": "/images/art-default.jpg",
  "neon-karaoke": "/images/art-neon.jpg",
  editorial: "/images/art-editorial.jpg",
  "stage-spotlight": "/images/art-spotlight.jpg",
};

function Shortcuts({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  if (!open) return null;
  const rows = [
    ["Space", "Play / pause preview"],
    ["J / K / L", "Back 2s / pause / forward 2s"],
    ["I / O", "Mark in / out points"],
    ["S / M", "Split / merge captions"],
    ["Home / End", "Jump to start / end"],
    ["[ / ]", "Prev / next caption block"],
    ["← / →", "Nudge timing 1 frame"],
    ["Shift + ←/→", "Nudge timing 10 frames"],
    ["Ctrl+Z / Shift+Z", "Undo / redo changes"],
    ["?", "Show / hide shortcuts"],
  ];
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] grid place-items-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md p-8" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0d111a] p-6 lf-enter shadow-2xl" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-3">
          <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-white">
            <Sparkles size={18} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Keyboard Shortcuts
          </h2>
          <span className="text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">Press Esc to close</span>
        </div>
        <dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-3 text-sm">
          {rows.map(([k, v]) => (
            <div key={k} className="contents">
              <dt className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--accent)] bg-[#05070a] px-2 py-1 rounded border border-white/10 w-fit">{k}</dt>
              <dd className="text-xs text-[var(--muted)] flex items-center">{v}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function HeaderMenu({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const studio = useStudio();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!(e.target as HTMLElement).closest("[data-header-menu]")) onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const items = [
    { label: "Paste / Edit Lyric Sheet", icon: FileText, action: () => { onClose(); studio.openLyricsModal(); } },
    { label: "Re-sync Captions (Heuristic)", icon: RefreshCw, action: () => { onClose(); studio.openResyncModal(); } },
    {
      label: "Insert Music Break at Playhead",
      icon: Music2,
      action: () => {
        onClose();
        studio.addCaption("♪");
        studio.notify("Inserted ♪ Music Break at playhead");
      },
    },
    {
      label: "Reset All Styles to Preset",
      icon: SlidersHorizontal,
      action: () => {
        onClose();
        studio.applyStylePreset(studio.project.presetId ?? "seven-clouds");
        studio.notify("Reset all caption styles to preset defaults");
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div
      data-header-menu
      className="absolute right-0 top-full z-[100] mt-2 w-64 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0f1422] p-2 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl lf-enter"
      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
    >
      <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">
        Studio Operations
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <button
            key={item.label}
            type="button"
            onClick={item.action}
            className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/15 hover:text-[var(--accent)] transition-all"
          >
            <item.icon size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)] shrink-0" />
            <span>{item.label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StudioInner({ audioUrl, peaks }: { audioUrl: string | null; peaks: number[] }) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const [help, setHelp] = useState(false);
  const [lyricsModalOpen, setLyricsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lyricsSheetText, setLyricsSheetText] = useState("");
  const [resyncModalOpen, setResyncModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const [exportPct, setExportPct] = useState(0);
  const [exportMsg, setExportMsg] = useState("");
  const [res, setRes] = useState("1920x1080");
  const [fps, setFps] = useState(30);
  const [quality, setQuality] = useState<"high" | "balanced" | "small">("high");
  const [headerMenuOpen, setHeaderMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [captionFilter, setCaptionFilter] = useState<"all" | "flagged" | "music">("all");
  const abort = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const saveTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Expose modal openers on the studio API
  useEffect(() => {
    studio._openLyricsModal = () => {
      const lines = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental).map((c) => c.text).join("\n");
      const metaHeader = `## title: ${studio.project.meta.title}\n## artist: ${studio.project.meta.artist}\n\n`;
      setLyricsSheetText(metaHeader + lines);
      setLyricsModalOpen(true);
    };
    studio._openResyncModal = () => setResyncModalOpen(true);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleApplyLyricsSheet = () => {
    if (!lyricsSheetText.trim()) return;
    studio.replaceLyrics(lyricsSheetText);
    setLyricsModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleResyncCaptions = () => {
    const lines = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental).map((c) => c.text).join("\n");
    const parsed = parseLyrics(lines);
    const dur = studio.project.meta.durationSec > 0 ? studio.project.meta.durationSec : 60;
    const synced = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, dur);
    studio.commit((d) => { d.captions = synced.captions; });
    studio.setPlayhead(0);
    studio.notify("Re-synced all captions across audio duration.");
    setResyncModalOpen(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("lf-layout");
    if (!raw) return;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { left?: number; right?: number; bottom?: number };
      if (parsed.left) studio.setPanelSize("left", parsed.left);
      if (parsed.right) studio.setPanelSize("right", parsed.right);
      if (parsed.bottom) studio.setPanelSize("bottom", parsed.bottom);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem("lf-layout", JSON.stringify({ left: studio.leftWidth, right: studio.rightWidth, bottom: studio.bottomHeight }));
  }, [studio.leftWidth, studio.rightWidth, studio.bottomHeight]);

  const { project, dirty, markSaved } = studio;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) return;
    if (saveTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    saveTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
      }).then(() => markSaved()).catch(() => undefined);
    }, 700);
  }, [project, dirty, markSaved]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName;
      if (tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT") return;
      if (e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); studio.setPlaying(!studio.playing); }
      if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "J") studio.setPlayhead(Math.max(0, studio.playhead - 2));
      if (e.key === "l" || e.key === "L") studio.setPlayhead(Math.min(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 9999, studio.playhead + 2));
      if (e.key === "k" || e.key === "K") studio.setPlaying(false);
      if (e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") studio.splitAtPlayhead();
      if (e.key === "m" || e.key === "M") studio.mergeSelected();
      if (e.key === "Home") studio.setPlayhead(0);
      if (e.key === "End") studio.setPlayhead(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 0);
      if (e.key === "[") {
        const prev = [...studio.project.captions].reverse().find((c) => c.startSec < studio.playhead - 0.01);
        if (prev) { studio.setPlayhead(prev.startSec); studio.select([prev.id]); }
      }
      if (e.key === "]") {
        const next = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.startSec > studio.playhead + 0.01);
        if (next) { studio.setPlayhead(next.startSec); studio.select([next.id]); }
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? -10 : -1);
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1);
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.shiftKey) studio.redo(); else studio.undo();
      }
      if (e.key === "?" || (e.shiftKey && e.key === "/")) setHelp((v) => !v);
      if (e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") studio.deleteSelected();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [studio]);

  const flagged = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6);
  const album = ART[studio.project.presetId ?? "seven-clouds"] ?? "/images/art-default.jpg";

  // Filtered captions for the left drawer
  const filteredCaptions = useMemo(() => {
    return studio.project.captions.filter((c) => {
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        if (!c.text.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !String(c.index + 1).includes(q)) return false;
      }
      if (captionFilter === "flagged") {
        return !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6;
      }
      if (captionFilter === "music") {
        return Boolean(c.instrumental || !c.text || c.text.trim() === "♪");
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [studio.project.captions, searchQuery, captionFilter]);

  async function runExport() {
    const [w, h] = res.split("x").map(Number);
    const ok = await isWebCodecsSupported(w || 1920, h || 1080);
    if (!ok) {
      studio.notify("WebCodecs unavailable — trying FFmpeg fallback.");
      const response = await fetch("/api/export", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format: "mp4", width: w, height: h }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) { studio.notify("FFmpeg fallback is not available in this environment."); return; }
      const blob = await response.blob();
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.mp4`);
      return;
    }
    setExporting(true);
    abort.current = new AbortController();
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    const bgAssetId = studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId;
    let customBlob: Blob | null = null;
    if (bgAssetId) { customBlob = (await getBlob(bgAssetId)) ?? null; }
    const img = new Image();
    if (customBlob) { img.src = URL.createObjectURL(customBlob); } else { img.src = album; }
    await img.decode().catch(() => undefined);
    let audioBuffer: AudioBuffer | null = null;
    if (audioUrl) { const buf = await fetch(audioUrl).then((r) => r.arrayBuffer()); audioBuffer = await decodeAudio(buf); }
    const durationSec = audioBuffer?.duration || studio.project.meta.durationSec || 8;
    const totalFrames = Math.round(durationSec * fps);
    const spectrumFrames = audioBuffer ? computeSpectrumFrames(audioBuffer, fps, totalFrames) : undefined;
    try {
      const blob = await exportWebCodecsMp4(
        { ...studio.project, meta: { ...studio.project.meta, durationSec, fps, resolution: res as Project["meta"]["resolution"] } },
        canvas, { albumArt: img, backgroundImage: img }, audioBuffer,
        { width: w, height: h, fps, quality, spectrumFrames, signal: abort.current.signal, onProgress: (p) => {
          const elapsedSec = p.elapsedMs / 1000;
          const etaSec = p.pct > 0.02 ? Math.round(((1 - p.pct) / p.pct) * elapsedSec) : 0;
          const etaStr = etaSec > 0 ? ` · ETA: ${etaSec}s` : "";
          setExportPct(p.pct);
          setExportMsg(`Frame ${p.frame}/${p.total} (${Math.round(p.pct * 100)}%)${etaStr}`);
        }},
      );
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${res}_${fps}fps.mp4`);
      studio.notify("Export complete.");
      setExportOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      studio.notify(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Export failed.");
    } finally { setExporting(false); }
  }

  async function sideExport(format: "srt" | "vtt" | "ass" | "json") {
    const res = await fetch("/api/export", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format }) });
    const blob = await res.blob();
    downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.${format}`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen min-w-[1280px] flex-col bg-[var(--bg)] text-[var(--ink)] select-none">
      {/* ===== HEADER ===== */}
      <header className="flex h-14 items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#090d16] px-4 shadow-md backdrop-blur-xl z-40">
        {/* Logo */}
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0 mr-1 group">
          <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-400 p-0.5 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.35)] group-hover:shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,193,90,0.6)] transition-all">
            <img src="/images/mark.png" alt="" className="h-full w-full rounded-[10px] object-cover" />
          </div>
          <span className="text-sm font-bold tracking-tight bg-gradient-to-r from-white to-neutral-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">LyricForge</span>
        </Link>

        <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

        {/* Title + Save Indicator */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
          <input
            value={studio.project.meta.title}
            onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.title = e.target.value; })}
            className="h-8 max-w-[220px] rounded-lg border border-transparent bg-white/[0.04] px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-white/[0.08] focus:bg-[#07090e] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[var(--accent)] transition-all truncate"
            title="Project Title"
          />
          <span className={`lf-badge text-[10px] ${studio.dirty ? "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30" : "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30"}`}>
            {studio.dirty ? "Unsaved" : "Saved"}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

        {/* Undo / Redo */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Tooltip label="Undo" shortcut="⌘Z">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[30px] !min-h-[30px]" disabled={!studio.canUndo} onClick={studio.undo}><Undo2 size={15} /></button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Redo" shortcut="⇧⌘Z">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[30px] !min-h-[30px]" disabled={!studio.canRedo} onClick={studio.redo}><Redo2 size={15} /></button>
          </Tooltip>
        </div>

        <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

        {/* Tools Dropdown */}
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setHeaderMenuOpen(!headerMenuOpen)}
            className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5 px-3 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:border-[var(--accent)]"
          >
            <span>Tools</span>
            <ChevronDown size={13} className={`text-[var(--accent)] transition-transform ${headerMenuOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
          </button>
          <HeaderMenu open={headerMenuOpen} onClose={() => setHeaderMenuOpen(false)} />
        </div>

        {/* Aspect Ratio */}
        <select
          value={studio.project.meta.aspectRatio}
          className="lf-select text-xs h-8 px-2.5 py-0 font-semibold"
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.aspectRatio = e.target.value as Project["meta"]["aspectRatio"]; })}
        >
          {["16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "21:9"].map((a) => <option key={a}>{a}</option>)}
        </select>

        {/* Spacer */}
        <div className="flex-1" />

        {/* Panel Toggles */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Captions Drawer">
            <button type="button" className={`lf-btn-icon !min-w-[32px] !min-h-[32px] ${studio.leftOpen ? "active" : ""}`} onClick={() => studio.setPanel("left", !studio.leftOpen)}>
              <PanelLeft size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Timeline">
            <button type="button" className={`lf-btn-icon !min-w-[32px] !min-h-[32px] ${studio.bottomOpen ? "active" : ""}`} onClick={() => studio.setPanel("bottom", !studio.bottomOpen)}>
              <PanelBottom size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Style Inspector">
            <button type="button" className={`lf-btn-icon !min-w-[32px] !min-h-[32px] ${studio.rightOpen ? "active" : ""}`} onClick={() => studio.setPanel("right", !studio.rightOpen)}>
              <PanelRight size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>

          <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

          <Tooltip label="Shortcuts" shortcut="?">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[32px] !min-h-[32px]" onClick={() => setHelp(true)}>
              <HelpCircle size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
        </div>

        <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

        {/* Export Button */}
        <button type="button" className="lf-btn-accent text-xs font-semibold py-2 px-4 shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,158,11,0.35)]" onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}>
          <Download size={14} /> Export Video
        </button>
      </header>

      {/* ===== MAIN LAYOUT ===== */}
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
        {/* Left Panel — Captions Drawer */}
        {studio.leftOpen && (
          <aside className="flex flex-col border-r border-[var(--line)] bg-[#090d16] shrink-0 z-10" style={{ width: studio.leftWidth }}>
            {/* Header & Quick Action */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d121e] px-4 py-2.5">
              <span className="lf-label flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
                Captions <span className="bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)] font-mono text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-[var(--accent)]/30">{studio.project.captions.length}</span>
              </span>
              <Tooltip label="Add new caption at playhead">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => studio.addCaption("New lyric line")}
                  className="lf-btn-accent !min-h-[28px] !py-1 !px-2.5 text-xs"
                >
                  <Plus size={13} /> Add Line
                </button>
              </Tooltip>
            </div>

            {/* Search & Filter Bar */}
            <div className="border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0a0e18] p-2 space-y-2">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search size={13} className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--faint)]" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Filter lyrics..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  className="lf-input !min-h-[30px] pl-8 text-xs bg-[#05070a]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px]">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCaptionFilter("all")}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-semibold transition-colors ${captionFilter === "all" ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-black" : "text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-white"}`}
                >
                  All ({studio.project.captions.length})
                </button>
                {flagged.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setCaptionFilter("flagged")}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-semibold transition-colors ${captionFilter === "flagged" ? "bg-amber-400 text-black" : "text-amber-300 hover:text-amber-200"}`}
                  >
                    Flagged ({flagged.length})
                  </button>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCaptionFilter("music")}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-semibold transition-colors ${captionFilter === "music" ? "bg-purple-500 text-white" : "text-purple-300 hover:text-purple-200"}`}
                >
                  Music Breaks
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Scrollable Captions List */}
            <ul className="lf-scroll flex-1 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto p-3">
              {filteredCaptions.map((c) => {
                const isSelected = studio.selectedIds.includes(c.id);
                const isMusic = Boolean(c.instrumental || !c.text || c.text.trim() === "♪" || c.text.toLowerCase().includes("instrumental") || c.text.toLowerCase().includes("music"));

                return (
                  <li
                    key={c.id}
                    className={`rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10 shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,158,11,0.15)] scale-[1.01]"
                        : isMusic
                        ? "border-purple-500/30 bg-purple-950/20 hover:border-purple-500/50"
                        : "border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d121e] hover:border-white/20"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="p-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">#{c.index + 1}</span>
                          {isMusic && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-purple-300 bg-purple-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-purple-500/30">
                              <Music2 size={10} /> MUSIC
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                          {formatTimecode(c.startSec)} → {formatTimecode(c.endSec)}
                        </span>
                        <Tooltip label={`Confidence: ${(c.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}>
                          <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full shrink-0 ${
                            c.confidence < 0.35 ? "bg-red-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(244,63,94,0.6)]" : c.confidence < 0.6 ? "bg-amber-300 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(251,191,36,0.6)]" : "bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(52,211,153,0.6)]"
                          }`} />
                        </Tooltip>
                      </div>

                      {isSelected ? (
                        <div className="mt-2 space-y-2.5">
                          <textarea
                            value={c.text}
                            rows={2}
                            onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionText(c.id, e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Type lyric line text..."
                            className="lf-input resize-none text-xs font-medium leading-relaxed"
                          />
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
                              <span className="text-[var(--faint)] font-mono">In</span>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="h-6 w-5 rounded bg-white/5 text-[10px] hover:bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)]"
                                  onClick={() => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, Math.max(0, c.startSec - 0.1), c.endSec)}
                                >-</button>
                                <input
                                  type="number" step="0.1" min="0"
                                  value={Number(c.startSec.toFixed(2))}
                                  onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, Number(e.target.value), c.endSec)}
                                  className="w-14 h-6 rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#05070a] px-1 text-center font-mono text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                                />
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="h-6 w-5 rounded bg-white/5 text-[10px] hover:bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)]"
                                  onClick={() => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, c.startSec + 0.1, c.endSec)}
                                >+</button>
                              </div>

                              <span className="text-[var(--faint)] font-mono ml-1">Out</span>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="h-6 w-5 rounded bg-white/5 text-[10px] hover:bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)]"
                                  onClick={() => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, c.startSec, Math.max(c.startSec + 0.1, c.endSec - 0.1))}
                                >-</button>
                                <input
                                  type="number" step="0.1" min="0"
                                  value={Number(c.endSec.toFixed(2))}
                                  onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, c.startSec, Number(e.target.value))}
                                  className="w-14 h-6 rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#05070a] px-1 text-center font-mono text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                                />
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="h-6 w-5 rounded bg-white/5 text-[10px] hover:bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)]"
                                  onClick={() => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, c.startSec, c.endSec + 0.1)}
                                >+</button>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Tooltip label="Audition line audio">
                                <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[26px] !min-h-[26px] !p-1 bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/30" onClick={() => { studio.setPlayhead(c.startSec); studio.setPlaying(true); }}>
                                  <Play size={12} fill="currentColor" />
                                </button>
                              </Tooltip>
                              <Tooltip label="Split at playhead (S)">
                                <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[26px] !min-h-[26px] !p-1" onClick={() => studio.splitAtPlayhead()}>
                                  <Scissors size={12} />
                                </button>
                              </Tooltip>
                              <Tooltip label="Duplicate line">
                                <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[26px] !min-h-[26px] !p-1" onClick={() => studio.duplicateSelected()}>
                                  <Copy size={12} />
                                </button>
                              </Tooltip>
                              <Tooltip label="Delete line">
                                <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[26px] !min-h-[26px] !p-1 hover:!text-red-400 hover:!bg-red-500/15" onClick={() => studio.deleteSelected()}>
                                  <Trash2 size={12} />
                                </button>
                              </Tooltip>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => { studio.select([c.id]); studio.setPlayhead(c.startSec); }}
                            className="mt-1 block flex-1 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:text-[var(--accent)] transition-colors line-clamp-2"
                          >
                            {c.text || <span className="italic text-purple-300 flex items-center gap-1"><Music2 size={11} /> Instrumental Break</span>}
                          </button>
                          <Tooltip label="Audition line">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[24px] !min-h-[24px] !p-0.5 text-[var(--faint)] hover:text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/10"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                studio.setPlayhead(c.startSec);
                                studio.setPlaying(true);
                              }}
                            >
                              <Play size={11} />
                            </button>
                          </Tooltip>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}

              {/* Polished Bottom Track Card (Prevents awkward empty void) */}
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0b0f19] to-[#07090e] p-4 text-center space-y-2 mt-4 shadow-inner">
                <div className="flex justify-center">
                  <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)]/10 flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--accent)]">
                    <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white">All {studio.project.captions.length} Lines Loaded</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                  Track length: {formatTimecode(studio.project.meta.durationSec)} · Click any block to edit.
                </div>
              </div>
            </ul>

            {/* Sticky Bottom Footer */}

              <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                {studio.project.captions.length} lines total
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  const first = studio.project.captions[0];
                  if (first) { studio.select([first.id]); studio.setPlayhead(first.startSec); }

        )}

        {/* Center — Preview Canvas + Timeline */}
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <PreviewCanvas audioUrl={audioUrl} albumUrl={album} />
          {studio.bottomOpen && (
            <div className="border-t border-[var(--line)] shrink-0" style={{ height: studio.bottomHeight }}>
              <Timeline peaks={peaks} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Right Panel — Inspector */}
        {studio.rightOpen && (
          <aside className="border-l border-[var(--line)] bg-[#090d16] shrink-0 z-10" style={{ width: studio.rightWidth }}>
            <Inspector />

        )}
      </div>

      <Toast text={studio.toast?.text ?? null} />
      <Shortcuts open={help} onClose={() => setHelp(false)} />

      </Modal>

        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Export Video Modal */}
      <Modal open={exportOpen} title="Export Studio Master Video" onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)} onConfirm={() => void runExport()} confirmLabel={exporting ? "Exporting…" : "Render MP4 1080p60"}>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--accent)]/20 bg-[var(--accent)]/5 p-3 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 border border-[var(--accent)]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--accent)] shrink-0">
              <Sparkles size={18} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs">
              <div className="font-semibold text-white">Production WebCodecs GPU Exporter</div>
              <div className="text-[var(--muted)]">Hardware accelerated MP4 video rendering with synced karaoke typography and audio reactive spectrum.</div>
            </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">

              <select value={fps} onChange={(e) => setFps(Number(e.target.value))} className="lf-select w-full">
                {[24, 25, 30, 50, 60].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} fps</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="lf-label">Quality</label>
              <select value={quality} onChange={(e) => setQuality(e.target.value as typeof quality)} className="lf-select w-full">
                <option value="high">High Bitrate</option>
                <option value="balanced">Balanced</option>
                <option value="small">Compact</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="lf-label">Export Subtitles & Sidecars</label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5" onClick={() => void sideExport("srt")}>SRT Subtitles</button>
              <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5" onClick={() => void sideExport("vtt")}>WebVTT</button>
              <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5" onClick={() => void sideExport("ass")}>ASS Karaoke</button>
              <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5" onClick={() => void sideExport("json")}>Project JSON</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          {exporting && (
            <div className="space-y-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#06080e] p-3.5">
              <div className="h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--line)]">

              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <p className="font-mono text-[var(--muted)]">{exportMsg}</p>
                <button type="button" className="text-xs text-rose-400 hover:underline font-semibold" onClick={() => abort.current?.abort()}>Cancel Export</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function StudioApp({ initial }: { initial: Project }) {
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>(() =>
    Array.from({ length: 180 }, (_, i) => Math.round((0.2 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 6))) * 100) / 100),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void (async () => {
      const blob = (await getBlob(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getBlob("draft-master"));
      if (blob) setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      const stored = (await getPeaks(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getPeaks("draft-master"));
      if (stored) setPeaks(Array.from(stored));
    })();
  }, [initial.id]);

  const project = useMemo(() => initial, [initial]);
  return (
    <StudioProvider initial={project}>
      <StudioInner audioUrl={audioUrl} peaks={peaks} />
    </StudioProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useMemo, useRef, useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { formatTimecode } from "@/lib/time";
import { useStudio } from "@/store/studio-store";
import {
  Maximize2,
  Minus,
  Music2,
  Plus,
  Scissors,
  Unlink,
  Volume2,
  Move,
  Layers,
  Sparkles,
  Lock,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Tooltip } from "../ui-kit";
import type { Caption } from "@/schema";

const CaptionBlock = React.memo(function CaptionBlock({
  cap,
  pxPerSec,
  selected,
  rippleMode,
  onSelect,
  onMove,
  onRoll,
  onResize,
  onTextPrompt,
}: {
  cap: Caption;
  pxPerSec: number;
  selected: boolean;
  rippleMode: string;
  onSelect: (ids: string[], shift?: boolean) => void;
  onMove: (id: string, nextStart: number) => void;
  onRoll: (id: string, nextBoundary: number) => void;
  onResize: (id: string, edge: "in" | "out", nextSec: number) => void;
  onTextPrompt: (id: string, current: string) => void;
}) {
  const left = Math.round(cap.startSec * pxPerSec);
  const dur = Math.max(0.05, cap.endSec - cap.startSec);
  const w = Math.round(Math.max(28, dur * pxPerSec));
  const isMusic = Boolean(
    cap.instrumental ||
      !cap.text ||
      cap.text.trim() === "♪" ||
      cap.text.toLowerCase().includes("instrumental") ||
      cap.text.toLowerCase().includes("music"),
  );

  let bgColor: string;
  let borderColor: string;
  let tagColor: string;

  if (isMusic) {
    bgColor = "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 100%)";
    borderColor = "rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.6)";
    tagColor = "bg-purple-500/30 text-purple-200";
  } else if (cap.confidence < 0.35) {
    bgColor = "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25) 0%, rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.15) 100%)";
    borderColor = "rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.7)";
    tagColor = "bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-200";
  } else if (cap.confidence < 0.6) {
    bgColor = "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25) 0%, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.15) 100%)";
    borderColor = "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.65)";
    tagColor = "bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-200";
  } else {
    bgColor = "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 193, 90, 0.2) 0%, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.12) 100%)";
    borderColor = "rgba(245, 193, 90, 0.5)";
    tagColor = "bg-amber-400/25 text-amber-100";
  }

  return (
    <div
      data-block="1"
      className={`group absolute cursor-grab overflow-hidden rounded-xl border text-[11px] transition-all shadow-md select-none ${
        selected
          ? "ring-2 ring-[var(--accent)] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#07090e] z-20 scale-[1.01] shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,193,90,0.35)]"
          : "hover:border-white/40 hover:brightness-110"
      }`}
      style={{
        left,
        width: w,
        top: 86,
        height: 56,
        background: bgColor,
        borderColor: selected ? "var(--accent)" : borderColor,
      }}
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onSelect([cap.id], e.shiftKey);
        const startX = e.clientX;
        const orig = cap.startSec;
        const move = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
          const dt = (ev.clientX - startX) / pxPerSec;
          if (rippleMode === "roll") {
            onRoll(cap.id, cap.endSec + dt);
          } else {
            onMove(cap.id, orig + dt);
          }
        };
        const up = () => {
          window.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
          window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
        };
        window.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
        window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
      }}
      onDoubleClick={() => onTextPrompt(cap.id, cap.text)}
    >
      {/* Left resize handle */}
      <span
        data-block="1"
        className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-3 cursor-ew-resize rounded-l-xl bg-white/0 hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center z-10"
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          const startX = e.clientX;
          const orig = cap.startSec;
          const move = (ev: MouseEvent) => onResize(cap.id, "in", orig + (ev.clientX - startX) / pxPerSec);
          const up = () => { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", move); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up); };
          window.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
          window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
        }}
      >
        <span className="h-4 w-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
      </span>

      {/* Content */}
      <div className="flex h-full flex-col justify-between p-2 pl-3 pr-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ${tagColor}`}>
              #{cap.index + 1}
            </span>
            {isMusic && <Music2 size={11} className="text-purple-300 shrink-0" />}
            <span className="truncate font-semibold text-white text-[11px]">
              {cap.text || "♪ Instrumental Gap ♪"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <span
            className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full shrink-0 ${
              cap.confidence >= 0.6
                ? "bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(52,211,153,0.8)]"
                : cap.confidence >= 0.35
                ? "bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(251,191,36,0.8)]"
                : "bg-rose-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(244,63,94,0.8)]"
            }`}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)] font-mono">
          <span>{formatTimecode(cap.startSec, 30, false)}</span>
          <span className="rounded bg-black/40 px-1 py-0.2 text-[9px] text-[var(--muted)]">
            {dur.toFixed(2)}s
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Right resize handle */}
      <span
        data-block="1"
        className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-3 cursor-ew-resize rounded-r-xl bg-white/0 hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center z-10"
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          const startX = e.clientX;
          const orig = cap.endSec;
          const move = (ev: MouseEvent) => onResize(cap.id, "out", orig + (ev.clientX - startX) / pxPerSec);
          const up = () => { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", move); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up); };
          window.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
          window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
        }}
      >
        <span className="h-4 w-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});

export function Timeline({ peaks }: { peaks: number[] }) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const duration = Math.max(0.1, studio.project.meta.durationSec);
  const pxPerSec = 90 * studio.zoom;
  const width = Math.max(900, duration * pxPerSec);

  const ticks = useMemo(() => {
    const step = studio.zoom > 5 ? 0.5 : studio.zoom > 2 ? 1 : studio.zoom > 0.8 ? 2 : 5;
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (let t = 0; t <= duration + step; t += step) out.push(t);
    return out;
  }, [duration, studio.zoom]);

  const waveformElements = useMemo(() => {
    if (!peaks || peaks.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center text-xs text-[var(--faint)] italic font-mono">
          <Volume2 size={13} className="mr-1.5 opacity-50" /> Master Audio Track Envelope
        </div>
      );
    }
    return (
      <div className="flex h-full w-full items-end gap-px px-0.5">
        {peaks.map((p, i) => (
          <span
            key={i}
            className="flex-1 rounded-t-sm transition-colors"
            style={{
              height: `${Math.round(Math.max(8, p * 100))}%`,
              background: `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35), rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.85))`,
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }, [peaks]);

  function timeFromEvent(e: React.MouseEvent) {
    const box = ref.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!box) return 0;
    const x = e.clientX - box.left + (ref.current?.scrollLeft ?? 0);
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(duration, x / pxPerSec));
  }

  const modeButtons = [
    { mode: "independent" as const, label: "Free Move" },
    { mode: "ripple" as const, label: "Ripple" },
    { mode: "roll" as const, label: "Roll Boundary" },
    { mode: "relink" as const, label: "Relink" },
  ];

  const handleFitZoom = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const containerWidth = ref.current.clientWidth - 80;
    if (containerWidth > 0 && duration > 0) {
      const calculated = containerWidth / (duration * 90);
      studio.setZoom(Math.max(0.2, Math.min(10, calculated)));
    }
  };

  const handleTextPrompt = (id: string, current: string) => {
    const next = window.prompt("Edit line lyric text", current);
    if (next !== null) studio.updateCaptionText(id, next);
  };

  // Selected line for micro word timing view
  const selectedCaption = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.id === studio.selectedIds[0]);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[#07090e] select-none">
      {/* ===== TIMELINE TOOLBAR ===== */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0c101a] px-4 py-2 flex-wrap shadow-md">
        {/* Left: Mode Buttons & Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {/* Edit modes */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 bg-[#05070a] border border-[var(--line)] rounded-lg p-0.5">
            {modeButtons.map((item) => (
              <button
                key={item.mode}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => studio.setRippleMode(item.mode)}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md transition-all ${
                  studio.project.settings.rippleMode === item.mode
                    ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-500 text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md font-bold"
                    : "text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5"
                }`}
              >
                {item.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="h-5 w-px bg-[var(--line)]" />

          {/* Quick Operations */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Tooltip label="Split line at playhead (S)" shortcut="S">
              <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1 px-2.5" onClick={() => studio.splitAtPlayhead()}>
                <Scissors size={13} className="text-amber-400" /> Split Line
              </button>
            </Tooltip>
            <Tooltip label="Merge selected lines (M)" shortcut="M">
              <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1 px-2.5" onClick={() => studio.mergeSelected()}>
                <Unlink size={13} className="text-cyan-400" /> Merge
              </button>
            </Tooltip>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center: Active Playhead Info */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
          <span className="text-[var(--accent)] font-bold">{formatTimecode(studio.playhead)}</span>
          <span>/</span>
          <span>{formatTimecode(duration)}</span>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Zoom & Track Fit Controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Tooltip label="Zoom Out (-)">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[28px] !min-h-[28px] !p-1"
                onClick={() => studio.setZoom(Math.max(0.25, studio.zoom * 0.8))}
              >
                <Minus size={13} />
              </button>
            </Tooltip>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white min-w-[3.2rem] text-center">
              {studio.zoom.toFixed(1)}×
            </span>
            <Tooltip label="Zoom In (+)">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[28px] !min-h-[28px] !p-1"
                onClick={() => studio.setZoom(Math.min(50, studio.zoom * 1.25))}
              >
                <Plus size={13} />
              </button>
            </Tooltip>
          </div>

          <Tooltip label="Fit entire track to timeline width">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1 px-2.5"
              onClick={handleFitZoom}
            >
              <Maximize2 size={12} /> Fit Track
            </button>
          </Tooltip>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 bg-[#05070a] border border-[var(--line)] rounded-lg p-0.5">
            {[1, 2, 5].map((z) => (
              <button
                key={z}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => studio.setZoom(z)}
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold rounded ${
                  Math.abs(studio.zoom - z) < 0.2 ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-black" : "text-[var(--faint)] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                {z}x
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ===== TRACKS CONTAINER ===== */}
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className="lf-scroll flex-1 overflow-auto bg-[#07090e] relative"
        onWheel={(e) => {
          if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const next = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(200, studio.zoom * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.88)));
            studio.setZoom(next);
          }
        }}
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          if ((e.target as HTMLElement).dataset.block) return;
          studio.setPlayhead(timeFromEvent(e));
        }}
      >
        <div className="relative min-h-[190px]" style={{ width, height: 190 }}>
          {/* Track 1: Time Ruler */}
          <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex h-7 border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#090d16]/95 backdrop-blur-md">
            {ticks.map((t) => (
              <span
                key={t}
                className="absolute top-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)] select-none pl-1.5 border-l border-white/10"
                style={{ left: t * pxPerSec }}
              >
                {formatTimecode(t, 30, false)}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Track 2: Audio Waveform */}
          <div className="relative mx-0 mt-1.5 flex h-11 items-end rounded-lg bg-[#05070a]/80 border border-white/5 mx-2 overflow-hidden">
            {waveformElements}
          </div>

          {/* Track 3: Caption Blocks */}
          {studio.project.captions.map((cap) => (
            <CaptionBlock
              key={cap.id}
              cap={cap}
              pxPerSec={pxPerSec}
              selected={studio.selectedIds.includes(cap.id)}
              rippleMode={studio.project.settings.rippleMode}
              onSelect={studio.select}
              onMove={studio.moveCaption}
              onRoll={studio.rollCaption}
              onResize={studio.resizeCaption}
              onTextPrompt={handleTextPrompt}
            />
          ))}

          {/* Word-level timing preview for selected caption */}
          {selectedCaption && selectedCaption.words && selectedCaption.words.length > 0 && (
            <div
              className="absolute pointer-events-none z-10 flex gap-0.5 rounded border border-[var(--accent)]/40 bg-[#05070a]/90 p-0.5 text-[9px] font-mono text-[var(--accent)] shadow-lg"
              style={{
                left: Math.round(selectedCaption.startSec * pxPerSec),
                top: 152,
                height: 24,
                width: Math.max(40, (selectedCaption.endSec - selectedCaption.startSec) * pxPerSec),
              }}
            >
              {selectedCaption.words.map((w, idx) => {
                const wLen = Math.max(12, (w.endSec - w.startSec) * pxPerSec);
                return (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className="h-full rounded bg-[var(--accent)]/15 border border-[var(--accent)]/30 px-1 flex items-center justify-center truncate"
                    style={{ width: wLen }}
                  >
                    <span className="truncate">{w.text}</span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Vertical Playhead Cursor */}
          <div
            className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 z-30 h-full w-px"
            style={{
              left: studio.playhead * pxPerSec,
              background: "linear-gradient(to bottom, #f5c15a, #fbbf24)",
              boxShadow: "0 0 12px rgba(245, 193, 90, 0.9)",
            }}
          >
            <div className="absolute -top-1 -left-[6px] w-[13px] h-[13px] rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)] border-2 border-black shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(245,158,11,1)]" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState, useRef } from "react";

  Sun,
  Eye,

  Compass,
} from "lucide-react";
import { STYLE_PRESETS } from "@/render-engine";

import type { OverlayType, OverlaySpec, VisualizerType, HighlightStyleSchema } from "@/schema";

import type { z } from "zod";

const TABS = [
  { id: "all", label: "All Settings", icon: LayoutGrid },
  { id: "text", label: "Typography", icon: Type },
  { id: "color", label: "Colors & FX", icon: Palette },
  { id: "motion", label: "Karaoke", icon: Play },

  { id: "overlays", label: "Atmosphere", icon: Layers },
] as const;

const OVERLAY_OPTIONS: { type: OverlayType; label: string; desc: string }[] = [
  { type: "none", label: "None", desc: "Clean background" },
  { type: "bokeh", label: "Bokeh Orbs", desc: "Warm ambient orbs" },
  { type: "starfield", label: "Starfield", desc: "Deep space warp" },
  { type: "soundwave", label: "Soundwave", desc: "Audio frequency ripples" },
  { type: "embers", label: "Audio Embers", desc: "Beat-reactive sparks" },
  { type: "light-leak", label: "Light Leak", desc: "Vintage color flares" },
  { type: "scanlines", label: "CRT Grain", desc: "Retro scanlines" },
  { type: "lottie", label: "Custom Lottie", desc: "Import JSON animation" },
];

const GOOGLE_FONTS = [
  "Fraunces", "Outfit", "Inter", "Cinzel", "Montserrat", "Bebas Neue",
  "Playfair Display", "Space Grotesk", "Permanent Marker", "Rubik",
  "Pacifico", "Righteous", "Poppins", "Syne",
