function Section({
  title,
  icon: Icon,
  badge,
  defaultOpen = true,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  icon?: React.ComponentType<{ size: number; className?: string }>;
  badge?: string;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0d121c] overflow-hidden shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-white/15">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-3 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--ink)] hover:bg-white/[0.03] transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {Icon && <Icon size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />}
          <span>{title}</span>
          {badge && (
            <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-[var(--accent)]/30">
              {badge}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {open ? <ChevronDown size={14} className="text-[var(--faint)]" /> : <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-[var(--faint)]" />}
      </button>
      {open && <div className="px-3.5 pb-4 pt-1 space-y-3.5 border-t border-white/5">{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Inspector() {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<(typeof TABS)[number]["id"]>("all");
  const [presetOpen, setPresetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [trackInfoOpen, setTrackInfoOpen] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fontInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const lottieInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const animFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const bgImageInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const selected = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.id === studio.selectedIds[0]);
  const style = selected?.styleOverride
    ? { ...studio.project.defaultStyle, ...selected.styleOverride }
    : studio.project.defaultStyle;
  const overridden = Boolean(selected?.styleOverride);

  const recentColors = useMemo(
    () => [
      style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA", style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A",
      style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4", style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA",
      "#F5C15A", "#67F0FF", "#FF5A92", "#FFFFFF", "#000000", "#10B981",
    ],
    [style.fill, style.highlightFill, style.pastFill, style.futureFill],
  );

  const patch = (p: Partial<typeof style>) => studio.updateStyle(p, selected ? "selected" : "default");

  const overlay: OverlaySpec = studio.project.media?.background?.overlay ?? {
    type: "none", opacity: 0.85, speed: 1, scale: 1, blendMode: "screen",
  };

  const patchOverlay = (p: Partial<OverlaySpec>) => {
    studio.commit((d) => {
      if (!d.media.background.overlay) {
        d.media.background.overlay = { type: "none", opacity: 0.85, speed: 1, scale: 1, blendMode: "screen" };
      }
      d.media.background.overlay = { ...d.media.background.overlay, ...p };
    });
  };

  const handleFontUpload = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      setUploadError(null);
      const fontName = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_");
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const fontFace = new FontFace(fontName, buffer);
      await fontFace.load();
      document.fonts.add(fontFace);
      patch({ fontFamily: fontName });
      studio.notify(`Custom font "${fontName}" loaded!`);
    } catch { setUploadError("Could not load font file. Use .ttf, .otf, or .woff2."); }
  };

  const handleAnimFileUpload = (file: File) => {
    setUploadError(null);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const text = e.target?.result as string;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
        if (parsed.inPreset || parsed.outPreset) {
          if (selected) {
            studio.commit((d) => { const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id); if (c) { if (parsed.inPreset) c.animation.in.preset = parsed.inPreset; if (parsed.outPreset) c.animation.out.preset = parsed.outPreset; } });
          } else {
            studio.commit((d) => { for (const c of d.captions) { if (parsed.inPreset) c.animation.in.preset = parsed.inPreset; if (parsed.outPreset) c.animation.out.preset = parsed.outPreset; } });
          }
        } else {
          patchOverlay({ type: "lottie", lottieJson: text, lottieName: file.name });
        }
      } catch { setUploadError("Invalid JSON animation file."); }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  const handleBgImageUpload = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      const assetId = `bg-${studio.project.id}-${Date.now()}`;
      await putBlob(assetId, file);
      studio.commit((d) => { d.media.background.type = "image"; d.media.background.imageAssetId = assetId; });
      studio.notify("Custom background backdrop applied!");
    } catch { setUploadError("Failed to store background image."); }
  };

  const applyAnimationToAll = (inPreset: string, highlightStyle: string) => {
    studio.commit((d) => { for (const c of d.captions) { c.animation.in.preset = inPreset as typeof c.animation.in.preset; c.animation.highlight.style = highlightStyle as typeof c.animation.highlight.style; } });
    studio.notify("Applied motion settings across all captions!");
  };

  const activePreset = STYLE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === studio.project.presetId) ?? STYLE_PRESETS[0];
  const highlightStyle = selected?.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";

  const showSection = (name: string) => activeTab === "all" || activeTab === name;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[#090d16] text-[var(--ink)] select-none">
      {/* ===== STICKY TOP HEADER ===== */}
      <div className="shrink-0 border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0c101a] p-3 space-y-2.5">
        {/* Preset Selector Banner */}
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setPresetOpen(!presetOpen)}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#171d2b] to-[#121622] p-2.5 text-left transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/60 hover:shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,193,90,0.15)] group"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
              <span className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-500 text-black shadow-md">
                <Sparkles size={16} />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <span className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] font-mono">Visual Style Preset</span>
                <span className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)] truncate">{activePreset.name}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown size={14} className={`text-[var(--accent)] transition-transform duration-200 ${presetOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
          </button>

          {presetOpen && (
            <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-2 z-50 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0d121c] p-2 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl lf-enter">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto lf-scroll p-1">
                {STYLE_PRESETS.map((p) => {
                  const isSelected = studio.project.presetId === p.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={p.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => { studio.applyStylePreset(p.id); setPresetOpen(false); }}
                      className={`flex flex-col text-left rounded-xl p-2.5 transition-all text-xs ${
                        isSelected
                          ? "border border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/15 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.2)]"
                          : "border border-transparent hover:border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className={`font-bold ${isSelected ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-white"}`}>{p.name}</span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-[var(--faint)] line-clamp-1 leading-snug">{p.blurb}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Scope Indicator Pill */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-[#06080e] px-3 py-1.5 border border-white/5 text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-[var(--muted)] flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${selected ? "bg-[var(--accent)] animate-pulse" : "bg-emerald-400"}`} />
            {selected ? <strong className="text-[var(--accent)]">Editing Line #{selected.index + 1}</strong> : <span>Default Style (All Lines)</span>}
          </span>
          {overridden && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { if (selected) studio.commit((d) => { const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id); if (c) delete c.styleOverride; }); }}
              className="text-[10px] text-[var(--accent)] hover:underline font-bold"
            >
              Reset to Default
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Category Navigation Tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto lf-scroll pb-1">
          {TABS.map((t) => {
            const Icon = t.icon;
            const isActive = activeTab === t.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={t.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(t.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-all shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md scale-[1.02]"
                    : "text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 border border-transparent"
                }`}
              >
                <Icon size={12} />
                <span>{t.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {uploadError && (
        <div className="m-3 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-red-950/40 p-2.5 text-xs text-red-200">{uploadError}</div>
      )}

      {/* ===== SCROLLABLE CONTROLS BODY ===== */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto lf-scroll p-3 space-y-3.5">
        {/* 1. TYPOGRAPHY & SIZING */}
        {showSection("text") && (
          <>
            <Section title="Typography & Font" icon={Type} defaultOpen={true}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="lf-label">Font Family</label>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => fontInputRef.current?.click()} className="lf-btn-ghost text-[10px] py-1 px-2.5">
                  <Upload size={11} /> Upload .TTF / .WOFF
                </button>
              </div>
              <input ref={fontInputRef} type="file" accept=".ttf,.otf,.woff,.woff2" hidden onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void handleFontUpload(e.target.files[0])} />
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <select
                  value={GOOGLE_FONTS.includes(style.fontFamily) ? style.fontFamily : "custom"}
                  onChange={(e) => { if (e.target.value !== "custom") patch({ fontFamily: e.target.value }); }}
                  className="lf-select text-xs"
                >
                  {GOOGLE_FONTS.map((f) => <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
                  <option value="custom">Custom font...</option>
                </select>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Font name..."
                  value={style.fontFamily}
                  onChange={(e) => patch({ fontFamily: e.target.value })}
                  className="lf-input text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-1.5 pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => patch({ italic: !style.italic })}
                  className={`lf-btn text-xs flex-1 !py-1.5 ${style.italic ? "!border-[var(--accent)] !text-[var(--accent)] !bg-[var(--accent)]/10 font-bold" : "!border-[var(--line)] !text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
                >
                  <em>Italic</em>
                </button>
                {(["left", "center", "right"] as const).map((a) => (
                  <button
                    key={a}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => patch({ align: a })}
                    className={`lf-btn text-xs flex-1 !py-1.5 capitalize ${style.align === a ? "!border-[var(--accent)] !text-[var(--accent)] !bg-[var(--accent)]/10 font-bold" : "!border-[var(--line)] !text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
                  >
                    {a}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="lf-label">Text Transformation</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1">
                  {(["none", "uppercase", "lowercase", "capitalize"] as const).map((tr) => (
                    <button
                      key={tr}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => patch({ transform: tr })}
                      className={`lf-btn text-[10px] capitalize !py-1 ${style.transform === tr ? "!border-[var(--accent)] !text-[var(--accent)] !bg-[var(--accent)]/10 font-bold" : "!border-white/5 !text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
                    >
                      {tr}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </Section>

            <Section title="Text Scale & Spacing" icon={SlidersHorizontal} defaultOpen={true}>
              <Slider label="Font Size (% of video height)" min={2.5} max={12} step={0.2} value={style.fontSizePct} onChange={(v) => patch({ fontSizePct: v })} />

                  <ColorField label="Treble Color B" value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.colorB ?? "#67F0FF"} onChange={(c) => studio.commit((d) => { if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.colorB = c; })} recent={recentColors} />
                </div>

                <Slider label="Audio Sensitivity" min={0.2} max={3} step={0.1} value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.sensitivity ?? 1} onChange={(v) => studio.commit((d) => { if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.sensitivity = v; })} />
                <Slider label="Spectrum Bars Count" min={16} max={96} step={4} value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.barCount ?? 48} onChange={(v) => studio.commit((d) => { if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.barCount = v; })} />

        )}

        {/* 6. ATMOSPHERIC OVERLAYS */}
        {showSection("overlays") && (

              <Flame size={14} className="shrink-0" />
              <span>Overlays react dynamically with live audio beats.</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
              {OVERLAY_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                const active = overlay.type === opt.type;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={opt.type}

                    onClick={() => { if (opt.type === "lottie") lottieInputRef.current?.click(); else patchOverlay({ type: opt.type }); }}

                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={`font-bold ${active ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-white"}`}>{opt.label}</span>
                    <span className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-[var(--faint)]">{opt.desc}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <input ref={lottieInputRef} type="file" accept=".json" hidden onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && handleAnimFileUpload(e.target.files[0])} />

            {overlay.type !== "none" && (
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                <Slider label="Overlay Opacity" min={0.1} max={1} step={0.05} value={overlay.opacity} onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ opacity: v })} />
                <Slider label="Animation Speed" min={0.2} max={3} step={0.1} value={overlay.speed} onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ speed: v })} />
                <Slider label="Particle Density" min={0.5} max={2.5} step={0.1} value={overlay.scale} onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ scale: v })} />
              </div>
            )}
          </Section>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Caption, CaptionStyle, Project, Word } from "@/schema";
import { mixHex, toRgba } from "@/lib/color";
import { applyEasing, hashString, mulberry32 } from "./easing";
import { fontString, type FrameContext, type FrameGradient, type ResolvedAssets } from "./context";
import { renderProceduralOverlay } from "./overlays";

function lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number {
  return a + (b - a) * t;
}

function resolveStyle(project: Project, caption?: Caption): CaptionStyle {
  if (!caption?.styleOverride) return project.defaultStyle;
  return { ...project.defaultStyle, ...caption.styleOverride };
}

function applyTransform(text: string, transform?: CaptionStyle["transform"]): string {
  if (transform === "uppercase") return text.toUpperCase();
  if (transform === "lowercase") return text.toLowerCase();
  if (transform === "capitalize") {
    return text.replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  }
  return text;
}

function wrapWords(words: string[], maxChars: number, maxLines: number): string[][] {
  const lines: string[][] = [[]];
  let count = 0;
  for (const word of words) {
    const next = count + word.length + (count > 0 ? 1 : 0);
    if (count > 0 && next > maxChars) {
      if (lines.length >= maxLines) {
        const last = lines[lines.length - 1]!;
        last[last.length - 1] = `${last[last.length - 1] ?? ""}…`;
        break;
      }
      lines.push([word]);
      count = word.length;
    } else {
      lines[lines.length - 1]!.push(word);
      count = next;
    }
  }
  return lines;
}

function captionOpacity(caption: Caption, timeSec: number): { alpha: number; tx: number; ty: number; scale: number; blur: number; waveOffset: number } {
  const inn = caption.animation?.in ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const out = caption.animation?.out ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const tIn = inn.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(inn.easing, (timeSec - caption.startSec - inn.delaySec) / inn.durationSec);
  const tOut = out.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(out.easing, (caption.endSec - timeSec - out.delaySec) / out.durationSec);
  const enter = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tIn));
  const leave = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tOut));
  const alpha = enter * leave;
  const dir = inn.direction ?? "up";
  const dist = inn.distance ?? 24;
  const slideIn = (1 - enter) * dist;
  const slideOut = (1 - leave) * dist;
  const ty = dir === "up" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "down" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  const tx = dir === "left" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "right" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  
  let scaleIn = 1;
  if (inn.preset === "scale") scaleIn = lerp(0.86, 1, enter);
  else if (inn.preset === "pop") scaleIn = enter < 1 ? lerp(0.5, 1.08, enter) : 1;
  else if (inn.preset === "bounce" || inn.preset === "spring") {
    scaleIn = enter < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(enter * Math.PI * 1.5) : 1;
  }
  
  let scaleOut = 1;
  if (out.preset === "scale" || out.preset === "pop") scaleOut = lerp(0.85, 1, leave);
  else if (out.preset === "bounce" || out.preset === "spring") scaleOut = leave < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(leave * Math.PI) : 1;

  const blur = (inn.preset === "blur" ? (1 - enter) * 10 : 0) + (out.preset === "blur" ? (1 - leave) * 10 : 0);
  const waveOffset = inn.preset === "wave" ? Math.sin((timeSec - caption.startSec) * 3) * 6 : 0;
  return { alpha, tx, ty, scale: scaleIn * scaleOut, blur, waveOffset };
}

function wordState(word: Word, timeSec: number): "past" | "active" | "future" {
  if (timeSec < word.startSec) return "future";
  if (timeSec >= word.endSec) return "past";
  return "active";
}

function paintVisualizer(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  config: import("@/schema").VisualizerConfig | undefined,
  spectrum: ArrayLike<number>,
  timeSec: number
): void {
  const cfg = config ?? {
    type: "bars",
    colorA: "#F5C15A",
    colorB: "#67F0FF",
    sensitivity: 1,
    position: "bottom",
    barCount: 48,
    opacity: 0.35,
  };

  const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, cfg.opacity ?? 0.35));
  if (alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const sens = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(3, cfg.sensitivity ?? 1));
  const count = Math.min(Math.max(8, cfg.barCount ?? 48), spectrum.length);
  const colorA = cfg.colorA ?? "#F5C15A";
  const colorB = cfg.colorB ?? "#67F0FF";
  
  const defaultYRatio = cfg.position === "middle" ? 0.5 : cfg.position === "behind-text" ? 0.72 : 0.92;
  const posY = (cfg.yPercent !== undefined ? cfg.yPercent / 100 : defaultYRatio) * height;
  const posX = (cfg.xPercent !== undefined ? cfg.xPercent / 100 : 0.5) * width;
  const vizW = (cfg.widthPercent !== undefined ? cfg.widthPercent / 100 : 0.74) * width;
  const vizH = (cfg.heightPercent !== undefined ? cfg.heightPercent / 100 : 0.22) * height;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  if (cfg.type === "wave") {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorA;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, height * 0.005);
    if ("lineCap" in ctx) ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";

    const step = vizW / Math.max(1, count - 1);
    const startX = posX - vizW / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.sin(timeSec * 4 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * vizH * 0.15;
      const y = posY - v * vizH * 0.85 + wave;
      const x = startX + i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorB;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, height * 0.003);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[count - 1 - i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.cos(timeSec * 3 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * vizH * 0.12;
      const y = posY + v * vizH * 0.55 + wave;
      const x = startX + i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (cfg.type === "circle") {
    const cx = posX;
    const cy = posY;
    const baseRadius = Math.min(vizW, vizH) * 0.5;
    const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / count;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, baseRadius * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = toRgba(colorB, 0.4);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const ang = i * angleStep;
      const len = Math.max(4, v * vizH * 0.8);
      const x1 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * baseRadius;
      const y1 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * baseRadius;
      const x2 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * (baseRadius + len);
      const y2 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * (baseRadius + len);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, width * 0.003);
      ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
      ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (cfg.type === "mirror") {
    const half = Math.floor(count / 2);
    const gap = 3;
    const bw = vizW / count;
    const cx = posX;

    for (let i = 0; i < half; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * vizH);
      const col = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillStyle = col;

      const rx = cx + i * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(rx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);

      const lx = cx - (i + 1) * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(lx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);
    }
  } else {
    const gap = Math.max(2, Math.round(width * 0.003));
    const bw = vizW / count;
    const startX = posX - vizW / 2;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * vizH);
      const x = startX + i * bw;
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillRect(x, posY - h, Math.max(1, bw - gap), h);
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function paintBackground(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number, assets: ResolvedAssets): void {
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const bg = project.media.background;
  const colA = bg.color || "#120a21";
  const colB = bg.colorB || "#2d124d";

  // Base fill with rich color harmony
  ctx.fillStyle = colA;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

  const ang = ((bg.angleDeg ?? 160) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const gx = Math.cos(ang) * width;
  const gy = Math.sin(ang) * height;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(width / 2 - gx / 2, height / 2 - gy / 2, width / 2 + gx / 2, height / 2 + gy / 2);
  g.addColorStop(0, colA);
  g.addColorStop(0.5, colB);
  g.addColorStop(1, bg.type === "gradient" ? (bg.colorB ?? "#080410") : "#080410");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

  const img = assets.backgroundImage ?? assets.albumArt;
  if (img && (bg.type === "image" || bg.type === "album-blur")) {
    const zoomBase = bg.kenBurns ? bg.kenBurnsZoom || 1.1 : 1;
    const seed = hashString(project.id);
    const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    const driftX = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const driftY = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const duration = Math.max(1, project.meta.durationSec);
    const k = bg.kenBurns ? (timeSec / duration) : 0;
    const zoom = lerp(1, zoomBase, k);
    const iw = img.width || width;
    const ih = img.height || height;
    const scale = Math.max(width / iw, height / ih) * zoom;
    const dw = iw * scale;
    const dh = ih * scale;
    const dx = (width - dw) / 2 + driftX * width * k;
    const dy = (height - dh) / 2 + driftY * height * k;
    ctx.save();
    if (bg.type === "album-blur" && bg.blurPx > 0) {
      ctx.filter = `blur(${bg.blurPx}px)`;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);
    ctx.filter = "none";
    ctx.restore();
  } else if (!img && (bg.type === "album-blur" || bg.type === "image")) {
    // Ambient procedural album aura when image is loading
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(timeSec * 0.8);
    const rad = ctx.createRadialGradient(width * 0.65, height * 0.45, 20, width * 0.65, height * 0.45, width * 0.6);
    rad.addColorStop(0, toRgba("#f5c15a", 0.45 + 0.15 * pulse));
    rad.addColorStop(0.4, toRgba("#e06b3a", 0.25));
    rad.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
    ctx.fillStyle = rad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const rad2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(width * 0.25, height * 0.75, 10, width * 0.25, height * 0.75, width * 0.5);
    rad2.addColorStop(0, toRgba("#8b5cf6", 0.35));
    rad2.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
    ctx.fillStyle = rad2;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  if (bg.dim > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = toRgba("#000000", Math.min(0.65, bg.dim));
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  if (bg.visualizer && assets.spectrum && assets.spectrum.length > 0) {
    paintVisualizer(ctx, width, height, bg.visualizerConfig, assets.spectrum, timeSec);
  }
}

function paintIntro(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number): void {
  if (timeSec > 2.6) return;
  const title = project.meta.title?.trim();
  const artist = project.meta.artist?.trim();
  const hasArtist = Boolean(artist && !artist.toLowerCase().includes("unknown") && artist.length > 0);
  const hasTitle = Boolean(title && !title.toLowerCase().includes("untitled") && title.length > 0);
  if (!hasTitle && !hasArtist) return;

  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, timeSec / 0.5));
  const fadeOut = timeSec > 1.8 ? 1 - (timeSec - 1.8) / 0.8 : 1;
  const alpha = t * fadeOut;
  if (alpha <= 0) return;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#F7F4EE";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  if (hasTitle) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Fraunces", 500, true, height * 0.07);
    ctx.fillText(title, width / 2, hasArtist ? height * 0.44 : height * 0.49);
  }
  if (hasArtist) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Outfit", 500, false, height * 0.028);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#F5C15A";
    ctx.fillText(artist.toUpperCase(), width / 2, hasTitle ? height * 0.53 : height * 0.49);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintRoundedRect(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  w: number,
  h: number,
  r: number,
  fill: string | FrameGradient,
): void {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintCaption(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  caption: Caption,
  timeSec: number,
): void {
  if (timeSec < caption.startSec - 0.05 || timeSec > caption.endSec + 0.05) return;

  const isInstrumental = Boolean(
    caption.instrumental ||
      !caption.text ||
      caption.text.trim() === "♪" ||
      caption.text.toLowerCase().includes("instrumental")
  );

  const gapDuration = caption.endSec - caption.startSec;
  const displayMode = project.settings?.instrumentalDisplay ?? "auto";

  if (isInstrumental) {
    if (displayMode === "hidden") return;
    if (displayMode === "auto" && gapDuration <= 3.0) return; // 2-3 sec instrumental: render NOTHING
  }

  const style = resolveStyle(project, caption);
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const motion = captionOpacity(caption, timeSec);
  if (motion.alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const fontPx = (style.fontSizePct / 100) * height * style.scale;
  const rawWords = (isInstrumental ? ["♪", "Instrumental", "♪"] : caption.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)).map((w) =>
    applyTransform(w, style.transform),
  );
  const lines = wrapWords(rawWords, style.maxCharsPerLine, style.maxLines);
  ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
  const lineMetrics = lines.map((line) => {
    const text = line.join(" ");
    return { line, text, width: ctx.measureText(text).width + style.letterSpacing * fontPx * Math.max(0, text.length - 1) };
  });
  const blockW = Math.max(...lineMetrics.map((l) => l.width), 10);
  const blockH = lineMetrics.length * fontPx * style.lineHeight;
  const px = (style.xPercent / 100) * width;
  const py = (style.yPercent / 100) * height + motion.waveOffset;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = motion.alpha;
  ctx.translate(px + motion.tx, py + motion.ty);
  ctx.rotate((style.rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
  ctx.scale(motion.scale, motion.scale);

  if (style.box?.enabled) {
    paintRoundedRect(
      ctx,
      -blockW / 2 - (style.box.paddingX ?? 28),
      -blockH / 2 - (style.box.paddingY ?? 16),
      blockW + (style.box.paddingX ?? 28) * 2,
      blockH + (style.box.paddingY ?? 16) * 2,
      style.box.radius ?? 12,
      toRgba(style.box.fill ?? "#000000", style.box.opacity ?? 0.35),
    );
  }

  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.miterLimit = 2;

  let wordCursor = 0;
  const wordLead = (project.settings?.wordLeadMs ?? 0) / 1000;
  const rawSource =
    caption.words && caption.words.length > 0
      ? caption.words
      : rawWords.map((text, i) => {
          const span = (caption.endSec - caption.startSec) / Math.max(1, rawWords.length);
          return {
            text,
            startSec: caption.startSec + i * span,
            endSec: caption.startSec + (i + 1) * span,
            confidence: 1,
          };
        });
  const sourceWords = wordLead
    ? rawSource.map((w) => ({
        ...w,
        startSec: w.startSec + wordLead,
        endSec: w.endSec + wordLead,
      }))
    : rawSource;

  const highlightStyle = caption.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";
  const karaokeEnabled =
    (project.settings?.karaoke ?? true) &&
    highlightStyle !== "none" &&
    caption.animation?.highlight?.enabled !== false;

  lineMetrics.forEach((lm, li) => {
    const y = -blockH / 2 + (li + 0.5) * fontPx * (style.lineHeight ?? 1.2);
    let x = -lm.width / 2;
    if (style.align === "left") x = -blockW / 2;
    if (style.align === "right") x = blockW / 2 - lm.width;
    for (const token of lm.line) {
      const word = sourceWords[Math.min(wordCursor, sourceWords.length - 1)];
      wordCursor += 1;
      const state = word ? wordState(word, timeSec) : "future";
      const localT = word ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (timeSec - word.startSec) / Math.max(0.04, word.endSec - word.startSec))) : 0;
      
      let fill = style.futureFill ?? style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA";
      if (!karaokeEnabled) {
        fill = style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA";
      } else {
        if (state === "past") fill = style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4";
        if (state === "active") {
          if (highlightStyle === "sweep") fill = mixHex(style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA", style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", localT);
          else fill = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
        }
      }
      const tw = ctx.measureText(token).width;

      if (karaokeEnabled && state === "active" && highlightStyle === "box") {
        paintRoundedRect(ctx, x - 8, y - fontPx * 0.55, tw + 16, fontPx * 1.1, 8, toRgba(style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", 0.25));
      }
      if (karaokeEnabled && state === "active" && highlightStyle === "underline") {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, fontPx * 0.06);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.lineTo(x + tw * localT, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      const bounce = state === "active" && highlightStyle === "scale" ? 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(localT * Math.PI) : 1;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x + tw / 2, y);
      ctx.scale(bounce, bounce);
      ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
      
      const glowBlur = style.glow?.blur ?? 0;
      const glowOpacity = style.glow?.opacity ?? 0;
      const shadowOpacity = style.shadow?.opacity ?? 0;

      if (glowBlur > 0 && glowOpacity > 0 && state === "active") {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.glow?.color ?? "#F5C15A", glowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = glowBlur * (highlightStyle === "glow" ? 1.5 : 1);
      } else if (shadowOpacity > 0 && style.shadow) {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.shadow.color ?? "#000000", shadowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = style.shadow.blur ?? 18;
        ctx.shadowOffsetX = style.shadow.x ?? 0;
        ctx.shadowOffsetY = style.shadow.y ?? 4;
      }
      if ((style.outlineWidth ?? 0) > 0) {
        ctx.lineWidth = (style.outlineWidth ?? 0) * 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.outlineColor ?? "#000000";
        ctx.strokeText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      }
      if (style.gradient?.enabled && state !== "active" && style.gradient.stops?.length >= 2) {
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, -fontPx / 2, tw / 2, fontPx / 2);
        for (const stop of style.gradient.stops) g.addColorStop(stop.offset, stop.color);
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
      } else if (state === "active" && highlightStyle === "shimmer") {
        const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, 0, tw / 2, 0);
        const st = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, localT));
        sg.addColorStop(Math.max(0, st - 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        sg.addColorStop(st, "#FFFFFF");
        sg.addColorStop(Math.min(1, st + 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        ctx.fillStyle = sg;
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = fill;
      }
      ctx.fillText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      ctx.restore();
      x += tw + fontPx * 0.28 + (style.wordSpacing ?? 0) + (style.letterSpacing ?? 0) * fontPx;
    }
  });

  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawFrame(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  timeSecRaw: number,
  assets: ResolvedAssets,
): void {
  // Single place where the global sync nudge is applied, so preview and
  // export can never disagree.
  const timeSec = timeSecRaw + (project.settings?.syncOffsetMs ?? 0) / 1000;

  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.filter = "none";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
  ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

  paintBackground(ctx, project, timeSec, assets);

  if (project.media?.background?.overlay && project.media.background.overlay.type !== "none") {
    renderProceduralOverlay(ctx, project.media.background.overlay, timeSec, assets);
  } else if (assets.lottieFrame) {
    ctx.drawImage(assets.lottieFrame, 0, 0, width, height);
  }

  paintIntro(ctx, project, timeSec);

  // Only paint captions that are actually on screen — with 300+ lines this
  // was iterating the whole array 60×/sec.
  for (const caption of project.captions ?? []) {
    if (timeSec < caption.startSec - 0.6) continue;
    if (timeSec > caption.endSec + 0.6) continue;
    paintCaption(ctx, project, caption, timeSec);
  }
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { parseHexColor } from "@/lib/color";

export function Tooltip({ label, shortcut, children }: { label: string; shortcut?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <span className="group relative inline-flex">
      {children}
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-[calc(100%+8px)] left-1/2 z-50 hidden -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1017] px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--ink)] shadow-xl group-hover:block group-focus-within:block">
        {label}
        {shortcut ? <kbd className="ml-2 rounded bg-[#1c2230] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--accent)]">{shortcut}</kbd> : null}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

export function Modal({
  open,
  title,
  children,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  confirmLabel = "Confirm",
  danger,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm?: () => void;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  danger?: boolean;
}) {
  if (!open) return null;
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] grid place-items-center bg-black/65 p-6" role="dialog" aria-modal>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] p-6 shadow-2xl lf-enter-scale">
        <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-2xl">{title}</h2>
        <div className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--muted)]">{children}</div>
        <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-2">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[var(--muted)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)]" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          {onConfirm ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${danger ? "bg-[var(--danger)] text-black" : "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)]"}`}
              onClick={onConfirm}
            >
              {confirmLabel}
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Toast({ text }: { text: string | null }) {
  if (!text) return null;
  return (
    <div className="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-[70] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f]/95 px-4 py-2 text-sm shadow-2xl lf-enter">
      {text}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ColorField({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  recent,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (hex: string) => void;
  recent: string[];
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value || "#FFFFFF");
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const parsed = parseHexColor(value || "#FFFFFF");
  const alpha = parsed?.alpha ?? 1;

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(parsed?.hex ?? value ?? "#FFFFFF");
    setError(false);
  }, [value, parsed?.hex]);

  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--faint)]">{label}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <input
          type="color"
          aria-label={`${label} swatch`}
          className="h-9 w-9 cursor-pointer rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent p-0"
          value={parsed?.hex ?? "#FFFFFF"}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
        />
        <input
          value={draft}
          spellCheck={false}
          className={`h-9 flex-1 rounded-md border bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm tracking-wider ${error ? "border-[var(--danger)]" : "border-[var(--line)]"}`}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setDraft(e.target.value);
            const next = parseHexColor(e.target.value);
            if (next) {
              setError(false);
              onChange(next.alpha < 1 ? `${next.hex}${Math.round(next.alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase()}` : next.hex);
            } else {
              setError(true);
            }
          }}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="h-9 rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 text-[11px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)]"
          onClick={async () => {
            try {
              const Eye = (window as unknown as { EyeDropper?: new () => { open: () => Promise<{ sRGBHex: string }> } }).EyeDropper;
              if (!Eye) return;
              const res = await new Eye().open();
              if (res?.sRGBHex) {
                onChange(res.sRGBHex.toUpperCase());
              }
            } catch {
              // User pressed Escape or EyeDropper aborted — harmless
            }
          }}
        >
          Drop
        </button>
      </div>
      <input
        type="range"
        min={0}
        max={100}
        value={Math.round(alpha * 100)}
        className="mt-2 w-full accent-[var(--accent)]"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const a = Number(e.target.value) / 100;
          const hex = parsed?.hex ?? "#FFFFFF";
          onChange(a >= 0.995 ? hex : `${hex}${Math.round(a * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase()}`);
        }}
      />
      {recent && recent.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {recent.filter(Boolean).map((c, i) => (
            <button
              key={`${c}-${i}`}
              type="button"
              title={c}
              className="h-4 w-4 rounded-sm border border-white/10"
              style={{ background: c }}
              onClick={() => onChange(c)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </label>
  );
}

export function Field({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <label className="block" htmlFor={id}>
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--faint)]">{label}</span>
      <div id={id}>{children}</div>
    </label>
  );
}

export function Slider({
  label,
  value = 0,
  min,
  max,
  step,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value?: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
}) {
  const safeVal = Number.isFinite(value) ? value : min;
  return (
    <Field label={`${label}  ${Number.isInteger(safeVal) ? safeVal : safeVal.toFixed(2)}`}>
      <input
        type="range"
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={step ?? 1}
        value={safeVal}
        className="w-full accent-[var(--accent)]"
        onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}

export function useClickOutside(onClose: () => void) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
  }, [onClose]);
  return ref;
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

import { defaultProject, type Caption, type AnchorHit } from "@/schema";

import { decodeAudio, encodeWavMono16, extractPeaks, downsampleMono } from "@/lib/audio-client";
