const SAMPLE_LYRICS = `[Verse 1]
Four in the morning
And I'm still wide awake
Counting the cracks in the ceiling
Like they're my last mistake

[Chorus]
If the night is a map then I'm lost on purpose
Pin every heartbeat to a borrowed sky
Say it slower so the dark can rehearse us
We only glow when we almost arrive

[Verse 2]
Vinyl dust on a kitchen table
Your laugh still lives in the hallway light
I would trade the whole constellation
For one more ordinary night
`;

interface ClipMap {
  name: string;
  file: File;
  lineIndex: number;
  isInstrumental: boolean;
  matchScore: number;
  matchReason: string;
  durationSec?: number;
  offsetSec?: number;
  fftLocked?: boolean;
}

function autoMapClip(file: File, lines: { index: number; text: string; instrumental?: boolean }[]): ClipMap {
  const name = file.name;
  const stem = name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").toLowerCase();

  const instrumentalKeywords = ["instrumental", "intro", "gap", "break", "solo", "outro", "interlude", "pause", "music"];
  const hasInstrumentalWord = instrumentalKeywords.some((kw) => stem.includes(kw));

  const cleanStem = stem
    .replace(/^(\d+)[-_]/, "")
    .replace(/line[-_]?0*(\d+)[-_]?/i, "")
    .replace(/[-_.]+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  const stemTokens = cleanStem.split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 1);

  const lineNumMatch = stem.match(/line[-_]?0*(\d+)/i);
  const targetLineNumber = lineNumMatch ? parseInt(lineNumMatch[1], 10) : null;

  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);

  let bestLineIndex = 0;
  let bestScore = 0;
  let bestReason = "Sequential";

  if (hasInstrumentalWord && !targetLineNumber && stemTokens.length <= 2) {
    return { name, file, lineIndex: -1, isInstrumental: true, matchScore: 0.95, matchReason: "Instrumental Gap" };
  }

  if (targetLineNumber !== null && targetLineNumber >= 1 && targetLineNumber <= vocalLines.length) {
    const matchedVocal = vocalLines[targetLineNumber - 1];
    if (matchedVocal) { bestLineIndex = matchedVocal.index; bestScore = 0.98; bestReason = `Line #${targetLineNumber}`; }
  }

  for (const l of vocalLines) {
    const lineLower = l.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, "");
    const lineTokens = lineLower.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);

    if (cleanStem.length > 4 && lineLower.includes(cleanStem)) {
      if (0.99 > bestScore) { bestScore = 0.99; bestLineIndex = l.index; bestReason = "100% Match"; }
    }

    let matchCount = 0;
    for (const st of stemTokens) { if (lineTokens.some((lt) => lt.includes(st) || st.includes(lt))) matchCount++; }
    const tokenScore = stemTokens.length > 0 ? matchCount / stemTokens.length : 0;
    if (tokenScore > bestScore && tokenScore > 0.3) { bestScore = tokenScore; bestLineIndex = l.index; bestReason = `${Math.round(tokenScore * 100)}% Match`; }
  }

  return { name, file, lineIndex: bestLineIndex, isInstrumental: false, matchScore: bestScore || 0.8, matchReason: bestReason };
}

export function Wizard() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState<number>(1);
  const [key, setKey] = useState("");
  const [showKey, setShowKey] = useState(false);
  const [persist, setPersist] = useState<"session" | "store">("session");
  const [keyOk, setKeyOk] = useState(false);
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [keyError, setKeyError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hasSessionKey, setHasSessionKey] = useState(false);

  const [songTitle, setSongTitle] = useState("");
  const [artistName, setArtistName] = useState("");
  const [audioFile, setAudioFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const [audioMeta, setAudioMeta] = useState<string>("");
  const [lyrics, setLyrics] = useState("");
  const [clips, setClips] = useState<ClipMap[]>([]);
  const [log, setLog] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [startedAt, setStartedAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [etaMs, setEtaMs] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  // Audio audition state
  const [playingClip, setPlayingClip] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [playingMaster, setPlayingMaster] = useState(false);
  const audioPlayerRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);

  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const clipRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const keySectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const audioSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lyricsSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const clipsSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetch("/api/session").then((r) => r.json()).then((j: { configured?: boolean; defaultKey?: string }) => {
      if (j.configured) { setHasSessionKey(true); setKeyOk(true); }
      if (j.defaultKey) setKey((prev) => prev || j.defaultKey || "");
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  const parsed = useMemo(() => parseLyrics(lyrics), [lyrics]);
  const vocalCount = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).length;
  const instrumentalCount = parsed.lines.filter((l) => l.instrumental).length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (parsed.title && !songTitle) setSongTitle(parsed.title);
    if (parsed.artist && !artistName) setArtistName(parsed.artist);
  }, [parsed.title, parsed.artist, songTitle, artistName]);

  const scrollToSection = (index: number) => {
    setActiveNav(index);
    const refs = [keySectionRef, audioSectionRef, lyricsSectionRef, clipsSectionRef];
    refs[index - 1]?.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };

  async function validateKey() {
    setKeyError(null); setValidating(true);
    try {
      const activeKey = key.trim();
      if (!activeKey) { setKeyError("Please enter a Groq API key."); setKeyOk(false); setValidating(false); return; }
      const res = await fetch("/api/session", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ key: activeKey, persist }) });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok) { setKeyError(json.error ?? "Could not validate that key."); setKeyOk(false); return; }
      setKeyOk(true); setHasSessionKey(true); setKey(activeKey);
    } catch { setKeyError("Network error while validating key."); setKeyOk(false); }
    finally { setValidating(false); }
  }

  // Audition playback helper
  const playAudioClip = (file: File, id: string) => {
    if (playingClip === id || (id === "master" && playingMaster)) {
      if (audioPlayerRef.current) {
        audioPlayerRef.current.pause();
        audioPlayerRef.current = null;
      }
      setPlayingClip(null);
      setPlayingMaster(false);
      return;
    }

    if (audioPlayerRef.current) {
      audioPlayerRef.current.pause();
    }

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const audio = new Audio(url);
    audioPlayerRef.current = audio;
    if (id === "master") setPlayingMaster(true);
    else setPlayingClip(id);

    audio.onended = () => {
      setPlayingClip(null);
      setPlayingMaster(false);
      audioPlayerRef.current = null;
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    };

    audio.play().catch(() => {
      setPlayingClip(null);
      setPlayingMaster(false);
    });
  };

  // Cached master audio buffers for zero-latency re-use
  const masterAudioBufferRef = useRef<AudioBuffer | null>(null);
  const masterMonoRef = useRef<Float32Array | null>(null);

  async function onAudio(file: File) {
    try {
      const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const decoded = await decodeAudio(buf);
      masterAudioBufferRef.current = decoded;
      masterMonoRef.current = downsampleMono(decoded, 16000);

      setAudioFile(file);
      setDuration(decoded.duration);
      if (!songTitle) setSongTitle(file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
      const p = extractPeaks(decoded, 240);
      setPeaks(Array.from(p));
      setAudioMeta(`${file.name} · ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB · ${decoded.duration.toFixed(1)}s · ${(decoded.sampleRate / 1000).toFixed(1)}kHz`);
      await putBlob("draft-master", file);
      await putPeaks("draft-master", p);
    } catch { setAudioMeta("Could not decode that audio file."); }
  }

  const handlePasteClipboard = async () => { try { const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText(); if (text) setLyrics(text); } catch {} };

  const handleClipsUpload = async (uploadedFiles: File[]) => {
    const sorted = Array.from(uploadedFiles).sort((a, b) => naturalSort(a.name, b.name));
    const initialClips = sorted.map((file) => autoMapClip(file, parsed.lines));
    setClips(initialClips);

    // If master audio is loaded, run hierarchical fast FFT cross-correlation with UI yields
    if (audioFile && (masterMonoRef.current || masterAudioBufferRef.current)) {
      try {
        let masterMono = masterMonoRef.current;
        if (!masterMono && masterAudioBufferRef.current) {
          masterMono = downsampleMono(masterAudioBufferRef.current, 16000);
          masterMonoRef.current = masterMono;
        }
        if (!masterMono) {
          const decoded = await decodeAudio(await audioFile.arrayBuffer());
          masterAudioBufferRef.current = decoded;
          masterMono = downsampleMono(decoded, 16000);
          masterMonoRef.current = masterMono;
        }

        const updated = [...initialClips];
        for (let i = 0; i < updated.length; i++) {
          const clip = updated[i];
          if (!clip) continue;
          try {
            // Yield to browser event loop so UI stays fluid
            await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
            const clipDecoded = await decodeAudio(await clip.file.arrayBuffer());
            const clipMono = downsampleMono(clipDecoded, 16000);
            const hit = crossCorrelate(masterMono, clipMono, 16000);
            if (hit.peakConfidence >= 0.35) {
              updated[i] = {
                ...clip,
                durationSec: clipDecoded.duration,
                offsetSec: hit.offsetSec,
                matchScore: hit.peakConfidence,
                matchReason: `FFT ${(hit.peakConfidence * 100).toFixed(0)}% @ ${hit.offsetSec.toFixed(1)}s`,
                fftLocked: true,
              };
              setClips([...updated]);
            }
          } catch {}
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Background FFT matching failed:", err);
      }
    }
  };

  async function generateWithoutAudio() {
    setRunning(true);
    setStartedAt(Date.now());
    setEtaMs(2000);
    setLog(["Parsing lyric sheet...", "Generating synchronized captions...", "Detecting instrumental breaks > 3.0s..."]);
    setProgress(0.4);
    const estDuration = Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8);
    const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, estDuration);
    const project = defaultProject({
      id: createId("proj"),
      meta: { title: songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || "Custom Lyrics", artist: artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist", durationSec: estDuration, fps: 30, resolution: "1920x1080", aspectRatio: "16:9", language: "en" },
      captions: sync.captions,
    });
    setProgress(0.8);
    const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ project }) });
    if (!saved.ok) {
      const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown");
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error saving project: ${errText}`]);
      setRunning(false);
      return;
    }
    const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
    setProgress(1); setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Project ready! Opening Studio..."]); setRunning(false);
    startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
  }

  async function analyze() {
    if (!audioFile) { await generateWithoutAudio(); return; }
    setRunning(true);
    setStartedAt(Date.now());
    setEtaMs(Math.round((6 + duration * 0.22) * 1000)); // initial estimate
    setLog(["Starting speech & DSP alignment pipeline..."]);
    setProgress(0.1);
    const form = new FormData();
    form.set("lyrics", lyrics); form.set("durationSec", String(duration));
    form.set("title", songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || audioFile.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
    form.set("artist", artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist"); form.set("language", "en");

    try {
      let masterMono = masterMonoRef.current;
      if (!masterMono) {
        const decoded = masterAudioBufferRef.current || (await decodeAudio(await audioFile.arrayBuffer()));
        masterAudioBufferRef.current = decoded;
        masterMono = downsampleMono(decoded, 16000);
        masterMonoRef.current = masterMono;
      }
      const wav = encodeWavMono16(masterMono, 16000);
      form.set("audio", new File([wav], "master.wav", { type: "audio/wav" }));

      // Fast collect anchors (reuse already locked clips, or correlate remaining)
      const anchors: AnchorHit[] = [];
      for (const clip of clips) {
        if (clip.lineIndex < 0 && !clip.isInstrumental) continue;
        if (clip.fftLocked && clip.offsetSec !== undefined) {
          anchors.push({
            lineIndex: clip.lineIndex,
            offsetSec: clip.offsetSec,
            durationSec: clip.durationSec,
            peakConfidence: clip.matchScore,
          });
        } else {
          try {
            const clipDecoded = await decodeAudio(await clip.file.arrayBuffer());
            const clipMono = downsampleMono(clipDecoded, 16000);
            const hit = crossCorrelate(masterMono, clipMono, 16000);
            if (hit.peakConfidence >= 0.35) {
              anchors.push({
                lineIndex: clip.lineIndex,
                offsetSec: hit.offsetSec,
                durationSec: clipDecoded.duration,
                peakConfidence: hit.peakConfidence,
              });
            }
          } catch {}
        }
      }

      if (anchors.length > 0) {
        setLog((curr) => [...curr, `✓ Locked ${anchors.length} cut audio clips with FFT precision!`]);
        form.set("anchors", JSON.stringify(anchors));
      }

      const res = await fetch("/api/analyze", { method: "POST", body: form });
      if (!res.body) { setLog(["The analyze stream failed."]); setRunning(false); return; }

      const reader = res.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buf = ""; let captions: Caption[] = []; let flagged = 0;
      let title = songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || "Untitled";
      let artist = artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist";
      let streamFailed = false;

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        buf += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const chunks = buf.split("\n\n"); buf = chunks.pop() ?? "";
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          const line = chunk.split("\n").find((l) => l.startsWith("data:"));
          if (!line) continue;
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim()) as {
              stage: string;
              label: string;
              progress: number;
              captions?: Caption[];
              flagged?: number;
              mode?: string;
              title?: string;
              artist?: string;
              etaMs?: number | null;
            };
            setProgress(payload.progress);
            if (payload.etaMs != null) setEtaMs(payload.etaMs);
            setLog((curr) => [...curr, `${payload.stage}  ${payload.label}`]);
            if (payload.mode) setLog((curr) => [...curr, payload.mode === "asr" ? "✓ High-accuracy Groq Whisper aligned" : "ℹ Syllable-weighted timing applied"]);
            if (payload.stage === "error") streamFailed = true;
            if (payload.captions) captions = payload.captions;
            if (payload.flagged !== undefined) flagged = payload.flagged;
            if (payload.title && !songTitle) title = payload.title;
            if (payload.artist && !artistName) artist = payload.artist;
          } catch {}
        }
      }

      if (streamFailed && captions.length === 0) {
        setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Whisper unavailable. Falling back to heuristic..."]);
        const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, duration || Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8)); captions = sync.captions;
      }

      const project = defaultProject({
        id: createId("proj"),
        meta: { title, artist, durationSec: duration, fps: 30, resolution: "1920x1080", aspectRatio: "16:9", language: "en" },
        captions,
      });
      await putBlob(`audio-${project.id}`, audioFile);
      const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ project }) });
      if (!saved.ok) {
        const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown");
        setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error: ${errText}`]);
        setRunning(false);
        return;
      }
      const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, flagged ? `Review ${flagged} flagged lines in studio.` : "All lines aligned!"]);
      setRunning(false); startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Generation error";
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error: ${msg}. Falling back...`]);
      await generateWithoutAudio();
    }
  }

  const navSteps = [
    { id: 1, label: "API Key", status: keyOk ? "Ready" : "Required" },
    { id: 2, label: "Master Audio", status: audioFile ? `${(duration / 60).toFixed(0)}m` : "Optional" },
    { id: 3, label: "Lyrics", status: vocalCount > 0 ? `${vocalCount} lines` : "Required" },
    { id: 4, label: "Cut Audio Slices", status: clips.length > 0 ? `${clips.length} stems` : "Optional" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-8 pb-20">
      {/* Sticky Step Navigation */}
      <nav className="sticky top-4 z-40 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#090d15]/90 px-6 py-3.5 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 overflow-x-auto">
          {navSteps.map((item) => {
            const isActive = activeNav === item.id;
            const isComplete = item.status === "Ready" || item.status.includes("lines") || item.status.includes("m") || item.status.includes("stems");
            return (
              <button key={item.id} type="button" onClick={() => scrollToSection(item.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-all duration-200 ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-500 text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.35)] scale-105"
                    : `border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)] ${isComplete ? "text-[var(--accent)] border-[var(--accent)]/30" : "text-[var(--faint)]"} hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:text-[var(--ink)]`
                }`}>
                <span className={`h-5 w-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${isActive ? "bg-black/30" : isComplete ? "bg-[var(--accent)]/20 text-[var(--accent)]" : "bg-white/5"}`}>{item.id}</span>
                <span>{item.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="lf-badge bg-[var(--purple)]/15 text-[var(--purple)] border border-[var(--purple)]/25 text-[11px] font-medium">
            <Radio size={12} className="animate-pulse" /> Auto Music Detect
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--accent)] font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/10">
            <Sparkles size={13} /> Perfect Sync
          </span>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* Main Form Grid */}
      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1.25fr_0.75fr]">
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* STEP 1: API Key */}
          <section ref={keySectionRef} className="lf-card lf-rise lf-rise-1 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-600 text-xs font-bold text-black shadow-md">1</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Groq Whisper API Key</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Word-level timestamps with Whisper Large v3</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {keyOk && <span className="lf-badge bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25"><CheckCircle2 size={13} /> Active & Ready</span>}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--muted)] mb-4">
              Powers instant phonetic transcription and AI semantic alignment. Keys are safely verified directly via SSL.
            </p>
            <div className="relative">
              <input type={showKey ? "text" : "password"} autoComplete="off" placeholder="gsk_…" value={key} onChange={(e) => { setKey(e.target.value); setKeyOk(false); }} className="lf-input pr-10 font-mono text-xs" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowKey(!showKey)} className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors">{showKey ? <EyeOff size={15} /> : <Eye size={15} />}</button>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] cursor-pointer hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={persist === "store"} onChange={(e) => setPersist(e.target.checked ? "store" : "session")} className="accent-[var(--accent)]" />
                  Remember key
                </label>
                {!key && (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => { void fetch("/api/session").then((r) => r.json()).then((j: { defaultKey?: string }) => { if (j.defaultKey) setKey(j.defaultKey); setKeyOk(false); }).catch(() => undefined); }} className="text-xs text-[var(--accent)] hover:underline font-medium">Use server key</button>
                )}
              </div>
              <button type="button" disabled={validating} onClick={() => void validateKey()} className="lf-btn-accent text-xs">
                <KeyRound size={14} /> {validating ? "Verifying…" : keyOk ? "Re-verify" : "Validate Key"}
              </button>
            </div>
            {keyError && <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-[var(--danger)] bg-rose-500/10 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/20">{keyError}</p>}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 2: Master Audio Deck */}
          <section ref={audioSectionRef} className="lf-card lf-rise lf-rise-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-600 text-xs font-bold text-black shadow-md">2</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Master / Original Audio</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Full song track (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A)</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {audioFile && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => playAudioClip(audioFile, "master")} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1 px-2.5">
                    {playingMaster ? <Square size={13} className="text-amber-400" /> : <Play size={13} className="text-emerald-400" />}
                    {playingMaster ? "Stop" : "Audition"}
                  </button>
                  <span className="lf-badge bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25">{duration.toFixed(1)}s</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()} className="flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg)] px-6 py-8 transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:bg-white/[0.02] group">
              <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)]/10 flex items-center justify-center mb-3 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                <Upload className="text-[var(--accent)]" size={22} />
              </div>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">{audioFile ? audioFile.name : "Drop master audio file or click to browse"}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">{audioMeta || "Supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG"}</span>
            </div>
            <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="audio/*" hidden onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void onAudio(e.target.files[0])} />

            {peaks.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg)] p-4 shadow-inner">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--faint)] mb-2.5">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[var(--accent)] font-medium"><Music size={14} />{audioFile?.name}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs">{duration.toFixed(1)}s</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex h-14 items-end gap-0.5 px-1 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#05070a]">
                  {peaks.map((p, i) => (
                    <span key={i} className="flex-1 rounded-t-sm transition-all" style={{ height: `${Math.max(8, p * 100)}%`, background: `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4), rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.85))` }} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {audioFile && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setAudioFile(null); setPeaks([]); setDuration(0); setAudioMeta(""); if (playingMaster && audioPlayerRef.current) { audioPlayerRef.current.pause(); setPlayingMaster(false); } }} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs !text-red-400 !border-red-500/20 hover:!bg-red-500/10">
                  <Trash2 size={13} /> Remove Audio
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 3: Lyrics & Metadata */}
          <section ref={lyricsSectionRef} className="lf-card lf-rise lf-rise-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-600 text-xs font-bold text-black shadow-md">3</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Lyric Sheet & Track Details</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Blank lines mark music breaks</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {vocalCount > 0 && <span className="lf-badge bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)] border border-[var(--accent)]/30 font-semibold">{vocalCount} vocal lines</span>}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">
              <div>
                <label className="lf-label">Song Title</label>
                <input type="text" placeholder="e.g. Four In The Morning" value={songTitle} onChange={(e) => setSongTitle(e.target.value)} className="lf-input text-xs" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="lf-label">Artist Name</label>
                <input type="text" placeholder="e.g. Original Artist" value={artistName} onChange={(e) => setArtistName(e.target.value)} className="lf-input text-xs" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 flex-wrap">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => { setSongTitle("Four in the morning"); setArtistName("Original Artist"); setLyrics(SAMPLE_LYRICS); }} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5 px-3">
                <Sparkles size={13} className="text-amber-400" /> Sample Lyrics
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={handlePasteClipboard} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5 px-3">
                <Clipboard size={13} /> Paste
              </button>
              {lyrics && <button type="button" onClick={() => setLyrics("")} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5 px-3 !text-red-400 !border-red-500/20 hover:!bg-red-500/10"><Trash2 size={13} /> Clear</button>}
            </div>

            <textarea value={lyrics} onChange={(e) => setLyrics(e.target.value)} placeholder={`[Verse 1]\nFirst lyric line\nSecond lyric line\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one\nChorus line two`} className="lf-input resize-y font-mono text-xs leading-6" style={{ minHeight: "13rem" }} />

            {/* Smart Music Gap Feature Note */}
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--purple)]/20 bg-[var(--purple)]/5 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              <Info size={16} className="text-[var(--purple)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <strong className="text-[var(--ink)]">Automatic Music Breaks (&ge; 3.0s) Enabled:</strong> Gaps between lyrics, song intros, and outros greater than 3 seconds will automatically display as <span className="text-[var(--purple)] font-semibold">♪ Music ♪</span> blocks with audio-reactive visualizers in the Studio timeline.
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* STEP 4: Cut Audio / Line Slices Deck */}
          <section ref={clipsSectionRef} className="lf-card lf-rise lf-rise-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--purple)] to-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md">4</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Cut Audio Slices / Stems</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Optional DSP FFT Cross-Correlation anchors</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {clips.length > 0 && <span className="lf-badge bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25"><CheckCircle2 size={13} /> {clips.length} cuts mapped</span>}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--muted)] mb-4">
              If you have separate vocal slices or cut audio files (e.g., <code>01.wav</code>, <code>line_01.wav</code>), upload them here. The system uses high-speed FFT Cross-Correlation to rigidly lock their exact timing in the master track!
            </p>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => clipRef.current?.click()} className="lf-btn-ghost w-full py-5 justify-center border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] hover:border-[var(--purple)]/50 hover:bg-[var(--purple)]/5 transition-all">
              <FileAudio size={18} className="text-[var(--purple)]" />
              <span className="font-medium text-xs">Add Cut Audio / Line Slices</span>
            </button>
            <input ref={clipRef} type="file" accept="audio/*" multiple hidden onChange={(e) => { if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) handleClipsUpload(Array.from(e.target.files)); }} />

            {clips.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="max-h-56 overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] lf-scroll bg-[var(--bg)] shadow-inner">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                    <thead className="border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)] sticky top-0"><tr>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Play</th>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Clip Name</th>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Matched Lyric Line</th>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] text-right">Lock Status</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody>{clips.map((c, i) => (
                      <tr key={c.name} className="border-t border-white/5 hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2">
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => playAudioClip(c.file, c.name)} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--accent)] transition-colors">
                            {playingClip === c.name ? <Square size={13} className="text-amber-400" /> : <Play size={13} className="text-emerald-400" />}
                          </button>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[180px]" title={c.name}>{c.name}</td>
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2">
                          <select value={c.lineIndex} className="bg-[var(--bg-panel)] border border-[var(--line)] rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:outline-none focus:border-[var(--accent)] cursor-pointer" onChange={(e) => {
                            const next = [...clips]; const val = Number(e.target.value);
                            next[i] = { ...c, lineIndex: val, isInstrumental: val === -1, matchReason: val === -1 ? "Instrumental" : "Manual" }; setClips(next);
                          }}>
                            <option value={-1}>♪ Instrumental Break</option>
                            {parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => <option key={l.index} value={l.index}>#{l.index + 1}: {l.text.slice(0, 32)}</option>)}
                          </select>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-right">
                          <span className={`lf-badge text-[10px] ${c.fftLocked ? "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/25" : c.isInstrumental ? "bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/25" : "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25"}`}>
                            {c.fftLocked && <Lock size={10} />}
                            {c.matchReason}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}</tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">
                  <span>{clips.filter((c) => c.fftLocked).length} FFT locked cuts</span>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setClips([])} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs !text-red-400 !border-red-500/20 hover:!bg-red-500/10">Clear all clips</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Launch Deck */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <section className="sticky top-20 lf-card border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-gradient-to-b from-[#111724] to-[#0c1017] shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[var(--accent)] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Sparkles size={14} /> Production Deck
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]"><Film size={14} /> 1080p60 MP4</span>
            </div>

            {/* Track Summary Card */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e]/80 p-4 mb-5 shadow-inner">
              <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--faint)] mb-1 font-mono">Current Project</p>
              <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--ink)] truncate">{songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || (lyrics ? "Untitled Project" : "Ready for Lyrics")}</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--accent)] mt-0.5 font-medium truncate">{artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist"}</p>
              
              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--bg-panel)] p-2.5 border border-[var(--line)]">
                  <span className="lf-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Master Audio</span>
                  <span className="block font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] mt-0.5">{audioFile ? `${duration.toFixed(1)}s` : "Heuristic"}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--bg-panel)] p-2.5 border border-[var(--line)]">
                  <span className="lf-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Vocal Lines</span>
                  <span className="block font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] mt-0.5">{vocalCount} lines ready</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Action Buttons */}
            <div className="space-y-3 mb-5">
              <button type="button" disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0} onClick={() => void analyze()} className="lf-btn-accent lf-glow w-full text-sm py-4 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]">
                <Sparkles size={18} /> {running ? "Aligning & Syncing Pipeline…" : audioFile ? "Generate with Multi-Source AI Sync" : "Generate Lyric Video"}
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0} onClick={() => void generateWithoutAudio()} className="lf-btn-ghost w-full text-xs py-2.5">
                <Zap size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Fast Heuristic Mode (No Audio)
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Pipeline Execution Log */}
            {(running || log.length > 0) && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#05070a] p-3.5 space-y-2.5 shadow-inner">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-[var(--accent)] font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5"><AudioLines size={13} /> Pipeline Status</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[var(--muted)]">
                    {Math.round(progress * 100)}%
                    {etaMs != null && progress < 1 && (
                      <span className="ml-2 text-[var(--faint)]">
                        ~{Math.max(1, Math.ceil(etaMs / 1000))}s left
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {progress >= 1 && startedAt && (
                      <span className="ml-2 text-[var(--ok)]">
                        done in {((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1c2230]">
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] via-amber-300 to-emerald-400 transition-[width] duration-500 ease-out" style={{ width: `${progress * 100}%` }} />
                </div>
                <ul className="max-h-36 overflow-auto space-y-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] pt-1 lf-scroll">
                  {log.slice(-12).map((line, i) => (
                    <li key={`${line}-${i}`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[var(--accent)] select-none">›</span>
                      <span>{line}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Feature Badges */}
            <div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-[var(--line)] space-y-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-emerald-400" /> DSP FFT Cross-Correlation Anchor Precision</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-emerald-400" /> Deep AI Semantic Mapping (Llama 3.3 70B)</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-purple-400" /> Automatic Music & Instrumental Gap Detection (&gt;3s)</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-amber-400" /> Hardware Accelerated 1080p60 WebCodecs MP4</div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { asrCoverage, heuristicSync, parseLyrics, runSync } from "@/align-engine";
import { AsrResultSchema, type AnalyzeProgress, type AsrResult, type Caption } from "@/schema";
import { getAsrCache, getAsset, putAsrCache } from "@/db/repository";
import { deepAiAlignLyrics, llmTiebreak, transcribeAudio, validateKey } from "@/lib/groq";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 120;

const modelCache = new Map<string, { asr: string; llm: string; at: number }>();
async function getModelsCached(apiKey: string) {
  const hit = modelCache.get(apiKey);
  if (hit && Date.now() - hit.at < 10 * 60 * 1000) return hit;
  const info = await validateKey(apiKey);
  const rec = { asr: info.asr, llm: info.llm, at: Date.now() };
  modelCache.set(apiKey, rec);
  return rec;
}

function sse(event: string, data: unknown): string {
  return `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const form = await req.formData();
  const lyrics = String(form.get("lyrics") ?? "");
  const language = String(form.get("language") ?? "en");
  const durationSec = Number(form.get("durationSec") ?? 0);
  const assetId = String(form.get("assetId") ?? "");
  const title = String(form.get("title") ?? "");
  const artist = String(form.get("artist") ?? "");
  const audio = form.get("audio");
  const anchorsRaw = form.get("anchors");
  let anchors: import("@/schema").AnchorHit[] = [];
  if (anchorsRaw && typeof anchorsRaw === "string") {
    try {
      anchors = JSON.parse(anchorsRaw);
    } catch {}
  }
  const parsed = parseLyrics(lyrics);
  if (title && !parsed.title) parsed.title = title;
  if (artist && !parsed.artist) parsed.artist = artist;

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const started = Date.now();
  const stream = new ReadableStream({
    async start(controller) {
      const send = (stage: AnalyzeProgress["stage"], label: string, progress: number, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        const elapsedMs = Date.now() - started;
        const etaMs = progress > 0.05 ? Math.round((elapsedMs * (1 - progress)) / progress) : null;
        const payload = { stage, label, progress, elapsedMs, etaMs, ...extra };
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sse("progress", payload)));
      };
      try {
        send("A", "Preprocess — inspecting audio and lyric sheet", 0.08);
        if (parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).length === 0) {
          throw new Error("Lyric sheet is empty. Paste lines; blank lines mark instrumental gaps.");
        }

        if (anchors.length > 0) {
          const vocalAnchors = anchors.filter((a) => a.lineIndex >= 0).length;
          const musicAnchors = anchors.length - vocalAnchors;
          send("B", `FFT anchors — locked ${vocalAnchors} cut clips + ${musicAnchors} music zones to the master track`, 0.18, {
            anchorsCount: anchors.length,
          });
        } else {
          send("B", "FFT anchors — waiting on optional split clips", 0.16, {
            detail: "No split clips supplied; skipping Stage B (highest-quality anchors).",
          });
        }

        let apiKey: string | null = null;
        try {
          apiKey = await readGroqKey();
        } catch {
          apiKey = null;
        }

        let asr: AsrResult | null = null;
        let modelId = "heuristic";

        let models: { asr: string; llm: string } | null = null;

        if (apiKey) {
          send("C", "Contacting Groq Whisper for word-level ASR", 0.28);
          try {
            models = await getModelsCached(apiKey);
            modelId = models.asr;
          } catch {
            modelId = "whisper-large-v3-turbo";
          }
          let blob: Blob | null = null;
          let filename = "audio.wav";
          let sha = "";
          if (audio instanceof File) {
            blob = audio;
            filename = audio.name;
            const buf = Buffer.from(await audio.arrayBuffer());
            sha = `${buf.length}_${buf.subarray(0, 64).toString("hex")}`;
            if (audio.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024) {
              throw new Error(messageFor("oversized_upload"));
            }
          } else if (assetId) {
            const asset = await getAsset(assetId);
            if (asset) {
              const abs = path.join(process.cwd(), asset.path);
              const buf = await readFile(abs);
              blob = new Blob([buf], { type: asset.mime });
              filename = asset.filename;
              sha = asset.sha256 ?? `${buf.length}`;
            }
          }
          if (blob) {
            let cached: AsrResult | null = null;
            if (sha) {
              try {
                cached = await getAsrCache(sha, modelId, language);
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn("ASR cache read failed:", err);
              }
            }
            if (cached) {
              asr = cached;
              send("C", "ASR cache hit — skipping Whisper", 0.42);
            } else {
              const prompt = lyricsPromptWindow(
                parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => l.text),
                0,
              );
              asr = await transcribeAudio({
                apiKey,
                file: blob,
                filename,
                language,
                prompt,
                model: modelId,
              });
              if (sha && asr) {
                try {
                  await putAsrCache(sha, modelId, language, asr);
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn("ASR cache write failed:", err);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          send("C", "No Groq key — using syllable-weighted heuristic timing", 0.36, {
            detail: "Add a Groq key for Whisper word timestamps.",
          });
        }

        const dur = durationSec > 0 ? durationSec : asr?.duration ?? 180;
        let captions: Caption[] = [];
        let flagged = 0;
        let meanConfidence = 0;
        let mode: "asr" | "heuristic" = "heuristic";

        const fullLyricText = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => l.text).join(" ");
        const coverage = asr?.words?.length ? asrCoverage(asr.words, fullLyricText) : 0;

        if (asr && asr.words && asr.words.length > 0 && coverage >= 0.15) {
          mode = "asr";
          send("D", "Normalize tokens (NFKC, numerals, metaphone)", 0.52);
          send("E", "Needleman–Wunsch word-level alignment & hallucination purge", 0.64);
          send("F", "Assign timestamps from sanitized ASR + FFT anchor warp", 0.74);
          send("G", "Assembling timeline + ♪ music breaks (≥3.5s)", 0.82);

          const parsedAsr = AsrResultSchema.parse(asr);
          if (!parsedAsr.text.trim()) throw new Error(messageFor("empty_asr"));
          const synced = runSync({ lines: parsed.lines, asr: parsedAsr, durationSec: dur, anchors });
          captions = synced.captions;
          flagged = synced.flagged;
          meanConfidence = synced.meanConfidence;
          if (synced.droppedAsrWords > 0) {
            send("F", `Filtered ${synced.droppedAsrWords} hallucinated ASR words`, 0.78);
          }
        } else {
          mode = "heuristic";
          if (asr && coverage < 0.15) {
            send("C", "Whisper coverage low (<15%) — falling back to syllable-weighted heuristic sync", 0.45);
          }
          const synced = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, dur);
          captions = synced.captions;
          flagged = synced.flagged;
          meanConfidence = synced.meanConfidence;
        }

        send("H", "Score confidence", 0.9);
        if (apiKey && flagged > 0 && asr?.segments?.length && models) {
          const ambiguous = captions
            .map((c, i) => ({ i, c }))
            .filter(({ c }) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.35)
            .slice(0, 8);
          if (ambiguous.length) {
            try {
              await llmTiebreak({
                apiKey,
                model: models.llm,
                payload: {
                  lyrics: ambiguous.map(({ i, c }) => ({ index: i, text: c.text })),
                  segments: (asr.segments ?? []).slice(0, 40).map((s, i) => ({
                    index: i,
                    start: s.start,
                    end: s.end,
                    text: s.text,
                  })),
                },
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn("LLM tiebreak optional step failed:", err);
            }
          }
        }

        send("done", `Sync complete (${mode.toUpperCase()})`, 1, {
          captions,
          flagged,
          meanConfidence,
          mode,
          title: parsed.title,
          artist: parsed.artist,
          jobId: createId("job"),
        });
        controller.close();
      } catch (err) {
        const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : messageFor("generic");
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sse("progress", { stage: "error", label: message, progress: 1 })));
        controller.close();
      }
    },
  });

  return new Response(stream, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/event-stream",
      "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform",
      Connection: "keep-alive",
    },
  });
}

import {
  defaultAnim,
  type AnchorHit,
  type AsrResult,
  type AsrWord,
  type Caption,
  type LyricLine,
  type Word,
} from "@/schema";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { needlemanWunsch } from "./needleman-wunsch";
import { countSyllables, tokenizeLine, type NormToken } from "./normalize";
import { sanitizeAsrWords } from "./sanitize";

export interface TimedLyricWord {
  lineIndex: number;
  tokenIndex: number;
  text: string;          // "" = expansion fragment, merged into previous word
  startSec: number;
  endSec: number;
  confidence: number;
  matched: boolean;
}

export interface SyncResult {
  captions: Caption[];
  flagged: number;
  meanConfidence: number;
  droppedAsrWords: number;
}

const MIN_WORD_DUR = 0.1;
const MAX_INTERP_WORD_DUR = 1.3;
const MIN_CAPTION_DUR = 0.7;

interface Owner {
  line: number;
  token: number;
  text: string;
  fragment: boolean;
}

function flattenLyrics(lines: LyricLine[]): { tokens: NormToken[]; owners: Owner[] } {
  const tokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const owners: Owner[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.instrumental) continue;
    let tokenIndex = 0;
    for (const raw of line.text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)) {
      const parts = tokenizeLine(raw); // may expand contractions: "I'm" -> i, am
      parts.forEach((t, k) => {
        tokens.push(t);
        owners.push({
          line: line.index,
          token: tokenIndex,
          text: k === 0 ? raw : "",       // fragments carry "" and merge later
          fragment: k > 0,
        });
      });
      tokenIndex += 1;
    }
  }
  return { tokens, owners };
}

function interpolate(start: number, end: number, weights: number[]) {
  const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || weights.length || 1;
  const span = Math.max(0.04, end - start);
  let cursor = start;
  return weights.map((w) => {
    const dur = (w / total) * span;
    const item = { startSec: cursor, endSec: cursor + dur };
    cursor += dur;
    return item;
  });
}

export function assignTimestamps(
  lyricTokens: NormToken[],
  owners: Owner[],
  asrWords: AsrWord[],
  path: { op: string; lyricIndex: number; asrIndex: number; score: number }[],
  durationSec: number,
): TimedLyricWord[] {
  const timed: Array<TimedLyricWord | null> = lyricTokens.map((t, i) => ({
    lineIndex: owners[i]?.line ?? 0,
    tokenIndex: owners[i]?.token ?? 0,
    text: owners[i]?.text ?? t.raw,
    startSec: -1,
    endSec: -1,
    confidence: 0,
    matched: false,
  }));

  for (const cell of path) {
    if (cell.op !== "match") continue;
    const asr = asrWords[cell.asrIndex];
    const slot = timed[cell.lyricIndex];
    if (!asr || !slot) continue;
    slot.startSec = asr.start;
    slot.endSec = Math.max(asr.start + MIN_WORD_DUR, asr.end);
    slot.confidence = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, cell.score));
    slot.matched = true;
  }

  // Outlier rejection: matched words must be monotonic in match order.
  // Anything jumping backwards is a hallucination match -> unmatch it.
  let lastStart = -Infinity;
  for (const t of timed) {
    if (!t || !t.matched) continue;
    if (t.startSec < lastStart - 0.02) {
      t.startSec = -1;
      t.endSec = -1;
      t.matched = false;
      t.confidence = 0;
    } else {
      lastStart = t.startSec;
    }
  }

  // Fill unmatched runs with syllable-weighted interpolation,
  // clamped so words never stretch absurdly across instrumental gaps.
  let i = 0;
  while (i < timed.length) {
    if ((timed[i]?.startSec ?? -1) >= 0) { i += 1; continue; }
    let j = i;
    while (j < timed.length && (timed[j]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) j += 1;
    let prev = i - 1;
    while (prev >= 0 && (timed[prev]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) prev -= 1;

    const leftT = prev >= 0 ? timed[prev]!.endSec : 0;
    const rightT = j < timed.length ? timed[j]!.startSec : durationSec;
    const gap = timed.slice(i, j);
    const weights = gap.map((_, k) => {
      const tok = lyricTokens[i + k];
      return tok ? tok.syllables || Math.max(1, tok.norm.length / 3) : 1;
    });

    const available = Math.max(0.2, rightT - leftT);
    const naturalTotal = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || 1;
    const naturalDurPerWeight = 0.28; // ~0.28s per syllable at normal singing pace
    const naturalBlock = naturalTotal * naturalDurPerWeight;

    let blockStart = leftT + 0.08;
    let blockDur = Math.min(available - 0.1, Math.max(naturalBlock, gap.length * MIN_WORD_DUR));
    if (blockDur < naturalBlock) blockDur = Math.max(gap.length * MIN_WORD_DUR, available - 0.1);
    // If the gap is much larger than needed, center the block (keeps lines off-beat safe)
    if (available > naturalBlock * 2.2) {
      blockStart = leftT + (available - naturalBlock) * 0.35;
      blockDur = naturalBlock;
    }
    blockDur = Math.max(blockDur, gap.length * MIN_WORD_DUR);

    const spans = interpolate(blockStart, blockStart + blockDur, weights);
    gap.forEach((g, k) => {
      if (!g) return;
      const s = spans[k]!;
      g.startSec = s.startSec;
      g.endSec = Math.max(s.startSec + MIN_WORD_DUR, Math.min(s.endSec, s.startSec + MAX_INTERP_WORD_DUR));
      g.confidence = 0.28;
    });
    i = j;
  }

  // Final monotonic sweep + minimum durations
  for (let k = 0; k < timed.length; k += 1) {
    const curr = timed[k]!;
    const prev = k > 0 ? timed[k - 1]! : null;
    if (prev && curr.startSec < prev.endSec) {
      const mid = (prev.endSec + curr.startSec) / 2;
      prev.endSec = mid;
      curr.startSec = mid;
    }
    if (curr.endSec - curr.startSec < MIN_WORD_DUR) {
      curr.endSec = curr.startSec + MIN_WORD_DUR;
    }
    if (prev && curr.startSec < prev.startSec + 0.02) {
      curr.startSec = prev.startSec + 0.02;
      curr.endSec = Math.max(curr.endSec, curr.startSec + MIN_WORD_DUR);
    }
  }

  return timed.filter((t): t is TimedLyricWord => t !== null);
}

export function assembleLines(
  lines: LyricLine[],
  words: TimedLyricWord[],
  durationSec: number,
): Caption[] {
  const byLine = new Map<number, TimedLyricWord[]>();
  for (const w of words) {
    const list = byLine.get(w.lineIndex) ?? [];
    list.push(w);
    byLine.set(w.lineIndex, list);
  }

  const captions: Caption[] = [];
  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);

  vocalLines.forEach((line, order) => {
    const group = (byLine.get(line.index) ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);

    // Merge contraction fragments ("i","am" -> one "I'm" word)
    const mergedWords: Word[] = [];
    for (const g of group) {
      if (g.text === "" && mergedWords.length > 0) {
        mergedWords[mergedWords.length - 1]!.endSec = g.endSec;
        continue;
      }
      mergedWords.push({
        text: g.text,
        startSec: g.startSec,
        endSec: g.endSec,
        confidence: g.confidence,
      });
    }

    const first = mergedWords[0];
    const last = mergedWords[mergedWords.length - 1];
    let start = first ? Math.max(0, first.startSec - 0.06) : 0;
    let end = last ? last.endSec + 0.12 : start + 1;
    if (end - start < MIN_CAPTION_DUR) end = start + MIN_CAPTION_DUR;
    end = Math.min(end, durationSec);

    const matched = group.filter((g) => g.matched).length;
    const conf =
      group.length === 0
        ? 0.2
        : 0.55 * (matched / group.length) +
          0.45 * (group.reduce((s, g) => s + g.confidence, 0) / group.length);

    captions.push({
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: mergedWords,
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: { ...defaultAnim("fade"), durationSec: 0.25 },
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, conf)),
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    });
  });

  captions.sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);

  // Overlap resolution with a hard floor — never squash below 0.3s
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const next = captions[i + 1];
    if (next && curr.endSec > next.startSec - 0.04) {
      const floor = curr.startSec + 0.3;
      curr.endSec = Math.max(floor, next.startSec - 0.04);
    }
    curr.endSec = Math.min(curr.endSec, durationSec);
    curr.index = i;
  }

  // Instrumental gap markers
  const withGaps: Caption[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const prev = withGaps[withGaps.length - 1];
    if (prev && curr.startSec - prev.endSec > 3.5) {
      withGaps.push({
        id: createId("gap"),
        index: withGaps.length,
        text: "♪",
        startSec: prev.endSec,
        endSec: curr.startSec,
        words: [],
        animation: {
          in: defaultAnim("fade"),
          out: defaultAnim("fade"),
          highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 0.4 },
        },
        confidence: 1,
        locked: false,
        instrumental: true,
      });
    }
    withGaps.push({ ...curr, index: withGaps.length });
  }
  return withGaps;
}

export function scoreLine(caption: Caption, anchors: AnchorHit[]): number {
  if (caption.instrumental) return 1;
  const words = caption.words;
  if (words.length === 0) return 0.2;
  const density = words.filter((w) => w.confidence >= 0.45).length / words.length;
  const gaps = words.filter((w) => w.confidence < 0.3).length / words.length;
  const anchor = anchors.find((a) => a.lineIndex === caption.index);
  const anchorAgree = anchor ? anchor.peakConfidence : 0.5;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.45 * density + 0.2 * (1 - gaps) + 0.2 * anchorAgree + 0.15 * caption.confidence));
}

export function runSync(input: {
  lines: LyricLine[];
  asr: AsrResult;
  durationSec: number;
  anchors?: AnchorHit[];
}): SyncResult {
  const { tokens: lyricTokens, owners } = flattenLyrics(input.lines);

  // *** THE KEY FIX: sanitize Whisper output BEFORE alignment ***
  const sanitized = sanitizeAsrWords(input.asr);
  const asrWords = sanitized.words;
  const asrTokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const asrWordOwner: AsrWord[] = [];
  for (const w of asrWords) {
    const parts = tokenizeLine(w.word);
    if (parts.length === 0) continue;
    // Keep multi-token expansions on ONE timestamp slot to avoid drift
    asrTokens.push(parts[0]!);
    asrWordOwner.push(w);
  }

  const aligned = needlemanWunsch(lyricTokens, asrTokens, []);
  const timed = assignTimestamps(lyricTokens, owners, asrWordOwner, aligned.path, input.durationSec);
  const captions = assembleLines(input.lines, timed, input.durationSec).map((c) => ({
    ...c,
    confidence: scoreLine(c, input.anchors ?? []),
  }));

  const flagged = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6).length;
  const vocal = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental);
  const meanConfidence = vocal.length ? vocal.reduce((s, c) => s + c.confidence, 0) / vocal.length : 0;

  return { captions, flagged, meanConfidence, droppedAsrWords: sanitized.droppedWords };
}

export function heuristicSync(lines: LyricLine[], durationSec: number): SyncResult {
  const vocal = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  const weights = vocal.map((l) => Math.max(1, countSyllables(l.text.replace(/\s+/g, "")) || l.text.length / 4));
  const lead = Math.min(2.4, durationSec * 0.06);
  const tail = Math.min(2.8, durationSec * 0.08);
  const usable = Math.max(1, durationSec - lead - tail);
  const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || 1;
  let cursor = lead;
  const captions: Caption[] = vocal.map((line, order) => {
    const span = (weights[order]! / total) * usable;
    const start = cursor;
    const end = Math.max(cursor + span * 0.82, start + MIN_CAPTION_DUR);
    cursor += span;
    const words = tokenizeLine(line.text);
    const wspan = Math.max(0.08, (end - start) / Math.max(1, words.length));
    return {
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: words.map((t, i) => ({
        text: t.raw,
        startSec: start + i * wspan,
        endSec: start + (i + 1) * wspan,
        confidence: 0.4,
      })),
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: defaultAnim("fade"),
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: 0.4,
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    };
  });
  return { captions, flagged: captions.length, meanConfidence: 0.4, droppedAsrWords: 0 };
}

export { countSyllables };

import type { AsrResult, AsrWord } from "@/schema";

export interface SanitizedAsr {
  words: AsrWord[];
  droppedWords: number;
  hallucinatedSegments: number;
}

const MIN_WORD_DUR_GOOD = 0.03;
const MIN_WORD_DUR_BAD = 0.09;   // stricter inside hallucinated segments
const MAX_WORD_DUR = 1.6;        // single word can never own >1.6s
const SEG_LOGPROB_FLOOR = -1.0;   // below this = Whisper hallucinating over music
const CLUSTER_WINDOW = 0.6;       // 7+ words inside 0.6s = compressed garbage
const CLUSTER_MIN = 7;

/**
 * Cleans Whisper output before alignment:
 *  - drops words inside hallucinated segments unless they look real
 *  - removes compressed word-clusters (classic instrumental hallucination)
 *  - enforces monotonic starts and sane durations
 */
export function sanitizeAsrWords(asr: AsrResult): SanitizedAsr {
  const segs = asr.segments ?? [];
  const badSegIds = new Set(
    segs
      .filter((s) => (s.avg_logprob ?? 0) < SEG_LOGPROB_FLOOR)
      .map((s) => s.id ?? -1),
  );

  let source: AsrWord[] = [];
  if (asr.words && asr.words.length > 0) source = asr.words;
  else for (const s of segs) if (s.words) source.push(...s.words);

  let dropped = 0;

  const segFor = (t: number) =>
    segs.find((s) => t >= s.start - 0.5 && t <= s.end + 0.5);

  // Pass 1 — basic validity + segment-aware minimum duration
  let words = source.filter((w) => {
    if (!Number.isFinite(w.start) || !Number.isFinite(w.end) || w.end <= w.start) {
      dropped += 1;
      return false;
    }
    const dur = w.end - w.start;
    const seg = segFor(w.start);
    const inBadSeg = seg ? badSegIds.has(seg.id ?? -999) : false;
    const minDur = inBadSeg ? MIN_WORD_DUR_BAD : MIN_WORD_DUR_GOOD;
    if (dur < minDur) {
      dropped += 1;
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  // Pass 2 — compressed-cluster removal (repeats until stable)
  for (let round = 0; round < 3; round += 1) {
    const doomed = new Set<number>();
    for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += 1) {
      const t0 = words[i]!.start;
      let count = 0;
      for (let j = i; j < words.length && words[j]!.start <= t0 + CLUSTER_WINDOW; j += 1) {
        count += 1;
      }
      if (count >= CLUSTER_MIN) {
        for (let j = i; j < words.length && words[j]!.start <= t0 + CLUSTER_WINDOW; j += 1) {
          doomed.add(j);
        }
      }
    }
    if (doomed.size === 0) break;
    dropped += doomed.size;
    words = words.filter((_, i) => !doomed.has(i));
  }

  // Pass 3 — monotonic starts, clamped durations
  words.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  const out: AsrWord[] = [];
  let prevEnd = -Infinity;
  for (const w of words) {
    let start = w.start;
    if (start < prevEnd) start = prevEnd + 0.005;
    const natural = w.end - start;
    const end =
      natural >= MIN_WORD_DUR_GOOD && natural <= MAX_WORD_DUR
        ? w.end
        : start + Math.max(MIN_WORD_DUR_GOOD, Math.min(natural, MAX_WORD_DUR));
    out.push({ ...w, start, end: Math.max(end, start + MIN_WORD_DUR_GOOD) });
    prevEnd = Math.max(end, start + MIN_WORD_DUR_GOOD);
  }

  return { words: out, droppedWords: dropped, hallucinatedSegments: badSegIds.size };
}

/**
 * Backward-compatible helper to clean raw ASR tokens.
 */
export function sanitizeAsr(words: AsrWord[], audioDurationSec: number): AsrWord[] {
  const result = sanitizeAsrWords({
    text: words.map((w) => w.word).join(" "),
    words,
    duration: audioDurationSec,
  });
  return result.words;
}

/**
 * Computes coverage ratio between clean ASR tokens and expected lyric text.
 */
export function asrCoverage(cleanTokens: AsrWord[], lyricText: string): number {
  const lyricWords = lyricText
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu, " ")
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (lyricWords.length === 0) return 0;
  if (!cleanTokens || cleanTokens.length === 0) return 0;

  return Math.min(1, cleanTokens.length / lyricWords.length);
}

interface ClipMap {
  name: string;
  file: File;
  lineIndex: number;
  isInstrumental: boolean;
  matchScore: number;
  matchReason: string;
  durationSec?: number;
  offsetSec?: number;
  fftLocked?: boolean;
}

function autoMapClip(file: File, lines: { index: number; text: string; instrumental?: boolean }[]): ClipMap {
  const name = file.name;
  const stem = name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").toLowerCase();

  const instrumentalKeywords = ["instrumental", "intro", "gap", "break", "solo", "outro", "interlude", "pause", "music"];
  const hasInstrumentalWord = instrumentalKeywords.some((kw) => stem.includes(kw));

  const cleanStem = stem
    .replace(/^(\d+)[-_]/, "")
    .replace(/line[-_]?0*(\d+)[-_]?/i, "")
    .replace(/[-_.]+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  const stemTokens = cleanStem.split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 1);

  const lineNumMatch = stem.match(/line[-_]?0*(\d+)/i);
  const targetLineNumber = lineNumMatch ? parseInt(lineNumMatch[1], 10) : null;

  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);

  let bestLineIndex = 0;
  let bestScore = 0;
  let bestReason = "Sequential";

  if (hasInstrumentalWord && !targetLineNumber && stemTokens.length <= 2) {
    return { name, file, lineIndex: -1, isInstrumental: true, matchScore: 0.95, matchReason: "Instrumental Gap" };
  }

  if (targetLineNumber !== null && targetLineNumber >= 1 && targetLineNumber <= vocalLines.length) {
    const matchedVocal = vocalLines[targetLineNumber - 1];
    if (matchedVocal) { bestLineIndex = matchedVocal.index; bestScore = 0.98; bestReason = `Line #${targetLineNumber}`; }
  }

  for (const l of vocalLines) {
    const lineLower = l.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, "");
    const lineTokens = lineLower.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);

    if (cleanStem.length > 4 && lineLower.includes(cleanStem)) {
      if (0.99 > bestScore) { bestScore = 0.99; bestLineIndex = l.index; bestReason = "100% Match"; }
    }

    let matchCount = 0;
    for (const st of stemTokens) { if (lineTokens.some((lt) => lt.includes(st) || st.includes(lt))) matchCount++; }
    const tokenScore = stemTokens.length > 0 ? matchCount / stemTokens.length : 0;
    if (tokenScore > bestScore && tokenScore > 0.3) { bestScore = tokenScore; bestLineIndex = l.index; bestReason = `${Math.round(tokenScore * 100)}% Match`; }
  }

  return { name, file, lineIndex: bestLineIndex, isInstrumental: false, matchScore: bestScore || 0.8, matchReason: bestReason };
}

          } catch {}
        }
