                    ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-500 text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.35)] scale-105"
                    : `border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)] ${isComplete ? "text-[var(--accent)] border-[var(--accent)]/30" : "text-[var(--faint)]"} hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:text-[var(--ink)]`
                }`}>
                <span className={`h-5 w-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${isActive ? "bg-black/30" : isComplete ? "bg-[var(--accent)]/20 text-[var(--accent)]" : "bg-white/5"}`}>{item.id}</span>
                <span>{item.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="lf-badge bg-[var(--purple)]/15 text-[var(--purple)] border border-[var(--purple)]/25 text-[11px] font-medium">
            <Radio size={12} className="animate-pulse" /> Auto Music Detect
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--accent)] font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/10">
            <Sparkles size={13} /> Perfect Sync
          </span>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* Main Form Grid */}
      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1.25fr_0.75fr]">
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* STEP 1: API Key */}
          <section ref={keySectionRef} className="lf-card relative overflow-hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-600 text-xs font-bold text-black shadow-md">1</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Groq Whisper API Key</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Word-level timestamps with Whisper Large v3</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {keyOk && <span className="lf-badge bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25"><CheckCircle2 size={13} /> Active & Ready</span>}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--muted)] mb-4">
              Powers instant phonetic transcription and AI semantic alignment. Keys are safely verified directly via SSL.
            </p>
            <div className="relative">
              <input type={showKey ? "text" : "password"} autoComplete="off" placeholder="gsk_…" value={key} onChange={(e) => { setKey(e.target.value); setKeyOk(false); }} className="lf-input pr-10 font-mono text-xs" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowKey(!showKey)} className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors">{showKey ? <EyeOff size={15} /> : <Eye size={15} />}</button>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] cursor-pointer hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={persist === "store"} onChange={(e) => setPersist(e.target.checked ? "store" : "session")} className="accent-[var(--accent)]" />
                  Remember key
                </label>
                {!key && (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => { void fetch("/api/session").then((r) => r.json()).then((j: { defaultKey?: string }) => { if (j.defaultKey) setKey(j.defaultKey); setKeyOk(false); }).catch(() => undefined); }} className="text-xs text-[var(--accent)] hover:underline font-medium">Use server key</button>
                )}
              </div>
              <button type="button" disabled={validating} onClick={() => void validateKey()} className="lf-btn-accent text-xs">
                <KeyRound size={14} /> {validating ? "Verifying…" : keyOk ? "Re-verify" : "Validate Key"}
              </button>
            </div>
            {keyError && <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-[var(--danger)] bg-rose-500/10 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/20">{keyError}</p>}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 2: Master Audio Deck */}
          <section ref={audioSectionRef} className="lf-card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-600 text-xs font-bold text-black shadow-md">2</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Master / Original Audio</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Full song track (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A)</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {audioFile && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => playAudioClip(audioFile, "master")} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1 px-2.5">
                    {playingMaster ? <Square size={13} className="text-amber-400" /> : <Play size={13} className="text-emerald-400" />}
                    {playingMaster ? "Stop" : "Audition"}
                  </button>
                  <span className="lf-badge bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25">{duration.toFixed(1)}s</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()} className="flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg)] px-6 py-8 transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:bg-white/[0.02] group">
              <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)]/10 flex items-center justify-center mb-3 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                <Upload className="text-[var(--accent)]" size={22} />
              </div>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">{audioFile ? audioFile.name : "Drop master audio file or click to browse"}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">{audioMeta || "Supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG"}</span>
            </div>
            <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="audio/*" hidden onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void onAudio(e.target.files[0])} />

            {peaks.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg)] p-4 shadow-inner">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--faint)] mb-2.5">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[var(--accent)] font-medium"><Music size={14} />{audioFile?.name}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs">{duration.toFixed(1)}s</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex h-14 items-end gap-0.5 px-1 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#05070a]">
                  {peaks.map((p, i) => (
                    <span key={i} className="flex-1 rounded-t-sm transition-all" style={{ height: `${Math.max(8, p * 100)}%`, background: `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4), rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.85))` }} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {audioFile && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setAudioFile(null); setPeaks([]); setDuration(0); setAudioMeta(""); if (playingMaster && audioPlayerRef.current) { audioPlayerRef.current.pause(); setPlayingMaster(false); } }} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs !text-red-400 !border-red-500/20 hover:!bg-red-500/10">
                  <Trash2 size={13} /> Remove Audio
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 3: Lyrics & Metadata */}
          <section ref={lyricsSectionRef} className="lf-card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-600 text-xs font-bold text-black shadow-md">3</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Lyric Sheet & Track Details</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Blank lines mark music breaks</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {vocalCount > 0 && <span className="lf-badge bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)] border border-[var(--accent)]/30 font-semibold">{vocalCount} vocal lines</span>}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">
              <div>
                <label className="lf-label">Song Title</label>
                <input type="text" placeholder="e.g. Four In The Morning" value={songTitle} onChange={(e) => setSongTitle(e.target.value)} className="lf-input text-xs" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="lf-label">Artist Name</label>
                <input type="text" placeholder="e.g. Original Artist" value={artistName} onChange={(e) => setArtistName(e.target.value)} className="lf-input text-xs" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 flex-wrap">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => { setSongTitle("Four in the morning"); setArtistName("Original Artist"); setLyrics(SAMPLE_LYRICS); }} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5 px-3">
                <Sparkles size={13} className="text-amber-400" /> Sample Lyrics
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={handlePasteClipboard} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5 px-3">
                <Clipboard size={13} /> Paste
              </button>
              {lyrics && <button type="button" onClick={() => setLyrics("")} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1.5 px-3 !text-red-400 !border-red-500/20 hover:!bg-red-500/10"><Trash2 size={13} /> Clear</button>}
            </div>

            <textarea value={lyrics} onChange={(e) => setLyrics(e.target.value)} placeholder={`[Verse 1]\nFirst lyric line\nSecond lyric line\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one\nChorus line two`} className="lf-input resize-y font-mono text-xs leading-6" style={{ minHeight: "13rem" }} />

            {/* Smart Music Gap Feature Note */}
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--purple)]/20 bg-[var(--purple)]/5 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              <Info size={16} className="text-[var(--purple)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <strong className="text-[var(--ink)]">Automatic Music Breaks ($\ge 3.0$s) Enabled:</strong> Gaps between lyrics, song intros, and outros greater than 3 seconds will automatically display as <span className="text-[var(--purple)] font-semibold">♪ Music ♪</span> blocks with audio-reactive visualizers in the Studio timeline.
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* STEP 4: Cut Audio / Line Slices Deck */}
          <section ref={clipsSectionRef} className="lf-card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--purple)] to-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md">4</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Cut Audio Slices / Stems</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">Optional DSP FFT Cross-Correlation anchors</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {clips.length > 0 && <span className="lf-badge bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25"><CheckCircle2 size={13} /> {clips.length} cuts mapped</span>}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--muted)] mb-4">
              If you have separate vocal slices or cut audio files (e.g., <code>01.wav</code>, <code>line_01.wav</code>), upload them here. The system uses high-speed FFT Cross-Correlation to rigidly lock their exact timing in the master track!
            </p>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => clipRef.current?.click()} className="lf-btn-ghost w-full py-5 justify-center border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] hover:border-[var(--purple)]/50 hover:bg-[var(--purple)]/5 transition-all">
              <FileAudio size={18} className="text-[var(--purple)]" />
              <span className="font-medium text-xs">Add Cut Audio / Line Slices</span>
            </button>
            <input ref={clipRef} type="file" accept="audio/*" multiple hidden onChange={(e) => { if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) handleClipsUpload(Array.from(e.target.files)); }} />

            {clips.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="max-h-56 overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] lf-scroll bg-[var(--bg)] shadow-inner">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                    <thead className="border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)] sticky top-0"><tr>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Play</th>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Clip Name</th>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Matched Lyric Line</th>
                      <th className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] text-right">Lock Status</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody>{clips.map((c, i) => (
                      <tr key={c.name} className="border-t border-white/5 hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2">
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => playAudioClip(c.file, c.name)} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--accent)] transition-colors">
                            {playingClip === c.name ? <Square size={13} className="text-amber-400" /> : <Play size={13} className="text-emerald-400" />}
                          </button>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[180px]" title={c.name}>{c.name}</td>
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2">
                          <select value={c.lineIndex} className="bg-[var(--bg-panel)] border border-[var(--line)] rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:outline-none focus:border-[var(--accent)] cursor-pointer" onChange={(e) => {
                            const next = [...clips]; const val = Number(e.target.value);
                            next[i] = { ...c, lineIndex: val, isInstrumental: val === -1, matchReason: val === -1 ? "Instrumental" : "Manual" }; setClips(next);
                          }}>
                            <option value={-1}>♪ Instrumental Break</option>
                            {parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => <option key={l.index} value={l.index}>#{l.index + 1}: {l.text.slice(0, 32)}</option>)}
                          </select>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-right">
                          <span className={`lf-badge text-[10px] ${c.fftLocked ? "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/25" : c.isInstrumental ? "bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/25" : "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/25"}`}>
                            {c.fftLocked && <Lock size={10} />}
                            {c.matchReason}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}</tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">
                  <span>{clips.filter((c) => c.fftLocked).length} FFT locked cuts</span>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setClips([])} className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs !text-red-400 !border-red-500/20 hover:!bg-red-500/10">Clear all clips</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Launch Deck */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <section className="sticky top-20 lf-card border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-gradient-to-b from-[#111724] to-[#0c1017] shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 mb-4 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[var(--accent)] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Sparkles size={14} /> Production Deck
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]"><Film size={14} /> 1080p60 MP4</span>
            </div>

            {/* Track Summary Card */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e]/80 p-4 mb-5 shadow-inner">
              <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--faint)] mb-1 font-mono">Current Project</p>
              <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--ink)] truncate">{songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || (lyrics ? "Untitled Project" : "Ready for Lyrics")}</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--accent)] mt-0.5 font-medium truncate">{artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist"}</p>
              
              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--bg-panel)] p-2.5 border border-[var(--line)]">
                  <span className="lf-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Master Audio</span>
                  <span className="block font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] mt-0.5">{audioFile ? `${duration.toFixed(1)}s` : "Heuristic"}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--bg-panel)] p-2.5 border border-[var(--line)]">
                  <span className="lf-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Vocal Lines</span>
                  <span className="block font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] mt-0.5">{vocalCount} lines ready</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Action Buttons */}
            <div className="space-y-3 mb-5">
              <button type="button" disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0} onClick={() => void analyze()} className="lf-btn-accent w-full text-sm py-4 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]">
                <Sparkles size={18} /> {running ? "Aligning & Syncing Pipeline…" : audioFile ? "Generate with Multi-Source AI Sync" : "Generate Lyric Video"}
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0} onClick={() => void generateWithoutAudio()} className="lf-btn-ghost w-full text-xs py-2.5">
                <Zap size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Fast Heuristic Mode (No Audio)
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Pipeline Execution Log */}
            {(running || log.length > 0) && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#05070a] p-3.5 space-y-2.5 shadow-inner">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-[var(--accent)] font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5"><AudioLines size={13} /> Pipeline Execution</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[var(--faint)]">{Math.round(progress * 100)}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--line)]">
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] via-amber-300 to-emerald-400 transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${progress * 100}%` }} />
                </div>
                <ul className="max-h-36 overflow-auto space-y-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] pt-1 lf-scroll">
                  {log.slice(-12).map((line, i) => (
                    <li key={`${line}-${i}`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[var(--accent)] select-none">›</span>
                      <span>{line}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Feature Badges */}
            <div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-[var(--line)] space-y-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-emerald-400" /> DSP FFT Cross-Correlation Anchor Precision</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-emerald-400" /> Deep AI Semantic Mapping (Llama 3.3 70B)</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-purple-400" /> Automatic Music & Instrumental Gap Detection (&gt;3s)</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Check size={14} className="text-amber-400" /> Hardware Accelerated 1080p60 WebCodecs MP4</div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { z } from "zod";

/** Industry-standard choice: document times are always float seconds; frames/ms only at display/encode edges. */

export const ASPECT_RATIOS = ["16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "21:9"] as const;
export const RESOLUTIONS = ["1280x720", "1920x1080", "2560x1440", "3840x2160"] as const;
export const FPS_OPTIONS = [24, 25, 30, 50, 60] as const;
export const RIPPLE_MODES = ["independent", "ripple", "roll", "relink"] as const;
export const QUALITY_PRESETS = ["high", "balanced", "small", "custom"] as const;

export const HexColorSchema = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{4}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/);

export const EasingNameSchema = z.enum([
  "linear",
  "ease-in",
  "ease-out",
  "ease-in-out",
  "ease-in-cubic",
  "ease-out-cubic",
  "ease-in-out-cubic",
  "ease-out-back",
  "ease-out-expo",
  ]);

export const EasingSchema = z.object({
  type: z.enum(["named", "cubic-bezier", "spring"]),
  name: EasingNameSchema.optional(),
  bezier: z.tuple([z.number(), z.number(), z.number(), z.number()]).optional(),
  stiffness: z.number().optional(),
  damping: z.number().optional(),
});

export const AnimPresetSchema = z.enum([
  "none",
  "fade",
  "slide",
  "scale",
  "blur",
  "typewriter",
  "cascade",
  "wipe",
  "spring",
  "pop",
  "bounce",
  "wave",
]);

export const AnimSpecSchema = z.object({
  preset: AnimPresetSchema,
  durationSec: z.number().nonnegative(),
  delaySec: z.number().nonnegative(),
  easing: EasingSchema,
  direction: z.enum(["up", "down", "left", "right"]).optional(),
  distance: z.number().optional(),
  staggerSec: z.number().optional(),
});

export const HighlightStyleSchema = z.enum([
  "none",
  "color",
  "sweep",
  "box",
  "scale",
  "underline",
  "glow",
  "shimmer",
]);

export const OVERLAY_TYPES = [
  "none",
  "bokeh",
  "starfield",
  "soundwave",
  "embers",
  "light-leak",
  "scanlines",
  "lottie",
] as const;

export const OverlaySpecSchema = z.object({
  type: z.enum(OVERLAY_TYPES).default("none"),
  opacity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.6),
  speed: z.number().min(0.1).max(5).default(1),
  blendMode: z.enum(["source-over", "screen", "lighter"]).default("screen"),
  scale: z.number().min(0.2).max(3).default(1),
  lottieJson: z.string().optional(),
  lottieName: z.string().optional(),
});

export type OverlaySpec = z.infer<typeof OverlaySpecSchema>;

export const HighlightSpecSchema = z.object({
  style: HighlightStyleSchema,
  intensity: z.number().min(0).max(2).default(1),
  enabled: z.boolean().default(true).optional(),
});

export const ShadowSchema = z.object({
  x: z.number(),
  y: z.number(),
  blur: z.number().nonnegative(),
  color: z.string(),
  opacity: z.number().min(0).max(1),
});

export const GlowSchema = z.object({
  color: z.string(),
  blur: z.number().nonnegative(),
  opacity: z.number().min(0).max(1),
});

export const GradientStopSchema = z.object({
  offset: z.number().min(0).max(1),
  color: z.string(),
});

export const GradientSchema = z.object({

export function defaultProject(partial?: Partial<Project>): Project {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    id: partial?.id ?? "proj_draft",
    version: CURRENT_VERSION,
    meta: {
      title: "Untitled",
      artist: "Unknown Artist",
      durationSec: 0,
      fps: 30,
      resolution: "1920x1080",
      aspectRatio: "16:9",
      language: "en",
      ...partial?.meta,
    },
    media: {
      background: defaultBackground(),
      ...partial?.media,
    },
    defaultStyle: partial?.defaultStyle ?? defaultStyle(),
    captions: partial?.captions ?? [],
    settings: {
      rippleMode: "ripple",
      snapping: true,
      quality: "high",
      previewQuality: "full",
      instrumentalDisplay: "auto",
      karaoke: true,
      syncOffsetMs: 0,
      wordLeadMs: -40,
      ...partial?.settings,
    },
    presetId: partial?.presetId ?? "seven-clouds",
    createdAt: partial?.createdAt ?? now,
    updatedAt: partial?.updatedAt ?? now,
  };
}

type LooseRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is LooseRecord {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/** v0 → v1 is a documented no-op so the migrate() chain exists and is tested. */
export function migrateV0ToV1(doc: unknown): unknown {
  if (!isRecord(doc)) return doc;
  const next: LooseRecord = { ...doc };
  if (next.version === 0 || next.version === undefined) {
    next.version = 1;
  }
  return next;
}

export function migrate(doc: unknown): Project {
  let current = doc;
  if (isRecord(current) && (current.version === 0 || current.version === undefined)) {
    current = migrateV0ToV1(current);
  }
  const parsed = ProjectSchema.safeParse(current);
  if (parsed.success) return parsed.data;
  if (isRecord(current)) {
    const fallback = defaultProject({
      id: typeof current.id === "string" ? current.id : undefined,
      meta: {
        title: typeof current.meta === "object" && current.meta && "title" in current.meta
          ? String((current.meta as LooseRecord).title ?? "Untitled")
          : "Untitled",
        artist: "Unknown Artist",
        durationSec: 0,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
    });
    return ProjectSchema.parse(fallback);
  }
  return defaultProject();
}

export const DOCUMENT_VERSION = CURRENT_VERSION;

function Shortcuts({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  if (!open) return null;
  const rows = [
    ["Space", "Play / pause"],
    ["J / K / L", "Back / pause / forward"],
    ["I / O", "Mark in / out"],
    ["S / M", "Split / merge"],
    ["Home / End", "Start / end"],
    ["[ / ]", "Prev / next caption"],
    ["Arrows", "Nudge 1 frame"],
    ["Shift+Arrows", "Nudge 10 frames"],
    ["Ctrl+Z / Shift+Z", "Undo / redo"],
    ["?", "This overlay"],
  ];
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] grid place-items-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-8" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0e131f] p-6 lf-enter shadow-2xl" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-3">
          <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles size={18} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Keyboard Shortcuts
          </h2>
          <span className="text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">Press Esc to close</span>
        </div>
        <dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-3 text-sm">
          {rows.map(([k, v]) => (
            <div key={k} className="contents">
              <dt className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--accent)] bg-[#05070a] px-2 py-1 rounded border border-white/5 w-fit">{k}</dt>
              <dd className="text-xs text-[var(--muted)] flex items-center">{v}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function HeaderMenu({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const studio = useStudio();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!(e.target as HTMLElement).closest("[data-header-menu]")) onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const items = [
    { label: "Paste / Edit Lyrics", icon: FileText, action: () => { onClose(); studio.openLyricsModal(); } },
    { label: "Re-sync Captions", icon: RefreshCw, action: () => { onClose(); studio.openResyncModal(); } },
  ];

  return (
    <div data-header-menu className="absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-1.5 w-52 rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#111726] p-1.5 shadow-2xl lf-enter backdrop-blur-xl" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <button
          key={item.label}
          type="button"
          onClick={item.action}
          className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors"
        >
          <item.icon size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
          {item.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function StudioInner({ audioUrl, peaks }: { audioUrl: string | null; peaks: number[] }) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const [help, setHelp] = useState(false);
  const [lyricsModalOpen, setLyricsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lyricsSheetText, setLyricsSheetText] = useState("");
  const [resyncModalOpen, setResyncModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const [exportPct, setExportPct] = useState(0);
  const [exportMsg, setExportMsg] = useState("");
  const [res, setRes] = useState("1920x1080");
  const [fps, setFps] = useState(30);
  const [quality, setQuality] = useState<"high" | "balanced" | "small">("high");
  const [headerMenuOpen, setHeaderMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const abort = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const saveTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Expose modal openers on the studio API
  useEffect(() => {
    studio._openLyricsModal = () => {
      const lines = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental).map((c) => c.text).join("\n");
      const metaHeader = `## title: ${studio.project.meta.title}\n## artist: ${studio.project.meta.artist}\n\n`;
      setLyricsSheetText(metaHeader + lines);
      setLyricsModalOpen(true);
    };
    studio._openResyncModal = () => setResyncModalOpen(true);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleApplyLyricsSheet = () => {
    if (!lyricsSheetText.trim()) return;
    studio.replaceLyrics(lyricsSheetText);
    setLyricsModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleResyncCaptions = () => {
    const lines = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental).map((c) => c.text).join("\n");
    const parsed = parseLyrics(lines);
    const dur = studio.project.meta.durationSec > 0 ? studio.project.meta.durationSec : 60;
    const synced = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, dur);
    studio.commit((d) => { d.captions = synced.captions; });
    studio.setPlayhead(0);
    studio.notify("Re-synced all captions across audio duration.");
    setResyncModalOpen(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("lf-layout");
    if (!raw) return;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { left?: number; right?: number; bottom?: number };
      if (parsed.left) studio.setPanelSize("left", parsed.left);
      if (parsed.right) studio.setPanelSize("right", parsed.right);
      if (parsed.bottom) studio.setPanelSize("bottom", parsed.bottom);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem("lf-layout", JSON.stringify({ left: studio.leftWidth, right: studio.rightWidth, bottom: studio.bottomHeight }));
  }, [studio.leftWidth, studio.rightWidth, studio.bottomHeight]);

  const { project, dirty, markSaved } = studio;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) return;
    if (saveTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    saveTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
      }).then(() => markSaved()).catch(() => undefined);
    }, 700);
  }, [project, dirty, markSaved]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName;
      if (tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT") return;
      if (e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); studio.setPlaying(!studio.playing); }
      if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "J") studio.setPlayhead(Math.max(0, studio.playhead - 2));
      if (e.key === "l" || e.key === "L") studio.setPlayhead(Math.min(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 9999, studio.playhead + 2));
      if (e.key === "k" || e.key === "K") studio.setPlaying(false);
      if (e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") studio.splitAtPlayhead();
      if (e.key === "m" || e.key === "M") studio.mergeSelected();
      if (e.key === "Home") studio.setPlayhead(0);
      if (e.key === "End") studio.setPlayhead(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 0);
      if (e.key === "[") {
        const prev = [...studio.project.captions].reverse().find((c) => c.startSec < studio.playhead - 0.01);
        if (prev) { studio.setPlayhead(prev.startSec); studio.select([prev.id]); }
      }
      if (e.key === "]") {
        const next = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.startSec > studio.playhead + 0.01);
        if (next) { studio.setPlayhead(next.startSec); studio.select([next.id]); }
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? -10 : -1);
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1);
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.shiftKey) studio.redo(); else studio.undo();
      }
      if (e.key === "?" || (e.shiftKey && e.key === "/")) setHelp((v) => !v);
      if (e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") studio.deleteSelected();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [studio]);

  const flagged = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6);
  const album = ART[studio.project.presetId ?? "seven-clouds"] ?? "/images/art-default.jpg";

  async function runExport() {
    const [w, h] = res.split("x").map(Number);
    const ok = await isWebCodecsSupported(w || 1920, h || 1080);
    if (!ok) {
      studio.notify("WebCodecs unavailable — trying FFmpeg fallback.");
      const response = await fetch("/api/export", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format: "mp4", width: w, height: h }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) { studio.notify("FFmpeg fallback is not available in this environment."); return; }
      const blob = await response.blob();
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.mp4`);
      return;
    }
    setExporting(true);
    abort.current = new AbortController();
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    const bgAssetId = studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId;
    let customBlob: Blob | null = null;
    if (bgAssetId) { customBlob = (await getBlob(bgAssetId)) ?? null; }
    const img = new Image();
    if (customBlob) { img.src = URL.createObjectURL(customBlob); } else { img.src = album; }
    await img.decode().catch(() => undefined);
    let audioBuffer: AudioBuffer | null = null;
    if (audioUrl) { const buf = await fetch(audioUrl).then((r) => r.arrayBuffer()); audioBuffer = await decodeAudio(buf); }
    const durationSec = audioBuffer?.duration || studio.project.meta.durationSec || 8;
    const totalFrames = Math.round(durationSec * fps);
    const spectrumFrames = audioBuffer ? computeSpectrumFrames(audioBuffer, fps, totalFrames) : undefined;
    try {
      const blob = await exportWebCodecsMp4(
        { ...studio.project, meta: { ...studio.project.meta, durationSec, fps, resolution: res as Project["meta"]["resolution"] } },
        canvas, { albumArt: img, backgroundImage: img }, audioBuffer,
        { width: w, height: h, fps, quality, spectrumFrames, signal: abort.current.signal, onProgress: (p) => {
          const elapsedSec = p.elapsedMs / 1000;
          const etaSec = p.pct > 0.02 ? Math.round(((1 - p.pct) / p.pct) * elapsedSec) : 0;
          const etaStr = etaSec > 0 ? ` · ETA: ${etaSec}s` : "";
          setExportPct(p.pct);
          setExportMsg(`Frame ${p.frame}/${p.total} (${Math.round(p.pct * 100)}%)${etaStr}`);
        }},
      );
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${res}_${fps}fps.mp4`);
      studio.notify("Export complete.");
      setExportOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      studio.notify(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Export failed.");
    } finally { setExporting(false); }
  }

  async function sideExport(format: "srt" | "vtt" | "ass" | "json") {
    const res = await fetch("/api/export", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format }) });
    const blob = await res.blob();
    downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.${format}`);
  }

  return (

      {/* ===== HEADER ===== */}

            <img src="/images/mark.png" alt="" className="h-full w-full rounded-[10px] object-cover" />
          </div>
          <span className="text-sm font-bold tracking-tight bg-gradient-to-r from-white to-neutral-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">LyricForge</span>
        </Link>

        {/* Title + Save */}

          <input
            value={studio.project.meta.title}
            onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.title = e.target.value; })}
            className="h-8 max-w-[220px] rounded-lg border border-transparent bg-white/[0.04] px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-white/[0.08] focus:bg-[#07090e] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[var(--accent)] transition-all truncate"
            title="Project Title"
          />
          <span className={`lf-badge text-[10px] ${studio.dirty ? "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30" : "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30"}`}>
            {studio.dirty ? "Unsaved" : "Saved"}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

        {/* Undo / Redo */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Tooltip label="Undo" shortcut="⌘Z">

          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Redo" shortcut="⇧⌘Z">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[30px] !min-h-[30px]" disabled={!studio.canRedo} onClick={studio.redo}><Redo2 size={15} /></button>
          </Tooltip>
        </div>

        <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

        {/* Tools dropdown */}
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setHeaderMenuOpen(!headerMenuOpen)}
            className="lf-btn-ghost text-xs py-1 px-2.5"
          >
            Tools <ChevronDown size={12} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
          </button>
          <HeaderMenu open={headerMenuOpen} onClose={() => setHeaderMenuOpen(false)} />
        </div>

        {/* Aspect ratio */}
        <select
          value={studio.project.meta.aspectRatio}
          className="lf-select text-xs h-8 px-2 py-0"
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.aspectRatio = e.target.value as Project["meta"]["aspectRatio"]; })}
        >
          {["16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "21:9"].map((a) => <option key={a}>{a}</option>)}

              <PanelLeft size={15} />

              <PanelBottom size={15} />

              <PanelRight size={15} />

          </Tooltip>

            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[32px] !min-h-[32px]" onClick={() => setHelp(true)}>

        </div>

        <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />

        <button type="button" className="lf-btn-accent text-xs font-semibold py-1.5 px-4 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]" onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}>
          <Download size={14} /> Export Video
        </button>
      </header>

      {/* ===== MAIN LAYOUT ===== */}
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        {/* Left Panel — Captions */}
        {studio.leftOpen && (
          <aside className="flex flex-col border-r border-[var(--line)] bg-[#090d16]" style={{ width: studio.leftWidth }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d121e] px-4 py-2.5">
              <span className="lf-label flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
                Captions <span className="bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)] font-mono text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-[var(--accent)]/30">{studio.project.captions.length}</span>
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Tooltip label="Add new caption at playhead">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => studio.addCaption("New lyric line")}
                    className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[28px] !min-h-[28px] !p-1"
                  >
                    <Plus size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />

                </Tooltip>
              </div>
            </div>

            {flagged.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mx-3 mt-2.5">
                <button

            <ul className="lf-scroll flex-1 space-y-2 overflow-auto p-3">
              {studio.project.captions.map((c) => {
                const isSelected = studio.selectedIds.includes(c.id);

      <Modal open={exportOpen} title="Export Studio Master Video" onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)} onConfirm={() => void runExport()} confirmLabel={exporting ? "Exporting…" : "Render MP4 1080p60"}>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--accent)]/20 bg-[var(--accent)]/5 p-3 flex items-center gap-3">

            </div>
          </div>
          {exporting && (

              </div>

                <p className="font-mono text-[var(--muted)]">{exportMsg}</p>
                <button type="button" className="text-xs text-rose-400 hover:underline font-semibold" onClick={() => abort.current?.abort()}>Cancel Export</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function StudioApp({ initial }: { initial: Project }) {
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>(() =>
    Array.from({ length: 180 }, (_, i) => Math.round((0.2 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 6))) * 100) / 100),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void (async () => {
      const blob = (await getBlob(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getBlob("draft-master"));
      if (blob) setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      const stored = (await getPeaks(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getPeaks("draft-master"));
      if (stored) setPeaks(Array.from(stored));
    })();
  }, [initial.id]);

  const project = useMemo(() => initial, [initial]);
  return (
    <StudioProvider initial={project}>
      <StudioInner audioUrl={audioUrl} peaks={peaks} />
    </StudioProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Pause, Play, Repeat, Volume2, VolumeX, Maximize2, SkipBack, SkipForward, RotateCcw, RotateCw, Activity } from "lucide-react";
import { drawFrame, asFrameContext, type ResolvedAssets } from "@/render-engine";
import { LottiePlayer } from "@/lib/lottie-renderer";
import { formatTimecode } from "@/lib/time";
import { useStudio } from "@/store/studio-store";
import { Tooltip } from "../ui-kit";

export function PreviewCanvas({
  audioUrl,
  albumUrl,
}: {
  audioUrl: string | null;
  albumUrl: string;
}) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const studioRef = useRef(studio);
  studioRef.current = studio;

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement>(null);
  const artRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const ctxClock = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const lottiePlayerRef = useRef<LottiePlayer | null>(null);

  const startedAt = useRef(0);
  const offset = useRef(0);
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const [fps, setFps] = useState(60);
  const [dropped, setDropped] = useState(0);
  const lastTs = useRef(0);
  const frames = useRef(0);
  const lastStateSync = useRef(0);

  const customBgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const analyserRef = useRef<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const freqDataRef = useRef<Uint8Array | null>(null);

  // Load Album Art
  useEffect(() => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = albumUrl;
    img.onload = () => { artRef.current = img; };
  }, [albumUrl]);

  // Load Custom Background Image from IDB
  useEffect(() => {
    const assetId = studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId;
    if (assetId && assetId.startsWith("bg-")) {
      import("@/lib/idb").then(({ getBlob }) => {
        getBlob(assetId).then((blob) => {
          if (blob) {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const img = new Image();
            img.src = url;
            img.onload = () => { customBgRef.current = img; };
          }
        });
      }).catch(() => undefined);
    } else {
      customBgRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId]);

  // Manage Lottie Player
  useEffect(() => {
    const overlay = studio.project.media?.background?.overlay;
    if (overlay?.type === "lottie" && overlay.lottieJson) {
      if (!lottiePlayerRef.current) { lottiePlayerRef.current = new LottiePlayer(640, 360); }
      lottiePlayerRef.current.load(overlay.lottieJson);
    } else {
      if (lottiePlayerRef.current) { lottiePlayerRef.current.destroy(); lottiePlayerRef.current = null; }
    }
  }, [studio.project.media?.background?.overlay?.type, studio.project.media?.background?.overlay?.lottieJson]);

  const latestSpectrumRef = useRef<number[] | null>(null);
  const errorCountRef = useRef(0);
  const lastDrawKeyRef = useRef("");

  // Main render loop
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false, desynchronized: true });
    if (!ctx) return;

    let cancelled = false;

    const loop = (now: number) => {
      if (!cancelled) raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);

      try {
        const s = studioRef.current;
        const audio = audioRef.current;
        let t = s.playhead;

        if (s.playing) {
          if (audio && !audio.paused && Number.isFinite(audio.currentTime)) {
            t = audio.currentTime;
          } else if (ctxClock.current) {
            t = offset.current + ctxClock.current.currentTime - startedAt.current;
          }

          if (t >= s.project.meta.durationSec - 0.01) {
            if (s.loop) {
              t = 0; offset.current = 0;
              if (ctxClock.current) startedAt.current = ctxClock.current.currentTime;
              if (audio) audio.currentTime = 0;
            } else {
              s.setPlaying(false); t = s.project.meta.durationSec;
            }
          }

          if (now - lastStateSync.current > 66) {
            s.setPlayhead(t);
            lastStateSync.current = now;
          }
        }

        const draft = s.project.settings.previewQuality === "draft";
        const [rw, rh] = (s.project.meta.resolution || "1920x1080").split("x").map(Number);
        const capW = draft ? 960 : 1600;
        const nativeW = rw || 1920;
        const nativeH = rh || 1080;
        const k = Math.min(1, capW / nativeW);
        const w = Math.round(nativeW * k);
        const h = Math.round(nativeH * k);
        if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
          canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
          lastDrawKeyRef.current = "";
        }

        let lottieFrame: HTMLCanvasElement | undefined;
        if (lottiePlayerRef.current?.isReady()) {
          lottieFrame = lottiePlayerRef.current.renderFrame(t) ?? undefined;
        }

        let spectrum: number[] | undefined;
        if (analyserRef.current && freqDataRef.current && s.playing) {
          analyserRef.current.getByteFrequencyData(freqDataRef.current as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>);
          spectrum = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) spectrum.push((freqDataRef.current[i] ?? 0) / 255);
          latestSpectrumRef.current = spectrum;
        }

        if (!s.playing) {
          const key = `${t.toFixed(3)}|${s.project.updatedAt}|${w}x${h}|${lottieFrame ? "L" : ""}`;
          if (key === lastDrawKeyRef.current) return;
          lastDrawKeyRef.current = key;
        }

        const assets: ResolvedAssets = {
          albumArt: artRef.current ?? undefined,
          backgroundImage: customBgRef.current ?? artRef.current ?? undefined,
          lottieFrame,
          spectrum,
        };

        drawFrame(asFrameContext(ctx), s.project, t, assets);
        errorCountRef.current = 0;

        frames.current += 1;
        if (lastTs.current && now - lastTs.current > 1000) {
          setFps(frames.current);
          setDropped(Math.max(0, Math.round((s.project.meta.fps || 60) - frames.current)));
          frames.current = 0; lastTs.current = now;
        } else if (!lastTs.current) {
          lastTs.current = now;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (errorCountRef.current < 5) {
          errorCountRef.current += 1;
          console.error("[preview] drawFrame failed:", err);
        }
      }
    };

    raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
      if (lottiePlayerRef.current) { lottiePlayerRef.current.destroy(); lottiePlayerRef.current = null; }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (audio) audio.volume = studio.volume;
  }, [studio.volume]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;

    if (studio.playing) {
      if (!ctxClock.current) { try { ctxClock.current = new AudioContext(); } catch { ctxClock.current = null; } }
      const ac = ctxClock.current;
      if (ac) {
        void ac.resume();
        if (!analyserRef.current) {
          try {
            const source = ac.createMediaElementSource(audio);
            const analyser = ac.createAnalyser();
            analyser.fftSize = 128; analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.72;
            source.connect(analyser); analyser.connect(ac.destination);
            analyserRef.current = analyser;
            freqDataRef.current = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
          } catch (err) { console.warn("[preview] analyser unavailable:", err); }
        }
        startedAt.current = ac.currentTime;
      }
      offset.current = studioRef.current.playhead;
      if (Math.abs(audio.currentTime - studioRef.current.playhead) > 0.05) {
        audio.currentTime = studioRef.current.playhead;
      }
      void audio.play().catch((e) => console.warn("[preview] play blocked:", e));
    } else {
      audio.pause();
    }
  }, [studio.playing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio || studio.playing) return;
    if (Math.abs(audio.currentTime - studio.playhead) > 0.05) {
      audio.currentTime = studio.playhead;
    }
  }, [studio.playhead, studio.playing]);

  const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    if (document.fullscreenElement) { void document.exitFullscreen(); } else { void containerRef.current.requestFullscreen(); }
  };

  const aspect = (studio.project.meta.aspectRatio || "16:9").replace(":", " / ");
  const duration = studio.project.meta.durationSec || 0;
  const progress = duration > 0 ? (studio.playhead / duration) * 100 : 0;

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[#07080c]">
      {/* Canvas Area */}
      <div className="relative grid flex-1 place-items-center overflow-hidden lf-grid p-4">
        <div className="relative max-h-full max-w-full lf-safe shadow-2xl rounded-xl overflow-hidden" style={{ aspectRatio: aspect, width: "min(100%, 1100px)" }}>
          <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="h-full w-full rounded-xl shadow-2xl" />
        </div>
        {audioUrl ? <audio ref={audioRef} src={audioUrl} preload="auto" /> : null}
      </div>

      {/* Transport Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d111a] px-6 py-3 flex-wrap shadow-lg">
        {/* Playback controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Tooltip label="Go to start (Home)">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon" onClick={() => studio.setPlayhead(0)}>
              <SkipBack size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Skip back 5s">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon" onClick={() => studio.setPlayhead(Math.max(0, studio.playhead - 5))}>
              <RotateCcw size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label={studio.playing ? "Pause (Space)" : "Play (Space)"} shortcut="Space">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-400 text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,158,11,0.4)] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all"
              onClick={() => studio.setPlaying(!studio.playing)}
            >
              {studio.playing ? <Pause size={18} fill="currentColor" /> : <Play size={18} fill="currentColor" className="ml-0.5" />}
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Skip forward 5s">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon" onClick={() => studio.setPlayhead(Math.min(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 9999, studio.playhead + 5))}>
              <RotateCw size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Go to end (End)">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-icon" onClick={() => studio.setPlayhead(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 0)}>
              <SkipForward size={15} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
        </div>

        {/* Time display + scrub progress */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 max-w-[360px] ml-2">
          <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-[var(--ink)] font-semibold min-w-[4.8rem] bg-[#05070a] px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-[var(--line)]">{formatTimecode(studio.playhead)}</span>
          <div
            className="flex-1 h-2 cursor-pointer rounded-full bg-[#182030] relative group"
            onClick={(e) => {
              const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
              const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
              studio.setPlayhead(pct * (studio.project.meta.durationSec || 1));
            }}
          >
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-300 transition-all duration-75"
              style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
            />
            <div
              className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)] shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(245,158,11,0.8)] opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
              style={{ left: `calc(${progress}% - 7px)` }}
            />
          </div>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-[var(--faint)] min-w-[4.8rem]">{formatTimecode(duration)}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 ml-2">

            type="button"
            className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[32px] !min-h-[32px]"

        {/* Loop */}
        <Tooltip label="Toggle Loop">

        {/* Spacer */}

          >
            {studio.project.settings.previewQuality}
          </button>
          <Tooltip label="Fullscreen">

              <Maximize2 size={14} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
        </div>
      </div>

  );

"use client";

import { useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { formatTimecode } from "@/lib/time";
import { useStudio } from "@/store/studio-store";
import { Maximize2, Minus, Music2, Plus, Scissors, Unlink } from "lucide-react";
import { Tooltip } from "../ui-kit";

export function Timeline({ peaks }: { peaks: number[] }) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const duration = Math.max(0.1, studio.project.meta.durationSec);
  const pxPerSec = 80 * studio.zoom;
  const width = Math.max(800, duration * pxPerSec);

  const ticks = useMemo(() => {
    const step = studio.zoom > 4 ? 0.5 : studio.zoom > 1.5 ? 1 : 5;
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (let t = 0; t <= duration; t += step) out.push(t);
    return out;
  }, [duration, studio.zoom]);

  function timeFromEvent(e: React.MouseEvent) {
    const box = ref.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!box) return 0;
    const x = e.clientX - box.left + (ref.current?.scrollLeft ?? 0);
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(duration, x / pxPerSec));
  }

  const modeButtons = [
    { mode: "independent" as const, label: "Free" },
    { mode: "ripple" as const, label: "Ripple" },
    { mode: "roll" as const, label: "Roll" },
    { mode: "relink" as const, label: "Relink" },
  ];

  const handleFitZoom = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const containerWidth = ref.current.clientWidth - 40;
    if (containerWidth > 0 && duration > 0) {
      const calculated = containerWidth / (duration * 80);
      studio.setZoom(Math.max(0.2, Math.min(10, calculated)));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[#07090e]">
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d111a] px-4 py-2 flex-wrap">
        {/* Ripple modes */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#05070a] border border-[var(--line)] rounded-lg p-0.5">
          {modeButtons.map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.mode}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => studio.setRippleMode(item.mode)}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium rounded-md transition-all ${
                studio.project.settings.rippleMode === item.mode
                  ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-500 text-[var(--accent-ink)] font-bold shadow-sm"
                  : "text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
              }`}
            >
              {item.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Quick Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Tooltip label="Split line at playhead (S)">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-[11px] py-1 px-2.5" onClick={() => studio.splitAtPlayhead()}>
              <Scissors size={12} className="text-amber-400" /> Split
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Merge selected lines (M)">
            <button type="button" className="lf-btn-ghost text-[11px] py-1 px-2.5" onClick={() => studio.mergeSelected()}>
              <Unlink size={12} className="text-cyan-400" /> Merge
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
        </div>

        {/* Zoom Controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 ml-auto">
          <Tooltip label="Zoom Out">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[28px] !min-h-[28px] !p-1"
              onClick={() => studio.setZoom(Math.max(0.25, studio.zoom * 0.8))}
            >
              <Minus size={13} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--ink)] font-semibold min-w-[3rem] text-center">
            {studio.zoom.toFixed(1)}×
          </span>
          <Tooltip label="Zoom In">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="lf-btn-icon !min-w-[28px] !min-h-[28px] !p-1"
              onClick={() => studio.setZoom(Math.min(50, studio.zoom * 1.25))}
            >
              <Plus size={13} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Fit to timeline width">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="lf-btn-ghost text-[10px] py-1 px-2"
              onClick={handleFitZoom}
            >
              <Maximize2 size={11} /> Fit
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 bg-[#05070a] border border-[var(--line)] rounded-md p-0.5 ml-1">
            {[1, 2, 5].map((z) => (
              <button
                key={z}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => studio.setZoom(z)}
                className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono rounded ${
                  Math.abs(studio.zoom - z) < 0.2 ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-black font-bold" : "text-[var(--faint)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                }`}
              >
                {z}x
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Scrollable timeline area */}
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className="lf-scroll flex-1 overflow-auto bg-[#07090e]"
        onWheel={(e) => {
          if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const next = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(200, studio.zoom * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.88)));
            studio.setZoom(next);
          }
        }}
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          if ((e.target as HTMLElement).dataset.block) return;
          studio.setPlayhead(timeFromEvent(e));
        }}
      >
        <div className="relative" style={{ width, height: 176 }}>
          {/* Time ruler */}
          <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex h-7 border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0a0d14] backdrop-blur-md">
            {ticks.map((t) => (
              <span key={t} className="absolute top-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)] select-none pl-1 border-l border-white/5" style={{ left: t * pxPerSec }}>
                {formatTimecode(t, 30, false)}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Waveform */}
          <div className="relative mx-0 mt-1 flex h-10 items-end gap-px px-0 bg-[#05070a]/60" suppressHydrationWarning>
            {peaks.map((p, i) => (
              <span
                key={i}
                className="flex-1 rounded-t-sm transition-colors"
                style={{
                  height: `${Math.round(Math.max(6, p * 100))}%`,
                  background: `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25), rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.65))`,
                }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Caption blocks */}
          {studio.project.captions.map((cap) => {
            const left = Math.round(cap.startSec * pxPerSec);
            const w = Math.round(Math.max(16, (cap.endSec - cap.startSec) * pxPerSec));
            const selected = studio.selectedIds.includes(cap.id);
            const isMusic = Boolean(cap.instrumental || !cap.text || cap.text.trim() === "♪" || cap.text.toLowerCase().includes("instrumental") || cap.text.toLowerCase().includes("music"));

            let bgColor: string;
            let borderColor: string;
            if (isMusic) {
              bgColor = "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.22) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15) 100%)";
              borderColor = "rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.55)";
            } else if (cap.confidence < 0.35) {
              bgColor = "rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15)";
              borderColor = "rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.5)";
            } else if (cap.confidence < 0.6) {
              bgColor = "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15)";
              borderColor = "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.45)";
            } else {
              bgColor = "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)";
              borderColor = "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35)";
            }

            return (
              <div
                key={cap.id}
                data-block="1"
                className={`absolute cursor-grab overflow-hidden rounded-xl border text-[11px] transition-all shadow-md ${
                  selected
                    ? "ring-2 ring-[var(--accent)] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#07090e] z-10 scale-[1.02]"
                    : "hover:brightness-125"
                }`}
                style={{
                  left,
                  width: w,
                  top: 92,
                  height: 52,
                  background: bgColor,
                  borderColor: selected ? "var(--accent)" : borderColor,
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  studio.select([cap.id], e.shiftKey);
                  const startX = e.clientX;
                  const orig = cap.startSec;
                  const move = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
                    const dt = (ev.clientX - startX) / pxPerSec;
                    if (studio.project.settings.rippleMode === "roll") {
                      studio.rollCaption(cap.id, cap.endSec + dt);
                    } else {
                      studio.moveCaption(cap.id, orig + dt);
                    }
                  };
                  const up = () => {
                    window.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
                    window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
                  };
                  window.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
                  window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
                }}
                onDoubleClick={() => {
                  const next = window.prompt("Edit line text", cap.text);
                  if (next !== null) studio.updateCaptionText(cap.id, next);
                }}
              >
                {/* Left edge handle */}
                <span
                  data-block="1"
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-2.5 cursor-ew-resize rounded-l-xl hover:bg-white/25 transition-colors"
                  onMouseDown={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const startX = e.clientX;
                    const orig = cap.startSec;
                    const move = (ev: MouseEvent) => studio.resizeCaption(cap.id, "in", orig + (ev.clientX - startX) / pxPerSec);
                    const up = () => { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", move); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up); };
                    window.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
                    window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
                  }}
                />
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate px-3 py-3 font-medium">
                  {isMusic && <Music2 size={13} className="text-purple-400 shrink-0" />}
                  <span className="truncate">{cap.text || "♪ Music ♪"}</span>
                </div>
                {/* Right edge handle */}
                <span
                  data-block="1"
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-2.5 cursor-ew-resize rounded-r-xl hover:bg-white/25 transition-colors"
                  onMouseDown={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const startX = e.clientX;
                    const orig = cap.endSec;
                    const move = (ev: MouseEvent) => studio.resizeCaption(cap.id, "out", orig + (ev.clientX - startX) / pxPerSec);
                    const up = () => { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", move); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up); };
                    window.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
                    window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            );
          })}

          {/* Playhead */}
          <div
            className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 z-20 h-full w-px"
            style={{
              left: studio.playhead * pxPerSec,
              background: "linear-gradient(to bottom, #f59e0b, #fbbf24)",
              boxShadow: "0 0 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6)",
            }}
          >
            <div className="absolute -top-1 -left-[5px] w-[11px] h-[11px] rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(245,158,11,0.8)]" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const SAMPLE_LYRICS = `[Verse 1]
Four in the morning
And I'm still wide awake
Counting the cracks in the ceiling
Like they're my last mistake

[Chorus]
If the night is a map then I'm lost on purpose
Pin every heartbeat to a borrowed sky
Say it slower so the dark can rehearse us

[Verse 2]

Your laugh still lives in the hallway light
I would trade the whole constellation
