function sse(event: string, data: unknown): string {
  return `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const form = await req.formData();
  const lyrics = String(form.get("lyrics") ?? "");
  const language = String(form.get("language") ?? "en");
  const durationSec = Number(form.get("durationSec") ?? 0);
  const assetId = String(form.get("assetId") ?? "");
  const title = String(form.get("title") ?? "");
  const artist = String(form.get("artist") ?? "");
  const audio = form.get("audio");
  const parsed = parseLyrics(lyrics);
  if (title && !parsed.title) parsed.title = title;
  if (artist && !parsed.artist) parsed.artist = artist;

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const started = Date.now();
  const stream = new ReadableStream({
    async start(controller) {
      const send = (stage: AnalyzeProgress["stage"], label: string, progress: number, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        const payload: AnalyzeProgress & Record<string, unknown> = {
          stage,
          label,
          progress,
          elapsedMs: Date.now() - started,
          ...extra,
        };
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sse("progress", payload)));
      };
      try {
        send("A", "Preprocess — inspecting audio and lyric sheet", 0.08);
        if (parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).length === 0) {
          throw new Error("Lyric sheet is empty. Paste lines; blank lines mark instrumental gaps.");
        }

        send("B", "FFT anchors — waiting on optional split clips", 0.16, {
          detail: "No split clips supplied; skipping Stage B (highest-quality anchors).",
        });

        let apiKey: string | null = null;
        try {
          apiKey = await readGroqKey();
        } catch {
          apiKey = null;
        }

        let asr: AsrResult | null = null;
        let modelId = "heuristic";

        if (apiKey) {
          send("C", "Contacting Groq Whisper for word-level ASR", 0.28);
          const models = await validateKey(apiKey);
          modelId = models.asr;
          let blob: Blob | null = null;
          let filename = "audio.wav";
          let sha = "";
          if (audio instanceof File) {
            blob = audio;
            filename = audio.name;
            const buf = Buffer.from(await audio.arrayBuffer());
            sha = `${buf.length}_${buf.subarray(0, 64).toString("hex")}`;
            if (audio.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024) {
              throw new Error(messageFor("oversized_upload"));
            }
          } else if (assetId) {
            const asset = await getAsset(assetId);
            if (asset) {
              const abs = path.join(process.cwd(), asset.path);
              const buf = await readFile(abs);
              blob = new Blob([buf], { type: asset.mime });
              filename = asset.filename;
              sha = asset.sha256 ?? `${buf.length}`;
            }
          }
          if (blob) {
            let cached: AsrResult | null = null;
            if (sha) {
              try {
                cached = await getAsrCache(sha, modelId, language);
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn("ASR cache read failed:", err);
              }
            }
            if (cached) {
              asr = cached;
              send("C", "ASR cache hit — skipping Whisper", 0.42);
            } else {
              const prompt = lyricsPromptWindow(
                parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => l.text),
                0,
              );
              asr = await transcribeAudio({
                apiKey,
                file: blob,
                filename,
                language,
                prompt,
                model: modelId,
              });
              if (sha && asr) {
                try {
                  await putAsrCache(sha, modelId, language, asr);
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn("ASR cache write failed:", err);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          send("C", "No Groq key — using syllable-weighted heuristic timing", 0.36, {
            detail: "Add a Groq key for Whisper word timestamps.",
          });
        }

        if (asr) {
          const sanitizedWords = sanitizeAsr(asr.words ?? [], durationSec);
          asr = {
            ...asr,
            words: sanitizedWords,
          };
        }

        const dur = durationSec > 0 ? durationSec : asr?.duration ?? 180;
        let captions: Caption[] = [];
        let flagged = 0;
        let meanConfidence = 0;
        let mode: "asr" | "heuristic" = "heuristic";

        const fullLyricText = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => l.text).join(" ");
        const coverage = asr?.words?.length ? asrCoverage(asr.words, fullLyricText) : 0;

        // Try Deep AI Alignment first if Groq API key and segments are available
        if (apiKey && asr && asr.segments && asr.segments.length > 0 && coverage >= 0.15) {
          try {
            send("D", "AI Analyzing audio cuts, song structure & semantic mapping (Llama 3.3 70B)", 0.55);
            const models = await validateKey(apiKey);
            const aiResult = await deepAiAlignLyrics({
              apiKey,
              model: models.llm,
              lines: parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => ({ index: l.index, text: l.text, section: l.section })),
              asrSegments: asr.segments.map((s, i) => ({ index: i, start: s.start, end: s.end, text: s.text })),
              durationSec: dur,
            });

            if (aiResult && aiResult.alignedLines && aiResult.alignedLines.length > 0) {
              mode = "asr";
              send("E", "Snapping word-level timestamps & assembling timeline", 0.78);
              const synced = alignWithDeepAi({
                lines: parsed.lines,
                aiResult,
                asr,
                durationSec: dur,
              });
              captions = synced.captions;
              flagged = synced.flagged;
              meanConfidence = synced.meanConfidence;
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("Deep AI alignment failed, falling back to Needleman-Wunsch:", err);
          }
        }

        // Fallback to Needleman-Wunsch if Deep AI was not run or returned empty
        if (captions.length === 0) {
          if (asr && asr.words && asr.words.length > 0 && coverage >= 0.15) {
            mode = "asr";
            send("D", "Normalize tokens (NFKC, numerals, metaphone)", 0.52);
            send("E", "Needleman–Wunsch global alignment", 0.64);
            send("F", "Assign timestamps from ASR + syllable interpolation", 0.74);
            send("G", "Assemble original lines with lead-in / hold", 0.82);

            const parsedAsr = AsrResultSchema.parse(asr);
            if (!parsedAsr.text.trim()) throw new Error(messageFor("empty_asr"));
            const synced = runSync({ lines: parsed.lines, asr: parsedAsr, durationSec: dur });
            captions = synced.captions;
            flagged = synced.flagged;
            meanConfidence = synced.meanConfidence;
          } else {
            mode = "heuristic";
            if (asr && coverage < 0.15) {
              send("C", "Whisper coverage low (<15%) — falling back to syllable-weighted heuristic sync", 0.45);
            }
            const synced = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, dur);
            captions = synced.captions;
            flagged = synced.flagged;
            meanConfidence = synced.meanConfidence;
          }
        }

        send("H", "Score confidence and optional LLM tie-break", 0.9);
        if (apiKey && flagged > 0 && asr?.segments?.length) {
          const ambiguous = captions
            .map((c, i) => ({ i, c }))
            .filter(({ c }) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.35)
            .slice(0, 8);
          if (ambiguous.length) {
            try {
              const models = await validateKey(apiKey);
              await llmTiebreak({
                apiKey,
                model: models.llm,
                payload: {
                  lyrics: ambiguous.map(({ i, c }) => ({ index: i, text: c.text })),
                  segments: (asr.segments ?? []).slice(0, 40).map((s, i) => ({
                    index: i,
                    start: s.start,
                    end: s.end,
                    text: s.text,
                  })),
                },
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn("LLM tiebreak optional step failed:", err);
            }
          }
        }

        send("done", `Sync complete (${mode.toUpperCase()})`, 1, {
          captions,
          flagged,
          meanConfidence,
          mode,
          title: parsed.title,
          artist: parsed.artist,
          jobId: createId("job"),
        });
        controller.close();
      } catch (err) {
        const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : messageFor("generic");
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sse("progress", { stage: "error", label: message, progress: 1 })));
        controller.close();
      }
    },
  });

  return new Response(stream, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/event-stream",
      "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform",
      Connection: "keep-alive",
    },
  });
}

import Groq from "groq-sdk";
import { AsrResultSchema, LlmTiebreakSchema, type AsrResult, type LlmTiebreak } from "@/schema";
import { StudioError } from "./errors";

const ASR_CANDIDATES = ["whisper-large-v3-turbo", "whisper-large-v3", "distil-whisper-large-v3-en"];
const LLM_CANDIDATES = ["llama-3.3-70b-versatile", "llama-3.1-70b-versatile", "llama-3.1-8b-instant"];

export interface GroqModel {
  id: string;
}

export async function listModels(apiKey: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models", {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` },
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
    throw new StudioError("invalid_api_key", "Groq rejected the API key.");
  }
  if (!res.ok) throw new StudioError("generic", `Could not list Groq models (${res.status}).`);
  const json = (await res.json()) as { data?: GroqModel[] };
  return (json.data ?? []).map((m) => m.id);
}

export function pickModel(available: string[], candidates: string[]): string {
  for (const id of candidates) {
    if (available.includes(id)) return id;
  }
  return candidates[0]!;
}

export async function validateKey(apiKey: string): Promise<{ ok: true; models: string[]; asr: string; llm: string }> {
  const models = await listModels(apiKey);
  return {
    ok: true,
    models,
    asr: pickModel(models, ASR_CANDIDATES),
    llm: pickModel(models, LLM_CANDIDATES),
  };
}

async function withBackoff<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  let last: unknown;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt += 1) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      last = err;
      const status = typeof err === "object" && err && "status" in err ? Number((err as { status: number }).status) : 0;
      if (status !== 429 && status < 500) throw err;
      const wait = Math.min(8000, 400 * 2 ** attempt);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, wait));
    }
  }
  throw last instanceof Error ? last : new Error("Groq request failed");
}

export async function transcribeAudio(input: {
  apiKey: string;
  file: File | Blob;
  filename: string;
  language: string;
  prompt: string;
  model: string;
}): Promise<AsrResult> {
  const client = new Groq({ apiKey: input.apiKey });
  const file = input.file instanceof File ? input.file : new File([input.file], input.filename);
  const raw = await withBackoff(() =>
    client.audio.transcriptions.create({
      file,
      model: input.model,
      language: input.language,
      temperature: 0,
      prompt: input.prompt.slice(0, 800),
      response_format: "verbose_json",
      timestamp_granularities: ["word", "segment"],
    }),
  );
  const parsed = AsrResultSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const loose = raw as { text?: string; words?: unknown; segments?: unknown };
    return AsrResultSchema.parse({
      text: loose.text ?? "",
      words: Array.isArray(loose.words) ? loose.words : [],
      segments: Array.isArray(loose.segments) ? loose.segments : [],
    });
  }
  return parsed.data;
}

export async function llmTiebreak(input: {
  apiKey: string;
  model: string;
  payload: unknown;
}): Promise<LlmTiebreak | null> {
  const client = new Groq({ apiKey: input.apiKey });
  try {
    const res = await withBackoff(() =>
      client.chat.completions.create({
        model: input.model,
        temperature: 0,
        response_format: { type: "json_object" },
        messages: [
          {
            role: "system",
            content:
              "You map lyric line indices to ASR segment indices. Return JSON {\"map\":[{\"lyricIndex\":0,\"segmentIndex\":0}]}. Only include genuinely ambiguous lines. Indices must be monotonic.",
          },
          { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify(input.payload) },
        ],
      }),
    );
    const text = res.choices[0]?.message?.content ?? "";
    const json = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
    const parsed = LlmTiebreakSchema.safeParse(json);
    if (!parsed.success) return null;
    let last = -1;
    for (const row of parsed.data.map) {
      if (row.lyricIndex <= last) return null;
      last = row.lyricIndex;
    }
    return parsed.data;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export interface AiAlignedLine {
  lineIndex: number;
  startSec: number;
  endSec: number;
  confidence: number;
  matchedText?: string;
}

export interface DeepAiAlignResult {
  alignedLines: AiAlignedLine[];
  instrumentalBreaks?: { startSec: number; endSec: number; label?: string }[];
}

export async function deepAiAlignLyrics(input: {
  apiKey: string;
  model: string;
  lines: { index: number; text: string; section?: string }[];
  asrSegments: { index: number; start: number; end: number; text: string }[];
  durationSec: number;
}): Promise<DeepAiAlignResult | null> {
  const client = new Groq({ apiKey: input.apiKey });
  const systemPrompt = `You are an expert audio-to-lyric synchronization and song structure alignment AI.
Your task is to accurately map each lyric line to its exact heard time interval [startSec, endSec] in the audio based on the ASR speech transcript segments.

Rules:
1. Every lyric line sung in the audio must be mapped with its real [startSec, endSec] timestamps.
2. Timestamps must be strictly non-decreasing (monotonic). Line N+1 cannot start before Line N starts.
3. If an instrumental intro exists (e.g. 0s to 18s), the first lyric line MUST start when singing actually begins, NOT at 0s!
4. If an instrumental solo, break, or interlude occurs between verses/choruses, the next lyric line must start after the break ends.
5. If a line is repeated in the lyrics (e.g. chorus), match it to the corresponding audio timestamp where that repetition occurs.
6. A single line should have a realistic singing duration (typically 1.5s to 6.0s depending on line length). NEVER crush multiple lines into a single second.
7. Output strictly valid JSON conforming to:
{
  "alignedLines": [
    {
      "lineIndex": 0,
      "startSec": 15.2,
      "endSec": 18.5,
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "matchedText": "heard words"
    }
  ],
  "instrumentalBreaks": [
    { "startSec": 0, "endSec": 15.2, "label": "Intro" }
  ]
}`;

  const userPrompt = JSON.stringify({
    totalDurationSec: input.durationSec,
    lyricLines: input.lines,
    heardAudioSegments: input.asrSegments,
  });

  try {
    const res = await withBackoff(() =>
      client.chat.completions.create({
        model: input.model,
        temperature: 0,
        response_format: { type: "json_object" },
        messages: [
          { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
          { role: "user", content: userPrompt },
        ],
      }),
    );
    const text = res.choices[0]?.message?.content ?? "";
    const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as DeepAiAlignResult;
    if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.alignedLines) || parsed.alignedLines.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Deep AI alignment call failed:", err);
    return null;
  }
}

import {
  defaultAnim,
  type AnchorHit,
  type AsrResult,
  type AsrWord,
  type Caption,
  type LyricLine,
  type Word,
} from "@/schema";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { needlemanWunsch } from "./needleman-wunsch";
import { countSyllables, normalizedLevenshtein, tokenizeLine, type NormToken } from "./normalize";

export interface TimedLyricWord {
  lineIndex: number;
  tokenIndex: number;
  text: string;
  startSec: number;
  endSec: number;
  confidence: number;
  matched: boolean;
}

export interface SyncResult {
  captions: Caption[];
  flagged: number;
  meanConfidence: number;
}

function flattenLyrics(lines: LyricLine[]): { tokens: NormToken[]; owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[] } {
  const tokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.instrumental) continue;
    const parts = tokenizeLine(line.text);
    parts.forEach((t, token) => {
      tokens.push(t);
      owners.push({ line: line.index, token, text: t.raw });
    });
  }
  return { tokens, owners };
}

function flattenAsr(asr: AsrResult): { tokens: NormToken[]; words: AsrWord[] } {
  const source =
    asr.words && asr.words.length > 0
      ? asr.words
      : (asr.segments ?? []).flatMap((s) =>
          (s.words ?? s.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map((word, i, arr) => {
            const span = Math.max(0.05, (s.end - s.start) / Math.max(1, arr.length));
            return { word, start: s.start + i * span, end: s.start + (i + 1) * span, probability: 0.5 };
          })),
        );
  const tokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const words: AsrWord[] = [];
  for (const w of source) {
    const parts = tokenizeLine(w.word);
    for (const t of parts) {
      tokens.push(t);
      words.push(w);
    }
  }
  return { tokens, words };
}

function interpolate(
  start: number,
  end: number,
  weights: number[],
): { startSec: number; endSec: number }[] {
  const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || weights.length || 1;
  const span = Math.max(0.04, end - start);
  let cursor = start;
  return weights.map((w) => {
    const dur = (w / total) * span;
    const item = { startSec: cursor, endSec: cursor + dur };
    cursor += dur;
    return item;
  });
}

export function assignTimestamps(
  lyricTokens: NormToken[],
  owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[],
  asrWords: AsrWord[],
  path: { op: string; lyricIndex: number; asrIndex: number; score: number }[],
  durationSec: number,
): TimedLyricWord[] {
  const timed: Array<TimedLyricWord | null> = lyricTokens.map((t, i) => ({
    lineIndex: owners[i]?.line ?? 0,
    tokenIndex: owners[i]?.token ?? 0,
    text: owners[i]?.text ?? t.raw,
    startSec: -1,
    endSec: -1,
    confidence: 0,
    matched: false,
  }));

  for (const cell of path) {
    if (cell.op !== "match") continue;
    const asr = asrWords[cell.asrIndex];
    const slot = timed[cell.lyricIndex];
    if (!asr || !slot) continue;
    if (cell.score > 0) {
      slot.startSec = asr.start;
      slot.endSec = Math.max(asr.start + 0.04, asr.end);
      slot.confidence = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1, cell.score / 2.0));
      slot.matched = true;
    }
  }

  let i = 0;
  while (i < timed.length) {
    if ((timed[i]?.startSec ?? -1) >= 0) {
      i += 1;
      continue;
    }
    let j = i;
    while (j < timed.length && (timed[j]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) j += 1;
    let prev = i - 1;
    while (prev >= 0 && (timed[prev]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) prev -= 1;
    const leftT = prev >= 0 ? timed[prev]!.endSec : 0;
    const rightT = j < timed.length ? timed[j]!.startSec : durationSec;
    const gap = timed.slice(i, j);
    const weights = gap.map((g, k) => {
      const tok = lyricTokens[i + k];
      return tok ? tok.syllables || Math.max(1, tok.norm.length / 3) : 1;
    });
    const spans = interpolate(leftT, rightT, weights);
    gap.forEach((g, k) => {
      if (!g) return;
      g.startSec = spans[k]!.startSec;
      g.endSec = spans[k]!.endSec;
      g.confidence = 0.28;
    });
    i = j;
  }

  for (let k = 1; k < timed.length; k += 1) {
    const prev = timed[k - 1]!;
    const curr = timed[k]!;
    if (curr.startSec < prev.endSec) {
      const mid = (prev.endSec + curr.startSec) / 2;
      prev.endSec = mid;
      curr.startSec = mid;
    }
    if (curr.endSec <= curr.startSec) curr.endSec = curr.startSec + 0.05;
  }
  return timed.filter((t): t is TimedLyricWord => t !== null);
}

export function assembleLines(
  lines: LyricLine[],
  words: TimedLyricWord[],
  durationSec: number,
): Caption[] {
  const byLine = new Map<number, TimedLyricWord[]>();
  for (const w of words) {
    const list = byLine.get(w.lineIndex) ?? [];
    list.push(w);
    byLine.set(w.lineIndex, list);
  }
  const captions: Caption[] = [];
  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  vocalLines.forEach((line, order) => {
    const group = (byLine.get(line.index) ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);
    const first = group[0];
    const last = group[group.length - 1];
    const start = first ? Math.max(0, first.startSec - 0.06) : 0;
    const end = last ? last.endSec + 0.12 : start + 1;
    const matched = group.filter((g) => g.matched).length;
    const conf =
      group.length === 0 ? 0.2 : 0.55 * (matched / group.length) + 0.45 * (group.reduce((s, g) => s + g.confidence, 0) / group.length);
    captions.push({
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: group.map(
        (g): Word => ({
          text: g.text,
          startSec: g.startSec,
          endSec: g.endSec,
          confidence: g.confidence,
        }),
      ),
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: { ...defaultAnim("fade"), durationSec: 0.25 },
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, conf)),
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    });
  });

  captions.sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const next = captions[i + 1];
    if (next && curr.endSec > next.startSec - 0.04) {
      curr.endSec = Math.max(curr.startSec + 0.04, next.startSec - 0.04);
    }
    curr.endSec = Math.min(curr.endSec, durationSec);
    curr.index = i;
  }

  const withGaps: Caption[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const prev = withGaps[withGaps.length - 1];
    if (prev && curr.startSec - prev.endSec > 3.5) {
      withGaps.push({
        id: createId("gap"),
        index: withGaps.length,
        text: "♪",
        startSec: prev.endSec,
        endSec: curr.startSec,
        words: [],
        animation: {
          in: defaultAnim("fade"),
          out: defaultAnim("fade"),
          highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 0.4 },
        },
        confidence: 1,
        locked: false,
        instrumental: true,
      });
    }
    withGaps.push({ ...curr, index: withGaps.length });
  }
  return withGaps;
}

export function scoreLine(
  caption: Caption,
  anchors: AnchorHit[],
): number {
  if (caption.instrumental) return 1;
  const words = caption.words;
  if (words.length === 0) return 0.2;
  const density = words.filter((w) => w.confidence >= 0.45).length / words.length;
  const gaps = words.filter((w) => w.confidence < 0.3).length / words.length;
  const anchor = anchors.find((a) => a.lineIndex === caption.index);
  const anchorAgree = anchor ? anchor.peakConfidence : 0.5;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.45 * density + 0.2 * (1 - gaps) + 0.2 * anchorAgree + 0.15 * caption.confidence));
}

export function findSegmentAnchors(
  lines: LyricLine[],
  lyricTokens: NormToken[],
  owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[],
  asr: AsrResult,
  asrWords: AsrWord[],
): AnchorPair[] {
  const anchors: AnchorPair[] = [];
  const segments = asr.segments ?? [];
  if (segments.length === 0) return anchors;

  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  let lastAsrIndex = 0;

  for (const line of vocalLines) {
    const lineOwner = owners.find((o) => o.line === line.index);
    if (!lineOwner) continue;
    const lyricIndex = owners.indexOf(lineOwner);

    // Find closest matching segment monotonically
    let bestSegIdx = -1;
    let bestSim = 0;

    const lineNorm = line.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");

    for (let si = 0; si < segments.length; si++) {
      const seg = segments[si]!;
      const segNorm = seg.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
      if (!segNorm || !lineNorm) continue;

      let score = 0;
      if (lineNorm.includes(segNorm) || segNorm.includes(lineNorm)) {
        score = 0.85;
      } else {
        const lev = normalizedLevenshtein(lineNorm.slice(0, 24), segNorm.slice(0, 24));
        score = lev;
      }

      if (score > bestSim && score >= 0.75) {
        bestSim = score;
        bestSegIdx = si;
      }
    }

    if (bestSegIdx >= 0) {
      const seg = segments[bestSegIdx]!;
      // Find the first asr word belonging to or closest to this segment
      for (let wi = lastAsrIndex; wi < asrWords.length; wi++) {
        const w = asrWords[wi]!;
        if (w.start >= seg.start - 0.5 && w.start <= seg.end + 0.5) {
          anchors.push({ lyricIndex, asrIndex: wi });
          lastAsrIndex = wi;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return anchors;
}

interface AnchorPair {
  lyricIndex: number;
  asrIndex: number;
}

export function runSync(input: {
  lines: LyricLine[];
  asr: AsrResult;
  durationSec: number;
  anchors?: AnchorHit[];
}): SyncResult {
  const { tokens: lyricTokens, owners } = flattenLyrics(input.lines);
  const { tokens: asrTokens, words: asrWords } = flattenAsr(input.asr);

  // Combine external split-clip anchors + automatic segment anchors
  const autoSegmentAnchors = findSegmentAnchors(input.lines, lyricTokens, owners, input.asr, asrWords);

  const splitClipAnchors = (input.anchors ?? [])
    .filter((a) => a.peakConfidence >= 0.42)
    .map((a) => {
      const owner = owners.find((o) => o.line === a.lineIndex);
      if (!owner) return null;
      const lyricIndex = owners.indexOf(owner);
      let asrIndex = 0;
      let best = Infinity;
      asrWords.forEach((w, i) => {
        const d = Math.abs(w.start - a.offsetSec);
        if (d < best) {
          best = d;
          asrIndex = i;
        }
      });
      return { lyricIndex, asrIndex };
    })
    .filter((x): x is { lyricIndex: number; asrIndex: number } => x !== null);

  const combinedAnchors = [...splitClipAnchors, ...autoSegmentAnchors].sort(
    (a, b) => a.lyricIndex - b.lyricIndex,
  );

  // Filter monotonic anchors
  const validAnchors: AnchorPair[] = [];
  let lastL = -1;
  let lastA = -1;
  for (const a of combinedAnchors) {
    if (a.lyricIndex > lastL && a.asrIndex >= lastA) {
      validAnchors.push(a);
      lastL = a.lyricIndex;
      lastA = a.asrIndex;
    }
  }

  const aligned = needlemanWunsch(lyricTokens, asrTokens, validAnchors);
  const timed = assignTimestamps(lyricTokens, owners, asrWords, aligned.path, input.durationSec);
  const rawCaptions = assembleLines(input.lines, timed, input.durationSec).map((c) => ({
    ...c,
    confidence: scoreLine(c, input.anchors ?? []),
  }));
  const captions = enforceTimeline(rawCaptions, input.durationSec);
  const flagged = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6).length;
  const vocal = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental);
  const meanConfidence = vocal.length ? vocal.reduce((s, c) => s + c.confidence, 0) / vocal.length : 0;
  return { captions, flagged, meanConfidence };
}

/**
 * Hard invariant enforcer for final captions list:
 * - Captions sorted strictly by startSec
 * - 0 <= startSec < endSec <= totalDurationSec
 * - No overlaps between consecutive captions (minimum 0.02s gap)
 * - Minimum caption duration 0.2s
 * - Word timestamps inside each caption strictly bounded by caption.startSec and caption.endSec
 */
export function enforceTimeline(captions: Caption[], totalDurationSec: number): Caption[] {
  if (!captions || captions.length === 0) return [];
  const maxDur = Math.max(0.5, totalDurationSec);

  // Sort by startSec
  const sorted = [...captions].sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);

  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const c = sorted[i]!;
    c.index = i;
    c.startSec = Math.max(0, Math.min(c.startSec, maxDur - 0.05));
    c.endSec = Math.max(c.startSec + 0.05, Math.min(c.endSec, maxDur));

    // Fix overlap with previous caption
    if (i > 0) {
      const prev = sorted[i - 1]!;
      if (c.startSec < prev.endSec) {
        if (prev.startSec + 0.1 <= c.startSec) {
          prev.endSec = c.startSec;
        } else {
          const mid = (prev.endSec + c.startSec) / 2;
          prev.endSec = Math.max(prev.startSec + 0.05, mid);
          c.startSec = Math.max(prev.endSec, c.startSec);
          if (c.endSec <= c.startSec) {
            c.endSec = Math.min(maxDur, c.startSec + 0.2);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Clamp word timestamps inside caption
    if (c.words && c.words.length > 0) {
      for (let wi = 0; wi < c.words.length; wi++) {
        const w = c.words[wi]!;
        w.startSec = Math.max(c.startSec, Math.min(w.startSec, c.endSec - 0.02));
        w.endSec = Math.max(w.startSec + 0.02, Math.min(w.endSec, c.endSec));
        if (wi > 0) {
          const prevW = c.words[wi - 1]!;
          if (w.startSec < prevW.endSec) {
            prevW.endSec = w.startSec;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return sorted;
}

export function heuristicSync(lines: LyricLine[], durationSec: number): SyncResult {
  const vocal = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  if (vocal.length === 0) {
    return { captions: [], flagged: 0, meanConfidence: 0 };
  }

  // Weight each line by syllable count (or character length fallback)
  const lineWeights = vocal.map((l) => {
    const rawSyls = countSyllables(l.text.replace(/\s+/g, ""));
    return Math.max(1, rawSyls || Math.round(l.text.length / 3.5));
  });

  const lead = Math.min(2.0, durationSec * 0.04);
  const tail = Math.min(2.5, durationSec * 0.05);
  const usable = Math.max(1, durationSec - lead - tail);
  const totalWeight = lineWeights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || 1;

  let cursor = lead;
  const rawCaptions: Caption[] = vocal.map((line, order) => {
    const lineSpan = (lineWeights[order]! / totalWeight) * usable;
    const start = cursor;
    // Active singing takes ~88% of line slot, remaining 12% is breathing space
    const end = cursor + lineSpan * 0.88;
    cursor += lineSpan;

    const words = tokenizeLine(line.text);
    const wordWeights = words.map((w) => Math.max(1, w.syllables || Math.round(w.raw.length / 3)));
    const totalWordWeight = wordWeights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || 1;
    const wordSpan = end - start;

    let wCursor = start;
    const timedWords: Word[] = words.map((t, i) => {
      const dur = (wordWeights[i]! / totalWordWeight) * wordSpan;
      const wStart = wCursor;
      const wEnd = wCursor + dur;
      wCursor += dur;
      return {
        text: t.raw,
        startSec: wStart,
        endSec: wEnd,
        confidence: 0.45,
      };
    });

    return {
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: timedWords,
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: defaultAnim("fade"),
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: 0.45,
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    };
  });

  const captions = enforceTimeline(rawCaptions, durationSec);
  return { captions, flagged: captions.length, meanConfidence: 0.45 };
}

export { countSyllables };

import { normalizedLevenshtein, type NormToken } from "./normalize";

export type AlignOp = "match" | "lyric-gap" | "asr-gap";

export interface AlignCell {
  op: AlignOp;
  lyricIndex: number;
  asrIndex: number;
  score: number;
}

export interface AlignResult {
  path: AlignCell[];
  score: number;
}

const MATCH_WEIGHT_LEV = 0.65;
const MATCH_WEIGHT_PHONE = 0.35;
const GAP_OPEN_ASR = -0.15; // cheap gap for ASR ad-libs/hallucinations/instrumental noise
const GAP_EXT_ASR = -0.02;
const GAP_OPEN_LYRIC = -0.40; // lyric skipping
const GAP_EXT_LYRIC = -0.08;

export function substitutionScore(a: NormToken, b: NormToken): number {
  if (a.norm === b.norm) {
    return 2.0 + (a.norm.length >= 4 ? 0.4 : 0);
  }
  const lev = normalizedLevenshtein(a.norm, b.norm);
  const phone =
    a.metaphone && a.metaphone === b.metaphone
      ? 1
      : a.metaphone && b.metaphone && a.metaphone[0] === b.metaphone[0]
      ? 0.4
      : 0;

  let prefixBonus = 0;
  if (
    a.norm.length >= 3 &&
    b.norm.length >= 3 &&
    (a.norm.startsWith(b.norm.slice(0, 3)) || b.norm.startsWith(a.norm.slice(0, 3)))
  ) {
    prefixBonus = 0.15;
  }

  const rawSim = MATCH_WEIGHT_LEV * lev + MATCH_WEIGHT_PHONE * phone + prefixBonus;

  if (rawSim >= 0.7) {
    return 1.0 + (rawSim - 0.7) * 2.5; // +1.0 to +1.75
  } else if (rawSim >= 0.45) {
    return 0.1 + (rawSim - 0.45) * 2.0; // +0.1 to +0.6
  } else {
    // Mismatch penalty: Ensures NW prefers opening gaps over matching distinct words
    return -0.8 - (0.45 - rawSim) * 1.5; // -0.8 to -1.48
  }
}

interface AnchorPair {
  lyricIndex: number;
  asrIndex: number;
}

/**
 * Needleman–Wunsch with affine gaps (Gotoh).
 * Fully unconstrained dynamic programming search space to prevent drift lockout
 * when songs have instrumental intros, interludes, or repeat sections.
 * Supports anchor pair landmarks with additive rewards.
 */
export function needlemanWunsch(
  lyric: NormToken[],
  asr: NormToken[],
  anchors: AnchorPair[] = [],
): AlignResult {
  const n = lyric.length;
  const m = asr.length;
  if (n === 0 && m === 0) return { path: [], score: 0 };
  if (n === 0) {
    return {
      path: asr.map((_, j) => ({ op: "asr-gap", lyricIndex: 0, asrIndex: j, score: 0 })),
      score: GAP_OPEN_ASR + (m - 1) * GAP_EXT_ASR,
    };
  }
  if (m === 0) {
    return {
      path: lyric.map((_, i) => ({ op: "lyric-gap", lyricIndex: i, asrIndex: 0, score: 0 })),
      score: GAP_OPEN_LYRIC + (n - 1) * GAP_EXT_LYRIC,
    };
  }

  const NEG = -1e9;
  const M = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, () => new Float64Array(m + 1).fill(NEG));
  const X = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, () => new Float64Array(m + 1).fill(NEG));
  const Y = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, () => new Float64Array(m + 1).fill(NEG));
  const ptr = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, () => new Int8Array(m + 1));

  M[0]![0] = 0;
  X[0]![0] = GAP_OPEN_LYRIC;
  Y[0]![0] = GAP_OPEN_ASR;
  for (let i = 1; i <= n; i += 1) {
    X[i]![0] = GAP_OPEN_LYRIC + (i - 1) * GAP_EXT_LYRIC;
    M[i]![0] = X[i]![0]!;
    ptr[i]![0] = 2;
  }
  for (let j = 1; j <= m; j += 1) {
    Y[0]![j] = GAP_OPEN_ASR + (j - 1) * GAP_EXT_ASR;
    M[0]![j] = Y[0]![j]!;
    ptr[0]![j] = 3;
  }

  const forced = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const a of anchors) {
    if (a.lyricIndex >= 0 && a.lyricIndex < n && a.asrIndex >= 0 && a.asrIndex < m) {
      forced.set(a.lyricIndex, a.asrIndex);
    }
  }

  for (let i = 1; i <= n; i += 1) {
    const lTok = lyric[i - 1]!;
    for (let j = 1; j <= m; j += 1) {
      const aTok = asr[j - 1]!;
      const sub = substitutionScore(lTok, aTok);
      const anchorReward = forced.get(i - 1) === j - 1 ? 4.0 : 0;
      const diag = Math.max(M[i - 1]![j - 1]!, X[i - 1]![j - 1]!, Y[i - 1]![j - 1]!) + sub + anchorReward;
      const delOpen = Math.max(M[i - 1]![j]!, Y[i - 1]![j]!) + GAP_OPEN_LYRIC;
      const delExt = X[i - 1]![j]! + GAP_EXT_LYRIC;
      const del = Math.max(delOpen, delExt);
      const insOpen = Math.max(M[i]![j - 1]!, X[i]![j - 1]!) + GAP_OPEN_ASR;
      const insExt = Y[i]![j - 1]! + GAP_EXT_ASR;
      const ins = Math.max(insOpen, insExt);

      M[i]![j] = diag;
      X[i]![j] = del;
      Y[i]![j] = ins;
      const best = Math.max(diag, del, ins);
      ptr[i]![j] = best === diag ? 1 : best === del ? 2 : 3;
    }
  }

  const path: AlignCell[] = [];
  let i = n;
  let j = m;
  while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
    const dir = ptr[i]?.[j] ?? (i > 0 ? 2 : 3);
    if (dir === 1 && i > 0 && j > 0) {
      path.push({
        op: "match",
        lyricIndex: i - 1,
        asrIndex: j - 1,
        score: substitutionScore(lyric[i - 1]!, asr[j - 1]!),
      });
      i -= 1;
      j -= 1;
    } else if (dir === 2 && i > 0) {
      path.push({ op: "lyric-gap", lyricIndex: i - 1, asrIndex: Math.max(0, j - 1), score: 0 });
      i -= 1;
    } else if (j > 0) {
      path.push({ op: "asr-gap", lyricIndex: Math.max(0, i - 1), asrIndex: j - 1, score: 0 });
      j -= 1;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }
  path.reverse();
  const score = Math.max(M[n]![m]!, X[n]![m]!, Y[n]![m]!);
  return { path, score };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { defaultAnim, type Caption } from "@/schema";
import { applyIndependentResize, applyRippleMove, applyRippleResize, applyRoll } from "./ripple";

function cap(id: string, start: number, end: number): Caption {
  return {
    id,
    index: 0,
    text: id,
    startSec: start,
    endSec: end,
    words: [{ text: id, startSec: start, endSec: end, confidence: 1 }],
    animation: { in: defaultAnim(), out: defaultAnim(), highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 } },
    confidence: 1,
    instrumental: false,
    locked: false,
  };
}

describe("ripple math", () => {
  it("preserves inter-caption gaps when rippling an out-point", () => {
    const caps = [cap("a", 1, 2), cap("b", 2.4, 3.4), cap("c", 3.8, 4.8)];
    const gapAB = 2.4 - 2;
    const gapBC = 3.8 - 3.4;
    const res = applyRippleResize(caps, "a", "out", 2.5, 20);
    const a = res.captions.find((c) => c.id === "a")!;
    const b = res.captions.find((c) => c.id === "b")!;
    const c = res.captions.find((c) => c.id === "c")!;
    expect(a.startSec).toBeCloseTo(1);
    expect(a.endSec).toBeCloseTo(2.5);
    expect(b.startSec - a.endSec).toBeCloseTo(gapAB);
    expect(c.startSec - b.endSec).toBeCloseTo(gapBC);
  });

  it("clamps a ripple at the audio boundary", () => {
    const caps = [cap("a", 8, 9), cap("b", 9.2, 9.8)];
    const res = applyRippleResize(caps, "a", "out", 12, 10);
    expect(res.clamped).toBe(true);
    expect(res.captions[res.captions.length - 1]!.endSec).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10);
  });

  it("rolls a shared boundary without changing total span", () => {
    const caps = [cap("a", 1, 2), cap("b", 2, 4)];
    const res = applyRoll(caps, "a", 2.6);
    expect(res.captions[0]!.endSec).toBeCloseTo(2.6);
    expect(res.captions[1]!.startSec).toBeCloseTo(2.6);
    expect(res.captions[1]!.endSec - res.captions[0]!.startSec).toBeCloseTo(3);
  });

  it("independent resize does not move neighbors", () => {
    const caps = [cap("a", 1, 2), cap("b", 3, 4)];
    const res = applyIndependentResize(caps, "a", "out", 2.5, 20);
    expect(res.captions[1]!.startSec).toBe(3);
    expect(res.captions[0]!.endSec).toBeCloseTo(2.5);
  });

  it("ripple move shifts the tail as one unit", () => {
    const caps = [cap("a", 1, 2), cap("b", 3, 4)];
    const res = applyRippleMove(caps, "a", 1.5, 20);
    expect(res.captions[0]!.startSec).toBeCloseTo(1.5);
    expect(res.captions[1]!.startSec).toBeCloseTo(3.5);
  });
});

    }
    // persist hook only on mount
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(
      "lf-layout",
      JSON.stringify({ left: studio.leftWidth, right: studio.rightWidth, bottom: studio.bottomHeight }),
    );
  }, [studio.leftWidth, studio.rightWidth, studio.bottomHeight]);

  const { project, dirty, markSaved } = studio;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) return;
    if (saveTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    saveTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
      })
        .then(() => markSaved())
        .catch(() => undefined);
    }, 700);
  }, [project, dirty, markSaved]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName;
      if (tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT") return;
      if (e.code === "Space") {
        e.preventDefault();
        studio.setPlaying(!studio.playing);
      }
      if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "J") studio.setPlayhead(Math.max(0, studio.playhead - 2));
      if (e.key === "l" || e.key === "L") studio.setPlayhead(Math.min(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 9999, studio.playhead + 2));
      if (e.key === "k" || e.key === "K") studio.setPlaying(false);
      if (e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") studio.splitAtPlayhead();
      if (e.key === "m" || e.key === "M") studio.mergeSelected();
      if (e.key === "Home") studio.setPlayhead(0);
      if (e.key === "End") studio.setPlayhead(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 0);
      if (e.key === "[") {
        const prev = [...studio.project.captions].reverse().find((c) => c.startSec < studio.playhead - 0.01);
        if (prev) {
          studio.setPlayhead(prev.startSec);
          studio.select([prev.id]);
        }
      }
      if (e.key === "]") {
        const next = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.startSec > studio.playhead + 0.01);
        if (next) {
          studio.setPlayhead(next.startSec);
          studio.select([next.id]);
        }
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? -10 : -1);
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1);
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.shiftKey) studio.redo();
        else studio.undo();
      }
      if (e.key === "?" || (e.shiftKey && e.key === "/")) setHelp((v) => !v);
      if (e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") studio.deleteSelected();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [studio]);

  const flagged = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6);
  const album = ART[studio.project.presetId ?? "seven-clouds"] ?? "/images/art-default.jpg";

  async function runExport() {
    const [w, h] = res.split("x").map(Number);
    const ok = await isWebCodecsSupported(w || 1920, h || 1080);
    if (!ok) {
      studio.notify("WebCodecs unavailable — trying FFmpeg fallback.");
      const response = await fetch("/api/export", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format: "mp4", width: w, height: h }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        studio.notify("FFmpeg fallback is not available in this environment.");
        return;
      }
      const blob = await response.blob();
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.mp4`);
      return;
    }
    setExporting(true);
    abort.current = new AbortController();
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    
    // Resolve background / album image from IDB if custom image was uploaded
    const bgAssetId = studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId;
    let customBlob: Blob | null = null;
    if (bgAssetId) {
      customBlob = (await getBlob(bgAssetId)) ?? null;
    }
    const img = new Image();
    if (customBlob) {
      img.src = URL.createObjectURL(customBlob);
    } else {
      img.src = album;
    }
    await img.decode().catch(() => undefined);

    let audioBuffer: AudioBuffer | null = null;
    if (audioUrl) {
      const buf = await fetch(audioUrl).then((r) => r.arrayBuffer());
      audioBuffer = await decodeAudio(buf);
    }

    const durationSec = audioBuffer?.duration || studio.project.meta.durationSec || 8;
    const totalFrames = Math.round(durationSec * fps);
    const spectrumFrames = audioBuffer ? computeSpectrumFrames(audioBuffer, fps, totalFrames) : undefined;

    try {
      const blob = await exportWebCodecsMp4(
        {
          ...studio.project,
          meta: {
            ...studio.project.meta,
            durationSec,
            fps,
            resolution: res as Project["meta"]["resolution"],
          },
        },
        canvas,
        { albumArt: img, backgroundImage: img },
        audioBuffer,
        {
          width: w,
          height: h,
          fps,
          quality,
          spectrumFrames,
          signal: abort.current.signal,
          onProgress: (p) => {
            const elapsedSec = p.elapsedMs / 1000;
            const etaSec = p.pct > 0.02 ? Math.round(((1 - p.pct) / p.pct) * elapsedSec) : 0;
            const etaStr = etaSec > 0 ? ` · ETA: ${etaSec}s` : "";
            setExportPct(p.pct);
            setExportMsg(`Frame ${p.frame}/${p.total} (${Math.round(p.pct * 100)}%)${etaStr}`);
          },
        },
      );
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${res}_${fps}fps.mp4`);
      studio.notify("Export complete.");
      setExportOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      studio.notify(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Export failed.");
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  }

  async function sideExport(format: "srt" | "vtt" | "ass" | "json") {
    const res = await fetch("/api/export", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format }),
    });
    const blob = await res.blob();
    downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.${format}`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen min-w-[1280px] flex-col bg-[var(--bg)]">
      <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--line)] px-3">
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <img src="/images/mark.png" alt="" className="h-7 w-7 rounded" />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">LyricForge</span>
        </Link>
        <input
          value={studio.project.meta.title}
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.title = e.target.value; })}
          className="h-8 w-56 rounded-md border border-transparent bg-transparent px-2 text-sm font-medium hover:border-[var(--line)] focus:border-[var(--accent)]"
          title="Project Title"
        />
        <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">{studio.dirty ? "Unsaved" : studio.saving ? "Saving" : "Saved"}</span>
        <Tooltip label="Undo" shortcut="⌘Z">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-30" disabled={!studio.canUndo} onClick={studio.undo}><Undo2 size={16} /></button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip label="Redo" shortcut="⇧⌘Z">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-30" disabled={!studio.canRedo} onClick={studio.redo}><Redo2 size={16} /></button>
        </Tooltip>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={openLyricsModal}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
        >
          <FileText size={14} /> Paste / Edit Lyrics
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setResyncModalOpen(true)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
          title="Evenly redistribute lyric timings across the track"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={13} /> Re-sync
        </button>

        <select
          value={studio.project.meta.aspectRatio}
          className="h-8 rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-xs"
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.aspectRatio = e.target.value as Project["meta"]["aspectRatio"]; })}
        >
          {["16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "21:9"].map((a) => <option key={a}>{a}</option>)}
        </select>

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Captions Panel">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.leftOpen ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
              onClick={() => studio.setPanel("left", !studio.leftOpen)}
            >
              <PanelLeft size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Timeline">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.bottomOpen ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
              onClick={() => studio.setPanel("bottom", !studio.bottomOpen)}
            >
              <PanelBottom size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Inspector">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.rightOpen ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
              onClick={() => studio.setPanel("right", !studio.rightOpen)}
            >
              <PanelRight size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />
          <Tooltip label="Shortcuts" shortcut="?">
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]" onClick={() => setHelp(true)}>
              <HelpCircle size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)] px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md hover:brightness-110"
            onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}
          >
            <Download size={14} /> Export
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        {studio.leftOpen && (
          <aside className="flex flex-col border-r border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]" style={{ width: studio.leftWidth }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--faint)]">
                Captions ({studio.project.captions.length})
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => studio.addCaption("New lyric line")}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-[var(--accent)]/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/25"
                  title="Add new lyric line at playhead"
                >
                  <Plus size={12} /> Add
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={openLyricsModal}
                  className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                  title="Paste / Import Sheet"
                >
                  <FileText size={13} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {flagged.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="mx-3 mt-2.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-400/15 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-400/25"
                onClick={() => {
                  const first = flagged[0];
                  if (!first) return;
                  studio.select([first.id]);
                  studio.setPlayhead(first.startSec);
                }}
              >
                Review {flagged.length} flagged low-confidence lines
              </button>
            )}

            <ul className="lf-scroll flex-1 space-y-1.5 overflow-auto p-2">
              {studio.project.captions.map((c) => {
                const isSelected = studio.selectedIds.includes(c.id);
                return (
                  <li
                    key={c.id}
                    className={`rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.1)]"
                        : "border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] hover:border-white/20"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="p-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">#{c.index + 1}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                          {formatTimecode(c.startSec)} → {formatTimecode(c.endSec)}
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${
                            c.confidence < 0.35 ? "bg-red-400" : c.confidence < 0.6 ? "bg-amber-300" : "bg-emerald-400"
                          }`}
                          title={`Confidence: ${(c.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
                        />
                      </div>

                      {isSelected ? (
                        <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
                          <textarea
                            value={c.text}
                            rows={2}
                            onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionText(c.id, e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Type lyric line text..."
                            className="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#06080d] p-2 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                          />
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 text-[11px]">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)]">
                              <span>In:</span>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                step="0.1"
                                min="0"
                                value={Number(c.startSec.toFixed(2))}
                                onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, Number(e.target.value), c.endSec)}
                                className="w-14 rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#06080d] px-1 py-0.5 text-center text-[var(--ink)]"
                              />
                              <span>Out:</span>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                step="0.1"
                                min="0"
                                value={Number(c.endSec.toFixed(2))}
                                onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, c.startSec, Number(e.target.value))}
                                className="w-14 rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#06080d] px-1 py-0.5 text-center text-[var(--ink)]"
                              />
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Play from line start"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  studio.setPlayhead(c.startSec);
                                  studio.setPlaying(true);
                                daylight:
                                }}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
                              >
                                <Play size={12} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Split at playhead"
                                onClick={() => studio.splitAtPlayhead()}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                              >
                                <Scissors size={12} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Duplicate line"
                                onClick={() => studio.duplicateSelected()}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                              >
                                <Copy size={12} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Delete line"
                                onClick={() => studio.deleteSelected()}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-red-400"
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={12} />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            studio.select([c.id]);
                            studio.setPlayhead(c.startSec);
                          }}
                          className="mt-1 block w-full text-left text-xs text-[var(--ink)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
                        >
                          <span className="line-clamp-2">{c.text || "♪ (Instrumental)"}</span>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </aside>
        )}

        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <PreviewCanvas audioUrl={audioUrl} albumUrl={album} />
          {studio.bottomOpen && (
            <div className="border-t border-[var(--line)]" style={{ height: studio.bottomHeight }}>
              <Timeline peaks={peaks} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {studio.rightOpen && (
          <aside className="border-l border-[var(--line)]" style={{ width: studio.rightWidth }}>
            <Inspector />
          </aside>
        )}
      </div>

      <Toast text={studio.toast?.text ?? null} />
      <Shortcuts open={help} onClose={() => setHelp(false)} />

      {/* Paste / Edit Full Lyrics Sheet Modal */}
      <Modal
        open={lyricsModalOpen}
        title="Paste / Edit Lyrics Sheet"
        onClose={() => setLyricsModalOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleApplyLyricsSheet}
        confirmLabel="Apply & Sync Lyrics"
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-white/5 pb-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              Line breaks define captions. Headers like <code className="text-[var(--accent)]">## title:</code> supported.
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={async () => {
                  try {
                    const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
                    if (text) setLyricsSheetText(text);
                  } catch {}
                }}
                className="rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-white"
              >
                Paste Clipboard
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLyricsSheetText("")}
                className="rounded border border-red-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  const lines = studio.project.captions
                    .filter((c) => !c.instrumental)
                    .map((c) => c.text)
                    .join("\n");
                  const metaHeader = `## title: ${studio.project.meta.title}\n## artist: ${studio.project.meta.artist}\n\n`;
                  setLyricsSheetText(metaHeader + lines);
                }}
                className="rounded border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20"
              >
                Reload Current
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <textarea
            value={lyricsSheetText}
            onChange={(e) => setLyricsSheetText(e.target.value)}
            rows={12}
            className="w-full resize-none rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] p-3 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
            placeholder={`## title: Song Title\n## artist: Artist Name\n\n[Verse 1]\nLine one lyrics\nLine two lyrics\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one`}
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Re-sync Captions Confirmation Modal */}
      <Modal
        open={resyncModalOpen}
        title="Re-sync Captions to Audio"
        onClose={() => setResyncModalOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleResyncCaptions}
        confirmLabel="Re-sync All Lines"
      >
        <div className="space-y-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--muted)]">
          <p>
            This will redistribute your existing lyric lines evenly across the entire track duration using syllable-weighted rhythm heuristics.
          </p>
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/10 p-3 text-amber-300">
            ⚠ Any custom manual word or line timestamp nudges will be recalculated. You can undo this action with Ctrl+Z anytime.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Export Video Modal */}
      <Modal
        open={exportOpen}
        title="Export lyric video"
        onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={() => void runExport()}
        confirmLabel={exporting ? "Exporting…" : "Render MP4"}
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Resolution
            <select value={res} onChange={(e) => setRes(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              <option>1280x720</option>
              <option>1920x1080</option>
              <option>2560x1440</option>
              <option>3840x2160</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Frame rate
            <select value={fps} onChange={(e) => setFps(Number(e.target.value))} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              {[24, 25, 30, 50, 60].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} fps</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Quality
            <select value={quality} onChange={(e) => setQuality(e.target.value as typeof quality)} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              <option value="high">High</option>
              <option value="balanced">Balanced</option>
              <option value="small">Small</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("srt")}>SRT</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("vtt")}>WebVTT</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("ass")}>ASS karaoke</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("json")}>Project JSON</button>
          </div>
          {exporting && (
            <div>
              <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1c2230]">
                <div className="h-full bg-[var(--accent)]" style={{ width: `${exportPct * 100}%` }} />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs">{exportMsg}</p>
              <button type="button" className="mt-2 text-xs text-[var(--danger)]" onClick={() => abort.current?.abort()}>Cancel</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function StudioApp({ initial }: { initial: Project }) {
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>(() =>
    Array.from({ length: 180 }, (_, i) => Math.round((0.2 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 6))) * 100) / 100),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void (async () => {
      const blob = (await getBlob(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getBlob("draft-master"));
      if (blob) setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      const stored = (await getPeaks(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getPeaks("draft-master"));
      if (stored) setPeaks(Array.from(stored));
    })();
  }, [initial.id]);

  const project = useMemo(() => initial, [initial]);
  return (
    <StudioProvider initial={project}>
      <StudioInner audioUrl={audioUrl} peaks={peaks} />
    </StudioProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { produce } from "immer";

import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";

const HISTORY_LIMIT = 100;

interface HistoryState {
  past: Project[];
  future: Project[];
}

interface StudioState {
  project: Project;
  selectedIds: string[];
  playhead: number;
  playing: boolean;
  loop: boolean;

  rightWidth: number;

  saving: boolean;
}

export interface StudioApi extends StudioState {
  canUndo: boolean;
  canRedo: boolean;
