const StudioContext = createContext<StudioApi | null>(null);

export function StudioProvider({ initial, children }: { initial: Project; children: ReactNode }) {
  const [project, setProjectState] = useState<Project>(initial);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [playhead, setPlayhead] = useState(0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [loop, setLoop] = useState(false);
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(0.9);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [leftOpen, setLeftOpen] = useState(true);
  const [rightOpen, setRightOpen] = useState(true);
  const [bottomOpen, setBottomOpen] = useState(true);
  const [leftWidth, setLeftWidth] = useState(300);
  const [rightWidth, setRightWidth] = useState(330);
  const [bottomHeight, setBottomHeight] = useState(196);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ id: number; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const history = useRef<HistoryState>({ past: [], future: [] });
  const [histSizes, setHistSizes] = useState({ past: 0, future: 0 });
  const toastId = useRef(0);

  const notify = useCallback((text: string) => {
    toastId.current += 1;
    setToast({ id: toastId.current, text });
  }, []);

  const pushHistory = useCallback((prev: Project) => {
    history.current = {
      past: [...history.current.past.slice(-(HISTORY_LIMIT - 1)), prev],
      future: [],
    };
    setHistSizes({ past: history.current.past.length, future: 0 });
  }, []);

  const setProject = useCallback(
    (next: Project, record = true) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        if (record) pushHistory(prev);
        const updated = { ...next, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        void mirrorProject(updated.id, updated, updated.updatedAt);
        return updated;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [pushHistory],
  );

  const commit = useCallback(
    (recipe: (draft: Project) => void) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          recipe(draft);
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [pushHistory],
  );

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    const prev = history.current.past.pop();
    if (!prev) return;
    setProjectState((curr) => {
      history.current.future.push(curr);
      setHistSizes({ past: history.current.past.length, future: history.current.future.length });
      return prev;
    });
    setDirty(true);
  }, []);

  const redo = useCallback(() => {
    const nxt = history.current.future.pop();
    if (!nxt) return;
    setProjectState((curr) => {
      history.current.past.push(curr);
      setHistSizes({ past: history.current.past.length, future: history.current.future.length });
      return nxt;
    });
    setDirty(true);
  }, []);

  const select = useCallback((ids: string[], additive = false) => {
    setSelectedIds((curr) => (additive ? Array.from(new Set([...curr, ...ids])) : ids));
  }, []);

  const applyCaptions = useCallback(
    (captions: Caption[], message?: string) => {
      commit((draft) => {
        draft.captions = captions;
      });
      if (message) notify(message);
    },
    [commit, notify],
  );

  const resizeCaption = useCallback(
    (id: string, edge: "in" | "out", nextSec: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: prev.settings.rippleMode, durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "resize", id, edge, nextSec },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        if (result.message) notify(result.message);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory, notify],
  );

  const moveCaption = useCallback(
    (id: string, nextStart: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: prev.settings.rippleMode, durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "move", id, nextStart },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        if (result.message) notify(result.message);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory, notify],
  );

  const rollCaption = useCallback(
    (leftId: string, nextBoundary: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: "roll", durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "roll", leftId, nextBoundary },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        if (result.message) notify(result.message);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory, notify],
  );

  const relinkCaption = useCallback(
    (id: string, startSec: number) => {
      setProjectState((prev) => {
        pushHistory(prev);
        const result = applyEdit(
          prev.captions,
          { mode: "relink", durationSec: prev.meta.durationSec, fps: prev.meta.fps, selectedIds },
          { kind: "relink", target: { captionId: id, startSec } },
        );
        const next = produce(prev, (draft) => {
          draft.captions = result.captions;
          draft.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        });
        void mirrorProject(next.id, next, next.updatedAt);
        return next;
      });
      setDirty(true);
    },
    [selectedIds, pushHistory],
  );

  const api = useMemo<StudioApi>(
    () => ({
      project,
      selectedIds,
      playhead,
      playing,
      loop,
      volume,
      zoom,
      leftOpen,
      rightOpen,
      bottomOpen,
      leftWidth,
      rightWidth,
      bottomHeight,
      toast,
      dirty,
      saving,
      canUndo: histSizes.past > 0,
      canRedo: histSizes.future > 0,
      setProject,
      commit,
      undo,
      redo,
      select,
      setPlayhead,
      setPlaying,
      setLoop,
      setVolume,
      setZoom,
      setRippleMode: (mode) => commit((d) => { d.settings.rippleMode = mode; }),
      updateStyle: (patch, scope) => {
        commit((d) => {
          if (scope === "default") Object.assign(d.defaultStyle, patch);
          else {
            for (const id of selectedIds) {
              const cap = d.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
              if (cap) cap.styleOverride = { ...(cap.styleOverride ?? {}), ...patch };
            }
          }
        });
      },
      applyStylePreset: (id) => setProject(applyPreset(project, id)),
      resizeCaption,
      moveCaption,
      rollCaption,
      relinkCaption,
      splitAtPlayhead: () => {
        const id = selectedIds[0];
        if (!id) return;
        applyCaptions(splitCaption(project.captions, id, playhead));
      },
      mergeSelected: () => applyCaptions(mergeCaptions(project.captions, selectedIds)),
      deleteSelected: () => {
        applyCaptions(project.captions.filter((c) => !selectedIds.includes(c.id)).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, index: i })));
        setSelectedIds([]);
      },
      duplicateSelected: () => {
        const copies = project.captions
          .filter((c) => selectedIds.includes(c.id))
          .map((c) => ({
            ...c,
            id: `${c.id}_copy_${Date.now()}`,
            startSec: c.endSec + 0.04,
            endSec: c.endSec + 0.04 + (c.endSec - c.startSec),
            words: c.words.map((w) => ({
              ...w,
              startSec: w.startSec + (c.endSec - c.startSec) + 0.04,
              endSec: w.endSec + (c.endSec - c.startSec) + 0.04,
            })),
          }));
        applyCaptions([...project.captions, ...copies].sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, index: i })));
      },
      nudge: (frames) => {
        const delta = frames / (project.meta.fps || 30);
        const id = selectedIds[0];
        if (!id) return;
        const cap = project.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
        if (!cap) return;
        moveCaption(id, cap.startSec + delta);
      },
      updateCaptionText: (id, text) => {
        commit((d) => {
          const cap = d.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
          if (cap) {
            cap.text = text;
            const words = tokenizeLine(text);
            const span = Math.max(0.04, cap.endSec - cap.startSec);
            const wspan = span / Math.max(1, words.length);
            cap.words = words.map((t, i) => ({
              text: t.raw,
              startSec: cap.startSec + i * wspan,
              endSec: cap.startSec + (i + 1) * wspan,
              confidence: 0.8,
            }));
          }
        });
      },
      updateCaptionTiming: (id, startSec, endSec) => {
        commit((d) => {
          const cap = d.captions.find((c) => c.id === id);
          if (cap) {
            const start = Math.max(0, Math.min(startSec, endSec - 0.05));
            const end = Math.min(d.meta.durationSec > 0 ? d.meta.durationSec : 9999, Math.max(endSec, start + 0.05));
            cap.startSec = start;
            cap.endSec = end;
            const span = end - start;
            const wspan = span / Math.max(1, cap.words.length);
            cap.words = cap.words.map((w, i) => ({
              ...w,
              startSec: start + i * wspan,
              endSec: start + (i + 1) * wspan,
            }));
          }
        });
      },
      addCaption: (text = "New lyric line", startSec, endSec) => {
        const start = startSec !== undefined ? startSec : playhead;
        const duration = project.meta.durationSec > 0 ? project.meta.durationSec : 60;
        const end = endSec !== undefined ? endSec : Math.min(duration, start + 2.5);
        const words = tokenizeLine(text);
        const wspan = Math.max(0.05, (end - start) / Math.max(1, words.length));
        const newCap: Caption = {
          id: createId("cap"),
          index: project.captions.length,
          text,
          startSec: start,
          endSec: Math.max(start + 0.1, end),
          words: words.map((t, i) => ({
            text: t.raw,
            startSec: start + i * wspan,
            endSec: start + (i + 1) * wspan,
            confidence: 0.8,
          })),
          animation: {
            in: defaultAnim("fade"),
            out: defaultAnim("fade"),
            highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
          },
          confidence: 0.8,
          instrumental: false,
          locked: false,
        };
        applyCaptions([...project.captions, newCap].sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, index: i })));
        setSelectedIds([newCap.id]);
      },
      replaceLyrics: (rawLyrics: string) => {
        const parsed = parseLyrics(rawLyrics);
        const vocalLines = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
        if (vocalLines.length === 0) {
          notify("No lyric lines found in sheet.");
          return;
        }
        commit((d) => {
          const existingVocal = d.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental);
          if (existingVocal.length === vocalLines.length) {
            // Preserving existing line boundaries and timestamps
            let vIdx = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < d.captions.length; i++) {
              const cap = d.captions[i]!;
              if (cap.instrumental) continue;
              const newL = vocalLines[vIdx]!;
              vIdx++;
              cap.text = newL.text;
              const words = tokenizeLine(newL.text);
              const span = Math.max(0.04, cap.endSec - cap.startSec);
              const wspan = span / Math.max(1, words.length);
              cap.words = words.map((t, wi) => ({
                text: t.raw,
                startSec: cap.startSec + wi * wspan,
                endSec: cap.startSec + (wi + 1) * wspan,
                confidence: cap.confidence ?? 0.8,
              }));
            }
            if (parsed.title && (!d.meta.title || d.meta.title === "Midnight Atlas")) d.meta.title = parsed.title;
            if (parsed.artist && (!d.meta.artist || d.meta.artist === "Northline")) d.meta.artist = parsed.artist;
            return;
          }

          // Line count changed -> full re-sync
          const dur = d.meta.durationSec > 0 ? d.meta.durationSec : Math.max(30, vocalLines.length * 3.6);
          const synced = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, dur);
          if (parsed.title) d.meta.title = parsed.title;
          else if (d.meta.title === "Midnight Atlas" || !d.meta.title) {
            d.meta.title = vocalLines[0]?.text.slice(0, 32) || "Custom Lyrics";
          }
          if (parsed.artist) d.meta.artist = parsed.artist;
          else if (d.meta.artist === "Northline") {
            d.meta.artist = "";
          }
          d.captions = synced.captions;
        });
        setPlayhead(0);
        setSelectedIds(project.captions[0] ? [project.captions[0].id] : []);
        notify(`Updated lyrics sheet.`);
      },
      setPanel: (which, open) => {
        if (which === "left") setLeftOpen(open);
        if (which === "right") setRightOpen(open);
        if (which === "bottom") setBottomOpen(open);
      },
      setPanelSize: (which, size) => {
        if (which === "left") setLeftWidth(size);
        if (which === "right") setRightWidth(size);
        if (which === "bottom") setBottomHeight(size);
      },
      notify,
      markSaved: () => {
        setDirty(false);
        setSaving(false);
      },
    }),
    [
      project,
      selectedIds,
      playhead,
      playing,
      loop,
      volume,
      zoom,
      leftOpen,
      rightOpen,
      bottomOpen,
      leftWidth,
      rightWidth,
      bottomHeight,
      toast,
      dirty,
      saving,
      histSizes,
      setProject,
      commit,
      undo,
      redo,
      select,
      resizeCaption,
      moveCaption,
      rollCaption,
      relinkCaption,
      applyCaptions,
      notify,
    ],
  );

  return <StudioContext.Provider value={api}>{children}</StudioContext.Provider>;
}

export function useStudio(): StudioApi {
  const ctx = useContext(StudioContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useStudio must be used within StudioProvider");
  return ctx;
}

import { Muxer, ArrayBufferTarget } from "mp4-muxer";
import { drawFrame, type ResolvedAssets } from "@/render-engine";
import type { Project } from "@/schema";
import { resolutionSize } from "@/lib/time";
import { StudioError } from "./errors";

export interface ExportOptions {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  fps?: number;
  quality: "high" | "balanced" | "small" | "custom";
  bitrateKbps?: number;
  spectrumFrames?: Float32Array[];
  onProgress?: (p: { frame: number; total: number; pct: number; elapsedMs: number }) => void;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

function bitrateFor(quality: ExportOptions["quality"], width: number, height: number, fps: number, custom?: number): number {
  if (quality === "custom" && custom) return custom * 1000;
  const pixels = width * height;
  const base = pixels >= 1920 * 1080 ? 12_000_000 : 6_000_000;
  const scale = quality === "high" ? 1 : quality === "balanced" ? 0.62 : 0.38;
  return Math.round(base * scale * (fps / 30));
}

export function computeSpectrumFrames(
  audioBuffer: AudioBuffer,
  fps: number,
  totalFrames: number,
  binCount = 48,
): Float32Array[] {
  const channelData = audioBuffer.getChannelData(0);
  const sampleRate = audioBuffer.sampleRate;
  const frames: Float32Array[] = [];
  const windowSize = 2048;

  for (let i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
    const centerSample = Math.round((i / fps) * sampleRate);
    const start = Math.max(0, centerSample - Math.floor(windowSize / 2));
    const end = Math.min(channelData.length, start + windowSize);

    const bins = new Float32Array(binCount);
    const sliceLen = end - start;
    if (sliceLen > 64) {
      const step = Math.floor(sliceLen / binCount);
      for (let b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
        let sum = 0;
        const bStart = start + b * step;
        const bEnd = Math.min(end, bStart + step);
        for (let s = bStart; s < bEnd; s++) {
          const v = channelData[s] ?? 0;
          sum += v * v;
        }
        const rms = Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, bEnd - bStart));
        const boost = 1 + (b / binCount) * 1.5;
        bins[b] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rms * 4.5 * boost));
      }
    }
    frames.push(bins);
  }
  return frames;
}

export async function isWebCodecsSupported(width: number, height: number): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof VideoEncoder === "undefined" || typeof VideoEncoder.isConfigSupported !== "function") return false;
  try {
    const res = await VideoEncoder.isConfigSupported({
      codec: "avc1.4d0028",
      width,
      height,
      bitrate: 6_000_000,
      framerate: 30,
    });
    return Boolean(res.supported);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function exportWebCodecsMp4(
  project: Project,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  assets: ResolvedAssets,
  audioBuffer: AudioBuffer | null,
  options: ExportOptions,
): Promise<Blob> {
  const { width, height } = options.width && options.height
    ? { width: options.width, height: options.height }
    : resolutionSize(project.meta.resolution);
  const fps = options.fps ?? project.meta.fps;
  const duration = Math.max(0.1, audioBuffer?.duration || project.meta.durationSec || 8);
  const totalFrames = Math.round(duration * fps);
  const supported = await isWebCodecsSupported(width, height);
  if (!supported) throw new StudioError("webcodecs_unsupported", "WebCodecs is not available.");

  canvas.width = width;
  canvas.height = height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("Could not acquire 2D context for export.");

  const target = new ArrayBufferTarget();
  const muxer = new Muxer({
    target,
    video: { codec: "avc", width, height },
    audio: audioBuffer
      ? { codec: "aac", numberOfChannels: Math.min(2, audioBuffer.numberOfChannels), sampleRate: 48000 }
      : undefined,
    fastStart: "in-memory",
    firstTimestampBehavior: "offset",
  });

  let encoderError: Error | null = null;
  const fail = (e: unknown) => {
    encoderError = e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e));
  };

  const bitrate = bitrateFor(options.quality, width, height, fps, options.bitrateKbps);
  const videoEncoder = new VideoEncoder({
    output: (chunk, meta) => muxer.addVideoChunk(chunk, meta),
    error: fail,
  });
  videoEncoder.configure({
    codec: "avc1.4d0028",
    width,
    height,
    bitrate,
    framerate: fps,
    latencyMode: "quality",
  });

  let audioEncoder: AudioEncoder | null = null;
  if (audioBuffer && typeof AudioEncoder !== "undefined") {
    audioEncoder = new AudioEncoder({
      output: (chunk, meta) => muxer.addAudioChunk(chunk, meta),
      error: fail,
    });
    audioEncoder.configure({
      codec: "mp4a.40.2",
      numberOfChannels: Math.min(2, audioBuffer.numberOfChannels),
      sampleRate: 48000,
      bitrate: options.quality === "small" ? 192_000 : options.quality === "balanced" ? 256_000 : 320_000,
    });
    const offline = new OfflineAudioContext(Math.min(2, audioBuffer.numberOfChannels), Math.ceil(48000 * duration), 48000);
    const src = offline.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = audioBuffer;
    src.connect(offline.destination);
    src.start();
    const rendered = await offline.startRendering();
    const channels = Math.min(2, rendered.numberOfChannels);
    const frameSize = 1024;
    const total = rendered.length;
    for (let offset = 0; offset < total; offset += frameSize) {
      if (options.signal?.aborted) throw new StudioError("export_cancelled", "Export cancelled.");
      if (encoderError) throw encoderError;
      const count = Math.min(frameSize, total - offset);
      const data = new Float32Array(count * channels);
      for (let ch = 0; ch < channels; ch += 1) {
        const plane = rendered.getChannelData(ch);
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) data[i * channels + ch] = plane[offset + i] ?? 0;
      }
      const audioData = new AudioData({
        format: "f32",
        sampleRate: 48000,
        numberOfFrames: count,
        numberOfChannels: channels,
        timestamp: Math.round((offset / 48000) * 1e6),
        data,
      });
      audioEncoder.encode(audioData);
      audioData.close();
    }
    await audioEncoder.flush();
    audioEncoder.close();
  }

  const started = performance.now();
  for (let i = 0; i < totalFrames; i += 1) {
    if (options.signal?.aborted) throw new StudioError("export_cancelled", "Export cancelled.");
    if (encoderError) throw encoderError;

    const drainDeadline = performance.now() + 5000;
    while (videoEncoder.encodeQueueSize > 8) {
      if (encoderError) throw encoderError;
      if (performance.now() > drainDeadline) {
        throw new Error("Video encoder backpressure timeout: queue failed to drain within 5s.");
      }
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 20);
        videoEncoder.ondequeue = () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          resolve();
        };
      });
    }

    const timeSec = i / fps;
    const frameAssets: ResolvedAssets = {
      ...assets,
      spectrum: options.spectrumFrames?.[i] ?? assets.spectrum,
    };
    try {
      drawFrame(ctx as unknown as Parameters<typeof drawFrame>[0], project, timeSec, frameAssets);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`drawFrame skipped at frame ${i} (t=${timeSec.toFixed(3)}s):`, err);
    }

    const frame = new VideoFrame(canvas, {
      timestamp: Math.round((i * 1e6) / fps),
      duration: Math.round(1e6 / fps),
    });
    videoEncoder.encode(frame, { keyFrame: i % (fps * 2) === 0 });
    frame.close();

    if (i % 4 === 0 || i === totalFrames - 1) {
      options.onProgress?.({
        frame: i + 1,
        total: totalFrames,
        pct: (i + 1) / totalFrames,
        elapsedMs: performance.now() - started,
      });
    }
  }

  await videoEncoder.flush();
  videoEncoder.close();
  muxer.finalize();
  const buffer = target.buffer;
  if (!buffer) throw new Error("Muxer produced an empty buffer.");
  options.onProgress?.({ frame: totalFrames, total: totalFrames, pct: 1, elapsedMs: performance.now() - started });
  return new Blob([buffer], { type: "video/mp4" });
}

const SAMPLE_LYRICS = `[Verse 1]
Four in the morning
And I'm still wide awake

[Chorus]

interface ClipMap {
  name: string;
  file: File;
  lineIndex: number; // matched line index, or -1 for instrumental
  isInstrumental: boolean;
  matchScore: number;
  matchReason: string;
}

// AI Auto-Mapper: Analyzes clip filenames and matches with lyric lines / instrumental gaps
function autoMapClip(file: File, lines: { index: number; text: string; instrumental?: boolean }[]): ClipMap {
  const name = file.name;
  const stem = name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").toLowerCase();
  
  // 1. Check for instrumental gap keywords
  const instrumentalKeywords = ["instrumental", "intro", "gap", "break", "solo", "outro", "interlude", "pause", "music"];
  const hasInstrumentalWord = instrumentalKeywords.some((kw) => stem.includes(kw));

  // Extract clean text words from filename (strip numbers, track prefixes, and line tags)
  const cleanStem = stem
    .replace(/^(\d+)[-_]/, "")
    .replace(/line[-_]?0*(\d+)[-_]?/i, "")
    .replace(/[-_.]+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  const stemTokens = cleanStem.split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 1);

  // Check line number pattern (e.g. line_01, line01, line_1)
  const lineNumMatch = stem.match(/line[-_]?0*(\d+)/i);
  const targetLineNumber = lineNumMatch ? parseInt(lineNumMatch[1], 10) : null;

  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);

  let bestLineIndex = 0;
  let bestScore = 0;
  let bestReason = "Sequential";

  if (hasInstrumentalWord && !targetLineNumber && stemTokens.length <= 2) {
    return {
      name,
      file,
      lineIndex: -1,
      isInstrumental: true,
      matchScore: 0.95,
      matchReason: "Instrumental Gap",
    };
  }

  // If explicit line number like line_01 -> match vocalLine index 0
  if (targetLineNumber !== null && targetLineNumber >= 1 && targetLineNumber <= vocalLines.length) {
    const matchedVocal = vocalLines[targetLineNumber - 1];
    if (matchedVocal) {
      bestLineIndex = matchedVocal.index;
      bestScore = 0.98;
      bestReason = `Line #${targetLineNumber}`;
    }
  }

  // Check textual similarity / word overlap with all lyric lines
  for (const l of vocalLines) {
    const lineLower = l.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, "");
    const lineTokens = lineLower.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);

    // Substring match
    if (cleanStem.length > 4 && lineLower.includes(cleanStem)) {
      const score = 0.99;
      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        bestLineIndex = l.index;
        bestReason = `100% Lyric Match`;
      }
    }

    // Word token overlap
    let matchCount = 0;
    for (const st of stemTokens) {
      if (lineTokens.some((lt) => lt.includes(st) || st.includes(lt))) {
        matchCount++;
      }
    }
    const tokenScore = stemTokens.length > 0 ? matchCount / stemTokens.length : 0;
    if (tokenScore > bestScore && tokenScore > 0.3) {
      bestScore = tokenScore;
      bestLineIndex = l.index;
      bestReason = `${Math.round(tokenScore * 100)}% Match`;
    }
  }

  return {
    name,
    file,
    lineIndex: bestLineIndex,
    isInstrumental: false,
    matchScore: bestScore || 0.8,
    matchReason: bestReason,
  };
}

export function Wizard() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState<number>(1);
  const [key, setKey] = useState("");
  const [showKey, setShowKey] = useState(false);
  const [persist, setPersist] = useState<"session" | "store">("session");
  const [keyOk, setKeyOk] = useState(false);
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [keyError, setKeyError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hasSessionKey, setHasSessionKey] = useState(false);

  // Dedicated Title and Artist
  const [songTitle, setSongTitle] = useState("");
  const [artistName, setArtistName] = useState("");

  // Audio and Lyrics
  const [audioFile, setAudioFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const [audioMeta, setAudioMeta] = useState<string>("");
  const [lyrics, setLyrics] = useState("");
  const [clips, setClips] = useState<ClipMap[]>([]);
  const [log, setLog] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const clipRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const keySectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const audioSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lyricsSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const clipsSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetch("/api/session")
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((j: { configured?: boolean; defaultKey?: string }) => {
        if (j.configured) {
          setHasSessionKey(true);
          setKeyOk(true);
        }
        if (j.defaultKey) {
          setKey((prev) => prev || j.defaultKey || "");
        }
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  const parsed = useMemo(() => parseLyrics(lyrics), [lyrics]);
  const vocalCount = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).length;
  const instrumentalCount = parsed.lines.filter((l) => l.instrumental).length;

  // Auto-sync parsed title / artist to separate fields if empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (parsed.title && !songTitle) setSongTitle(parsed.title);
    if (parsed.artist && !artistName) setArtistName(parsed.artist);
  }, [parsed.title, parsed.artist, songTitle, artistName]);

  const scrollToSection = (index: number) => {
    setActiveNav(index);
    const refs = [keySectionRef, audioSectionRef, lyricsSectionRef, clipsSectionRef];
    refs[index - 1]?.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };

  async function validateKey() {
    setKeyError(null);
    setValidating(true);
    try {
      const activeKey = key.trim();
      if (!activeKey) {
        setKeyError("Please enter a Groq API key.");
        setKeyOk(false);
        setValidating(false);
        return;
      }
      const res = await fetch("/api/session", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ key: activeKey, persist }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok) {
        setKeyError(json.error ?? "Could not validate that key.");
        setKeyOk(false);
        return;
      }
      setKeyOk(true);
      setHasSessionKey(true);
      setKey(activeKey);
    } catch {
      setKeyError("Network error while validating key.");
      setKeyOk(false);
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  }

  async function onAudio(file: File) {
    try {
      const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const decoded = await decodeAudio(buf);
      setAudioFile(file);
      setDuration(decoded.duration);
      if (!songTitle) {
        setSongTitle(file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
      }
      const p = extractPeaks(decoded, 240);
      setPeaks(Array.from(p));
      setAudioMeta(`${file.name} · ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB · ${decoded.duration.toFixed(1)}s`);
      await putBlob("draft-master", file);
      await putPeaks("draft-master", p);
    } catch {
      setAudioMeta("Could not decode that audio file. Re-export as MP3 or WAV.");
    }
  }

  const handlePasteClipboard = async () => {
    try {
      const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
      if (text) {
        setLyrics(text);
      }
    } catch {}
  };

  // Split Clips Upload Handler with automatic AI mapping
  const handleClipsUpload = (uploadedFiles: File[]) => {
    const sorted = Array.from(uploadedFiles).sort((a, b) => naturalSort(a.name, b.name));
    const mapped = sorted.map((file) => autoMapClip(file, parsed.lines));
    setClips(mapped);
  };

  async function generateWithoutAudio() {
    setRunning(true);
    setLog(["Parsing lyric sheet...", "Generating synchronized captions with rhythm heuristics..."]);
    setProgress(0.4);
    const estDuration = Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8);
    const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, estDuration);

    const project = defaultProject({
      id: createId("proj"),
      meta: {
        title: songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || "Custom Lyrics",
        artist: artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist",
        durationSec: estDuration,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
      captions: sync.captions,
    });

    setProgress(0.8);
    const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
    });

    if (!saved.ok) {
      const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown error");
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error saving project: ${errText}`]);
      setRunning(false);
      return;
    }

    const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
    setProgress(1);
    setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Project ready! Opening Studio..."]);
    setRunning(false);
    startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
  }

  async function analyze() {
    if (!audioFile) {
      await generateWithoutAudio();
      return;
    }
    setRunning(true);
    setLog(["Starting Whisper large-v3-turbo speech-to-text alignment..."]);
    setProgress(0.1);

    const form = new FormData();
    form.set("lyrics", lyrics);
    form.set("durationSec", String(duration));
    form.set("title", songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || audioFile.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
    form.set("artist", artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist");
    form.set("language", "en");

    try {
      const decoded = await decodeAudio(await audioFile.arrayBuffer());
      const wav = encodeWavMono16(downsampleMono(decoded), 16000);
      form.set("audio", new File([wav], "master.wav", { type: "audio/wav" }));

      const res = await fetch("/api/analyze", { method: "POST", body: form });
      if (!res.body) {
        setLog(["The analyze stream failed to open."]);
        setRunning(false);
        return;
      }

      const reader = res.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buf = "";
      let captions: Caption[] = [];
      let flagged = 0;
      let title = songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || "Untitled";
      let artist = artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist";
      let streamFailed = false;

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        buf += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const chunks = buf.split("\n\n");
        buf = chunks.pop() ?? "";
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          const line = chunk.split("\n").find((l) => l.startsWith("data:"));
          if (!line) continue;
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim()) as {
              stage: string;
              label: string;
              progress: number;
              captions?: Caption[];
              flagged?: number;
              mode?: "asr" | "heuristic";
              title?: string;
              artist?: string;
            };
            setProgress(payload.progress);
            setLog((curr) => [...curr, `${payload.stage}  ${payload.label}`]);
            if (payload.mode) {
              setLog((curr) => [
                ...curr,
                payload.mode === "asr"
                  ? "✓ High-accuracy Groq Whisper word timings aligned"
                  : "ℹ Syllable-weighted rhythm timing applied",
              ]);
            }
            if (payload.stage === "error") streamFailed = true;
            if (payload.captions) captions = payload.captions;
            if (payload.flagged !== undefined) flagged = payload.flagged;
            if (payload.title && !songTitle) title = payload.title;
            if (payload.artist && !artistName) artist = payload.artist;
          } catch {}
        }
      }

      if (streamFailed && captions.length === 0) {
        setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Whisper API unavailable. Falling back to heuristic rhythm timing sync..."]);
        const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, duration || Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8));
        captions = sync.captions;
      }

      const project = defaultProject({
        id: createId("proj"),
        meta: {
          title,
          artist,
          durationSec: duration,
          fps: 30,
          resolution: "1920x1080",
          aspectRatio: "16:9",
          language: "en",
        },
        captions,
      });

      await putBlob(`audio-${project.id}`, audioFile);

      const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
      });

      if (!saved.ok) {
        const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown error");
        setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error saving project: ${errText}`]);
        setRunning(false);
        return;
      }

      const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, flagged ? `Review ${flagged} flagged lines in the studio.` : "All lines aligned confidently!"]);
      setRunning(false);
      startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Generation error";
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error: ${msg}. Falling back to heuristic sync...`]);
      await generateWithoutAudio();
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      {/* 4-Step Sticky Nav Bar */}
      <div className="sticky top-4 z-40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0c1017]/95 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {[
            { id: 1, label: "1 KEY", status: keyOk ? "READY" : key ? "ENTERED" : "REQUIRED" },
            { id: 2, label: "2 AUDIO", status: audioFile ? `${(duration / 60).toFixed(0)}m` : "OPTIONAL" },
            { id: 3, label: "3 LYRICS", status: vocalCount > 0 ? `${vocalCount} LINES` : "REQUIRED" },

                onClick={() => scrollToSection(item.id)}
                className={`group flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] transition-all ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,193,90,0.35)] scale-105"
                    : "border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] text-[var(--muted)] hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                <span
                  className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[9px] font-bold ${
                    isActive
                      ? "bg-black/20 text-[var(--accent-ink)]"
                      : item.status.includes("READY") || item.status.includes("LINES") || item.status.includes("m")
                      ? "bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)]"
                      : "bg-white/5 text-[var(--faint)]"
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.status}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[var(--accent)] font-semibold">
            <Sparkles size={13} /> AI Lyric Video Generator
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Grid Layout */}
      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* STEP 1: Connect Groq */}
          <section
            ref={keySectionRef}
            id="step-key"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  1

                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Speech-to-Text Engine & API Key
                </h3>
              </div>
              {keyOk && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ok)] bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5">
                  <Check size={13} /> Active & Verified
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Whisper large-v3-turbo provides word-level timestamps. Keys remain secure on the server and are never logged or exported.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showKey ? "text" : "password"}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  placeholder="gsk_…"
                  value={key}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setKey(e.target.value);
                    setKeyOk(false);
                  }}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] pl-4 pr-10 py-2.5 font-mono text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowKey(!showKey)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                >
                  {showKey ? <EyeOff size={15} /> : <Eye size={15} />}
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                <span className="text-[var(--faint)]">
                  {key ? "Custom key entered" : "Paste your Groq API key (starts with gsk_)"}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    void fetch("/api/session")
                      .then((r) => r.json())
                      .then((j: { defaultKey?: string }) => {
                        if (j.defaultKey) {
                          setKey(j.defaultKey);
                          setKeyOk(false);
                        }
                      })
                      .catch(() => undefined);
                  }}
                  className="text-[var(--accent)] hover:underline font-medium"
                >
                  Use Preconfigured Server Key
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={persist === "store"}
                  onChange={(e) => setPersist(e.target.checked ? "store" : "session")}
                  className="rounded border-[var(--line)] accent-[var(--accent)]"
                />
                Remember key on this machine
              </label>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={validating}
                onClick={() => void validateKey()}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--accent)] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50 transition-all active:scale-95"
              >
                <KeyRound size={14} /> {validating ? "Verifying..." : keyOk ? "Re-verify Key" : "Validate Key"}
              </button>
            </div>

            {keyError && <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-[var(--danger)]">{keyError}</p>}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 2: Master Audio */}
          <section
            ref={audioSectionRef}
            id="step-audio"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  2
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Master Audio Track
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">Optional for Heuristic mode</span>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Upload full mix (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG). The audio is decoded client-side into synchronized audio frames.
            </p>

            <div
              onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
              className="mt-4 flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-6 py-8 transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[#0f141f]"
            >
              <Upload className="mb-2 text-[var(--accent)]" size={24} />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--ink)]">
                {audioFile ? audioFile.name : "Drop a full audio track (MP3/WAV), or click to browse"}
              </span>
              <span className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">
                {audioMeta || "Waveform spectrum will render automatically upon decoding"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <input
              ref={fileRef}
              type="file"
              accept="audio/*"
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void onAudio(e.target.files[0])}
            />

            {peaks.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#07090e] p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--faint)] mb-2">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[var(--accent)] font-medium">
                    <Music size={13} /> {audioFile?.name}
                  </span>
                  <span>{duration.toFixed(1)}s total</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex h-14 items-end gap-px">
                  {peaks.map((p, i) => (
                    <span
                      key={i}
                      className="flex-1 rounded-t-sm bg-gradient-to-t from-[var(--accent)]/40 to-[var(--accent)]"
                      style={{ height: `${Math.max(8, p * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {audioFile && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAudioFile(null);
                    setPeaks([]);
                    setDuration(0);
                    setAudioMeta("");
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-red-400 hover:underline"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={13} /> Remove audio
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 3: Lyric Sheet & Track Metadata */}
          <section
            ref={lyricsSectionRef}
            id="step-lyrics"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  3
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Track Info & Lyric Sheet
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)]/15 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent)]">
                {vocalCount} vocal lines
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Dedicated Title and Artist Input Fields */}
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Song Title</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Midnight Atlas"
                  value={songTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setSongTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Artist Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Northline"
                  value={artistName}
                  onChange={(e) => setArtistName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Action Toolbar */}
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-white/5 pb-2">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSongTitle("Four in the morning");
                    setArtistName("Original Artist");
                    setLyrics(SAMPLE_LYRICS);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Sparkles size={13} /> Load Sample Lyrics
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePasteClipboard}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors"
                >
                  <Clipboard size={13} /> Paste Clipboard
                </button>
                {lyrics && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setLyrics("")}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={13} /> Clear
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <textarea
              value={lyrics}
              onChange={(e) => setLyrics(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={`[Verse 1]\nFirst lyric line here\nSecond lyric line here\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one\nChorus line two`}
              className="mt-3 h-56 w-full resize-y rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] p-4 font-mono text-xs leading-6 text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
            />

            {/* Real-time Parser Badge Deck */}
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <span className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2 py-1 text-[var(--muted)]">
                Lines: <strong className="text-[var(--accent)]">{vocalCount}</strong>
              </span>
              {instrumentalCount > 0 && (
                <span className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2 py-1 text-[var(--faint)]">
                  {instrumentalCount} instrumental pauses
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* STEP 4: Split Clips with AI Auto-Mapping */}
          <section
            ref={clipsSectionRef}
            id="step-clips"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  4
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Split Audio Clips (AI Auto-Mapped)
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">Multi-track alignment</span>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Drop 001.wav, 01_line_01.wav, or instrumental slices. AI automatically analyzes filenames and links each clip to its matching lyric line or instrumental pause.
            </p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => clipRef.current?.click()}
              className="mt-4 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0b0e14] py-6 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--muted)] hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <FileAudio size={16} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Add Line Slices (00_intro.wav, 01_line_01.wav...)
            </button>
            <input
              ref={clipRef}
              type="file"
              accept="audio/*"
              multiple
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
                  handleClipsUpload(Array.from(e.target.files));
                }
              }}
            />

            {clips.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[var(--ok)] font-medium bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-500/20 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px]">
                    <Check size={12} /> AI Auto-Mapped ({clips.length}/{clips.length} clips matched)
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setClips([])}
                    className="text-red-400 text-[11px] hover:underline"
                  >
                    Clear clips
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="max-h-56 overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] lf-scroll bg-[#07090e]">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                    <thead className="border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="px-3 py-2.5">Audio Slice</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-2.5">AI Matched Lyric Line</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">Status</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {clips.map((c, i) => (
                        <tr key={c.name} className="border-t border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5">
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5 font-mono text-[var(--ink)] max-w-[220px] truncate" title={c.name}>
                            {c.name}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5">
                            <select
                              value={c.lineIndex}
                              className="w-full bg-transparent text-xs text-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                const next = [...clips];
                                const val = Number(e.target.value);
                                next[i] = {
                                  ...c,
                                  lineIndex: val,
                                  isInstrumental: val === -1,
                                  matchReason: val === -1 ? "Instrumental Gap" : "Manual",
                                };
                                setClips(next);
                              }}
                            >
                              <option value={-1} className="bg-[#12161f] text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                                ♪ Instrumental Gap
                              </option>
                              {parsed.lines
                                .filter((l) => !l.instrumental)
                                .map((l) => (
                                  <option key={l.index} value={l.index} className="bg-[#12161f] text-white">
                                    #{l.index + 1}: {l.text.slice(0, 42)}
                                  </option>
                                ))}
                            </select>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">
                            <span
                              className={`inline-block rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                                c.isInstrumental
                                  ? "bg-purple-950/40 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30"
                                  : "bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {c.matchReason}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Generation Deck & Action Summary */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <section className="sticky top-20 rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-gradient-to-b from-[#121722] to-[var(--bg-panel)] p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--accent)] font-bold">
                Launch Ready
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
                <Film size={14} /> 1080p60 WebCodecs
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Song Preview Summary */}
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#07090e]/80 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--faint)]">Lyric Video Project</p>
              <h4 className="mt-1 font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-2xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                {songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || (lyrics ? "Untitled Project" : "Drop audio or paste lyrics")}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--accent)] mt-0.5">{artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist"}</p>

              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-[#12161f] p-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-[var(--faint)] block">Audio</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-[var(--ink)]">
                    {audioFile ? `${duration.toFixed(0)}s Track` : "Heuristic Sync"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-[#12161f] p-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-[var(--faint)] block">Captions</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-[var(--accent)]">{vocalCount} lines ready</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Primary Generation CTAs */}
            <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0}
                onClick={() => void analyze()}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] via-amber-400 to-amber-300 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(245,193,90,0.3)] hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Sparkles size={18} />
                {running ? "Processing Auto-Sync..." : audioFile ? "Generate with AI (Audio + Whisper)" : "Generate Lyric Video"}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0}
                onClick={() => void generateWithoutAudio()}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:text-[var(--accent)] active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Zap size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Fast Heuristic Sync (No Audio needed)
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Live Progress Bar & SSE Log Console */}
            {running || log.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] p-3.5 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-[var(--accent)] font-medium">Pipeline Status</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[var(--muted)]">{Math.round(progress * 100)}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1c2230]">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-300 transition-all duration-300"
                    style={{ width: `${progress * 100}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
                <ul className="max-h-36 overflow-auto space-y-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] pt-1 lf-scroll">
                  {log.map((line, i) => (
                    <li key={`${line}-${i}`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[var(--accent)] select-none">›</span>
                      <span>{line}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {/* Feature Badges */}
            <div className="mt-6 border-t border-[var(--line)] pt-4 space-y-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AudioLines size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
                <span>Needleman–Wunsch alignment with Whisper word timestamps</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sparkles size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
                <span>Dynamic canvas renderer for live preview and 1080p60 MP4 export</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Layers size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
                <span>Custom animations, beat-reactive overlays & visualizers</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { asrCoverage, heuristicSync, parseLyrics, runSync, sanitizeAsr } from "@/align-engine";
import { AsrResultSchema, type AnalyzeProgress, type AsrResult, type Caption } from "@/schema";
import { getAsrCache, getAsset, putAsrCache } from "@/db/repository";
import { llmTiebreak, transcribeAudio, validateKey } from "@/lib/groq";
import { readGroqKey } from "@/lib/session";
import { messageFor } from "@/lib/errors";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { lyricsPromptWindow } from "@/align-engine/lyrics";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 120;

function sse(event: string, data: unknown): string {
  return `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const form = await req.formData();
  const lyrics = String(form.get("lyrics") ?? "");
  const language = String(form.get("language") ?? "en");
  const durationSec = Number(form.get("durationSec") ?? 0);
  const assetId = String(form.get("assetId") ?? "");
  const title = String(form.get("title") ?? "");
  const artist = String(form.get("artist") ?? "");
  const audio = form.get("audio");
  const parsed = parseLyrics(lyrics);
  if (title && !parsed.title) parsed.title = title;
  if (artist && !parsed.artist) parsed.artist = artist;

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const started = Date.now();
  const stream = new ReadableStream({
    async start(controller) {
      const send = (stage: AnalyzeProgress["stage"], label: string, progress: number, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        const payload: AnalyzeProgress & Record<string, unknown> = {
          stage,
          label,
          progress,
          elapsedMs: Date.now() - started,
          ...extra,
        };
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sse("progress", payload)));
      };
      try {
        send("A", "Preprocess — inspecting audio and lyric sheet", 0.08);
        if (parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).length === 0) {
          throw new Error("Lyric sheet is empty. Paste lines; blank lines mark instrumental gaps.");
        }

        send("B", "FFT anchors — waiting on optional split clips", 0.16, {
          detail: "No split clips supplied; skipping Stage B (highest-quality anchors).",
        });

        let apiKey: string | null = null;
        try {
          apiKey = await readGroqKey();
        } catch {
          apiKey = null;
        }

        let asr: AsrResult | null = null;
        let modelId = "heuristic";

        if (apiKey) {
          send("C", "Contacting Groq Whisper for word-level ASR", 0.28);
          const models = await validateKey(apiKey);
          modelId = models.asr;
          let blob: Blob | null = null;
          let filename = "audio.wav";
          let sha = "";
          if (audio instanceof File) {
            blob = audio;
            filename = audio.name;
            const buf = Buffer.from(await audio.arrayBuffer());
            sha = `${buf.length}_${buf.subarray(0, 64).toString("hex")}`;
            if (audio.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024) {
              throw new Error(messageFor("oversized_upload"));
            }
          } else if (assetId) {
            const asset = await getAsset(assetId);
            if (asset) {
              const abs = path.join(process.cwd(), asset.path);
              const buf = await readFile(abs);
              blob = new Blob([buf], { type: asset.mime });
              filename = asset.filename;
              sha = asset.sha256 ?? `${buf.length}`;
            }
          }
          if (blob) {
            let cached: AsrResult | null = null;
            if (sha) {
              try {
                cached = await getAsrCache(sha, modelId, language);
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn("ASR cache read failed:", err);
              }
            }
            if (cached) {
              asr = cached;
              send("C", "ASR cache hit — skipping Whisper", 0.42);
            } else {
              const prompt = lyricsPromptWindow(
                parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => l.text),
                0,
              );
              asr = await transcribeAudio({
                apiKey,
                file: blob,
                filename,
                language,
                prompt,
                model: modelId,
              });
              if (sha && asr) {
                try {
                  await putAsrCache(sha, modelId, language, asr);
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn("ASR cache write failed:", err);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          send("C", "No Groq key — using syllable-weighted heuristic timing", 0.36, {
            detail: "Add a Groq key for Whisper word timestamps.",
          });
        }

        if (asr) {
          const sanitizedWords = sanitizeAsr(asr.words ?? [], durationSec);
          asr = {
            ...asr,
            words: sanitizedWords,
          };
        }

        send("D", "Normalize tokens (NFKC, numerals, metaphone)", 0.52);
        send("E", "Needleman–Wunsch global alignment", 0.64);
        send("F", "Assign timestamps from ASR + syllable interpolation", 0.74);
        send("G", "Assemble original lines with lead-in / hold", 0.82);

        const dur = durationSec > 0 ? durationSec : asr?.duration ?? 180;
        let captions: Caption[];
        let flagged = 0;
        let meanConfidence = 0;
        let mode: "asr" | "heuristic" = "heuristic";

        const fullLyricText = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => l.text).join(" ");
        const coverage = asr?.words?.length ? asrCoverage(asr.words, fullLyricText) : 0;

        if (asr && asr.words && asr.words.length > 0 && coverage >= 0.15) {
          mode = "asr";
          const parsedAsr = AsrResultSchema.parse(asr);
          if (!parsedAsr.text.trim()) throw new Error(messageFor("empty_asr"));
          const synced = runSync({ lines: parsed.lines, asr: parsedAsr, durationSec: dur });
          captions = synced.captions;
          flagged = synced.flagged;
          meanConfidence = synced.meanConfidence;
        } else {
          mode = "heuristic";
          if (asr && coverage < 0.15) {
            send("C", "Whisper coverage low (<15%) — falling back to syllable-weighted heuristic sync", 0.45);
          }
          const synced = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, dur);
          captions = synced.captions;
          flagged = synced.flagged;
          meanConfidence = synced.meanConfidence;
        }

        send("H", "Score confidence and optional LLM tie-break", 0.9);
        if (apiKey && flagged > 0 && asr?.segments?.length) {
          const ambiguous = captions
            .map((c, i) => ({ i, c }))
            .filter(({ c }) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.35)
            .slice(0, 8);
          if (ambiguous.length) {
            try {
              const models = await validateKey(apiKey);
              await llmTiebreak({
                apiKey,
                model: models.llm,
                payload: {
                  lyrics: ambiguous.map(({ i, c }) => ({ index: i, text: c.text })),
                  segments: (asr.segments ?? []).slice(0, 40).map((s, i) => ({
                    index: i,
                    start: s.start,
                    end: s.end,
                    text: s.text,
                  })),
                },
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn("LLM tiebreak optional step failed:", err);
            }
          }
        }

        send("done", `Sync complete (${mode.toUpperCase()})`, 1, {
          captions,
          flagged,
          meanConfidence,
          mode,
          title: parsed.title,
          artist: parsed.artist,
          jobId: createId("job"),
        });
        controller.close();
      } catch (err) {
        const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : messageFor("generic");
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sse("progress", { stage: "error", label: message, progress: 1 })));
        controller.close();
      }
    },
  });

  return new Response(stream, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/event-stream",
      "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform",
      Connection: "keep-alive",
    },
  });
}
