import {
  defaultAnim,
  type AnchorHit,
  type AsrResult,
  type AsrWord,
  type Caption,
  type LyricLine,
  type Word,
} from "@/schema";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { needlemanWunsch } from "./needleman-wunsch";
import { countSyllables, normalizedLevenshtein, tokenizeLine, type NormToken } from "./normalize";

export interface TimedLyricWord {
  lineIndex: number;
  tokenIndex: number;
  text: string;
  startSec: number;
  endSec: number;
  confidence: number;
  matched: boolean;
}

export interface SyncResult {
  captions: Caption[];
  flagged: number;
  meanConfidence: number;
}

function flattenLyrics(lines: LyricLine[]): { tokens: NormToken[]; owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[] } {
  const tokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.instrumental) continue;
    const parts = tokenizeLine(line.text);
    parts.forEach((t, token) => {
      tokens.push(t);
      owners.push({ line: line.index, token, text: t.raw });
    });
  }
  return { tokens, owners };
}

function flattenAsr(asr: AsrResult): { tokens: NormToken[]; words: AsrWord[] } {
  const source =
    asr.words && asr.words.length > 0
      ? asr.words
      : (asr.segments ?? []).flatMap((s) =>
          (s.words ?? s.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map((word, i, arr) => {
            const span = Math.max(0.05, (s.end - s.start) / Math.max(1, arr.length));
            return { word, start: s.start + i * span, end: s.start + (i + 1) * span, probability: 0.5 };
          })),
        );
  const tokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const words: AsrWord[] = [];
  for (const w of source) {
    const parts = tokenizeLine(w.word);
    for (const t of parts) {
      tokens.push(t);
      words.push(w);
    }
  }
  return { tokens, words };
}

function interpolate(
  start: number,
  end: number,
  weights: number[],
): { startSec: number; endSec: number }[] {
  const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || weights.length || 1;
  const span = Math.max(0.04, end - start);
  let cursor = start;
  return weights.map((w) => {
    const dur = (w / total) * span;
    const item = { startSec: cursor, endSec: cursor + dur };
    cursor += dur;
    return item;
  });
}

export function assignTimestamps(
  lyricTokens: NormToken[],
  owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[],
  asrWords: AsrWord[],
  path: { op: string; lyricIndex: number; asrIndex: number; score: number }[],
  durationSec: number,
): TimedLyricWord[] {
  const timed: Array<TimedLyricWord | null> = lyricTokens.map((t, i) => ({
    lineIndex: owners[i]?.line ?? 0,
    tokenIndex: owners[i]?.token ?? 0,
    text: owners[i]?.text ?? t.raw,
    startSec: -1,
    endSec: -1,
    confidence: 0,
    matched: false,
  }));

  for (const cell of path) {
    if (cell.op !== "match") continue;
    const asr = asrWords[cell.asrIndex];
    const slot = timed[cell.lyricIndex];
    if (!asr || !slot) continue;
    slot.startSec = asr.start;
    slot.endSec = Math.max(asr.start + 0.04, asr.end);
    slot.confidence = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, cell.score));
    slot.matched = true;
  }

  let i = 0;
  while (i < timed.length) {
    if ((timed[i]?.startSec ?? -1) >= 0) {
      i += 1;
      continue;
    }
    let j = i;
    while (j < timed.length && (timed[j]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) j += 1;
    let prev = i - 1;
    while (prev >= 0 && (timed[prev]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) prev -= 1;
    const leftT = prev >= 0 ? timed[prev]!.endSec : 0;
    const rightT = j < timed.length ? timed[j]!.startSec : durationSec;
    const gap = timed.slice(i, j);
    const weights = gap.map((g, k) => {
      const tok = lyricTokens[i + k];
      return tok ? tok.syllables || Math.max(1, tok.norm.length / 3) : 1;
    });
    const spans = interpolate(leftT, rightT, weights);
    gap.forEach((g, k) => {
      if (!g) return;
      g.startSec = spans[k]!.startSec;
      g.endSec = spans[k]!.endSec;
      g.confidence = 0.28;
    });
    i = j;
  }

  for (let k = 1; k < timed.length; k += 1) {
    const prev = timed[k - 1]!;
    const curr = timed[k]!;
    if (curr.startSec < prev.endSec) {
      const mid = (prev.endSec + curr.startSec) / 2;
      prev.endSec = mid;
      curr.startSec = mid;
    }
    if (curr.endSec <= curr.startSec) curr.endSec = curr.startSec + 0.05;
  }
  return timed.filter((t): t is TimedLyricWord => t !== null);
}

export function assembleLines(
  lines: LyricLine[],
  words: TimedLyricWord[],
  durationSec: number,
): Caption[] {
  const byLine = new Map<number, TimedLyricWord[]>();
  for (const w of words) {
    const list = byLine.get(w.lineIndex) ?? [];
    list.push(w);
    byLine.set(w.lineIndex, list);
  }
  const captions: Caption[] = [];
  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  vocalLines.forEach((line, order) => {
    const group = (byLine.get(line.index) ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);
    const first = group[0];
    const last = group[group.length - 1];
    const start = first ? Math.max(0, first.startSec - 0.06) : 0;
    const end = last ? last.endSec + 0.12 : start + 1;
    const matched = group.filter((g) => g.matched).length;
    const conf =
      group.length === 0 ? 0.2 : 0.55 * (matched / group.length) + 0.45 * (group.reduce((s, g) => s + g.confidence, 0) / group.length);
    captions.push({
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: group.map(
        (g): Word => ({
          text: g.text,
          startSec: g.startSec,
          endSec: g.endSec,
          confidence: g.confidence,
        }),
      ),
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: { ...defaultAnim("fade"), durationSec: 0.25 },
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, conf)),
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    });
  });

  captions.sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const next = captions[i + 1];
    if (next && curr.endSec > next.startSec - 0.04) {
      curr.endSec = Math.max(curr.startSec + 0.04, next.startSec - 0.04);
    }
    curr.endSec = Math.min(curr.endSec, durationSec);
    curr.index = i;
  }

  const withGaps: Caption[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const prev = withGaps[withGaps.length - 1];
    if (prev && curr.startSec - prev.endSec > 3.5) {
      withGaps.push({
        id: createId("gap"),
        index: withGaps.length,
        text: "♪",
        startSec: prev.endSec,
        endSec: curr.startSec,
        words: [],
        animation: {
          in: defaultAnim("fade"),
          out: defaultAnim("fade"),
          highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 0.4 },
        },
        confidence: 1,
        locked: false,
        instrumental: true,
      });
    }
    withGaps.push({ ...curr, index: withGaps.length });
  }
  return withGaps;
}

export function scoreLine(
  caption: Caption,
  anchors: AnchorHit[],
): number {
  if (caption.instrumental) return 1;
  const words = caption.words;
  if (words.length === 0) return 0.2;
  const density = words.filter((w) => w.confidence >= 0.45).length / words.length;
  const gaps = words.filter((w) => w.confidence < 0.3).length / words.length;
  const anchor = anchors.find((a) => a.lineIndex === caption.index);
  const anchorAgree = anchor ? anchor.peakConfidence : 0.5;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.45 * density + 0.2 * (1 - gaps) + 0.2 * anchorAgree + 0.15 * caption.confidence));
}

export function findSegmentAnchors(
  lines: LyricLine[],
  lyricTokens: NormToken[],
  owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[],
  asr: AsrResult,
  asrWords: AsrWord[],
): AnchorPair[] {
  const anchors: AnchorPair[] = [];
  const segments = asr.segments ?? [];
  if (segments.length === 0) return anchors;

  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  let lastAsrIndex = 0;

  for (const line of vocalLines) {
    const lineOwner = owners.find((o) => o.line === line.index);
    if (!lineOwner) continue;
    const lyricIndex = owners.indexOf(lineOwner);

    // Find closest matching segment monotonically
    let bestSegIdx = -1;
    let bestSim = 0;

    const lineNorm = line.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");

    for (let si = 0; si < segments.length; si++) {
      const seg = segments[si]!;
      const segNorm = seg.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
      if (!segNorm || !lineNorm) continue;

      let score = 0;
      if (lineNorm.includes(segNorm) || segNorm.includes(lineNorm)) {
        score = 0.85;
      } else {
        const lev = normalizedLevenshtein(lineNorm.slice(0, 24), segNorm.slice(0, 24));
        score = lev;
      }

      if (score > bestSim && score >= 0.45) {
        bestSim = score;
        bestSegIdx = si;
      }
    }

    if (bestSegIdx >= 0) {
      const seg = segments[bestSegIdx]!;
      // Find the first asr word belonging to or closest to this segment
      for (let wi = lastAsrIndex; wi < asrWords.length; wi++) {
        const w = asrWords[wi]!;
        if (w.start >= seg.start - 0.5 && w.start <= seg.end + 0.5) {
          anchors.push({ lyricIndex, asrIndex: wi });
          lastAsrIndex = wi;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return anchors;
}

interface AnchorPair {
  lyricIndex: number;
  asrIndex: number;
}

export function runSync(input: {
  lines: LyricLine[];
  asr: AsrResult;
  durationSec: number;
  anchors?: AnchorHit[];
}): SyncResult {
  const { tokens: lyricTokens, owners } = flattenLyrics(input.lines);
  const { tokens: asrTokens, words: asrWords } = flattenAsr(input.asr);

  // Combine external split-clip anchors + automatic segment anchors
  const autoSegmentAnchors = findSegmentAnchors(input.lines, lyricTokens, owners, input.asr, asrWords);

  const splitClipAnchors = (input.anchors ?? [])
    .filter((a) => a.peakConfidence >= 0.42)
    .map((a) => {
      const owner = owners.find((o) => o.line === a.lineIndex);
      if (!owner) return null;
      const lyricIndex = owners.indexOf(owner);
      let asrIndex = 0;
      let best = Infinity;
      asrWords.forEach((w, i) => {
        const d = Math.abs(w.start - a.offsetSec);
        if (d < best) {
          best = d;
          asrIndex = i;
        }
      });
      return { lyricIndex, asrIndex };
    })
    .filter((x): x is { lyricIndex: number; asrIndex: number } => x !== null);

  const combinedAnchors = [...splitClipAnchors, ...autoSegmentAnchors].sort(
    (a, b) => a.lyricIndex - b.lyricIndex,
  );

  // Filter monotonic anchors
  const validAnchors: AnchorPair[] = [];
  let lastL = -1;
  let lastA = -1;
  for (const a of combinedAnchors) {
    if (a.lyricIndex > lastL && a.asrIndex >= lastA) {
      validAnchors.push(a);
      lastL = a.lyricIndex;
      lastA = a.asrIndex;
    }
  }

  const aligned = needlemanWunsch(lyricTokens, asrTokens, validAnchors);
  const timed = assignTimestamps(lyricTokens, owners, asrWords, aligned.path, input.durationSec);
  const rawCaptions = assembleLines(input.lines, timed, input.durationSec).map((c) => ({
    ...c,
    confidence: scoreLine(c, input.anchors ?? []),
  }));
  const captions = enforceTimeline(rawCaptions, input.durationSec);
  const flagged = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6).length;
  const vocal = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental);
  const meanConfidence = vocal.length ? vocal.reduce((s, c) => s + c.confidence, 0) / vocal.length : 0;
  return { captions, flagged, meanConfidence };
}

/**
 * Hard invariant enforcer for final captions list:
 * - Captions sorted strictly by startSec
 * - 0 <= startSec < endSec <= totalDurationSec
 * - No overlaps between consecutive captions (minimum 0.02s gap)
 * - Minimum caption duration 0.2s
 * - Word timestamps inside each caption strictly bounded by caption.startSec and caption.endSec
 */
export function enforceTimeline(captions: Caption[], totalDurationSec: number): Caption[] {
  if (!captions || captions.length === 0) return [];
  const maxDur = Math.max(0.5, totalDurationSec);

  // Sort by startSec
  const sorted = [...captions].sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);

  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const c = sorted[i]!;
    c.index = i;
    c.startSec = Math.max(0, Math.min(c.startSec, maxDur - 0.05));
    c.endSec = Math.max(c.startSec + 0.05, Math.min(c.endSec, maxDur));

    // Fix overlap with previous caption
    if (i > 0) {
      const prev = sorted[i - 1]!;
      if (c.startSec < prev.endSec) {
        if (prev.startSec + 0.1 <= c.startSec) {
          prev.endSec = c.startSec;
        } else {
          const mid = (prev.endSec + c.startSec) / 2;
          prev.endSec = Math.max(prev.startSec + 0.05, mid);
          c.startSec = Math.max(prev.endSec, c.startSec);
          if (c.endSec <= c.startSec) {
            c.endSec = Math.min(maxDur, c.startSec + 0.2);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Clamp word timestamps inside caption
    if (c.words && c.words.length > 0) {
      for (let wi = 0; wi < c.words.length; wi++) {
        const w = c.words[wi]!;
        w.startSec = Math.max(c.startSec, Math.min(w.startSec, c.endSec - 0.02));
        w.endSec = Math.max(w.startSec + 0.02, Math.min(w.endSec, c.endSec));
        if (wi > 0) {
          const prevW = c.words[wi - 1]!;
          if (w.startSec < prevW.endSec) {
            prevW.endSec = w.startSec;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return sorted;
}

export function heuristicSync(lines: LyricLine[], durationSec: number): SyncResult {
  const vocal = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  if (vocal.length === 0) {
    return { captions: [], flagged: 0, meanConfidence: 0 };
  }

  // Weight each line by syllable count (or character length fallback)
  const lineWeights = vocal.map((l) => {
    const rawSyls = countSyllables(l.text.replace(/\s+/g, ""));
    return Math.max(1, rawSyls || Math.round(l.text.length / 3.5));
  });

  const lead = Math.min(2.0, durationSec * 0.04);
  const tail = Math.min(2.5, durationSec * 0.05);
  const usable = Math.max(1, durationSec - lead - tail);
  const totalWeight = lineWeights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || 1;

  let cursor = lead;
  const rawCaptions: Caption[] = vocal.map((line, order) => {
    const lineSpan = (lineWeights[order]! / totalWeight) * usable;
    const start = cursor;
    // Active singing takes ~88% of line slot, remaining 12% is breathing space
    const end = cursor + lineSpan * 0.88;
    cursor += lineSpan;

    const words = tokenizeLine(line.text);
    const wordWeights = words.map((w) => Math.max(1, w.syllables || Math.round(w.raw.length / 3)));
    const totalWordWeight = wordWeights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || 1;
    const wordSpan = end - start;

    let wCursor = start;
    const timedWords: Word[] = words.map((t, i) => {
      const dur = (wordWeights[i]! / totalWordWeight) * wordSpan;
      const wStart = wCursor;
      const wEnd = wCursor + dur;
      wCursor += dur;
      return {
        text: t.raw,
        startSec: wStart,
        endSec: wEnd,
        confidence: 0.45,
      };
    });

    return {
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: timedWords,
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: defaultAnim("fade"),
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: 0.45,
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    };
  });

  const captions = enforceTimeline(rawCaptions, durationSec);
  return { captions, flagged: captions.length, meanConfidence: 0.45 };
}

export { countSyllables };

import type { AsrWord } from "@/schema";

/**
 * Clean and normalize raw ASR / Whisper word tokens.
 * - Filters out invalid tokens: start >= end, negative times, duration < 0.02s
 * - Clamps end times to total audio duration
 * - Fixes non-monotonic start times
 * - Splits / clamps unrealistically long tokens (> 4s, common when Whisper hallucinates over instrumental breaks)
 */
export function sanitizeAsr(words: AsrWord[], audioDurationSec: number): AsrWord[] {
  if (!words || words.length === 0) return [];
  const maxDur = audioDurationSec > 0 ? audioDurationSec : Infinity;

  const valid = words
    .filter((w) => {
      if (typeof w.start !== "number" || typeof w.end !== "number") return false;
      if (isNaN(w.start) || isNaN(w.end)) return false;
      if (w.start < 0 || w.start >= maxDur) return false;
      if (w.end <= w.start) return false;
      if (w.end - w.start < 0.02) return false;
      return true;
    })
    .map((w) => {
      let end = Math.min(w.end, maxDur);
      // Clamp hallucinated long tokens across instrumental breaks to max 4 seconds
      if (end - w.start > 4.0) {
        end = w.start + 4.0;
      }
      return {
        ...w,
        start: w.start,
        end,
        word: w.word.trim(),
      };
    })
    .filter((w) => w.word.length > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);

  // Ensure non-decreasing monotonic timestamps and fix overlap
  for (let i = 1; i < valid.length; i++) {
    const prev = valid[i - 1]!;
    const curr = valid[i]!;
    if (curr.start < prev.start) {
      curr.start = prev.start;
    }
    if (curr.end <= curr.start) {
      curr.end = curr.start + 0.05;
    }
  }

  return valid;
}

/**
 * Computes coverage ratio between clean ASR tokens and expected lyric text.
 */
export function asrCoverage(cleanTokens: AsrWord[], lyricText: string): number {
  const lyricWords = lyricText
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu, " ")
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (lyricWords.length === 0) return 0;
  if (!cleanTokens || cleanTokens.length === 0) return 0;

  return Math.min(1, cleanTokens.length / lyricWords.length);
}

const GOOGLE_FONTS = [
  "Fraunces",
  "Outfit",
  "Inter",
  "Cinzel",
  "Montserrat",
  "Bebas Neue",
  "Playfair Display",
  "Space Grotesk",
  "Permanent Marker",
  "Rubik",
  "Pacifico",
  "Righteous",
  "Poppins",
  "Syne",
];

export function Inspector() {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<(typeof TABS)[number]["id"]>("Text");
  const [presetOpen, setPresetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [trackInfoOpen, setTrackInfoOpen] = useState(false);
  const [customFontInput, setCustomFontInput] = useState("");
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fontInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const lottieInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const animFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const bgImageInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const selected = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.id === studio.selectedIds[0]);
  const style = selected?.styleOverride
    ? { ...studio.project.defaultStyle, ...selected.styleOverride }
    : studio.project.defaultStyle;
  const overridden = Boolean(selected?.styleOverride);

  const recentColors = useMemo(
    () => [
      style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA",
      style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A",
      style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4",
      style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA",
      "#F5C15A",
      "#67F0FF",
      "#FF5A92",
      "#FFFFFF",
    ],
    [style.fill, style.highlightFill, style.pastFill, style.futureFill]
  );

  const patch = (p: Partial<typeof style>) => studio.updateStyle(p, selected ? "selected" : "default");

  const overlay: OverlaySpec = studio.project.media?.background?.overlay ?? {
    type: "none",
    opacity: 0.85,
    speed: 1,
    scale: 1,
    blendMode: "screen",
  };

  const patchOverlay = (p: Partial<OverlaySpec>) => {
    studio.commit((d) => {
      if (!d.media.background.overlay) {
        d.media.background.overlay = {
          type: "none",
          opacity: 0.85,
          speed: 1,
          scale: 1,
          blendMode: "screen",
        };
      }
      d.media.background.overlay = { ...d.media.background.overlay, ...p };
    });
  };

  // Custom Font Upload
  const handleFontUpload = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      setUploadError(null);
      const fontName = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_");
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const fontFace = new FontFace(fontName, buffer);
      await fontFace.load();
      document.fonts.add(fontFace);
      patch({ fontFamily: fontName });
    } catch {
      setUploadError("Could not load font file. Please use .ttf, .otf, or .woff2.");
    }
  };

  // Custom Animation File Upload
  const handleAnimFileUpload = (file: File) => {
    setUploadError(null);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const text = e.target?.result as string;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
        if (parsed.inPreset || parsed.outPreset) {
          if (selected) {
            studio.commit((d) => {
              const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
              if (c) {
                if (parsed.inPreset) c.animation.in.preset = parsed.inPreset;
                if (parsed.outPreset) c.animation.out.preset = parsed.outPreset;
                if (parsed.easing) c.animation.in.easing = parsed.easing;
              }
            });
          } else {
            studio.commit((d) => {
              for (const c of d.captions) {
                if (parsed.inPreset) c.animation.in.preset = parsed.inPreset;
                if (parsed.outPreset) c.animation.out.preset = parsed.outPreset;
                if (parsed.easing) c.animation.in.easing = parsed.easing;
              }
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Lottie or custom overlay
          patchOverlay({
            type: "lottie",
            lottieJson: text,
            lottieName: file.name,
          });
        }
      } catch {
        setUploadError("Invalid JSON animation file.");
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  // Background Image Upload
  const handleBgImageUpload = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      const assetId = `bg-${studio.project.id}-${Date.now()}`;
      await putBlob(assetId, file);
      studio.commit((d) => {
        d.media.background.type = "image";
        d.media.background.imageAssetId = assetId;
      });
    } catch {
      setUploadError("Failed to store background image.");
    }
  };

  const applyAnimationToAll = (inPreset: string, highlightStyle: string) => {
    studio.commit((d) => {
      for (const c of d.captions) {
        c.animation.in.preset = inPreset as typeof c.animation.in.preset;
        c.animation.highlight.style = highlightStyle as typeof c.animation.highlight.style;
      }
    });
  };

  const activePreset = STYLE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === studio.project.presetId) ?? STYLE_PRESETS[0];
  const highlightStyle = selected?.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";
  const isKaraokeOn = highlightStyle !== "none";

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[var(--bg-panel)] font-sans text-[var(--ink)] lf-scroll overflow-y-auto">
      {/* 1. Sleek Presets Dropdown Box */}
      <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0a0d13]">
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setPresetOpen(!presetOpen)}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#121620] px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 transition-all shadow-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)]">
                <Sparkles size={13} />
              </span>
              <div className="text-left">
                <span className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Visual Preset</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-[var(--accent)]">{activePreset.name}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown size={14} className={`text-[var(--muted)] transition-transform ${presetOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
          </button>

          {presetOpen && (
            <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 z-50 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0e121a] p-2 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                {STYLE_PRESETS.map((p) => {
                  const isSelected = studio.project.presetId === p.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={p.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        studio.applyStylePreset(p.id);
                        setPresetOpen(false);
                      }}
                      className={`flex flex-col text-left rounded-xl p-2.5 transition-all ${
                        isSelected
                          ? "border border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/15 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.2)]"
                          : "border border-white/5 bg-[#141924] hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-[#1a2130]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${isSelected ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-white"}`}>
                        {p.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-[var(--faint)] leading-snug line-clamp-2">{p.blurb}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 2. Track Title & Artist Info Accordion */}
        <div className="mt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTrackInfoOpen(!trackInfoOpen)}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-white"
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Music size={12} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
              <span>{studio.project.meta.title || "Untitled"} · {studio.project.meta.artist || "Unknown Artist"}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)] underline">Edit Info</span>
          </button>

          {trackInfoOpen && (
            <div className="mt-2 space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-[#080a0f] p-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Song Title</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={studio.project.meta.title}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    studio.commit((d) => {
                      d.meta.title = e.target.value;
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                  placeholder="Song Title"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Artist Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={studio.project.meta.artist}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    studio.commit((d) => {
                      d.meta.artist = e.target.value;
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                  placeholder="Artist Name"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Sleek Icon Tab Navigation */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0b0e14] px-2 py-1 gap-1 overflow-x-auto lf-scroll">
        {TABS.map((t) => {
          const Icon = t.icon;
          const isActive = tab === t.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-all shrink-0 ${
                isActive
                  ? "bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)] border border-[var(--accent)]/30 font-semibold"
                  : "text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5"
              }`}
            >
              <Icon size={13} />
              <span>{t.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Target scope pill */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 text-[10px] bg-[#07090e] border-b border-white/5 text-[var(--faint)]">
        <span>{selected ? `Editing Line #${selected.index + 1}` : "Default Style (All Lines)"}</span>
        {overridden && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (selected) {
                studio.commit((d) => {
                  const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                  if (c) delete c.styleOverride;
                });
              }
            }}
            className="text-amber-400 hover:underline"
          >
            Reset to Default
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {uploadError && (
        <div className="m-3 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-red-950/40 p-2 text-xs text-red-300">
          {uploadError}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. Tab Content Panels */}
      <div className="flex-1 p-4 space-y-4">
        {/* TAB: TEXT */}
        {tab === "Text" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* Custom Font Uploader */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Typography</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => fontInputRef.current?.click()}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20"
                >
                  <Upload size={11} /> Upload Font (.ttf/.otf)
                </button>
              </div>
              <input
                ref={fontInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".ttf,.otf,.woff,.woff2"
                hidden
                onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void handleFontUpload(e.target.files[0])}
              />

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <select
                  value={GOOGLE_FONTS.includes(style.fontFamily) ? style.fontFamily : "custom"}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    if (e.target.value !== "custom") {
                      patch({ fontFamily: e.target.value });
                    }
                  }}
                  className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                >
                  {GOOGLE_FONTS.map((f) => (
                    <option key={f} value={f}>
                      {f}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                  <option value="custom">Custom Font Name...</option>
                </select>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Custom Font Family"
                  value={style.fontFamily}
                  onChange={(e) => patch({ fontFamily: e.target.value })}
                  className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2.5 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => patch({ italic: !style.italic })}
                  className={`flex-1 rounded-xl border py-1.5 text-xs ${
                    style.italic ? "border-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10" : "border-[var(--line)] text-[var(--muted)]"
                  }`}
                >
                  <em>Italic</em>
                </button>
                {(["left", "center", "right"] as const).map((a) => (
                  <button
                    key={a}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => patch({ align: a })}
                    className={`flex-1 rounded-xl border py-1.5 text-xs capitalize ${
                      style.align === a ? "border-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10" : "border-[var(--line)] text-[var(--muted)]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {a}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Sizing & Dimensions */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <Slider
                label="Font Size (%)"
                min={2.5}
                max={12}
                step={0.2}
                value={style.fontSizePct}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ fontSizePct: v })}
              />
              <Slider
                label="Font Weight"
                min={200}
                max={900}
                step={100}
                value={style.fontWeight}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ fontWeight: v })}
              />
              <Slider
                label="Line Height"
                min={0.9}
                max={2.0}
                step={0.05}
                value={style.lineHeight}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ lineHeight: v })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB: COLOR */}
        {tab === "Color" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">Caption Colors</span>
              <ColorField
                label="Highlight Fill (Active word)"
                value={style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A"}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ highlightFill: v })}
                recent={recentColors}
              />
              <ColorField
                label="Main / Future Words"
                value={style.futureFill ?? style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA"}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ futureFill: v, fill: v })}
                recent={recentColors}
              />
              <ColorField
                label="Past / Sung Words"
                value={style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4"}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ pastFill: v })}
                recent={recentColors}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">Effects & Outline</span>
              <ColorField
                label="Text Outline"
                value={style.outlineColor ?? "#000000"}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ outlineColor: v })}
                recent={recentColors}
              />
              <Slider
                label="Outline Width"
                min={0}
                max={12}
                step={0.5}
                value={style.outlineWidth ?? 0}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ outlineWidth: v })}
              />
              <Slider
                label="Glow Blur"
                min={0}
                max={60}
                step={2}
                value={style.glow?.blur ?? 0}
                onChange={(v) => patch({ glow: { color: style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", blur: v, opacity: v > 0 ? 0.8 : 0 } })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB: MOTION */}
        {tab === "Motion" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* Karaoke master switch + timing nudges */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">
                    Karaoke Highlighting
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)]">
                    Global switch — affects every line & the export
                  </span>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    studio.commit((d) => {
                      d.settings.karaoke = !(d.settings.karaoke ?? true);
                    })
                  }
                  className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    studio.project.settings.karaoke ?? true
                      ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.3)]"
                      : "bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)] border border-white/10"
                  }`}
                >
                  {studio.project.settings.karaoke ?? true ? "KARAOKE ON" : "KARAOKE OFF"}
                </button>
              </div>

              {(studio.project.settings.karaoke ?? true) && (
                <>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">
                      Highlight Style {selected ? "(this line)" : "(all lines)"}
                    </label>
                    <select
                      value={highlightStyle}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const st = e.target.value as z.infer<typeof HighlightStyleSchema>;
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          const targets = selected
                            ? d.captions.filter((x) => x.id === selected.id)
                            : d.captions;
                          for (const c of targets) c.animation.highlight.style = st;
                        });
                      }}
                      className="h-9 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                    >
                      <option value="color">Color Fill</option>
                      <option value="sweep">Karaoke Sweep</option>
                      <option value="box">Rounded Box Badge</option>
                      <option value="scale">Bounce Scale</option>
                      <option value="underline">Underline Marker</option>
                      <option value="glow">Pulse Glow</option>
                      <option value="shimmer">Golden Shimmer</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <Slider
                    label="Global Sync Offset (ms)"
                    min={-1500}
                    max={1500}
                    step={10}
                    value={studio.project.settings.syncOffsetMs ?? 0}
                    onChange={(v) =>
                      studio.commit((d) => {
                        d.settings.syncOffsetMs = v;
                      })
                    }
                  />
                  <Slider
                    label="Word Highlight Lead (ms)"
                    min={-250}
                    max={250}
                    step={5}
                    value={studio.project.settings.wordLeadMs ?? -40}
                    onChange={(v) =>
                      studio.commit((d) => {
                        d.settings.wordLeadMs = v;
                      })
                    }
                  />
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                    Negative offset = captions appear earlier. Scrub with playback
                    running and nudge until the highlight lands on the vowel.
                  </p>
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Instrumental Gap Display Settings */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-2.5">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">Instrumental Gaps Display</span>
              <select
                value={studio.project.settings.instrumentalDisplay ?? "auto"}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = e.target.value as "auto" | "always-show" | "hidden";
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    d.settings.instrumentalDisplay = val;
                  });
                }}
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
              >
                <option value="auto">Auto (≤3s Hidden / &gt;3s Show &quot;Instrumental&quot;)</option>
                <option value="always-show">Always Show &quot;♪ Instrumental ♪&quot;</option>
                <option value="hidden">Always Hide (Nothing on Gaps)</option>
              </select>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                Short pauses (2–3 sec) show a clean screen with no text; extended solos (&gt;3 sec) show ♪ Instrumental.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Custom Animation Upload */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Custom Animation File</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => animFileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20"
                >
                  <Upload size={11} /> Upload JSON
                </button>
              </div>
              <input
                ref={animFileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".json"
                hidden
                onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && handleAnimFileUpload(e.target.files[0])}
              />
              <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">Supports motion curve presets or Lottie JSON files.</p>
            </div>

            {/* In / Out Presets */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">Motion In & Out</span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">In Preset</label>
                  <select
                    value={selected?.animation?.in?.preset ?? "fade"}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const p = e.target.value;
                      if (selected) {
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                          if (c) c.animation.in.preset = p as typeof c.animation.in.preset;
                        });
                      } else {
                        applyAnimationToAll(p, highlightStyle);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {["fade", "slide", "scale", "pop", "bounce", "blur", "wave", "typewriter", "cascade", "wipe", "spring", "none"].map((p) => (
                      <option key={p} value={p}>{p}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Out Preset</label>
                  <select
                    value={selected?.animation?.out?.preset ?? "fade"}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const p = e.target.value;
                      if (selected) {

import type { Caption, CaptionStyle, Project, Word } from "@/schema";
import { mixHex, toRgba } from "@/lib/color";
import { applyEasing, hashString, mulberry32 } from "./easing";
import { fontString, type FrameContext, type FrameGradient, type ResolvedAssets } from "./context";
import { renderProceduralOverlay } from "./overlays";

function lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number {
  return a + (b - a) * t;
}

function resolveStyle(project: Project, caption?: Caption): CaptionStyle {
  if (!caption?.styleOverride) return project.defaultStyle;
  return { ...project.defaultStyle, ...caption.styleOverride };
}

function applyTransform(text: string, transform?: CaptionStyle["transform"]): string {
  if (transform === "uppercase") return text.toUpperCase();
  if (transform === "lowercase") return text.toLowerCase();
  if (transform === "capitalize") {
    return text.replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  }
  return text;
}

function wrapWords(words: string[], maxChars: number, maxLines: number): string[][] {
  const lines: string[][] = [[]];
  let count = 0;
  for (const word of words) {
    const next = count + word.length + (count > 0 ? 1 : 0);
    if (count > 0 && next > maxChars) {
      if (lines.length >= maxLines) {
        const last = lines[lines.length - 1]!;
        last[last.length - 1] = `${last[last.length - 1] ?? ""}…`;
        break;
      }
      lines.push([word]);
      count = word.length;
    } else {
      lines[lines.length - 1]!.push(word);
      count = next;
    }
  }
  return lines;
}

function captionOpacity(caption: Caption, timeSec: number): { alpha: number; tx: number; ty: number; scale: number; blur: number; waveOffset: number } {
  const inn = caption.animation?.in ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const out = caption.animation?.out ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const tIn = inn.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(inn.easing, (timeSec - caption.startSec - inn.delaySec) / inn.durationSec);
  const tOut = out.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(out.easing, (caption.endSec - timeSec - out.delaySec) / out.durationSec);
  const enter = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tIn));
  const leave = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tOut));
  const alpha = enter * leave;
  const dir = inn.direction ?? "up";
  const dist = inn.distance ?? 24;
  const slideIn = (1 - enter) * dist;
  const slideOut = (1 - leave) * dist;
  const ty = dir === "up" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "down" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  const tx = dir === "left" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "right" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  
  let scaleIn = 1;
  if (inn.preset === "scale") scaleIn = lerp(0.86, 1, enter);
  else if (inn.preset === "pop") scaleIn = enter < 1 ? lerp(0.5, 1.08, enter) : 1;
  else if (inn.preset === "bounce" || inn.preset === "spring") {
    scaleIn = enter < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(enter * Math.PI * 1.5) : 1;
  }
  
  let scaleOut = 1;
  if (out.preset === "scale" || out.preset === "pop") scaleOut = lerp(0.85, 1, leave);
  else if (out.preset === "bounce" || out.preset === "spring") scaleOut = leave < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(leave * Math.PI) : 1;

  const blur = (inn.preset === "blur" ? (1 - enter) * 10 : 0) + (out.preset === "blur" ? (1 - leave) * 10 : 0);
  const waveOffset = inn.preset === "wave" ? Math.sin((timeSec - caption.startSec) * 3) * 6 : 0;
  return { alpha, tx, ty, scale: scaleIn * scaleOut, blur, waveOffset };
}

function wordState(word: Word, timeSec: number): "past" | "active" | "future" {
  if (timeSec < word.startSec) return "future";
  if (timeSec >= word.endSec) return "past";
  return "active";
}

function paintVisualizer(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  config: import("@/schema").VisualizerConfig | undefined,
  spectrum: ArrayLike<number>,
  timeSec: number
): void {
  const cfg = config ?? {
    type: "bars",
    colorA: "#F5C15A",
    colorB: "#67F0FF",
    sensitivity: 1,
    position: "bottom",
    barCount: 48,
    opacity: 0.35,
  };

  const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, cfg.opacity ?? 0.35));
  if (alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const sens = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(3, cfg.sensitivity ?? 1));
  const count = Math.min(Math.max(8, cfg.barCount ?? 48), spectrum.length);
  const colorA = cfg.colorA ?? "#F5C15A";
  const colorB = cfg.colorB ?? "#67F0FF";
  
  const defaultYRatio = cfg.position === "middle" ? 0.5 : cfg.position === "behind-text" ? 0.72 : 0.92;
  const posY = (cfg.yPercent !== undefined ? cfg.yPercent / 100 : defaultYRatio) * height;
  const posX = (cfg.xPercent !== undefined ? cfg.xPercent / 100 : 0.5) * width;
  const vizW = (cfg.widthPercent !== undefined ? cfg.widthPercent / 100 : 0.74) * width;
  const vizH = (cfg.heightPercent !== undefined ? cfg.heightPercent / 100 : 0.22) * height;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  if (cfg.type === "wave") {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorA;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, height * 0.005);
    if ("lineCap" in ctx) ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";

    const step = vizW / Math.max(1, count - 1);
    const startX = posX - vizW / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.sin(timeSec * 4 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * vizH * 0.15;
      const y = posY - v * vizH * 0.85 + wave;
      const x = startX + i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorB;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, height * 0.003);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[count - 1 - i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.cos(timeSec * 3 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * vizH * 0.12;
      const y = posY + v * vizH * 0.55 + wave;
      const x = startX + i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (cfg.type === "circle") {
    const cx = posX;
    const cy = posY;
    const baseRadius = Math.min(vizW, vizH) * 0.5;
    const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / count;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, baseRadius * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = toRgba(colorB, 0.4);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const ang = i * angleStep;
      const len = Math.max(4, v * vizH * 0.8);
      const x1 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * baseRadius;
      const y1 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * baseRadius;
      const x2 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * (baseRadius + len);
      const y2 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * (baseRadius + len);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, width * 0.003);
      ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
      ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (cfg.type === "mirror") {
    const half = Math.floor(count / 2);
    const gap = 3;
    const bw = vizW / count;
    const cx = posX;

    for (let i = 0; i < half; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * vizH);
      const col = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillStyle = col;

      const rx = cx + i * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(rx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);

      const lx = cx - (i + 1) * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(lx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);
    }
  } else {
    const gap = Math.max(2, Math.round(width * 0.003));
    const bw = vizW / count;
    const startX = posX - vizW / 2;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * vizH);
      const x = startX + i * bw;
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillRect(x, posY - h, Math.max(1, bw - gap), h);
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function paintBackground(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number, assets: ResolvedAssets): void {
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const bg = project.media.background;
  ctx.fillStyle = bg.color ?? "#0B0D12";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

  if (bg.type === "gradient") {
    const ang = ((bg.angleDeg ?? 160) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const gx = Math.cos(ang) * width;
    const gy = Math.sin(ang) * height;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(width / 2 - gx / 2, height / 2 - gy / 2, width / 2 + gx / 2, height / 2 + gy / 2);
    g.addColorStop(0, bg.color ?? "#0B0D12");
    g.addColorStop(1, bg.colorB ?? "#1A1408");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  const img = assets.backgroundImage ?? assets.albumArt;
  if (img && (bg.type === "image" || bg.type === "album-blur")) {
    const zoomBase = bg.kenBurns ? bg.kenBurnsZoom || 1.1 : 1;
    const seed = hashString(project.id);
    const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    const driftX = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const driftY = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const duration = Math.max(1, project.meta.durationSec);
    const k = bg.kenBurns ? (timeSec / duration) : 0;
    const zoom = lerp(1, zoomBase, k);
    const iw = img.width || width;
    const ih = img.height || height;
    const scale = Math.max(width / iw, height / ih) * zoom;
    const dw = iw * scale;
    const dh = ih * scale;
    const dx = (width - dw) / 2 + driftX * width * k;
    const dy = (height - dh) / 2 + driftY * height * k;
    ctx.save();
    if (bg.type === "album-blur" && bg.blurPx > 0) {
      ctx.filter = `blur(${bg.blurPx}px)`;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);
    ctx.filter = "none";
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if (bg.dim > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = toRgba("#000000", bg.dim);
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  if (bg.visualizer && assets.spectrum && assets.spectrum.length > 0) {
    paintVisualizer(ctx, width, height, bg.visualizerConfig, assets.spectrum, timeSec);
  }
}

function paintIntro(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number): void {
  if (timeSec > 2.6) return;
  const title = project.meta.title?.trim();
  const artist = project.meta.artist?.trim();
  const hasArtist = Boolean(artist && !artist.toLowerCase().includes("unknown") && artist.length > 0);
  const hasTitle = Boolean(title && !title.toLowerCase().includes("untitled") && title.length > 0);
  if (!hasTitle && !hasArtist) return;

  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, timeSec / 0.5));
  const fadeOut = timeSec > 1.8 ? 1 - (timeSec - 1.8) / 0.8 : 1;
  const alpha = t * fadeOut;
  if (alpha <= 0) return;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#F7F4EE";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  if (hasTitle) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Fraunces", 500, true, height * 0.07);
    ctx.fillText(title, width / 2, hasArtist ? height * 0.44 : height * 0.49);
  }
  if (hasArtist) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Outfit", 500, false, height * 0.028);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#F5C15A";
    ctx.fillText(artist.toUpperCase(), width / 2, hasTitle ? height * 0.53 : height * 0.49);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintRoundedRect(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  w: number,
  h: number,
  r: number,
  fill: string | FrameGradient,
): void {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintCaption(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  caption: Caption,
  timeSec: number,
): void {
  if (timeSec < caption.startSec - 0.05 || timeSec > caption.endSec + 0.05) return;

  const isInstrumental = Boolean(
    caption.instrumental ||
      !caption.text ||
      caption.text.trim() === "♪" ||
      caption.text.toLowerCase().includes("instrumental")
  );

  const gapDuration = caption.endSec - caption.startSec;
  const displayMode = project.settings?.instrumentalDisplay ?? "auto";

  if (isInstrumental) {
    if (displayMode === "hidden") return;
    if (displayMode === "auto" && gapDuration <= 3.0) return; // 2-3 sec instrumental: render NOTHING
  }

  const style = resolveStyle(project, caption);
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const motion = captionOpacity(caption, timeSec);
  if (motion.alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const fontPx = (style.fontSizePct / 100) * height * style.scale;
  const rawWords = (isInstrumental ? ["♪", "Instrumental", "♪"] : caption.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)).map((w) =>
    applyTransform(w, style.transform),
  );
  const lines = wrapWords(rawWords, style.maxCharsPerLine, style.maxLines);
  ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
  const lineMetrics = lines.map((line) => {
    const text = line.join(" ");
    return { line, text, width: ctx.measureText(text).width + style.letterSpacing * fontPx * Math.max(0, text.length - 1) };
  });
  const blockW = Math.max(...lineMetrics.map((l) => l.width), 10);
  const blockH = lineMetrics.length * fontPx * style.lineHeight;
  const px = (style.xPercent / 100) * width;
  const py = (style.yPercent / 100) * height + motion.waveOffset;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = motion.alpha;
  ctx.translate(px + motion.tx, py + motion.ty);
  ctx.rotate((style.rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
  ctx.scale(motion.scale, motion.scale);

  if (style.box?.enabled) {
    paintRoundedRect(
      ctx,
      -blockW / 2 - (style.box.paddingX ?? 28),
      -blockH / 2 - (style.box.paddingY ?? 16),
      blockW + (style.box.paddingX ?? 28) * 2,
      blockH + (style.box.paddingY ?? 16) * 2,
      style.box.radius ?? 12,
      toRgba(style.box.fill ?? "#000000", style.box.opacity ?? 0.35),
    );
  }

  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.miterLimit = 2;

  let wordCursor = 0;
  const wordLead = (project.settings?.wordLeadMs ?? 0) / 1000;
  const rawSource =
    caption.words && caption.words.length > 0
      ? caption.words
      : rawWords.map((text, i) => {
          const span = (caption.endSec - caption.startSec) / Math.max(1, rawWords.length);
          return {
            text,
            startSec: caption.startSec + i * span,
            endSec: caption.startSec + (i + 1) * span,
            confidence: 1,
          };
        });
  const sourceWords = wordLead
    ? rawSource.map((w) => ({
        ...w,
        startSec: w.startSec + wordLead,
        endSec: w.endSec + wordLead,
      }))
    : rawSource;

  const highlightStyle = caption.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";
  const karaokeEnabled =
    (project.settings?.karaoke ?? true) &&
    highlightStyle !== "none" &&
    caption.animation?.highlight?.enabled !== false;

  lineMetrics.forEach((lm, li) => {
    const y = -blockH / 2 + (li + 0.5) * fontPx * (style.lineHeight ?? 1.2);
    let x = -lm.width / 2;
    if (style.align === "left") x = -blockW / 2;
    if (style.align === "right") x = blockW / 2 - lm.width;
    for (const token of lm.line) {
      const word = sourceWords[Math.min(wordCursor, sourceWords.length - 1)];
      wordCursor += 1;
      const state = word ? wordState(word, timeSec) : "future";
      const localT = word ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (timeSec - word.startSec) / Math.max(0.04, word.endSec - word.startSec))) : 0;
      
      let fill = style.futureFill ?? style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA";
      if (!karaokeEnabled) {
        fill = style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA";
      } else {
        if (state === "past") fill = style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4";
        if (state === "active") {
          if (highlightStyle === "sweep") fill = mixHex(style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA", style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", localT);
          else fill = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
        }
      }
      const tw = ctx.measureText(token).width;

      if (karaokeEnabled && state === "active" && highlightStyle === "box") {
        paintRoundedRect(ctx, x - 8, y - fontPx * 0.55, tw + 16, fontPx * 1.1, 8, toRgba(style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", 0.25));
      }
      if (karaokeEnabled && state === "active" && highlightStyle === "underline") {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, fontPx * 0.06);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.lineTo(x + tw * localT, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      const bounce = state === "active" && highlightStyle === "scale" ? 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(localT * Math.PI) : 1;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x + tw / 2, y);
      ctx.scale(bounce, bounce);
      ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
      
      const glowBlur = style.glow?.blur ?? 0;
      const glowOpacity = style.glow?.opacity ?? 0;
      const shadowOpacity = style.shadow?.opacity ?? 0;

      if (glowBlur > 0 && glowOpacity > 0 && state === "active") {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.glow?.color ?? "#F5C15A", glowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = glowBlur * (highlightStyle === "glow" ? 1.5 : 1);
      } else if (shadowOpacity > 0 && style.shadow) {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.shadow.color ?? "#000000", shadowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = style.shadow.blur ?? 18;
        ctx.shadowOffsetX = style.shadow.x ?? 0;
        ctx.shadowOffsetY = style.shadow.y ?? 4;
      }
      if ((style.outlineWidth ?? 0) > 0) {
        ctx.lineWidth = (style.outlineWidth ?? 0) * 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.outlineColor ?? "#000000";
        ctx.strokeText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      }
      if (style.gradient?.enabled && state !== "active" && style.gradient.stops?.length >= 2) {
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, -fontPx / 2, tw / 2, fontPx / 2);
        for (const stop of style.gradient.stops) g.addColorStop(stop.offset, stop.color);
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
      } else if (state === "active" && highlightStyle === "shimmer") {
        const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, 0, tw / 2, 0);
        const st = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, localT));
        sg.addColorStop(Math.max(0, st - 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        sg.addColorStop(st, "#FFFFFF");
        sg.addColorStop(Math.min(1, st + 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        ctx.fillStyle = sg;
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = fill;
      }
      ctx.fillText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      ctx.restore();
      x += tw + fontPx * 0.28 + (style.wordSpacing ?? 0) + (style.letterSpacing ?? 0) * fontPx;
    }
  });

  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawFrame(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  timeSecRaw: number,
  assets: ResolvedAssets,
): void {
  // Single place where the global sync nudge is applied, so preview and
  // export can never disagree.
  const timeSec = timeSecRaw + (project.settings?.syncOffsetMs ?? 0) / 1000;

  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.filter = "none";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
  ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

  paintBackground(ctx, project, timeSec, assets);

  if (project.media?.background?.overlay && project.media.background.overlay.type !== "none") {
    renderProceduralOverlay(ctx, project.media.background.overlay, timeSec, assets);
  } else if (assets.lottieFrame) {
    ctx.drawImage(assets.lottieFrame, 0, 0, width, height);
  }

  paintIntro(ctx, project, timeSec);

  // Only paint captions that are actually on screen — with 300+ lines this
  // was iterating the whole array 60×/sec.
  for (const caption of project.captions ?? []) {
    if (timeSec < caption.startSec - 0.6) continue;
    if (timeSec > caption.endSec + 0.6) continue;
    paintCaption(ctx, project, caption, timeSec);
  }
}

    },

type LooseRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is LooseRecord {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/** v0 → v1 is a documented no-op so the migrate() chain exists and is tested. */
export function migrateV0ToV1(doc: unknown): unknown {
  if (!isRecord(doc)) return doc;
  const next: LooseRecord = { ...doc };
  if (next.version === 0 || next.version === undefined) {
    next.version = 1;
  }
  return next;
}

export function migrate(doc: unknown): Project {
  let current = doc;
  if (isRecord(current) && (current.version === 0 || current.version === undefined)) {
    current = migrateV0ToV1(current);
  }
  const parsed = ProjectSchema.safeParse(current);
  if (parsed.success) return parsed.data;
  if (isRecord(current)) {
    const fallback = defaultProject({
      id: typeof current.id === "string" ? current.id : undefined,
      meta: {
        title: typeof current.meta === "object" && current.meta && "title" in current.meta
          ? String((current.meta as LooseRecord).title ?? "Untitled")
          : "Untitled",
        artist: "Unknown Artist",
        durationSec: 0,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
    });
    return ProjectSchema.parse(fallback);
  }
  return defaultProject();
}

export const DOCUMENT_VERSION = CURRENT_VERSION;

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Pause, Play, Repeat, Volume2, Maximize2 } from "lucide-react";
import { drawFrame, asFrameContext, type ResolvedAssets } from "@/render-engine";
import { LottiePlayer } from "@/lib/lottie-renderer";
import { formatTimecode } from "@/lib/time";
import { useStudio } from "@/store/studio-store";
import { Tooltip } from "../ui-kit";

export function PreviewCanvas({
  audioUrl,
  albumUrl,
}: {
  audioUrl: string | null;
  albumUrl: string;
}) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const studioRef = useRef(studio);
  studioRef.current = studio;

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement>(null);
  const artRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const ctxClock = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const lottiePlayerRef = useRef<LottiePlayer | null>(null);

  const startedAt = useRef(0);
  const offset = useRef(0);
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const [fps, setFps] = useState(60);
  const [dropped, setDropped] = useState(0);
  const lastTs = useRef(0);
  const frames = useRef(0);
  const lastStateSync = useRef(0);

  const customBgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const analyserRef = useRef<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const freqDataRef = useRef<Uint8Array | null>(null);

  // Load Album Art
  useEffect(() => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = albumUrl;
    img.onload = () => {
      artRef.current = img;
    };
  }, [albumUrl]);

  // Load Custom Background Image from IDB
  useEffect(() => {
    const assetId = studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId;
    if (assetId && assetId.startsWith("bg-")) {
      import("@/lib/idb").then(({ getBlob }) => {
        getBlob(assetId).then((blob) => {
          if (blob) {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const img = new Image();
            img.src = url;
            img.onload = () => {
              customBgRef.current = img;
            };
          }
        });
      }).catch(() => undefined);
    } else {
      customBgRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId]);

  // Manage Lottie Player
  useEffect(() => {
    const overlay = studio.project.media?.background?.overlay;
    if (overlay?.type === "lottie" && overlay.lottieJson) {
      if (!lottiePlayerRef.current) {
        lottiePlayerRef.current = new LottiePlayer(640, 360);
      }
      lottiePlayerRef.current.load(overlay.lottieJson);
    } else {
      if (lottiePlayerRef.current) {
        lottiePlayerRef.current.destroy();
        lottiePlayerRef.current = null;
      }
    }
  }, [studio.project.media?.background?.overlay?.type, studio.project.media?.background?.overlay?.lottieJson]);

  const latestSpectrumRef = useRef<number[] | null>(null);
  const errorCountRef = useRef(0);
  const lastDrawKeyRef = useRef("");

  // Main render loop — crash-proof, audio-element-clocked, idle-throttled
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false, desynchronized: true });
    if (!ctx) return;

    let cancelled = false;

    const loop = (now: number) => {
      // Schedule FIRST so a throw below can never kill the loop.
      if (!cancelled) raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);

      try {
        const s = studioRef.current;
        const audio = audioRef.current;
        let t = s.playhead;

        if (s.playing) {
          // ---- MASTER CLOCK = the <audio> element itself ----
          // AudioContext.currentTime and HTMLAudioElement.currentTime are two
          // independent clocks; using the former to drive visuals is what makes
          // the karaoke drift by seconds/minutes over a long track.
          if (audio && !audio.paused && Number.isFinite(audio.currentTime)) {
            t = audio.currentTime;
          } else if (ctxClock.current) {
            t = offset.current + ctxClock.current.currentTime - startedAt.current;
          }

          if (t >= s.project.meta.durationSec - 0.01) {
            if (s.loop) {
              t = 0;
              offset.current = 0;
              if (ctxClock.current) startedAt.current = ctxClock.current.currentTime;
              if (audio) audio.currentTime = 0;
            } else {
              s.setPlaying(false);
              t = s.project.meta.durationSec;
            }
          }

          if (now - lastStateSync.current > 66) {
            s.setPlayhead(t);
            lastStateSync.current = now;
          }
        }

        const draft = s.project.settings.previewQuality === "draft";
        const [rw, rh] = (s.project.meta.resolution || "1920x1080").split("x").map(Number);
        // Cap the backing store: nobody needs a 4K canvas for a ~1000px preview.
        const capW = draft ? 960 : 1600;
        const nativeW = rw || 1920;
        const nativeH = rh || 1080;
        const k = Math.min(1, capW / nativeW);
        const w = Math.round(nativeW * k);
        const h = Math.round(nativeH * k);
        if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
          canvas.width = w;
          canvas.height = h;
          lastDrawKeyRef.current = ""; // force redraw
        }

        let lottieFrame: HTMLCanvasElement | undefined;
        if (lottiePlayerRef.current?.isReady()) {
          lottieFrame = lottiePlayerRef.current.renderFrame(t) ?? undefined;
        }

        let spectrum: number[] | undefined;
        if (analyserRef.current && freqDataRef.current && s.playing) {
          analyserRef.current.getByteFrequencyData(
            freqDataRef.current as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>,
          );
          spectrum = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) spectrum.push((freqDataRef.current[i] ?? 0) / 255);
          latestSpectrumRef.current = spectrum;
        }

        // ---- Idle throttle: while paused, only repaint when something changed.
        if (!s.playing) {
          const key = `${t.toFixed(3)}|${s.project.updatedAt}|${w}x${h}|${
            lottieFrame ? "L" : ""
          }`;
          if (key === lastDrawKeyRef.current) return;
          lastDrawKeyRef.current = key;
        }

        const assets: ResolvedAssets = {
          albumArt: artRef.current ?? undefined,
          backgroundImage: customBgRef.current ?? artRef.current ?? undefined,
          lottieFrame,
          spectrum,
        };

        drawFrame(asFrameContext(ctx), s.project, t, assets);
        errorCountRef.current = 0;

        frames.current += 1;
        if (lastTs.current && now - lastTs.current > 1000) {
          setFps(frames.current);
          setDropped(Math.max(0, Math.round((s.project.meta.fps || 60) - frames.current)));
          frames.current = 0;
          lastTs.current = now;
        } else if (!lastTs.current) {
          lastTs.current = now;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Never let a bad frame stop playback. Log at most a few times.
        if (errorCountRef.current < 5) {
          errorCountRef.current += 1;
          console.error("[preview] drawFrame failed:", err);
        }
      }
    };

    raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
      if (lottiePlayerRef.current) {
        lottiePlayerRef.current.destroy();
        lottiePlayerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (audio) audio.volume = studio.volume;
  }, [studio.volume]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;

    if (studio.playing) {
      if (!ctxClock.current) {
        try {
          ctxClock.current = new AudioContext();
        } catch {
          ctxClock.current = null;
        }
      }
      const ac = ctxClock.current;
      if (ac) {
        void ac.resume();
        if (!analyserRef.current) {
          try {
            const source = ac.createMediaElementSource(audio);
            const analyser = ac.createAnalyser();
            analyser.fftSize = 128;
            analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.72;
            source.connect(analyser);
            analyser.connect(ac.destination);
            analyserRef.current = analyser;
            freqDataRef.current = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("[preview] analyser unavailable, audio plays direct:", err);
          }
        }
        startedAt.current = ac.currentTime;
      }
      offset.current = studioRef.current.playhead;
      // Only seek if we're actually out of position — seeking on every play
      // click adds a fresh decode latency that shows up as lyric lag.
      if (Math.abs(audio.currentTime - studioRef.current.playhead) > 0.05) {
        audio.currentTime = studioRef.current.playhead;
      }
      void audio.play().catch((e) => console.warn("[preview] play blocked:", e));
    } else {
      audio.pause();
    }
  }, [studio.playing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio || studio.playing) return;
    if (Math.abs(audio.currentTime - studio.playhead) > 0.05) {
      audio.currentTime = studio.playhead;
    }
  }, [studio.playhead, studio.playing]);

  const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    if (document.fullscreenElement) {
      void document.exitFullscreen();
    } else {
      void containerRef.current.requestFullscreen();
    }
  };

  const aspect = (studio.project.meta.aspectRatio || "16:9").replace(":", " / ");

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[#07080c]">
      <div className="relative grid flex-1 place-items-center overflow-hidden lf-grid">
        <div className="relative max-h-full max-w-full lf-safe shadow-2xl" style={{ aspectRatio: aspect, width: "min(100%, 1100px)" }}>
          <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="h-full w-full rounded-md shadow-2xl" />
        </div>
        {audioUrl ? <audio ref={audioRef} src={audioUrl} preload="auto" /> : null}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-4 py-2">
        <Tooltip label="Play / pause" shortcut="Space">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] text-[var(--ink)]" onClick={() => studio.setPlaying(!studio.playing)}>
            {studio.playing ? <Pause size={16} /> : <Play size={16} />}
          </button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip label="Loop">
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.loop ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
            onClick={() => studio.setLoop(!studio.loop)}
          >
            <Repeat size={16} />
          </button>
        </Tooltip>
        <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-[var(--ink)]">{formatTimecode(studio.playhead)}</span>
        <span className="text-[var(--faint)]">/</span>
        <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-[var(--faint)]">{formatTimecode(studio.project.meta.durationSec)}</span>

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">
          <Volume2 size={14} className="text-[var(--muted)]" />
          <input
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={1}
            step={0.01}
            value={studio.volume}
            onChange={(e) => studio.setVolume(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-20 accent-[var(--accent)]"
          />
          <span className="tabular-nums font-mono">{fps} fps</span>
          <span className="tabular-nums font-mono">{dropped} drop</span>

const SAMPLE_LYRICS = `[Verse 1]
Four in the morning
And I'm still wide awake

[Chorus]
