    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] grid place-items-center bg-black/70 p-8" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] p-6" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-2xl">Shortcuts</h2>
        <dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-2 text-sm">
          {rows.map(([k, v]) => (
            <div key={k} className="contents">
              <dt className="font-mono text-[var(--accent)]">{k}</dt>
              <dd className="text-[var(--muted)]">{v}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StudioInner({ audioUrl, peaks }: { audioUrl: string | null; peaks: number[] }) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const [help, setHelp] = useState(false);
  const [lyricsModalOpen, setLyricsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lyricsSheetText, setLyricsSheetText] = useState("");
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const [exportPct, setExportPct] = useState(0);
  const [exportMsg, setExportMsg] = useState("");
  const [res, setRes] = useState("1920x1080");
  const [fps, setFps] = useState(30);
  const [quality, setQuality] = useState<"high" | "balanced" | "small">("high");
  const abort = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const saveTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Initialize lyrics modal text from current project
  const openLyricsModal = () => {
    const lines = studio.project.captions
      .filter((c) => !c.instrumental)
      .map((c) => c.text)
      .join("\n");
    const metaHeader = `## title: ${studio.project.meta.title}\n## artist: ${studio.project.meta.artist}\n\n`;
    setLyricsSheetText(metaHeader + lines);
    setLyricsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleApplyLyricsSheet = () => {
    if (!lyricsSheetText.trim()) return;
    studio.replaceLyrics(lyricsSheetText);
    setLyricsModalOpen(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("lf-layout");
    if (!raw) return;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { left?: number; right?: number; bottom?: number };
      if (parsed.left) studio.setPanelSize("left", parsed.left);
      if (parsed.right) studio.setPanelSize("right", parsed.right);
      if (parsed.bottom) studio.setPanelSize("bottom", parsed.bottom);
    } catch {
      /* ignore corrupt layout cache */
    }
    // persist hook only on mount
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(
      "lf-layout",
      JSON.stringify({ left: studio.leftWidth, right: studio.rightWidth, bottom: studio.bottomHeight }),
    );
  }, [studio.leftWidth, studio.rightWidth, studio.bottomHeight]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!studio.dirty) return;
    if (saveTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    saveTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void fetch(`/api/projects/${studio.project.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project }),
      })
        .then(() => studio.markSaved())
        .catch(() => undefined);
    }, 700);
  }, [studio.project, studio.dirty, studio]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName;
      if (tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT") return;
      if (e.code === "Space") {
        e.preventDefault();
        studio.setPlaying(!studio.playing);
      }
      if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "J") studio.setPlayhead(Math.max(0, studio.playhead - 2));
      if (e.key === "l" || e.key === "L") studio.setPlayhead(Math.min(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 9999, studio.playhead + 2));
      if (e.key === "k" || e.key === "K") studio.setPlaying(false);
      if (e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") studio.splitAtPlayhead();
      if (e.key === "m" || e.key === "M") studio.mergeSelected();
      if (e.key === "Home") studio.setPlayhead(0);
      if (e.key === "End") studio.setPlayhead(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 0);
      if (e.key === "[") {
        const prev = [...studio.project.captions].reverse().find((c) => c.startSec < studio.playhead - 0.01);
        if (prev) {
          studio.setPlayhead(prev.startSec);
          studio.select([prev.id]);
        }
      }
      if (e.key === "]") {
        const next = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.startSec > studio.playhead + 0.01);
        if (next) {
          studio.setPlayhead(next.startSec);
          studio.select([next.id]);
        }
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? -10 : -1);
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1);
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.shiftKey) studio.redo();
        else studio.undo();
      }
      if (e.key === "?" || (e.shiftKey && e.key === "/")) setHelp((v) => !v);
      if (e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") studio.deleteSelected();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [studio]);

  const flagged = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6);
  const album = ART[studio.project.presetId ?? "seven-clouds"] ?? "/images/art-default.jpg";

  async function runExport() {
    const [w, h] = res.split("x").map(Number);
    const ok = await isWebCodecsSupported(w || 1920, h || 1080);
    if (!ok) {
      studio.notify("WebCodecs unavailable — trying FFmpeg fallback.");
      const response = await fetch("/api/export", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format: "mp4", width: w, height: h }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        studio.notify("FFmpeg fallback is not available in this environment.");
        return;
      }
      const blob = await response.blob();
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.mp4`);
      return;
    }
    setExporting(true);
    abort.current = new AbortController();
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = album;
    await img.decode().catch(() => undefined);
    let audioBuffer: AudioBuffer | null = null;
    if (audioUrl) {
      const buf = await fetch(audioUrl).then((r) => r.arrayBuffer());
      audioBuffer = await decodeAudio(buf);
    }
    try {
      const blob = await exportWebCodecsMp4(
        { ...studio.project, meta: { ...studio.project.meta, fps, resolution: res as Project["meta"]["resolution"] } },
        canvas,
        { albumArt: img, backgroundImage: img },
        audioBuffer,
        {
          width: w,
          height: h,
          fps,
          quality,
          signal: abort.current.signal,
          onProgress: (p) => {
            setExportPct(p.pct);
            setExportMsg(`Frame ${p.frame}/${p.total}`);
          },
        },
      );
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${res}_${fps}fps.mp4`);
      studio.notify("Export complete.");
      setExportOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      studio.notify(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Export failed.");
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  }

  async function sideExport(format: "srt" | "vtt" | "ass" | "json") {
    const res = await fetch("/api/export", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format }),
    });
    const blob = await res.blob();
    downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.${format}`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen min-w-[1280px] flex-col bg-[var(--bg)]">
      <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--line)] px-3">
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <img src="/images/mark.png" alt="" className="h-7 w-7 rounded" />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">LyricForge</span>
        </Link>
        <input
          value={studio.project.meta.title}
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.title = e.target.value; })}
          className="h-8 w-56 rounded-md border border-transparent bg-transparent px-2 text-sm font-medium hover:border-[var(--line)] focus:border-[var(--accent)]"
          title="Project Title"
        />
        <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">{studio.dirty ? "Unsaved" : studio.saving ? "Saving" : "Saved"}</span>
        <Tooltip label="Undo" shortcut="⌘Z">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-30" disabled={!studio.canUndo} onClick={studio.undo}><Undo2 size={16} /></button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip label="Redo" shortcut="⇧⌘Z">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-30" disabled={!studio.canRedo} onClick={studio.redo}><Redo2 size={16} /></button>
        </Tooltip>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={openLyricsModal}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
        >
          <FileText size={14} /> Paste / Edit Lyrics
        </button>

        <select
          value={studio.project.meta.aspectRatio}
          className="h-8 rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-xs"
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.aspectRatio = e.target.value as Project["meta"]["aspectRatio"]; })}
        >
          {["16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "21:9"].map((a) => <option key={a}>{a}</option>)}
        </select>

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Captions Panel">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.leftOpen ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
              onClick={() => studio.setPanel("left", !studio.leftOpen)}
            >
              <PanelLeft size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Timeline">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.bottomOpen ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
              onClick={() => studio.setPanel("bottom", !studio.bottomOpen)}
            >
              <PanelBottom size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Inspector">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.rightOpen ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
              onClick={() => studio.setPanel("right", !studio.rightOpen)}
            >
              <PanelRight size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />
          <Tooltip label="Shortcuts" shortcut="?">
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]" onClick={() => setHelp(true)}>
              <HelpCircle size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)] px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md hover:brightness-110"
            onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}
          >
            <Download size={14} /> Export
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        {studio.leftOpen && (
          <aside className="flex flex-col border-r border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]" style={{ width: studio.leftWidth }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--faint)]">
                Captions ({studio.project.captions.length})
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => studio.addCaption("New lyric line")}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-[var(--accent)]/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/25"
                  title="Add new lyric line at playhead"
                >
                  <Plus size={12} /> Add
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={openLyricsModal}
                  className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                  title="Paste / Import Sheet"
                >
                  <FileText size={13} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {flagged.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="mx-3 mt-2.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-400/15 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-400/25"
                onClick={() => {
                  const first = flagged[0];
                  if (!first) return;
                  studio.select([first.id]);
                  studio.setPlayhead(first.startSec);
                }}
              >
                Review {flagged.length} flagged low-confidence lines
              </button>
            )}

            <ul className="lf-scroll flex-1 space-y-1.5 overflow-auto p-2">
              {studio.project.captions.map((c) => {
                const isSelected = studio.selectedIds.includes(c.id);
                return (
                  <li
                    key={c.id}
                    className={`rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.1)]"
                        : "border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] hover:border-white/20"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="p-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">#{c.index + 1}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                          {formatTimecode(c.startSec)} → {formatTimecode(c.endSec)}
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${
                            c.confidence < 0.35 ? "bg-red-400" : c.confidence < 0.6 ? "bg-amber-300" : "bg-emerald-400"
                          }`}
                          title={`Confidence: ${(c.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
                        />
                      </div>

                      {isSelected ? (
                        <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
                          <textarea
                            value={c.text}
                            rows={2}
                            onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionText(c.id, e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Type lyric line text..."
                            className="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#06080d] p-2 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                          />
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 text-[11px]">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)]">
                              <span>In:</span>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                step="0.1"
                                min="0"
                                value={Number(c.startSec.toFixed(2))}
                                onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, Number(e.target.value), c.endSec)}
                                className="w-14 rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#06080d] px-1 py-0.5 text-center text-[var(--ink)]"
                              />
                              <span>Out:</span>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                step="0.1"
                                min="0"
                                value={Number(c.endSec.toFixed(2))}
                                onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(c.id, c.startSec, Number(e.target.value))}
                                className="w-14 rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#06080d] px-1 py-0.5 text-center text-[var(--ink)]"
                              />
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Play from line start"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  studio.setPlayhead(c.startSec);
                                  studio.setPlaying(true);
                                }}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
                              >
                                <Play size={12} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Split at playhead"
                                onClick={() => studio.splitAtPlayhead()}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                              >
                                <Scissors size={12} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Duplicate line"
                                onClick={() => studio.duplicateSelected()}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                              >
                                <Copy size={12} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Delete line"
                                onClick={() => studio.deleteSelected()}
                                className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-red-400"
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={12} />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            studio.select([c.id]);
                            studio.setPlayhead(c.startSec);
                          }}
                          className="mt-1 block w-full text-left text-xs text-[var(--ink)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
                        >
                          <span className="line-clamp-2">{c.text || "♪ (Instrumental)"}</span>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </aside>
        )}

        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <PreviewCanvas audioUrl={audioUrl} albumUrl={album} />
          {studio.bottomOpen && (
            <div className="border-t border-[var(--line)]" style={{ height: studio.bottomHeight }}>
              <Timeline peaks={peaks} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {studio.rightOpen && (
          <aside className="border-l border-[var(--line)]" style={{ width: studio.rightWidth }}>
            <Inspector />
          </aside>
        )}
      </div>

      <Toast text={studio.toast?.text ?? null} />
      <Shortcuts open={help} onClose={() => setHelp(false)} />

      {/* Paste / Edit Full Lyrics Sheet Modal */}
      <Modal
        open={lyricsModalOpen}
        title="Paste / Edit Lyrics Sheet"
        onClose={() => setLyricsModalOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleApplyLyricsSheet}
        confirmLabel="Apply & Sync Lyrics"
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-white/5 pb-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              Line breaks define captions. Headers like <code className="text-[var(--accent)]">## title:</code> supported.
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={async () => {
                  try {
                    const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
                    if (text) setLyricsSheetText(text);
                  } catch {}
                }}
                className="rounded border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-white"
              >
                Paste Clipboard
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLyricsSheetText("")}
                className="rounded border border-red-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  const lines = studio.project.captions
                    .filter((c) => !c.instrumental)
                    .map((c) => c.text)
                    .join("\n");
                  const metaHeader = `## title: ${studio.project.meta.title}\n## artist: ${studio.project.meta.artist}\n\n`;
                  setLyricsSheetText(metaHeader + lines);
                }}
                className="rounded border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20"
              >
                Reload Current
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <textarea
            value={lyricsSheetText}
            onChange={(e) => setLyricsSheetText(e.target.value)}
            rows={12}
            className="w-full resize-none rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] p-3 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
            placeholder={`## title: Song Title\n## artist: Artist Name\n\n[Verse 1]\nLine one lyrics\nLine two lyrics\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one`}
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Export Video Modal */}
      <Modal
        open={exportOpen}
        title="Export lyric video"
        onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={() => void runExport()}
        confirmLabel={exporting ? "Exporting…" : "Render MP4"}
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Resolution
            <select value={res} onChange={(e) => setRes(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              <option>1280x720</option>
              <option>1920x1080</option>
              <option>2560x1440</option>
              <option>3840x2160</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Frame rate
            <select value={fps} onChange={(e) => setFps(Number(e.target.value))} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              {[24, 25, 30, 50, 60].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} fps</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Quality
            <select value={quality} onChange={(e) => setQuality(e.target.value as typeof quality)} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              <option value="high">High</option>
              <option value="balanced">Balanced</option>
              <option value="small">Small</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("srt")}>SRT</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("vtt")}>WebVTT</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("ass")}>ASS karaoke</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("json")}>Project JSON</button>
          </div>
          {exporting && (
            <div>
              <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1c2230]">
                <div className="h-full bg-[var(--accent)]" style={{ width: `${exportPct * 100}%` }} />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs">{exportMsg}</p>
              <button type="button" className="mt-2 text-xs text-[var(--danger)]" onClick={() => abort.current?.abort()}>Cancel</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function StudioApp({ initial }: { initial: Project }) {
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>(() =>
    Array.from({ length: 180 }, (_, i) => Math.round((0.2 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 6))) * 100) / 100),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void (async () => {
      const blob = (await getBlob(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getBlob("draft-master"));
      if (blob) setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      const stored = (await getPeaks(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getPeaks("draft-master"));
      if (stored) setPeaks(Array.from(stored));
    })();
  }, [initial.id]);

  const project = useMemo(() => initial, [initial]);
  return (
    <StudioProvider initial={project}>
      <StudioInner audioUrl={audioUrl} peaks={peaks} />
    </StudioProvider>
  );
}

export function Inspector() {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<(typeof TABS)[number]["id"]>("Text");
  const [presetOpen, setPresetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [trackInfoOpen, setTrackInfoOpen] = useState(false);
  const [customFontInput, setCustomFontInput] = useState("");
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fontInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const lottieInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const animFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const bgImageInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const selected = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.id === studio.selectedIds[0]);
  const style = selected?.styleOverride
    ? { ...studio.project.defaultStyle, ...selected.styleOverride }
    : studio.project.defaultStyle;
  const overridden = Boolean(selected?.styleOverride);

  const recentColors = useMemo(
    () => [
      style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA",
      style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A",
      style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4",
      style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA",
      "#F5C15A",
      "#67F0FF",
      "#FF5A92",
      "#FFFFFF",
    ],
    [style.fill, style.highlightFill, style.pastFill, style.futureFill]
  );

  const patch = (p: Partial<typeof style>) => studio.updateStyle(p, selected ? "selected" : "default");

  const overlay: OverlaySpec = studio.project.media?.background?.overlay ?? {
    type: "none",
    opacity: 0.85,
    speed: 1,
    scale: 1,
    blendMode: "screen",
  };

  const patchOverlay = (p: Partial<OverlaySpec>) => {
    studio.commit((d) => {
      if (!d.media.background.overlay) {
        d.media.background.overlay = {
          type: "none",
          opacity: 0.85,
          speed: 1,
          scale: 1,
          blendMode: "screen",
        };
      }
      d.media.background.overlay = { ...d.media.background.overlay, ...p };
    });
  };

  // Custom Font Upload
  const handleFontUpload = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      setUploadError(null);
      const fontName = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_");
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const fontFace = new FontFace(fontName, buffer);
      await fontFace.load();
      document.fonts.add(fontFace);
      patch({ fontFamily: fontName });
    } catch {
      setUploadError("Could not load font file. Please use .ttf, .otf, or .woff2.");
    }
  };

  // Custom Animation File Upload
  const handleAnimFileUpload = (file: File) => {
    setUploadError(null);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const text = e.target?.result as string;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
        if (parsed.inPreset || parsed.outPreset) {
          if (selected) {
            studio.commit((d) => {
              const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
              if (c) {
                if (parsed.inPreset) c.animation.in.preset = parsed.inPreset;
                if (parsed.outPreset) c.animation.out.preset = parsed.outPreset;
                if (parsed.easing) c.animation.in.easing = parsed.easing;
              }
            });
          } else {
            studio.commit((d) => {
              for (const c of d.captions) {
                if (parsed.inPreset) c.animation.in.preset = parsed.inPreset;
                if (parsed.outPreset) c.animation.out.preset = parsed.outPreset;
                if (parsed.easing) c.animation.in.easing = parsed.easing;
              }
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Lottie or custom overlay
          patchOverlay({
            type: "lottie",
            lottieJson: text,
            lottieName: file.name,
          });
        }
      } catch {
        setUploadError("Invalid JSON animation file.");
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  // Background Image Upload
  const handleBgImageUpload = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      const assetId = `bg-${studio.project.id}-${Date.now()}`;
      await putBlob(assetId, file);
      studio.commit((d) => {
        d.media.background.type = "image";
        d.media.background.imageAssetId = assetId;
      });
    } catch {
      setUploadError("Failed to store background image.");
    }
  };

  const applyAnimationToAll = (inPreset: string, highlightStyle: string) => {
    studio.commit((d) => {
      for (const c of d.captions) {
        c.animation.in.preset = inPreset as typeof c.animation.in.preset;
        c.animation.highlight.style = highlightStyle as typeof c.animation.highlight.style;
      }
    });
  };

  const activePreset = STYLE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === studio.project.presetId) ?? STYLE_PRESETS[0];
  const highlightStyle = selected?.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";
  const isKaraokeOn = highlightStyle !== "none";

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[var(--bg-panel)] font-sans text-[var(--ink)] lf-scroll overflow-y-auto">
      {/* 1. Sleek Presets Dropdown Box */}
      <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0a0d13]">
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setPresetOpen(!presetOpen)}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#121620] px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 transition-all shadow-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)]">
                <Sparkles size={13} />
              </span>
              <div className="text-left">
                <span className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Visual Preset</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-[var(--accent)]">{activePreset.name}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown size={14} className={`text-[var(--muted)] transition-transform ${presetOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
          </button>

          {presetOpen && (
            <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 z-50 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0e121a] p-2 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                {STYLE_PRESETS.map((p) => {
                  const isSelected = studio.project.presetId === p.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={p.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        studio.applyStylePreset(p.id);
                        setPresetOpen(false);
                      }}
                      className={`flex flex-col text-left rounded-xl p-2.5 transition-all ${
                        isSelected
                          ? "border border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/15 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.2)]"
                          : "border border-white/5 bg-[#141924] hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-[#1a2130]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${isSelected ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-white"}`}>
                        {p.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-[var(--faint)] leading-snug line-clamp-2">{p.blurb}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 2. Track Title & Artist Info Accordion */}
        <div className="mt-2">
          <button

          </button>

          {trackInfoOpen && (
            <div className="mt-2 space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-[#080a0f] p-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Song Title</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={studio.project.meta.title}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    studio.commit((d) => {
                      d.meta.title = e.target.value;
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"

              />

                      if (selected) {

                          if (c) c.animation.highlight.style = st;

                  >
                    <option value="color">Color Fill</option>
                    <option value="sweep">Karaoke Sweep</option>
                    <option value="box">Rounded Box Badge</option>
                    <option value="scale">Bounce Scale</option>
                    <option value="underline">Underline Marker</option>
                    <option value="glow">Pulse Glow</option>
                    <option value="shimmer">Golden Shimmer</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Custom Animation Upload */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Custom Animation File</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => animFileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20"
                >
                  <Upload size={11} /> Upload JSON
                </button>
              </div>
              <input
                ref={animFileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".json"
                hidden
                onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && handleAnimFileUpload(e.target.files[0])}
              />
              <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">Supports motion curve presets or Lottie JSON files.</p>
            </div>

            {/* In / Out Presets */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">Motion In & Out</span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">In Preset</label>
                  <select
                    value={selected?.animation?.in?.preset ?? "fade"}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const p = e.target.value;
                      if (selected) {
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                          if (c) c.animation.in.preset = p as typeof c.animation.in.preset;
                        });
                      } else {
                        applyAnimationToAll(p, highlightStyle);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {["fade", "slide", "scale", "pop", "bounce", "blur", "wave", "typewriter", "cascade", "wipe", "spring", "none"].map((p) => (
                      <option key={p} value={p}>{p}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Out Preset</label>
                  <select
                    value={selected?.animation?.out?.preset ?? "fade"}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const p = e.target.value;
                      if (selected) {
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                          if (c) c.animation.out.preset = p as typeof c.animation.out.preset;
                        });
                      }
                    }}
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {["fade", "slide", "scale", "pop", "bounce", "blur", "wipe", "spring", "none"].map((p) => (
                      <option key={p} value={p}>{p}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => applyAnimationToAll(selected?.animation?.in?.preset ?? "fade", highlightStyle)}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--accent)]/40 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20 transition-all"
                >
                  Apply Current Animation to All Lines
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB: OVERLAYS */}
        {tab === "Overlays" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-950/20 p-2.5 text-xs text-amber-300">
              <Flame size={14} className="text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>Overlays are <strong>beat-reactive</strong> and pulse with live audio energy!</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {OVERLAY_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                const active = overlay.type === opt.type;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={opt.type}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (opt.type === "lottie") {
                        lottieInputRef.current?.click();
                      } else {
                        patchOverlay({ type: opt.type });
                      }
                    }}
                    className={`flex flex-col text-left rounded-2xl p-3 transition-all ${
                      active
                        ? "border border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/15 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,193,90,0.25)]"
                        : "border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-[#121620]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${active ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-white"}`}>
                      {opt.label}

                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <input
              ref={lottieInputRef}
              type="file"
              accept=".json"
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && handleAnimFileUpload(e.target.files[0])}
            />

            {overlay.type !== "none" && (
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
                <Slider
                  label="Overlay Opacity"
                  min={0.1}
                  max={1}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={overlay.opacity}
                  onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ opacity: v })}
                />
                <Slider
                  label="Speed Multiplier"
                  min={0.2}
                  max={3}
                  step={0.1}
                  value={overlay.speed}
                  onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ speed: v })}
                />
                <Slider
                  label="Scale / Density"
                  min={0.5}
                  max={2.5}
                  step={0.1}
                  value={overlay.scale}
                  onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ scale: v })}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB: VISUALIZER */}
        {tab === "Visualizer" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">Audio Visualizer</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)]">Real-time spectrum renderer</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    studio.commit((d) => {
                      d.media.background.visualizer = !d.media.background.visualizer;
                    })
                  }
                  className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    studio.project.media?.background?.visualizer
                      ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)]"
                      : "bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)] border border-white/10"
                  }`}
                >
                  {studio.project.media?.background?.visualizer ? "ACTIVE" : "OFF"}
                </button>
              </div>

              {studio.project.media?.background?.visualizer && (
                <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">Visualizer Style</label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    {[
                      { id: "bars", label: "Spectrum Bars" },

                                  d.media.background.visualizerConfig.position = pos;

                              isPos ? "border-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10" : "border-white/5 text-[var(--muted)]"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {pos}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Fine-Grained Position Coordinates */}
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-[#080a0f] p-3 space-y-3">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[var(--accent)] block">Position & Scale Settings</span>
                    <Slider
                      label="X Position Center (%)"
                      min={10}
                      max={90}
                      step={1}
                      value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.xPercent ?? 50}
                      onChange={(v) =>

                    />
                    <Slider
                      label="Y Position Height (%)"
                      min={10}
                      max={98}
                      step={1}
                      value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.yPercent ?? 92}
                      onChange={(v) =>
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.yPercent = v;
                        })
                      }
                    />
                    <Slider
                      label="Width Width (%)"
                      min={20}
                      max={100}
                      step={2}
                      value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.widthPercent ?? 74}
                      onChange={(v) =>
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.widthPercent = v;
                        })
                      }
                    />
                    <Slider
                      label="Amplitude / Height (%)"
                      min={5}
                      max={50}
                      step={1}
                      value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.heightPercent ?? 22}
                      onChange={(v) =>
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.heightPercent = v;
                        })
                      }
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <ColorField
                      label="Color A"
                      value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.colorA ?? "#F5C15A"}
                      onChange={(c) =>
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.colorA = c;
                        })
                      }
                      recent={recentColors}
                    />
                    <ColorField
                      label="Color B"
                      value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.colorB ?? "#67F0FF"}
                      onChange={(c) =>
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.colorB = c;
                        })
                      }
                      recent={recentColors}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <Slider
                    label="Sensitivity Multiplier"
                    min={0.2}
                    max={3}
                    step={0.1}
                    value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.sensitivity ?? 1}
                    onChange={(v) =>
                      studio.commit((d) => {
                        if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.sensitivity = v;
                      })
                    }
                  />

                  <Slider
                    label="Bar Count / Granularity"
                    min={12}
                    max={96}
                    step={4}
                    value={studio.project.media?.background?.visualizerConfig?.barCount ?? 48}
                    onChange={(v) =>
                      studio.commit((d) => {
                        if (d.media.background.visualizerConfig) d.media.background.visualizerConfig.barCount = v;
                      })
                    }
                  />
                </div>
              )}

        {/* TAB: BACKGROUND */}
        {tab === "Background" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] block">Background Backdrop</span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {[
                  { id: "solid", label: "Solid Dark" },
                  { id: "gradient", label: "Gradient" },
                  { id: "image", label: "Custom Image" },
                  { id: "album-blur", label: "Album Art Blur" },
                ].map((b) => {
                  const isSel = studio.project.media.background.type === b.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={b.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          d.media.background.type = b.id as typeof d.media.background.type;
                        })
                      }
                      className={`rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-left transition-all ${
                        isSel
                          ? "border border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)]"
                          : "border border-white/5 bg-[#121620] text-white hover:border-white/20"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {b.label}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Image Upload Button */}
              {(studio.project.media.background.type === "image" || studio.project.media.background.type === "album-blur") && (
                <div className="pt-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => bgImageInputRef.current?.click()}
                    className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--accent)]/40 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20 transition-all"
                  >
                    <Upload size={14} /> Upload Custom Background Image
                  </button>
                  <input
                    ref={bgImageInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    hidden
                    onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void handleBgImageUpload(e.target.files[0])}
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              {studio.project.media.background.type === "solid" && (
                <ColorField
                  label="Solid Background Color"
                  value={studio.project.media.background.color ?? "#0B0D12"}
                  onChange={(c) =>
                    studio.commit((d) => {
                      d.media.background.color = c;
                    })
                  }
                  recent={recentColors}
                />
              )}

              {studio.project.media.background.type === "gradient" && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <ColorField
                    label="Primary Gradient Color"
                    value={studio.project.media.background.color ?? "#0B0D12"}
                    onChange={(c) =>
                      studio.commit((d) => {
                        d.media.background.color = c;
                      })
                    }
                    recent={recentColors}
                  />
                  <ColorField
                    label="Secondary Gradient Color"
                    value={studio.project.media.background.colorB ?? "#1B2232"}
                    onChange={(c) =>
                      studio.commit((d) => {
                        d.media.background.colorB = c;
                      })
                    }
                    recent={recentColors}
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              <Slider
                label="Dim Overlay"
                min={0}
                max={0.9}
                step={0.05}
                value={studio.project.media.background.dim}
                onChange={(v) =>
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    d.media.background.dim = v;
                  })
                }
              />

              <Slider
                label="Blur (px)"
                min={0}
                max={40}
                step={2}
                value={studio.project.media.background.blurPx}
                onChange={(v) =>
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    d.media.background.blurPx = v;
                  })
                }
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
