"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  AudioLines,
  Check,
  Clipboard,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  FileAudio,
  Film,
  KeyRound,
  Layers,
  Music,
  Sparkles,
  Trash2,
  Upload,
  Zap,
  Mic,
} from "lucide-react";
import { defaultProject, type Caption } from "@/schema";
import { heuristicSync, parseLyrics } from "@/align-engine";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { decodeAudio, encodeWavMono16, extractPeaks, downsampleMono } from "@/lib/audio-client";
import { putBlob, putPeaks } from "@/lib/idb";
import { naturalSort } from "@/lib/time";

const SAMPLE_LYRICS = `[Verse 1]
City lights fold over the river
I keep your name in the back of my throat
Every red signal feels like a letter
I never found the courage to post

[Chorus]
If the night is a map then I'm lost on purpose
Pin every heartbeat to a borrowed sky
Say it slower so the dark can rehearse us
We only glow when we almost arrive

[Verse 2]
Vinyl dust on a kitchen table
Your laugh still lives in the hallway light
I would trade the whole constellation
For one more ordinary night
`;

interface ClipMap {
  name: string;
  file: File;
  lineIndex: number;
}

export function Wizard() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState<number>(1);
  const [key, setKey] = useState("");
  const [showKey, setShowKey] = useState(false);
  const [persist, setPersist] = useState<"session" | "store">("session");
  const [keyOk, setKeyOk] = useState(false);
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [keyError, setKeyError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hasSessionKey, setHasSessionKey] = useState(false);

  // Dedicated Title and Artist
  const [songTitle, setSongTitle] = useState("");
  const [artistName, setArtistName] = useState("");
  const [karaokeEnabled, setKaraokeEnabled] = useState(true);

  // Audio and Lyrics
  const [audioFile, setAudioFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const [audioMeta, setAudioMeta] = useState<string>("");
  const [lyrics, setLyrics] = useState("");
  const [clips, setClips] = useState<ClipMap[]>([]);
  const [log, setLog] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const clipRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const keySectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const audioSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lyricsSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const clipsSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetch("/api/session")
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((j: { configured?: boolean; defaultKey?: string }) => {
        if (j.configured) {
          setHasSessionKey(true);
          setKeyOk(true);
        }
        if (j.defaultKey) {
          setKey((prev) => prev || j.defaultKey || "");
        }
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  const parsed = useMemo(() => parseLyrics(lyrics), [lyrics]);
  const vocalCount = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).length;
  const instrumentalCount = parsed.lines.filter((l) => l.instrumental).length;

  // Auto-sync parsed title / artist to separate fields if empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (parsed.title && !songTitle) setSongTitle(parsed.title);
    if (parsed.artist && !artistName) setArtistName(parsed.artist);
  }, [parsed.title, parsed.artist, songTitle, artistName]);

  const scrollToSection = (index: number) => {
    setActiveNav(index);
    const refs = [keySectionRef, audioSectionRef, lyricsSectionRef, clipsSectionRef];
    refs[index - 1]?.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };

  async function validateKey() {
    setKeyError(null);
    setValidating(true);
    try {
      const activeKey = key.trim();
      if (!activeKey) {
        setKeyError("Please enter a Groq API key.");
        setKeyOk(false);
        setValidating(false);
        return;
      }
      const res = await fetch("/api/session", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ key: activeKey, persist }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok) {
        setKeyError(json.error ?? "Could not validate that key.");
        setKeyOk(false);
        return;
      }
      setKeyOk(true);
      setHasSessionKey(true);
      setKey(activeKey);
    } catch {
      setKeyError("Network error while validating key.");
      setKeyOk(false);
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  }

  async function onAudio(file: File) {
    try {
      const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const decoded = await decodeAudio(buf);
      setAudioFile(file);
      setDuration(decoded.duration);
      if (!songTitle) {
        setSongTitle(file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
      }
      const p = extractPeaks(decoded, 240);
      setPeaks(Array.from(p));
      setAudioMeta(`${file.name} · ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB · ${decoded.duration.toFixed(1)}s`);
      await putBlob("draft-master", file);
      await putPeaks("draft-master", p);
    } catch {
      setAudioMeta("Could not decode that audio file. Re-export as MP3 or WAV.");
    }
  }

  const handlePasteClipboard = async () => {
    try {
      const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
      if (text) {
        setLyrics(text);
      }
    } catch {}
  };

  async function generateWithoutAudio() {
    setRunning(true);
    setLog(["Parsing lyric sheet...", "Generating synchronized captions with rhythm heuristics..."]);
    setProgress(0.4);
    const estDuration = Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8);
    const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, estDuration);

    const finalCaptions = sync.captions.map((c) => ({
      ...c,
      animation: {
        ...c.animation,
        highlight: {
          ...c.animation.highlight,
          style: karaokeEnabled ? c.animation.highlight.style : ("none" as const),
          enabled: karaokeEnabled,
        },
      },
    }));

    const project = defaultProject({
      id: createId("proj"),
      meta: {
        title: songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || "Custom Lyrics",
        artist: artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist",
        durationSec: estDuration,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
      captions: finalCaptions,
    });

    setProgress(0.8);
    const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
    });

    if (!saved.ok) {
      const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown error");
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error saving project: ${errText}`]);
      setRunning(false);
      return;
    }

    const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
    setProgress(1);
    setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Project ready! Opening Studio..."]);
    setRunning(false);
    startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
  }

  async function analyze() {
    if (!audioFile) {
      await generateWithoutAudio();
      return;
    }
    setRunning(true);
    setLog(["Starting Whisper large-v3-turbo speech-to-text alignment..."]);
    setProgress(0.1);

    const form = new FormData();
    form.set("lyrics", lyrics);
    form.set("durationSec", String(duration));
    form.set("title", songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || audioFile.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
    form.set("artist", artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist");
    form.set("language", "en");

    try {
      const decoded = await decodeAudio(await audioFile.arrayBuffer());
      const wav = encodeWavMono16(downsampleMono(decoded), 16000);
      form.set("audio", new File([wav], "master.wav", { type: "audio/wav" }));

      const res = await fetch("/api/analyze", { method: "POST", body: form });
      if (!res.body) {
        setLog(["The analyze stream failed to open."]);
        setRunning(false);
        return;
      }

      const reader = res.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buf = "";
      let captions: Caption[] = [];
      let flagged = 0;
      let title = songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || "Untitled";
      let artist = artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist";
      let streamFailed = false;

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        buf += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const chunks = buf.split("\n\n");
        buf = chunks.pop() ?? "";
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          const line = chunk.split("\n").find((l) => l.startsWith("data:"));
          if (!line) continue;
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim()) as {
              stage: string;
              label: string;
              progress: number;
              captions?: Caption[];
              flagged?: number;
              title?: string;
              artist?: string;
            };
            setProgress(payload.progress);
            setLog((curr) => [...curr, `${payload.stage}  ${payload.label}`]);
            if (payload.stage === "error") streamFailed = true;
            if (payload.captions) captions = payload.captions;
            if (payload.flagged !== undefined) flagged = payload.flagged;
            if (payload.title && !songTitle) title = payload.title;
            if (payload.artist && !artistName) artist = payload.artist;
          } catch {}
        }
      }

      if (streamFailed && captions.length === 0) {
        setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Whisper API unavailable. Falling back to heuristic rhythm timing sync..."]);
        const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, duration || Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8));
        captions = sync.captions;
      }

      const finalCaptions = captions.map((c) => ({
        ...c,
        animation: {
          ...c.animation,
          highlight: {
            ...c.animation.highlight,
            style: karaokeEnabled ? c.animation.highlight.style : ("none" as const),
            enabled: karaokeEnabled,
          },
        },
      }));

      const project = defaultProject({
        id: createId("proj"),
        meta: {
          title,
          artist,
          durationSec: duration,
          fps: 30,
          resolution: "1920x1080",
          aspectRatio: "16:9",
          language: "en",
        },
        captions: finalCaptions,
      });

      await putBlob(`audio-${project.id}`, audioFile);

      const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
      });

      if (!saved.ok) {
        const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown error");
        setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error saving project: ${errText}`]);
        setRunning(false);
        return;
      }

      const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, flagged ? `Review ${flagged} flagged lines in the studio.` : "All lines aligned confidently!"]);
      setRunning(false);
      startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Generation error";
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error: ${msg}. Falling back to heuristic sync...`]);
      await generateWithoutAudio();
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      {/* 4-Step Sticky Nav Bar */}
      <div className="sticky top-4 z-40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0c1017]/95 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {[
            { id: 1, label: "1 KEY", status: keyOk ? "READY" : key ? "ENTERED" : "REQUIRED" },
            { id: 2, label: "2 AUDIO", status: audioFile ? `${(duration / 60).toFixed(0)}m` : "OPTIONAL" },
            { id: 3, label: "3 LYRICS", status: vocalCount > 0 ? `${vocalCount} LINES` : "REQUIRED" },
            { id: 4, label: "4 CLIPS", status: clips.length > 0 ? `${clips.length} STEMS` : "OPTIONAL" },
          ].map((item) => {
            const isActive = activeNav === item.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollToSection(item.id)}
                className={`group flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] transition-all ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,193,90,0.35)] scale-105"
                    : "border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] text-[var(--muted)] hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                <span
                  className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[9px] font-bold ${
                    isActive
                      ? "bg-black/20 text-[var(--accent-ink)]"
                      : item.status.includes("READY") || item.status.includes("LINES") || item.status.includes("m")
                      ? "bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-[var(--accent)]"
                      : "bg-white/5 text-[var(--faint)]"
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.status}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[var(--accent)]">
            <Sparkles size={13} /> AI Lyric Video Studio
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Grid Layout */}
      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* STEP 1: Connect Groq */}
          <section
            ref={keySectionRef}
            id="step-key"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  1
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Speech-to-Text Engine & API Key
                </h3>
              </div>
              {keyOk && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ok)] bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5">
                  <Check size={13} /> Active & Verified
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Whisper large-v3-turbo provides word-level timestamps. Keys remain secure on the server and are never logged or exported.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showKey ? "text" : "password"}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  placeholder="gsk_…"
                  value={key}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setKey(e.target.value);
                    setKeyOk(false);
                  }}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] pl-4 pr-10 py-2.5 font-mono text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowKey(!showKey)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                >
                  {showKey ? <EyeOff size={15} /> : <Eye size={15} />}
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                <span className="text-[var(--faint)]">
                  {key ? "Custom key entered" : "Paste your Groq API key (starts with gsk_)"}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    void fetch("/api/session")
                      .then((r) => r.json())
                      .then((j: { defaultKey?: string }) => {
                        if (j.defaultKey) {
                          setKey(j.defaultKey);
                          setKeyOk(false);
                        }
                      })
                      .catch(() => undefined);
                  }}
                  className="text-[var(--accent)] hover:underline font-medium"
                >
                  Use Preconfigured Server Key
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={persist === "store"}
                  onChange={(e) => setPersist(e.target.checked ? "store" : "session")}
                  className="rounded border-[var(--line)] accent-[var(--accent)]"
                />
                Remember key on this machine
              </label>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={validating}
                onClick={() => void validateKey()}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--accent)] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50 transition-all active:scale-95"
              >
                <KeyRound size={14} /> {validating ? "Verifying..." : keyOk ? "Re-verify Key" : "Validate Key"}
              </button>
            </div>

            {keyError && <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-[var(--danger)]">{keyError}</p>}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 2: Master Audio */}
          <section
            ref={audioSectionRef}
            id="step-audio"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  2
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Master Audio Track
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">Optional for Heuristic mode</span>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Upload full mix (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG). The audio is decoded client-side into synchronized audio frames.
            </p>

            <div
              onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
              className="mt-4 flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-6 py-8 transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[#0f141f]"
            >
              <Upload className="mb-2 text-[var(--accent)]" size={24} />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--ink)]">
                {audioFile ? audioFile.name : "Drop a full audio track (MP3/WAV), or click to browse"}
              </span>
              <span className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">
                {audioMeta || "Waveform spectrum will render automatically upon decoding"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <input
              ref={fileRef}
              type="file"
              accept="audio/*"
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void onAudio(e.target.files[0])}
            />

            {peaks.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#07090e] p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--faint)] mb-2">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[var(--accent)] font-medium">
                    <Music size={13} /> {audioFile?.name}
                  </span>
                  <span>{duration.toFixed(1)}s total</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex h-14 items-end gap-px">
                  {peaks.map((p, i) => (
                    <span
                      key={i}
                      className="flex-1 rounded-t-sm bg-gradient-to-t from-[var(--accent)]/40 to-[var(--accent)]"
                      style={{ height: `${Math.max(8, p * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {audioFile && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAudioFile(null);
                    setPeaks([]);
                    setDuration(0);
                    setAudioMeta("");
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-red-400 hover:underline"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={13} /> Remove audio
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          {/* STEP 3: Lyric Sheet & Track Metadata */}
          <section
            ref={lyricsSectionRef}
            id="step-lyrics"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  3
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Track Info & Lyric Sheet
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)]/15 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent)]">
                {vocalCount} vocal lines
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Dedicated Title and Artist Input Fields */}
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Song Title</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Midnight Atlas"
                  value={songTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setSongTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Artist Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Northline"
                  value={artistName}
                  onChange={(e) => setArtistName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Karaoke Mode Toggle Option */}
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#0b0e14] p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Mic size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-white block">Karaoke Mode</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)]">Word-by-word active timing highlights</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setKaraokeEnabled(!karaokeEnabled)}
                className={`rounded-full px-3.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                  karaokeEnabled
                    ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.3)]"
                    : "bg-white/10 text-[var(--muted)] border border-white/10"
                }`}
              >
                {karaokeEnabled ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED"}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Action Toolbar */}
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-white/5 pb-2">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSongTitle("Midnight Atlas");
                    setArtistName("Northline");
                    setLyrics(SAMPLE_LYRICS);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Sparkles size={13} /> Load Sample Lyrics
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePasteClipboard}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors"
                >
                  <Clipboard size={13} /> Paste Clipboard
                </button>
                {lyrics && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setLyrics("")}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={13} /> Clear
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <textarea
              value={lyrics}
              onChange={(e) => setLyrics(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={`[Verse 1]\nFirst lyric line here\nSecond lyric line here\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one\nChorus line two`}
              className="mt-3 h-56 w-full resize-y rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] p-4 font-mono text-xs leading-6 text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
            />

            {/* Real-time Parser Badge Deck */}
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <span className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2 py-1 text-[var(--muted)]">
                Lines: <strong className="text-[var(--accent)]">{vocalCount}</strong>
              </span>
              {instrumentalCount > 0 && (
                <span className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2 py-1 text-[var(--faint)]">
                  {instrumentalCount} instrumental pauses
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* STEP 4: Split Clips (Optional) */}
          <section
            ref={clipsSectionRef}
            id="step-clips"
            className="rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-6 shadow-xl transition-all hover:border-[var(--accent)]/40"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)]/15 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--accent)]">
                  4
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                  Split Audio Clips (Optional FFT Anchors)
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">Multi-track alignment</span>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Drop 001.wav… per line. FFT cross-correlation locks each line to a sample-accurate anchor in the master mix.
            </p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => clipRef.current?.click()}
              className="mt-4 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0b0e14] py-6 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--muted)] hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:text-[var(--ink)] transition-colors"
            >
              <FileAudio size={16} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Add Line Slices (001.wav, 002.wav...)
            </button>
            <input
              ref={clipRef}
              type="file"
              accept="audio/*"
              multiple
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => {
                const files = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []).sort((a, b) => naturalSort(a.name, b.name));
                setClips(files.map((file, i) => ({ name: file.name, file, lineIndex: i })));
              }}
            />

            {clips.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 max-h-44 overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] lf-scroll">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                  <thead className="border-b border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)]">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-3 py-2">Audio Slice</th>
                      <th>Assigned Lyric Line</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {clips.map((c, i) => (
                      <tr key={c.name} className="border-t border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5">
                        <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[var(--ink)]">{c.name}</td>
                        <td>
                          <select
                            value={c.lineIndex}
                            className="bg-transparent text-xs text-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const next = [...clips];
                              next[i] = { ...c, lineIndex: Number(e.target.value) };
                              setClips(next);
                            }}
                          >
                            {parsed.lines
                              .filter((l) => !l.instrumental)
                              .map((l) => (
                                <option key={l.index} value={l.index} className="bg-[#12161f] text-white">
                                  #{l.index + 1}: {l.text.slice(0, 36)}
                                </option>
                              ))}
                          </select>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Generation Deck & Action Summary */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <section className="sticky top-20 rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-gradient-to-b from-[#121722] to-[var(--bg-panel)] p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--line)]">
              <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--accent)] font-bold">
                Launch Ready
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
                <Film size={14} /> 1080p60 WebCodecs
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Song Preview Summary */}
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#07090e]/80 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--faint)]">Lyric Video Project</p>
              <h4 className="mt-1 font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-2xl text-[var(--ink)]">
                {songTitle.trim() || parsed.title || (lyrics ? "Untitled Project" : "Drop audio or paste lyrics")}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--accent)] mt-0.5">{artistName.trim() || parsed.artist || "Unknown Artist"}</p>

              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-[#12161f] p-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-[var(--faint)] block">Audio</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-[var(--ink)]">
                    {audioFile ? `${duration.toFixed(0)}s Track` : "Heuristic Sync"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-[#12161f] p-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-[var(--faint)] block">Mode</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-[var(--accent)]">
                    {karaokeEnabled ? "Karaoke Highlights" : "Static Lines"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Primary Generation CTAs */}
            <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0}
                onClick={() => void analyze()}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] via-amber-400 to-amber-300 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(245,193,90,0.3)] hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Sparkles size={18} />
                {running ? "Processing Auto-Sync..." : audioFile ? "Generate with AI (Audio + Whisper)" : "Generate Lyric Video"}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={running || pending || vocalCount === 0}
                onClick={() => void generateWithoutAudio()}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)]/50 hover:text-[var(--accent)] active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Zap size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Fast Heuristic Sync (No Audio needed)
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Live Progress Bar & SSE Log Console */}
            {running || log.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] p-3.5 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-[var(--accent)] font-medium">Pipeline Status</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[var(--muted)]">{Math.round(progress * 100)}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1c2230]">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--accent)] to-amber-300 transition-all duration-300"
                    style={{ width: `${progress * 100}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
                <ul className="max-h-36 overflow-auto space-y-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] pt-1 lf-scroll">
                  {log.map((line, i) => (
                    <li key={`${line}-${i}`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[var(--accent)] select-none">›</span>
                      <span>{line}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {/* Feature Badges */}
            <div className="mt-6 border-t border-[var(--line)] pt-4 space-y-2 text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AudioLines size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
                <span>Needleman–Wunsch alignment with Whisper word timestamps</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sparkles size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
                <span>Dynamic canvas renderer for live preview and 1080p60 MP4 export</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Layers size={15} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />
                <span>Custom animations, beat-reactive overlays & visualizers</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type LooseRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is LooseRecord {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/** v0 → v1 is a documented no-op so the migrate() chain exists and is tested. */
export function migrateV0ToV1(doc: unknown): unknown {
  if (!isRecord(doc)) return doc;
  const next: LooseRecord = { ...doc };
  if (next.version === 0 || next.version === undefined) {
    next.version = 1;
  }
  return next;
}

export function migrate(doc: unknown): Project {
  let current = doc;
  if (isRecord(current) && (current.version === 0 || current.version === undefined)) {
    current = migrateV0ToV1(current);
  }
  const parsed = ProjectSchema.safeParse(current);
  if (parsed.success) return parsed.data;
  if (isRecord(current)) {
    const fallback = defaultProject({
      id: typeof current.id === "string" ? current.id : undefined,
      meta: {
        title: typeof current.meta === "object" && current.meta && "title" in current.meta
          ? String((current.meta as LooseRecord).title ?? "Untitled")
          : "Untitled",
        artist: "Unknown Artist",
        durationSec: 0,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
    });
    return ProjectSchema.parse(fallback);
  }
  return defaultProject();
}

export const DOCUMENT_VERSION = CURRENT_VERSION;

import type { OverlaySpec } from "@/schema";
import type { FrameContext, ResolvedAssets } from "./context";
import { hashString, mulberry32 } from "./easing";

function getAudioEnergy(spectrum?: ArrayLike<number>): { bass: number; mid: number; high: number; kick: number } {
  if (!spectrum || spectrum.length === 0) {
    return { bass: 0, mid: 0, high: 0, kick: 0 };
  }
  let b = 0, m = 0, h = 0;
  const n = Math.min(spectrum.length, 48);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const val = spectrum[i] ?? 0;
    if (i < 6) b += val;
    else if (i < 20) m += val;
    else h += val;
  }
  const bass = b / 6;
  const mid = m / 14;
  const high = h / Math.max(1, n - 20);
  const kick = Math.pow(Math.max(0, bass * 1.5), 1.6);
  return { bass, mid, high, kick };
}

export function renderProceduralOverlay(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  overlay: OverlaySpec,
  timeSec: number,
  assets: ResolvedAssets,
): void {
  if (!overlay || overlay.type === "none" || overlay.opacity <= 0) return;

  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const energy = getAudioEnergy(assets.spectrum);
  const speed = (overlay.speed ?? 1) * (1 + energy.kick * 0.4);
  const t = timeSec * speed;
  const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (overlay.opacity ?? 0.6) * (0.85 + energy.bass * 0.4)));
  const scale = (overlay.scale ?? 1) * (1 + energy.kick * 0.15);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  switch (overlay.type) {
    case "bokeh":
      paintBokeh(ctx, width, height, t, scale, energy);
      break;
    case "starfield":
      paintStarfield(ctx, width, height, t, scale, energy);
      break;
    case "soundwave":
      paintSoundwaveAura(ctx, width, height, t, scale, energy);
      break;
    case "embers":
      paintEmbers(ctx, width, height, t, scale, energy);
      break;
    case "light-leak":
      paintLightLeak(ctx, width, height, t, scale, energy);
      break;
    case "scanlines":
      paintScanlines(ctx, width, height, t);
      break;
    case "lottie":
      if (assets.lottieFrame) {
        ctx.drawImage(assets.lottieFrame, 0, 0, width, height);
      }
      break;
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function paintBokeh(ctx: FrameContext, w: number, h: number, t: number, scale: number, energy: { bass: number; kick: number }): void {
  const count = 28;
  const beatScale = 1 + energy.kick * 0.35;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const seed = hashString(`bokeh-${i}`);
    const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    const baseX = rnd() * w;
    const baseY = rnd() * h;
    const baseR = (rnd() * 36 + 18) * scale * beatScale;
    const speedX = (rnd() - 0.5) * 28;
    const speedY = -rnd() * 22 - 6;
    const phase = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;

    const x = (baseX + speedX * t + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + phase) * 24 + w) % w;
    const y = (baseY + speedY * t + h) % h;
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 1.5 + phase) + energy.bass * 0.5;
    const r = baseR * pulse;

    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
    const hue = i % 3 === 0 ? "rgba(245, 193, 90, " : i % 3 === 1 ? "rgba(103, 240, 255, " : "rgba(255, 160, 200, ";
    g.addColorStop(0, `${hue}${Math.min(1, 0.45 * pulse + energy.kick * 0.3)})`);
    g.addColorStop(0.5, `${hue}${Math.min(1, 0.15 * pulse + energy.bass * 0.2)})`);
    g.addColorStop(1, `${hue}0)`);

    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function paintStarfield(ctx: FrameContext, w: number, h: number, t: number, scale: number, energy: { kick: number; bass: number }): void {
  const count = 80;
  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h / 2;
  const warp = 1 + energy.kick * 0.6;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const seed = hashString(`star-${i}`);
    const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    const angle = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
    const baseDist = rnd() * 0.95 + 0.05;
    const maxRadius = Math.sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy);

    const progress = (baseDist + t * 0.12 * warp) % 1;
    const r = progress * maxRadius * scale;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
    const size = Math.max(1, progress * 4.5 * scale * (1 + energy.kick * 0.5));
    const alpha = Math.min(1, progress * 1.6 * (1 + energy.bass * 0.5));

    ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha * 0.85})` : `rgba(103, 240, 255, ${alpha * 0.95})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function paintSoundwaveAura(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  w: number,
  h: number,
  t: number,
  scale: number,
  energy: { bass: number; kick: number },
): void {
  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h * 0.72;
  const ringCount = 6;
  const audioKick = energy.kick > 0 ? energy.kick : 0.2;

  for (let i = 0; i < ringCount; i++) {
    const phase = (t * 0.8 + i / ringCount) % 1;
    const radius = phase * (Math.min(w, h) * 0.55) * scale * (1 + audioKick * 0.4);
    const alpha = (1 - phase) * (0.35 + audioKick * 0.65);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? `rgba(245, 193, 90, ${alpha * 0.8})` : `rgba(103, 240, 255, ${alpha * 0.75})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, (1 - phase) * 7 * scale * (1 + audioKick * 0.5));
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    if (i === 0) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius * 0.7);
      g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(245, 193, 90, ${alpha * 0.35})`);
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(245, 193, 90, 0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function paintEmbers(ctx: FrameContext, w: number, h: number, t: number, scale: number, energy: { kick: number; bass: number }): void {
  const count = 45;
  const boost = 1 + energy.kick * 0.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const seed = hashString(`ember-${i}`);
    const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    const baseX = rnd() * w;
    const baseY = rnd() * h;
    const speedY = (-rnd() * 32 - 14) * boost;
    const swayAmp = rnd() * 20 + 8;
    const swayFreq = rnd() * 2 + 1;
    const phase = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;

    const x = (baseX + Math.sin(t * swayFreq + phase) * swayAmp + w) % w;
    const y = (baseY + speedY * t + h) % h;
    const twinkle = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 4 + phase) + energy.bass * 0.4;
    const size = (rnd() * 2.5 + 1.2) * scale * boost;

    ctx.fillStyle = rnd() > 0.3 ? `rgba(255, 185, 70, ${Math.min(1, twinkle * 0.9)})` : `rgba(255, 100, 50, ${Math.min(1, twinkle * 0.85)})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function paintLightLeak(ctx: FrameContext, w: number, h: number, t: number, scale: number, energy: { kick: number; mid: number }): void {
  const p1 = (Math.sin(t * 0.5) * 0.5 + 0.5) * (1 + energy.kick * 0.4);
  const p2 = (Math.cos(t * 0.35) * 0.5 + 0.5) * (1 + energy.mid * 0.4);

  const g1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(w * 0.15, h * 0.1, 0, w * 0.15, h * 0.1, (w * 0.6) * scale * (1 + energy.kick * 0.2));
  g1.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 190, 110, ${Math.min(1, 0.4 * p1)})`);
  g1.addColorStop(0.6, `rgba(255, 90, 140, ${Math.min(1, 0.15 * p1)})`);
  g1.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g1;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const g2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(w * 0.85, h * 0.85, 0, w * 0.85, h * 0.85, (w * 0.55) * scale * (1 + energy.mid * 0.2));
  g2.addColorStop(0, `rgba(103, 240, 255, ${Math.min(1, 0.32 * p2)})`);
  g2.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(138, 108, 255, ${Math.min(1, 0.12 * p2)})`);
  g2.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g2;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
}

function paintScanlines(ctx: FrameContext, w: number, h: number, t: number): void {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)";
  const step = 4;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y += step) {
    ctx.fillRect(0, y, w, 1.5);
  }
  const sweepY = ((t * 60) % (h + 100)) - 50;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, sweepY - 30, 0, sweepY + 30);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, sweepY - 30, w, 60);
  ctx.restore();
}

import type { Caption, CaptionStyle, Project, Word } from "@/schema";
import { mixHex, toRgba } from "@/lib/color";
import { applyEasing, hashString, mulberry32 } from "./easing";
import { fontString, type FrameContext, type FrameGradient, type ResolvedAssets } from "./context";
import { renderProceduralOverlay } from "./overlays";

function lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number {
  return a + (b - a) * t;
}

function resolveStyle(project: Project, caption?: Caption): CaptionStyle {
  if (!caption?.styleOverride) return project.defaultStyle;
  return { ...project.defaultStyle, ...caption.styleOverride };
}

function applyTransform(text: string, transform?: CaptionStyle["transform"]): string {
  if (transform === "uppercase") return text.toUpperCase();
  if (transform === "lowercase") return text.toLowerCase();
  if (transform === "capitalize") {
    return text.replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  }
  return text;
}

function wrapWords(words: string[], maxChars: number, maxLines: number): string[][] {
  const lines: string[][] = [[]];
  let count = 0;
  for (const word of words) {
    const next = count + word.length + (count > 0 ? 1 : 0);
    if (count > 0 && next > maxChars) {
      if (lines.length >= maxLines) {
        const last = lines[lines.length - 1]!;
        last[last.length - 1] = `${last[last.length - 1] ?? ""}…`;
        break;
      }
      lines.push([word]);
      count = word.length;
    } else {
      lines[lines.length - 1]!.push(word);
      count = next;
    }
  }
  return lines;
}

function captionOpacity(caption: Caption, timeSec: number): { alpha: number; tx: number; ty: number; scale: number; blur: number; waveOffset: number } {
  const inn = caption.animation?.in ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const out = caption.animation?.out ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const tIn = inn.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(inn.easing, (timeSec - caption.startSec - inn.delaySec) / inn.durationSec);
  const tOut = out.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(out.easing, (caption.endSec - timeSec - out.delaySec) / out.durationSec);
  const enter = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tIn));
  const leave = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tOut));
  const alpha = enter * leave;
  const dir = inn.direction ?? "up";
  const dist = inn.distance ?? 24;
  const slideIn = (1 - enter) * dist;
  const slideOut = (1 - leave) * dist;
  const ty = dir === "up" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "down" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  const tx = dir === "left" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "right" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  
  let scaleIn = 1;
  if (inn.preset === "scale") scaleIn = lerp(0.86, 1, enter);
  else if (inn.preset === "pop") scaleIn = enter < 1 ? lerp(0.5, 1.08, enter) : 1;
  else if (inn.preset === "bounce" || inn.preset === "spring") {
    scaleIn = enter < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(enter * Math.PI * 1.5) : 1;
  }
  
  let scaleOut = 1;
  if (out.preset === "scale" || out.preset === "pop") scaleOut = lerp(0.85, 1, leave);
  else if (out.preset === "bounce" || out.preset === "spring") scaleOut = leave < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(leave * Math.PI) : 1;

  const blur = (inn.preset === "blur" ? (1 - enter) * 10 : 0) + (out.preset === "blur" ? (1 - leave) * 10 : 0);
  const waveOffset = inn.preset === "wave" ? Math.sin((timeSec - caption.startSec) * 3) * 6 : 0;
  return { alpha, tx, ty, scale: scaleIn * scaleOut, blur, waveOffset };
}

function wordState(word: Word, timeSec: number): "past" | "active" | "future" {
  if (timeSec < word.startSec) return "future";
  if (timeSec >= word.endSec) return "past";
  return "active";
}

function paintVisualizer(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  config: import("@/schema").VisualizerConfig | undefined,
  spectrum: ArrayLike<number>,
  timeSec: number
): void {
  const cfg = config ?? {
    type: "bars",
    colorA: "#F5C15A",
    colorB: "#67F0FF",
    sensitivity: 1,
    position: "bottom",
    barCount: 48,
    opacity: 0.35,
  };

  const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, cfg.opacity ?? 0.35));
  if (alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const sens = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(3, cfg.sensitivity ?? 1));
  const count = Math.min(Math.max(8, cfg.barCount ?? 48), spectrum.length);
  const colorA = cfg.colorA ?? "#F5C15A";
  const colorB = cfg.colorB ?? "#67F0FF";
  
  const defaultYRatio = cfg.position === "middle" ? 0.5 : cfg.position === "behind-text" ? 0.72 : 0.92;
  const posY = (cfg.yPercent !== undefined ? cfg.yPercent / 100 : defaultYRatio) * height;
  const posX = (cfg.xPercent !== undefined ? cfg.xPercent / 100 : 0.5) * width;
  const vizW = (cfg.widthPercent !== undefined ? cfg.widthPercent / 100 : 0.74) * width;
  const vizH = (cfg.heightPercent !== undefined ? cfg.heightPercent / 100 : 0.22) * height;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  if (cfg.type === "wave") {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorA;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, height * 0.005);
    if ("lineCap" in ctx) ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";

    const step = vizW / Math.max(1, count - 1);
    const startX = posX - vizW / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.sin(timeSec * 4 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * vizH * 0.15;
      const y = posY - v * vizH * 0.85 + wave;
      const x = startX + i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorB;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, height * 0.003);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[count - 1 - i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.cos(timeSec * 3 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * vizH * 0.12;
      const y = posY + v * vizH * 0.55 + wave;
      const x = startX + i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (cfg.type === "circle") {
    const cx = posX;
    const cy = posY;
    const baseRadius = Math.min(vizW, vizH) * 0.5;
    const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / count;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, baseRadius * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = toRgba(colorB, 0.4);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const ang = i * angleStep;
      const len = Math.max(4, v * vizH * 0.8);
      const x1 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * baseRadius;
      const y1 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * baseRadius;
      const x2 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * (baseRadius + len);
      const y2 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * (baseRadius + len);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, width * 0.003);
      ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
      ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (cfg.type === "mirror") {
    const half = Math.floor(count / 2);
    const gap = 3;
    const bw = vizW / count;
    const cx = posX;

    for (let i = 0; i < half; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * vizH);
      const col = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillStyle = col;

      const rx = cx + i * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(rx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);

      const lx = cx - (i + 1) * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(lx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);
    }
  } else {
    const gap = Math.max(2, Math.round(width * 0.003));
    const bw = vizW / count;
    const startX = posX - vizW / 2;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * vizH);
      const x = startX + i * bw;
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillRect(x, posY - h, Math.max(1, bw - gap), h);
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function paintBackground(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number, assets: ResolvedAssets): void {
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const bg = project.media.background;
  ctx.fillStyle = bg.color ?? "#0B0D12";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

  if (bg.type === "gradient") {
    const ang = ((bg.angleDeg ?? 160) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const gx = Math.cos(ang) * width;
    const gy = Math.sin(ang) * height;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(width / 2 - gx / 2, height / 2 - gy / 2, width / 2 + gx / 2, height / 2 + gy / 2);
    g.addColorStop(0, bg.color ?? "#0B0D12");
    g.addColorStop(1, bg.colorB ?? "#1A1408");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  const img = assets.backgroundImage ?? assets.albumArt;
  if (img && (bg.type === "image" || bg.type === "album-blur")) {
    const zoomBase = bg.kenBurns ? bg.kenBurnsZoom || 1.1 : 1;
    const seed = hashString(project.id);
    const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    const driftX = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const driftY = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const duration = Math.max(1, project.meta.durationSec);
    const k = bg.kenBurns ? (timeSec / duration) : 0;
    const zoom = lerp(1, zoomBase, k);
    const iw = img.width || width;
    const ih = img.height || height;
    const scale = Math.max(width / iw, height / ih) * zoom;
    const dw = iw * scale;
    const dh = ih * scale;
    const dx = (width - dw) / 2 + driftX * width * k;
    const dy = (height - dh) / 2 + driftY * height * k;
    ctx.save();
    if (bg.type === "album-blur" && bg.blurPx > 0) {
      ctx.filter = `blur(${bg.blurPx}px)`;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);
    ctx.filter = "none";
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if (bg.dim > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = toRgba("#000000", bg.dim);
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  if (bg.visualizer && assets.spectrum && assets.spectrum.length > 0) {
    paintVisualizer(ctx, width, height, bg.visualizerConfig, assets.spectrum, timeSec);
  }
}

function paintIntro(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number): void {
  if (timeSec > 2.6) return;
  const title = project.meta.title?.trim();
  const artist = project.meta.artist?.trim();
  const hasArtist = Boolean(artist && !artist.toLowerCase().includes("unknown") && artist.length > 0);
  const hasTitle = Boolean(title && !title.toLowerCase().includes("untitled") && title.length > 0);
  if (!hasTitle && !hasArtist) return;

  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, timeSec / 0.5));
  const fadeOut = timeSec > 1.8 ? 1 - (timeSec - 1.8) / 0.8 : 1;
  const alpha = t * fadeOut;
  if (alpha <= 0) return;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#F7F4EE";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  if (hasTitle) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Fraunces", 500, true, height * 0.07);
    ctx.fillText(title, width / 2, hasArtist ? height * 0.44 : height * 0.49);
  }
  if (hasArtist) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Outfit", 500, false, height * 0.028);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#F5C15A";
    ctx.fillText(artist.toUpperCase(), width / 2, hasTitle ? height * 0.53 : height * 0.49);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintRoundedRect(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  w: number,
  h: number,
  r: number,
  fill: string | FrameGradient,
): void {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintCaption(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  caption: Caption,
  timeSec: number,
): void {
  if (timeSec < caption.startSec - 0.05 || timeSec > caption.endSec + 0.05) return;
  const style = resolveStyle(project, caption);
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const motion = captionOpacity(caption, timeSec);
  if (motion.alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const fontPx = (style.fontSizePct / 100) * height * style.scale;
  const rawWords = (caption.instrumental ? ["♪"] : caption.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)).map((w) =>
    applyTransform(w, style.transform),
  );
  const lines = wrapWords(rawWords, style.maxCharsPerLine, style.maxLines);
  ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
  const lineMetrics = lines.map((line) => {
    const text = line.join(" ");
    return { line, text, width: ctx.measureText(text).width + style.letterSpacing * fontPx * Math.max(0, text.length - 1) };
  });
  const blockW = Math.max(...lineMetrics.map((l) => l.width), 10);
  const blockH = lineMetrics.length * fontPx * style.lineHeight;
  const px = (style.xPercent / 100) * width;
  const py = (style.yPercent / 100) * height + motion.waveOffset;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = motion.alpha;
  ctx.translate(px + motion.tx, py + motion.ty);
  ctx.rotate((style.rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
  ctx.scale(motion.scale, motion.scale);

  if (style.box?.enabled) {
    paintRoundedRect(
      ctx,
      -blockW / 2 - (style.box.paddingX ?? 28),
      -blockH / 2 - (style.box.paddingY ?? 16),
      blockW + (style.box.paddingX ?? 28) * 2,
      blockH + (style.box.paddingY ?? 16) * 2,
      style.box.radius ?? 12,
      toRgba(style.box.fill ?? "#000000", style.box.opacity ?? 0.35),
    );
  }

  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.miterLimit = 2;

  let wordCursor = 0;
  const sourceWords = caption.words && caption.words.length > 0 ? caption.words : rawWords.map((text, i) => {
    const span = (caption.endSec - caption.startSec) / Math.max(1, rawWords.length);
    return { text, startSec: caption.startSec + i * span, endSec: caption.startSec + (i + 1) * span, confidence: 1 };
  });

  const highlightStyle = caption.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";
  const karaokeEnabled = highlightStyle !== "none" && caption.animation?.highlight?.enabled !== false;

  lineMetrics.forEach((lm, li) => {
    const y = -blockH / 2 + (li + 0.5) * fontPx * (style.lineHeight ?? 1.2);
    let x = -lm.width / 2;
    if (style.align === "left") x = -blockW / 2;
    if (style.align === "right") x = blockW / 2 - lm.width;
    for (const token of lm.line) {
      const word = sourceWords[Math.min(wordCursor, sourceWords.length - 1)];
      wordCursor += 1;
      const state = word ? wordState(word, timeSec) : "future";
      const localT = word ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (timeSec - word.startSec) / Math.max(0.04, word.endSec - word.startSec))) : 0;
      
      let fill = style.futureFill ?? style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA";
      if (!karaokeEnabled) {
        fill = style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA";
      } else {
        if (state === "past") fill = style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4";
        if (state === "active") {
          if (highlightStyle === "sweep") fill = mixHex(style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA", style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", localT);
          else fill = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
        }
      }
      const tw = ctx.measureText(token).width;

      if (karaokeEnabled && state === "active" && highlightStyle === "box") {
        paintRoundedRect(ctx, x - 8, y - fontPx * 0.55, tw + 16, fontPx * 1.1, 8, toRgba(style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", 0.25));
      }
      if (karaokeEnabled && state === "active" && highlightStyle === "underline") {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, fontPx * 0.06);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.lineTo(x + tw * localT, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      const bounce = state === "active" && highlightStyle === "scale" ? 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(localT * Math.PI) : 1;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x + tw / 2, y);
      ctx.scale(bounce, bounce);
      ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
      
      const glowBlur = style.glow?.blur ?? 0;
      const glowOpacity = style.glow?.opacity ?? 0;
      const shadowOpacity = style.shadow?.opacity ?? 0;

      if (glowBlur > 0 && glowOpacity > 0 && state === "active") {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.glow?.color ?? "#F5C15A", glowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = glowBlur * (highlightStyle === "glow" ? 1.5 : 1);
      } else if (shadowOpacity > 0 && style.shadow) {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.shadow.color ?? "#000000", shadowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = style.shadow.blur ?? 18;
        ctx.shadowOffsetX = style.shadow.x ?? 0;
        ctx.shadowOffsetY = style.shadow.y ?? 4;
      }
      if ((style.outlineWidth ?? 0) > 0) {
        ctx.lineWidth = (style.outlineWidth ?? 0) * 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.outlineColor ?? "#000000";
        ctx.strokeText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      }
      if (style.gradient?.enabled && state !== "active" && style.gradient.stops?.length >= 2) {
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, -fontPx / 2, tw / 2, fontPx / 2);
        for (const stop of style.gradient.stops) g.addColorStop(stop.offset, stop.color);
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
      } else if (state === "active" && highlightStyle === "shimmer") {
        const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, 0, tw / 2, 0);
        const st = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, localT));
        sg.addColorStop(Math.max(0, st - 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        sg.addColorStop(st, "#FFFFFF");
        sg.addColorStop(Math.min(1, st + 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        ctx.fillStyle = sg;
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = fill;
      }
      ctx.fillText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      ctx.restore();
      x += tw + fontPx * 0.28 + (style.wordSpacing ?? 0) + (style.letterSpacing ?? 0) * fontPx;
    }
  });

  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawFrame(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  timeSec: number,
  assets: ResolvedAssets,
): void {
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.filter = "none";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
  paintBackground(ctx, project, timeSec, assets);
  
  if (project.media?.background?.overlay && project.media.background.overlay.type !== "none") {
    renderProceduralOverlay(ctx, project.media.background.overlay, timeSec, assets);
  } else if (assets.lottieFrame) {
    ctx.drawImage(assets.lottieFrame, 0, 0, width, height);
  }

  paintIntro(ctx, project, timeSec);
  for (const caption of project.captions ?? []) {
    paintCaption(ctx, project, caption, timeSec);
  }
}

import {
  defaultAnim,
  type AnchorHit,
  type AsrResult,
  type AsrWord,
  type Caption,
  type LyricLine,
  type Word,
} from "@/schema";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { needlemanWunsch } from "./needleman-wunsch";
import { countSyllables, normalizedLevenshtein, tokenizeLine, type NormToken } from "./normalize";

export interface TimedLyricWord {
  lineIndex: number;
  tokenIndex: number;
  text: string;
  startSec: number;
  endSec: number;
  confidence: number;
  matched: boolean;
}

export interface SyncResult {
  captions: Caption[];
  flagged: number;
  meanConfidence: number;
}

function flattenLyrics(lines: LyricLine[]): { tokens: NormToken[]; owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[] } {
  const tokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.instrumental) continue;
    const parts = tokenizeLine(line.text);
    parts.forEach((t, token) => {
      tokens.push(t);
      owners.push({ line: line.index, token, text: t.raw });
    });
  }
  return { tokens, owners };
}

function flattenAsr(asr: AsrResult): { tokens: NormToken[]; words: AsrWord[] } {
  const source =
    asr.words && asr.words.length > 0
      ? asr.words
      : (asr.segments ?? []).flatMap((s) =>
          (s.words ?? s.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map((word, i, arr) => {
            const span = Math.max(0.05, (s.end - s.start) / Math.max(1, arr.length));
            return { word, start: s.start + i * span, end: s.start + (i + 1) * span, probability: 0.5 };
          })),
        );
  const tokens: NormToken[] = [];
  const words: AsrWord[] = [];
  for (const w of source) {
    const parts = tokenizeLine(w.word);
    for (const t of parts) {
      tokens.push(t);
      words.push(w);
    }
  }
  return { tokens, words };
}

function interpolate(
  start: number,
  end: number,
  weights: number[],
): { startSec: number; endSec: number }[] {
  const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || weights.length || 1;
  const span = Math.max(0.04, end - start);
  let cursor = start;
  return weights.map((w) => {
    const dur = (w / total) * span;
    const item = { startSec: cursor, endSec: cursor + dur };
    cursor += dur;
    return item;
  });
}

export function assignTimestamps(
  lyricTokens: NormToken[],
  owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[],
  asrWords: AsrWord[],
  path: { op: string; lyricIndex: number; asrIndex: number; score: number }[],
  durationSec: number,
): TimedLyricWord[] {
  const timed: Array<TimedLyricWord | null> = lyricTokens.map((t, i) => ({
    lineIndex: owners[i]?.line ?? 0,
    tokenIndex: owners[i]?.token ?? 0,
    text: owners[i]?.text ?? t.raw,
    startSec: -1,
    endSec: -1,
    confidence: 0,
    matched: false,
  }));

  for (const cell of path) {
    if (cell.op !== "match") continue;
    const asr = asrWords[cell.asrIndex];
    const slot = timed[cell.lyricIndex];
    if (!asr || !slot) continue;
    slot.startSec = asr.start;
    slot.endSec = Math.max(asr.start + 0.04, asr.end);
    slot.confidence = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, cell.score));
    slot.matched = true;
  }

  let i = 0;
  while (i < timed.length) {
    if ((timed[i]?.startSec ?? -1) >= 0) {
      i += 1;
      continue;
    }
    let j = i;
    while (j < timed.length && (timed[j]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) j += 1;
    let prev = i - 1;
    while (prev >= 0 && (timed[prev]?.startSec ?? -1) < 0) prev -= 1;
    const leftT = prev >= 0 ? timed[prev]!.endSec : 0;
    const rightT = j < timed.length ? timed[j]!.startSec : durationSec;
    const gap = timed.slice(i, j);
    const weights = gap.map((g, k) => {
      const tok = lyricTokens[i + k];
      return tok ? tok.syllables || Math.max(1, tok.norm.length / 3) : 1;
    });
    const spans = interpolate(leftT, rightT, weights);
    gap.forEach((g, k) => {
      if (!g) return;
      g.startSec = spans[k]!.startSec;
      g.endSec = spans[k]!.endSec;
      g.confidence = 0.28;
    });
    i = j;
  }

  for (let k = 1; k < timed.length; k += 1) {
    const prev = timed[k - 1]!;
    const curr = timed[k]!;
    if (curr.startSec < prev.endSec) {
      const mid = (prev.endSec + curr.startSec) / 2;
      prev.endSec = mid;
      curr.startSec = mid;
    }
    if (curr.endSec <= curr.startSec) curr.endSec = curr.startSec + 0.05;
  }
  return timed.filter((t): t is TimedLyricWord => t !== null);
}

export function assembleLines(
  lines: LyricLine[],
  words: TimedLyricWord[],
  durationSec: number,
): Caption[] {
  const byLine = new Map<number, TimedLyricWord[]>();
  for (const w of words) {
    const list = byLine.get(w.lineIndex) ?? [];
    list.push(w);
    byLine.set(w.lineIndex, list);
  }
  const captions: Caption[] = [];
  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  vocalLines.forEach((line, order) => {
    const group = (byLine.get(line.index) ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);
    const first = group[0];
    const last = group[group.length - 1];
    const start = first ? Math.max(0, first.startSec - 0.06) : 0;
    const end = last ? last.endSec + 0.12 : start + 1;
    const matched = group.filter((g) => g.matched).length;
    const conf =
      group.length === 0 ? 0.2 : 0.55 * (matched / group.length) + 0.45 * (group.reduce((s, g) => s + g.confidence, 0) / group.length);
    captions.push({
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: group.map(
        (g): Word => ({
          text: g.text,
          startSec: g.startSec,
          endSec: g.endSec,
          confidence: g.confidence,
        }),
      ),
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: { ...defaultAnim("fade"), durationSec: 0.25 },
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, conf)),
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    });
  });

  captions.sort((a, b) => a.startSec - b.startSec);
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const next = captions[i + 1];
    if (next && curr.endSec > next.startSec - 0.04) {
      curr.endSec = Math.max(curr.startSec + 0.04, next.startSec - 0.04);
    }
    curr.endSec = Math.min(curr.endSec, durationSec);
    curr.index = i;
  }

  const withGaps: Caption[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < captions.length; i += 1) {
    const curr = captions[i]!;
    const prev = withGaps[withGaps.length - 1];
    if (prev && curr.startSec - prev.endSec > 3.5) {
      withGaps.push({
        id: createId("gap"),
        index: withGaps.length,
        text: "♪",
        startSec: prev.endSec,
        endSec: curr.startSec,
        words: [],
        animation: {
          in: defaultAnim("fade"),
          out: defaultAnim("fade"),
          highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 0.4 },
        },
        confidence: 1,
        locked: false,
        instrumental: true,
      });
    }
    withGaps.push({ ...curr, index: withGaps.length });
  }
  return withGaps;
}

export function scoreLine(
  caption: Caption,
  anchors: AnchorHit[],
): number {
  if (caption.instrumental) return 1;
  const words = caption.words;
  if (words.length === 0) return 0.2;
  const density = words.filter((w) => w.confidence >= 0.45).length / words.length;
  const gaps = words.filter((w) => w.confidence < 0.3).length / words.length;
  const anchor = anchors.find((a) => a.lineIndex === caption.index);
  const anchorAgree = anchor ? anchor.peakConfidence : 0.5;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.45 * density + 0.2 * (1 - gaps) + 0.2 * anchorAgree + 0.15 * caption.confidence));
}

export function findSegmentAnchors(
  lines: LyricLine[],
  lyricTokens: NormToken[],
  owners: { line: number; token: number; text: string }[],
  asr: AsrResult,
  asrWords: AsrWord[],
): AnchorPair[] {
  const anchors: AnchorPair[] = [];
  const segments = asr.segments ?? [];
  if (segments.length === 0) return anchors;

  const vocalLines = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  let lastAsrIndex = 0;

  for (const line of vocalLines) {
    const lineOwner = owners.find((o) => o.line === line.index);
    if (!lineOwner) continue;
    const lyricIndex = owners.indexOf(lineOwner);

    // Find closest matching segment monotonically
    let bestSegIdx = -1;
    let bestSim = 0;

    const lineNorm = line.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");

    for (let si = 0; si < segments.length; si++) {
      const seg = segments[si]!;
      const segNorm = seg.text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
      if (!segNorm || !lineNorm) continue;

      let score = 0;
      if (lineNorm.includes(segNorm) || segNorm.includes(lineNorm)) {
        score = 0.85;
      } else {
        const lev = normalizedLevenshtein(lineNorm.slice(0, 24), segNorm.slice(0, 24));
        score = lev;
      }

      if (score > bestSim && score >= 0.45) {
        bestSim = score;
        bestSegIdx = si;
      }
    }

    if (bestSegIdx >= 0) {
      const seg = segments[bestSegIdx]!;
      // Find the first asr word belonging to or closest to this segment
      for (let wi = lastAsrIndex; wi < asrWords.length; wi++) {
        const w = asrWords[wi]!;
        if (w.start >= seg.start - 0.5 && w.start <= seg.end + 0.5) {
          anchors.push({ lyricIndex, asrIndex: wi });
          lastAsrIndex = wi;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return anchors;
}

interface AnchorPair {
  lyricIndex: number;
  asrIndex: number;
}

export function runSync(input: {
  lines: LyricLine[];
  asr: AsrResult;
  durationSec: number;
  anchors?: AnchorHit[];
}): SyncResult {
  const { tokens: lyricTokens, owners } = flattenLyrics(input.lines);
  const { tokens: asrTokens, words: asrWords } = flattenAsr(input.asr);

  // Combine external split-clip anchors + automatic segment anchors
  const autoSegmentAnchors = findSegmentAnchors(input.lines, lyricTokens, owners, input.asr, asrWords);

  const splitClipAnchors = (input.anchors ?? [])
    .filter((a) => a.peakConfidence >= 0.42)
    .map((a) => {
      const owner = owners.find((o) => o.line === a.lineIndex);
      if (!owner) return null;
      const lyricIndex = owners.indexOf(owner);
      let asrIndex = 0;
      let best = Infinity;
      asrWords.forEach((w, i) => {
        const d = Math.abs(w.start - a.offsetSec);
        if (d < best) {
          best = d;
          asrIndex = i;
        }
      });
      return { lyricIndex, asrIndex };
    })
    .filter((x): x is { lyricIndex: number; asrIndex: number } => x !== null);

  const combinedAnchors = [...splitClipAnchors, ...autoSegmentAnchors].sort(
    (a, b) => a.lyricIndex - b.lyricIndex,
  );

  // Filter monotonic anchors
  const validAnchors: AnchorPair[] = [];
  let lastL = -1;
  let lastA = -1;
  for (const a of combinedAnchors) {
    if (a.lyricIndex > lastL && a.asrIndex >= lastA) {
      validAnchors.push(a);
      lastL = a.lyricIndex;
      lastA = a.asrIndex;
    }
  }

  const aligned = needlemanWunsch(lyricTokens, asrTokens, validAnchors);
  const timed = assignTimestamps(lyricTokens, owners, asrWords, aligned.path, input.durationSec);
  const captions = assembleLines(input.lines, timed, input.durationSec).map((c) => ({
    ...c,
    confidence: scoreLine(c, input.anchors ?? []),
  }));
  const flagged = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6).length;
  const vocal = captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental);
  const meanConfidence = vocal.length ? vocal.reduce((s, c) => s + c.confidence, 0) / vocal.length : 0;
  return { captions, flagged, meanConfidence };
}

export function heuristicSync(lines: LyricLine[], durationSec: number): SyncResult {
  const vocal = lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental);
  const weights = vocal.map((l) => Math.max(1, countSyllables(l.text.replace(/\s+/g, "")) || l.text.length / 4));
  const lead = Math.min(2.4, durationSec * 0.06);
  const tail = Math.min(2.8, durationSec * 0.08);
  const usable = Math.max(1, durationSec - lead - tail);
  const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0) || 1;
  let cursor = lead;
  const captions: Caption[] = vocal.map((line, order) => {
    const span = (weights[order]! / total) * usable;
    const start = cursor;
    const end = cursor + span * 0.82;
    cursor += span;
    const words = tokenizeLine(line.text);
    const wspan = Math.max(0.05, (end - start) / Math.max(1, words.length));
    return {
      id: createId("cap"),
      index: order,
      text: line.text,
      startSec: start,
      endSec: end,
      words: words.map((t, i) => ({
        text: t.raw,
        startSec: start + i * wspan,
        endSec: start + (i + 1) * wspan,
        confidence: 0.4,
      })),
      animation: {
        in: defaultAnim("fade"),
        out: defaultAnim("fade"),
        highlight: { style: "color", intensity: 1 },
      },
      confidence: 0.4,
      instrumental: false,
      locked: false,
      section: line.section,
    };
  });
  return { captions, flagged: captions.length, meanConfidence: 0.4 };
}

export { countSyllables };

"use client";

const HISTORY_LIMIT = 100;

interface HistoryState {
  past: Project[];
  future: Project[];
}

interface StudioState {
  project: Project;
  selectedIds: string[];
  playhead: number;
  playing: boolean;
  loop: boolean;
  volume: number;
  zoom: number;
