"use client";

import { useMemo, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { RotateCcw, Upload, Sparkles, Film, Check, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { STYLE_PRESETS } from "@/render-engine";
import { useStudio } from "@/store/studio-store";
import type { OverlayType, OverlaySpec } from "@/schema";
import { ColorField, Field, Slider } from "../ui-kit";

const TABS = ["Text", "Color", "Animation", "Overlays", "Position", "Background"] as const;

const OVERLAY_OPTIONS: { type: OverlayType; label: string; desc: string }[] = [
  { type: "none", label: "None", desc: "No motion graphic overlay" },
  { type: "bokeh", label: "Golden Bokeh", desc: "Warm floating light orbs with soft pulse" },
  { type: "starfield", label: "Neon Starfield", desc: "Hyperdrive depth stars with cyan/magenta hues" },
  { type: "soundwave", label: "Soundwave Aura", desc: "Reactive glowing frequency ripples" },
  { type: "embers", label: "Floating Embers", desc: "Drifting sparks with turbulent wind" },
  { type: "light-leak", label: "Prismatic Light Leak", desc: "Cinematic color flares across the screen" },
  { type: "scanlines", label: "Retro Scanlines", desc: "Vintage CRT phosphor sweep & grain" },
  { type: "lottie", label: "Custom Lottie Upload", desc: "Vector animation JSON from After Effects / LottieFiles" },
];

export function Inspector() {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<(typeof TABS)[number]>("Text");
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const selected = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.id === studio.selectedIds[0]);
  const style = selected?.styleOverride ? { ...studio.project.defaultStyle, ...selected.styleOverride } : studio.project.defaultStyle;
  const overridden = Boolean(selected?.styleOverride);

  const recent = useMemo(
    () => [
      style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA",
      style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A",
      style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4",
      style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA",
      "#F5C15A",
      "#67F0FF",
      "#FFFFFF",
    ],
    [style.fill, style.highlightFill, style.pastFill, style.futureFill],
  );

  const patch = (p: Partial<typeof style>) => studio.updateStyle(p, selected ? "selected" : "default");

  const overlay: OverlaySpec = studio.project.media?.background?.overlay ?? {
    type: "none",
    opacity: 0.85,
    speed: 1,
    scale: 1,
    blendMode: "screen",
  };

  const patchOverlay = (p: Partial<OverlaySpec>) => {
    studio.commit((d) => {
      if (!d.media.background.overlay) {
        d.media.background.overlay = {
          type: "none",
          opacity: 0.85,
          speed: 1,
          scale: 1,
          blendMode: "screen",
        };
      }
      d.media.background.overlay = { ...d.media.background.overlay, ...p };
    });
  };

  const handleLottieFile = (file: File) => {
    setUploadError(null);
    if (!file.name.endsWith(".json")) {
      setUploadError("Please upload a .json Lottie animation file.");
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const text = e.target?.result as string;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
        if (typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null) {
          throw new Error("Invalid JSON");
        }
        patchOverlay({
          type: "lottie",
          lottieJson: text,
          lottieName: file.name,
        });
      } catch {
        setUploadError("Invalid Lottie JSON file. Please check file format.");
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  const applyAnimationToAll = (inPreset: string, highlightStyle: string) => {
    studio.commit((d) => {
      for (const c of d.captions) {
        c.animation.in.preset = inPreset as typeof c.animation.in.preset;
        c.animation.highlight.style = highlightStyle as typeof c.animation.highlight.style;
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[var(--bg-panel)]">
      <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-2">
        {TABS.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab(t)}
            className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === t ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] font-medium" : "text-[var(--muted)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)]"
            }`}
          >
            {t}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="lf-scroll flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-auto p-3">
        {selected ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--ink)]">
            <span className="truncate">
              Line #{selected.index + 1}: <em className="text-[var(--accent)]">"{selected.text.slice(0, 24)}..."</em>
            </span>
            {overridden && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-amber-400/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-400/30"
                onClick={() =>
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    const cap = d.captions.find((c) => c.id === selected.id);
                    if (cap) cap.styleOverride = undefined;
                  })
                }
              >
                <RotateCcw size={10} /> Reset
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-[#12161f] p-2.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--muted)]">
            <span className="font-semibold text-[var(--ink)]">Default Project Style</span>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">Changes apply across all lyric lines.</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {tab === "Text" && (
          <>
            {selected && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[#0c1017] p-3 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent)]">
                    Edit Line #{selected.index + 1}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => studio.select([])}
                    className="text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                  >
                    Deselect (Edit All)
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Lyric Text</label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={2}
                    value={selected.text}
                    onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionText(selected.id, e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] p-2 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
                    placeholder="Enter lyric line text..."
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">Start (sec)</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step="0.05"
                      min="0"
                      value={Number(selected.startSec.toFixed(2))}
                      onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(selected.id, Number(e.target.value), selected.endSec)}
                      className="h-8 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-[var(--ink)]"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--faint)] mb-1">End (sec)</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step="0.05"
                      min="0.05"
                      value={Number(selected.endSec.toFixed(2))}
                      onChange={(e) => studio.updateCaptionTiming(selected.id, selected.startSec, Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="h-8 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] px-2 text-xs text-[var(--ink)]"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-1.5 pt-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => studio.splitAtPlayhead()}
                    className="flex-1 rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] py-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                  >
                    Split at Playhead
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => studio.duplicateSelected()}
                    className="flex-1 rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] py-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                  >
                    Duplicate
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => studio.deleteSelected()}
                    className="rounded-md border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-red-300 hover:bg-red-500/20"
                  >
                    Delete
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <Field label="Font">
              <select
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)]"
                value={style.fontFamily}
                onChange={(e) => patch({ fontFamily: e.target.value })}
              >
                {["Outfit", "Fraunces", "Orbitron", "Cinzel", "Inter", "Arial", "Georgia", "Impact", "Times New Roman"].map((f) => (
                  <option key={f}>{f}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Slider label="Weight" min={100} max={900} step={100} value={style.fontWeight} onChange={(v) => patch({ fontWeight: v })} />
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)] cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={style.italic ?? false} onChange={(e) => patch({ italic: e.target.checked })} /> Italic
            </label>
            <Slider label="Size % of frame" min={2} max={12} step={0.1} value={style.fontSizePct} onChange={(v) => patch({ fontSizePct: v })} />
            <Slider label="Letter spacing" min={-0.05} max={0.3} step={0.01} value={style.letterSpacing} onChange={(v) => patch({ letterSpacing: v })} />
            <Slider label="Line height" min={0.9} max={2} step={0.05} value={style.lineHeight} onChange={(v) => patch({ lineHeight: v })} />
            <Field label="Align">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
                {(["left", "center", "right"] as const).map((a) => (
                  <button
                    key={a}
                    type="button"
                    className={`rounded-md py-1 text-xs capitalize ${
                      style.align === a ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] font-medium" : "bg-[#0d1118] text-[var(--muted)]"
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => patch({ align: a })}
                  >
                    {a}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Transform">
              <select
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)]"
                value={style.transform ?? "none"}
                onChange={(e) => patch({ transform: e.target.value as typeof style.transform })}
              >
                <option value="none">None</option>
                <option value="uppercase">Uppercase</option>
                <option value="lowercase">Lowercase</option>
                <option value="capitalize">Capitalize</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Slider label="Max chars / line" min={12} max={60} value={style.maxCharsPerLine} onChange={(v) => patch({ maxCharsPerLine: v })} />
            <Slider label="Max lines" min={1} max={4} value={style.maxLines} onChange={(v) => patch({ maxLines: v })} />
          </>
        )}

        {tab === "Color" && (
          <>
            <ColorField label="Fill" value={style.fill ?? "#F4F1EA"} onChange={(v) => patch({ fill: v })} recent={recent} />
            <ColorField label="Highlight" value={style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A"} onChange={(v) => patch({ highlightFill: v })} recent={recent} />
            <ColorField label="Past" value={style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4"} onChange={(v) => patch({ pastFill: v })} recent={recent} />
            <ColorField label="Future" value={style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA"} onChange={(v) => patch({ futureFill: v })} recent={recent} />
            <ColorField label="Outline" value={style.outlineColor ?? "#000000"} onChange={(v) => patch({ outlineColor: v })} recent={recent} />
            <Slider label="Outline width" min={0} max={12} value={style.outlineWidth ?? 0} onChange={(v) => patch({ outlineWidth: v })} />
            <ColorField
              label="Shadow"
              value={style.shadow?.color ?? "#000000"}
              onChange={(v) => patch({ shadow: { ...(style.shadow ?? { color: "#000000", blur: 18, x: 0, y: 4, opacity: 0.5 }), color: v } })}
              recent={recent}
            />
            <Slider
              label="Shadow blur"
              min={0}
              max={40}
              value={style.shadow?.blur ?? 18}
              onChange={(v) => patch({ shadow: { ...(style.shadow ?? { color: "#000000", blur: 18, x: 0, y: 4, opacity: 0.5 }), blur: v } })}
            />
            <Slider
              label="Glow"
              min={0}
              max={40}
              value={style.glow?.blur ?? 0}
              onChange={(v) => patch({ glow: { ...(style.glow ?? { color: "#F5C15A", blur: 0, opacity: 0.8 }), blur: v, opacity: v > 0 ? 0.85 : 0 } })}
            />
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)] cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={style.box?.enabled ?? false}
                onChange={(e) => patch({ box: { ...(style.box ?? { enabled: false, fill: "#000000", opacity: 0.35, paddingX: 28, paddingY: 16, radius: 12 }), enabled: e.target.checked } })}
              />{" "}
              Background box
            </label>
            {style.box?.enabled && (
              <>
                <ColorField
                  label="Box fill"
                  value={style.box?.fill ?? "#000000"}
                  onChange={(v) => patch({ box: { ...(style.box ?? { enabled: true, fill: "#000000", opacity: 0.35, paddingX: 28, paddingY: 16, radius: 12 }), fill: v } })}
                  recent={recent}
                />
                <Slider
                  label="Box opacity"
                  min={0}
                  max={1}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={style.box?.opacity ?? 0.35}
                  onChange={(v) => patch({ box: { ...(style.box ?? { enabled: true, fill: "#000000", opacity: 0.35, paddingX: 28, paddingY: 16, radius: 12 }), opacity: v } })}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {tab === "Animation" && (
          <>
            <Field label="In Preset">
              <select
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)]"
                value={selected ? selected.animation?.in?.preset ?? "fade" : studio.project.captions[0]?.animation?.in?.preset ?? "fade"}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = e.target.value as any;
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    if (selected) {
                      const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                      if (c) c.animation.in.preset = val;
                    } else {
                      for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.in.preset = val;
                    }
                  });
                }}
              >
                {["none", "fade", "slide", "scale", "pop", "bounce", "blur", "wave", "typewriter", "cascade", "wipe", "spring"].map((p) => (
                  <option key={p} value={p}>
                    {p.toUpperCase()}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>

            <Field label="Out Preset">
              <select
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)]"
                value={selected ? selected.animation?.out?.preset ?? "fade" : studio.project.captions[0]?.animation?.out?.preset ?? "fade"}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = e.target.value as any;
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    if (selected) {
                      const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                      if (c) c.animation.out.preset = val;
                    } else {
                      for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.out.preset = val;
                    }
                  });
                }}
              >
                {["none", "fade", "slide", "scale", "pop", "bounce", "blur", "wipe", "spring"].map((p) => (
                  <option key={p} value={p}>
                    {p.toUpperCase()}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>

            <Field label="Motion Direction">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1">
                {(["up", "down", "left", "right"] as const).map((dir) => {
                  const currentDir = selected ? selected.animation?.in?.direction ?? "up" : studio.project.captions[0]?.animation?.in?.direction ?? "up";
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={dir}
                      type="button"
                      className={`rounded-md py-1 text-xs capitalize ${
                        currentDir === dir ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] font-medium" : "bg-[#0d1118] text-[var(--muted)]"
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => {
                        studio.commit((d) => {
                          if (selected) {
                            const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                            if (c) c.animation.in.direction = dir;
                          } else {
                            for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.in.direction = dir;
                          }
                        });
                      }}
                    >
                      {dir}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </Field>

            <Field label="Animation Easing">
              <select
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)]"
                value={selected?.animation?.in?.easing?.name ?? "ease-out-cubic"}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = e.target.value as any;
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    if (selected) {
                      const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                      if (c) c.animation.in.easing = { type: "named", name: val };
                    } else {
                      for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.in.easing = { type: "named", name: val };
                    }
                  });
                }}
              >
                {["ease-out-cubic", "ease-in-out-cubic", "ease-out-back", "ease-out-expo", "ease-in", "ease-out", "ease-in-out", "linear"].map((es) => (
                  <option key={es} value={es}>
                    {es}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>

            <Field label="Karaoke Highlight Style">
              <select
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)]"
                value={selected ? selected.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color" : studio.project.captions[0]?.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color"}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = e.target.value as any;
                  studio.commit((d) => {
                    if (selected) {
                      const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                      if (c) c.animation.highlight.style = val;
                    } else {
                      for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.highlight.style = val;
                    }
                  });
                }}
              >
                {["color", "sweep", "box", "scale", "underline", "glow", "shimmer"].map((p) => (
                  <option key={p} value={p}>
                    {p.toUpperCase()}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>

            <Slider
              label="In duration (s)"
              min={0}
              max={1.5}
              step={0.05}
              value={selected ? selected.animation?.in?.durationSec ?? 0.25 : 0.25}
              onChange={(v) => {
                studio.commit((d) => {
                  if (selected) {
                    const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                    if (c) c.animation.in.durationSec = v;
                  } else {
                    for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.in.durationSec = v;
                  }
                });
              }}
            />

            <Slider
              label="Out duration (s)"
              min={0}
              max={1.5}
              step={0.05}
              value={selected ? selected.animation?.out?.durationSec ?? 0.25 : 0.25}
              onChange={(v) => {
                studio.commit((d) => {
                  if (selected) {
                    const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                    if (c) c.animation.out.durationSec = v;
                  } else {
                    for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.out.durationSec = v;
                  }
                });
              }}
            />

            <Slider
              label="Slide Distance"
              min={0}
              max={80}
              step={2}
              value={selected ? selected.animation?.in?.distance ?? 24 : 24}
              onChange={(v) => {
                studio.commit((d) => {
                  if (selected) {
                    const c = d.captions.find((x) => x.id === selected.id);
                    if (c) c.animation.in.distance = v;
                  } else {
                    for (const c of d.captions) c.animation.in.distance = v;
                  }
                });
              }}
            />

            <button
              type="button"
              className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--accent)]/40 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20"
              onClick={() => {
                const inPreset = selected?.animation?.in?.preset ?? "fade";
                const highlight = selected?.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";
                applyAnimationToAll(inPreset, highlight);
              }}
            >
              Apply Current Animation to All Lines
            </button>
          </>
        )}

        {tab === "Overlays" && (
          <>
            <Field label="Motion Graphics & Overlay Library">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                {OVERLAY_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                  const isActive = overlay.type === opt.type;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={opt.type}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => patchOverlay({ type: opt.type })}
                      className={`w-full rounded-xl border p-2.5 text-left transition-all ${
                        isActive
                          ? "border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,193,90,0.15)]"
                          : "border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] hover:border-white/20"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${isActive ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--ink)]"}`}>
                          {opt.label}
                        </span>
                        {isActive && <Check size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" />}
                      </div>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">{opt.desc}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </Field>

            {overlay.type === "lottie" && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0d1118] p-3 space-y-2.5">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--ink)] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Film size={14} className="text-[var(--accent)]" /> Upload Custom Lottie (.json)
                </p>
                <input
                  type="file"
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  accept=".json,application/json"
                  className="hidden"
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                    if (file) handleLottieFile(file);
                  }}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-[var(--accent)]/40 bg-[var(--accent)]/5 py-3 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/15"
                >
                  <Upload size={14} /> Choose Lottie JSON File
                </button>
                {overlay.lottieName && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded bg-[#161c27] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--ink)]">
                    <span className="truncate">{overlay.lottieName}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      title="Remove Lottie"
                      className="text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-red-400"
                      onClick={() => patchOverlay({ lottieJson: undefined, lottieName: undefined, type: "none" })}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                {uploadError && <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--danger)]">{uploadError}</p>}
              </div>
            )}

            {overlay.type !== "none" && (
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                <Slider
                  label="Overlay Opacity"
                  min={0}
                  max={1}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={overlay.opacity ?? 0.85}
                  onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ opacity: v })}
                />
                <Slider
                  label="Animation Speed"
                  min={0.2}
                  max={3}
                  step={0.1}
                  value={overlay.speed ?? 1}
                  onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ speed: v })}
                />
                <Slider
                  label="Scale"
                  min={0.5}
                  max={2.5}
                  step={0.1}
                  value={overlay.scale ?? 1}
                  onChange={(v) => patchOverlay({ scale: v })}
                />
                <Field label="Blend Mode">
                  <select
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-sm text-[var(--ink)]"
                    value={overlay.blendMode ?? "screen"}
                    onChange={(e) => patchOverlay({ blendMode: e.target.value as any })}
                  >
                    <option value="screen">Screen (Luminescent)</option>

import type { Caption, CaptionStyle, Project, Word } from "@/schema";
import { mixHex, toRgba } from "@/lib/color";
import { applyEasing, hashString, mulberry32 } from "./easing";
import { fontString, type FrameContext, type FrameGradient, type ResolvedAssets } from "./context";
import { renderProceduralOverlay } from "./overlays";

function lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number {
  return a + (b - a) * t;
}

function resolveStyle(project: Project, caption?: Caption): CaptionStyle {
  if (!caption?.styleOverride) return project.defaultStyle;
  return { ...project.defaultStyle, ...caption.styleOverride };
}

function applyTransform(text: string, transform?: CaptionStyle["transform"]): string {
  if (transform === "uppercase") return text.toUpperCase();
  if (transform === "lowercase") return text.toLowerCase();
  if (transform === "capitalize") {
    return text.replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  }
  return text;
}

function wrapWords(words: string[], maxChars: number, maxLines: number): string[][] {
  const lines: string[][] = [[]];
  let count = 0;
  for (const word of words) {
    const next = count + word.length + (count > 0 ? 1 : 0);
    if (count > 0 && next > maxChars) {
      if (lines.length >= maxLines) {
        const last = lines[lines.length - 1]!;
        last[last.length - 1] = `${last[last.length - 1] ?? ""}…`;
        break;
      }
      lines.push([word]);
      count = word.length;
    } else {
      lines[lines.length - 1]!.push(word);
      count = next;
    }
  }
  return lines;
}

function captionOpacity(caption: Caption, timeSec: number): { alpha: number; tx: number; ty: number; scale: number; blur: number; waveOffset: number } {
  const inn = caption.animation?.in ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const out = caption.animation?.out ?? { preset: "fade", durationSec: 0.25, delaySec: 0, easing: { type: "named", name: "ease-out-cubic" } };
  const tIn = inn.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(inn.easing, (timeSec - caption.startSec - inn.delaySec) / inn.durationSec);
  const tOut = out.durationSec <= 0 ? 1 : applyEasing(out.easing, (caption.endSec - timeSec - out.delaySec) / out.durationSec);
  const enter = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tIn));
  const leave = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tOut));
  const alpha = enter * leave;
  const dir = inn.direction ?? "up";
  const dist = inn.distance ?? 24;
  const slideIn = (1 - enter) * dist;
  const slideOut = (1 - leave) * dist;
  const ty = dir === "up" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "down" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  const tx = dir === "left" ? slideIn - slideOut : dir === "right" ? -slideIn + slideOut : 0;
  
  let scaleIn = 1;
  if (inn.preset === "scale") scaleIn = lerp(0.86, 1, enter);
  else if (inn.preset === "pop") scaleIn = enter < 1 ? lerp(0.5, 1.08, enter) : 1;
  else if (inn.preset === "bounce" || inn.preset === "spring") {
    scaleIn = enter < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(enter * Math.PI * 1.5) : 1;
  }
  
  let scaleOut = 1;
  if (out.preset === "scale" || out.preset === "pop") scaleOut = lerp(0.85, 1, leave);
  else if (out.preset === "bounce" || out.preset === "spring") scaleOut = leave < 1 ? 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(leave * Math.PI) : 1;

  const blur = (inn.preset === "blur" ? (1 - enter) * 10 : 0) + (out.preset === "blur" ? (1 - leave) * 10 : 0);
  const waveOffset = inn.preset === "wave" ? Math.sin((timeSec - caption.startSec) * 3) * 6 : 0;
  return { alpha, tx, ty, scale: scaleIn * scaleOut, blur, waveOffset };
}

function wordState(word: Word, timeSec: number): "past" | "active" | "future" {
  if (timeSec < word.startSec) return "future";
  if (timeSec >= word.endSec) return "past";
  return "active";
}

function paintVisualizer(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  config: import("@/schema").VisualizerConfig | undefined,
  spectrum: ArrayLike<number>,
  timeSec: number
): void {
  const cfg = config ?? {
    type: "bars",
    colorA: "#F5C15A",
    colorB: "#67F0FF",
    sensitivity: 1,
    position: "bottom",
    barCount: 48,
    opacity: 0.35,
  };

  const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, cfg.opacity ?? 0.35));
  if (alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const sens = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(3, cfg.sensitivity ?? 1));
  const count = Math.min(Math.max(8, cfg.barCount ?? 48), spectrum.length);
  const colorA = cfg.colorA ?? "#F5C15A";
  const colorB = cfg.colorB ?? "#67F0FF";
  const posY = cfg.position === "middle" ? height * 0.5 : cfg.position === "behind-text" ? height * 0.72 : height * 0.92;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  if (cfg.type === "wave") {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorA;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, height * 0.005);
    if ("lineCap" in ctx) ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";

    const step = width / Math.max(1, count - 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.sin(timeSec * 4 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * height * 0.02;
      const y = posY - v * height * 0.18 + wave;
      const x = i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = colorB;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, height * 0.003);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[count - 1 - i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const wave = Math.cos(timeSec * 3 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 4) * height * 0.015;
      const y = posY + v * height * 0.12 + wave;
      const x = i * step;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (cfg.type === "circle") {
    const cx = width / 2;
    const cy = cfg.position === "bottom" ? height * 0.8 : posY;
    const baseRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.22;
    const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / count;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, baseRadius * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = toRgba(colorB, 0.4);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const ang = i * angleStep;
      const len = Math.max(4, v * height * 0.18);
      const x1 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * baseRadius;
      const y1 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * baseRadius;
      const x2 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * (baseRadius + len);
      const y2 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * (baseRadius + len);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, width * 0.003);
      ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
      ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (cfg.type === "mirror") {
    const half = Math.floor(count / 2);
    const gap = 3;
    const bw = (width * 0.8) / count;
    const cx = width / 2;

    for (let i = 0; i < half; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * height * 0.24);
      const col = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillStyle = col;

      const rx = cx + i * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(rx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);

      const lx = cx - (i + 1) * bw + gap / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(lx, posY - h, bw - gap, h);
    }
  } else {
    const gap = Math.max(2, Math.round(width * 0.003));
    const bw = (width * 0.74) / count;
    const startX = width * 0.13;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const v = (spectrum[i] ?? 0) * sens;
      const h = Math.max(4, v * height * 0.22);
      const x = startX + i * bw;
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? colorA : colorB;
      ctx.fillRect(x, posY - h, Math.max(1, bw - gap), h);
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function paintBackground(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number, assets: ResolvedAssets): void {
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const bg = project.media.background;
  ctx.fillStyle = bg.color ?? "#0B0D12";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

  if (bg.type === "gradient") {
    const ang = ((bg.angleDeg ?? 160) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const gx = Math.cos(ang) * width;
    const gy = Math.sin(ang) * height;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(width / 2 - gx / 2, height / 2 - gy / 2, width / 2 + gx / 2, height / 2 + gy / 2);
    g.addColorStop(0, bg.color ?? "#0B0D12");
    g.addColorStop(1, bg.colorB ?? "#1A1408");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  const img = assets.backgroundImage ?? assets.albumArt;
  if (img && (bg.type === "image" || bg.type === "album-blur")) {
    const zoomBase = bg.kenBurns ? bg.kenBurnsZoom || 1.1 : 1;
    const seed = hashString(project.id);
    const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
    const driftX = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const driftY = rnd() * 0.08 - 0.04;
    const duration = Math.max(1, project.meta.durationSec);
    const k = bg.kenBurns ? (timeSec / duration) : 0;
    const zoom = lerp(1, zoomBase, k);
    const iw = img.width || width;
    const ih = img.height || height;
    const scale = Math.max(width / iw, height / ih) * zoom;
    const dw = iw * scale;
    const dh = ih * scale;
    const dx = (width - dw) / 2 + driftX * width * k;
    const dy = (height - dh) / 2 + driftY * height * k;
    ctx.save();
    if (bg.type === "album-blur" && bg.blurPx > 0) {
      ctx.filter = `blur(${bg.blurPx}px)`;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);
    ctx.filter = "none";
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if (bg.dim > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = toRgba("#000000", bg.dim);
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  if (bg.visualizer && assets.spectrum && assets.spectrum.length > 0) {
    paintVisualizer(ctx, width, height, bg.visualizerConfig, assets.spectrum, timeSec);
  }
}

function paintIntro(ctx: FrameContext, project: Project, timeSec: number): void {
  if (timeSec > 2.6) return;
  const title = project.meta.title?.trim();
  const artist = project.meta.artist?.trim();
  const hasArtist = Boolean(artist && !artist.toLowerCase().includes("unknown") && artist.length > 0);
  const hasTitle = Boolean(title && !title.toLowerCase().includes("untitled") && title.length > 0);
  if (!hasTitle && !hasArtist) return;

  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, timeSec / 0.5));
  const fadeOut = timeSec > 1.8 ? 1 - (timeSec - 1.8) / 0.8 : 1;
  const alpha = t * fadeOut;
  if (alpha <= 0) return;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#F7F4EE";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  if (hasTitle) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Fraunces", 500, true, height * 0.07);
    ctx.fillText(title, width / 2, hasArtist ? height * 0.44 : height * 0.49);
  }
  if (hasArtist) {
    ctx.font = fontString("Outfit", 500, false, height * 0.028);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#F5C15A";
    ctx.fillText(artist.toUpperCase(), width / 2, hasTitle ? height * 0.53 : height * 0.49);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintRoundedRect(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  w: number,
  h: number,
  r: number,
  fill: string | FrameGradient,
): void {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function paintCaption(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  caption: Caption,
  timeSec: number,
): void {
  if (timeSec < caption.startSec - 0.05 || timeSec > caption.endSec + 0.05) return;
  const style = resolveStyle(project, caption);
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  const motion = captionOpacity(caption, timeSec);
  if (motion.alpha <= 0.01) return;

  const fontPx = (style.fontSizePct / 100) * height * style.scale;
  const rawWords = (caption.instrumental ? ["♪"] : caption.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)).map((w) =>
    applyTransform(w, style.transform),
  );
  const lines = wrapWords(rawWords, style.maxCharsPerLine, style.maxLines);
  ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
  const lineMetrics = lines.map((line) => {
    const text = line.join(" ");
    return { line, text, width: ctx.measureText(text).width + style.letterSpacing * fontPx * Math.max(0, text.length - 1) };
  });
  const blockW = Math.max(...lineMetrics.map((l) => l.width), 10);
  const blockH = lineMetrics.length * fontPx * style.lineHeight;
  const px = (style.xPercent / 100) * width;
  const py = (style.yPercent / 100) * height + motion.waveOffset;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = motion.alpha;
  ctx.translate(px + motion.tx, py + motion.ty);
  ctx.rotate((style.rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
  ctx.scale(motion.scale, motion.scale);

  if (style.box?.enabled) {
    paintRoundedRect(
      ctx,
      -blockW / 2 - (style.box.paddingX ?? 28),
      -blockH / 2 - (style.box.paddingY ?? 16),
      blockW + (style.box.paddingX ?? 28) * 2,
      blockH + (style.box.paddingY ?? 16) * 2,
      style.box.radius ?? 12,
      toRgba(style.box.fill ?? "#000000", style.box.opacity ?? 0.35),
    );
  }

  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.miterLimit = 2;

  let wordCursor = 0;
  const sourceWords = caption.words && caption.words.length > 0 ? caption.words : rawWords.map((text, i) => {
    const span = (caption.endSec - caption.startSec) / Math.max(1, rawWords.length);
    return { text, startSec: caption.startSec + i * span, endSec: caption.startSec + (i + 1) * span, confidence: 1 };
  });

  const highlightStyle = caption.animation?.highlight?.style ?? "color";

  lineMetrics.forEach((lm, li) => {
    const y = -blockH / 2 + (li + 0.5) * fontPx * (style.lineHeight ?? 1.2);
    let x = -lm.width / 2;
    if (style.align === "left") x = -blockW / 2;
    if (style.align === "right") x = blockW / 2 - lm.width;
    for (const token of lm.line) {
      const word = sourceWords[Math.min(wordCursor, sourceWords.length - 1)];
      wordCursor += 1;
      const state = word ? wordState(word, timeSec) : "future";
      const localT = word ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (timeSec - word.startSec) / Math.max(0.04, word.endSec - word.startSec))) : 0;
      let fill = style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA";
      if (state === "past") fill = style.pastFill ?? "#C8C2B4";
      if (state === "active") {
        if (highlightStyle === "sweep") fill = mixHex(style.futureFill ?? "#F4F1EA", style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", localT);
        else fill = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
      }
      const tw = ctx.measureText(token).width;

      if (state === "active" && highlightStyle === "box") {
        paintRoundedRect(ctx, x - 8, y - fontPx * 0.55, tw + 16, fontPx * 1.1, 8, toRgba(style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A", 0.25));
      }
      if (state === "active" && highlightStyle === "underline") {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A";
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, fontPx * 0.06);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.lineTo(x + tw * localT, y + fontPx * 0.48);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      const bounce = state === "active" && highlightStyle === "scale" ? 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(localT * Math.PI) : 1;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x + tw / 2, y);
      ctx.scale(bounce, bounce);
      ctx.font = fontString(style.fontFamily, style.fontWeight, style.italic, fontPx);
      
      const glowBlur = style.glow?.blur ?? 0;
      const glowOpacity = style.glow?.opacity ?? 0;
      const shadowOpacity = style.shadow?.opacity ?? 0;

      if (glowBlur > 0 && glowOpacity > 0 && state === "active") {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.glow.color ?? "#F5C15A", glowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = glowBlur * (highlightStyle === "glow" ? 1.5 : 1);
      } else if (shadowOpacity > 0 && style.shadow) {
        ctx.shadowColor = toRgba(style.shadow.color ?? "#000000", shadowOpacity);
        ctx.shadowBlur = style.shadow.blur ?? 18;
        ctx.shadowOffsetX = style.shadow.x ?? 0;
        ctx.shadowOffsetY = style.shadow.y ?? 4;
      }
      if ((style.outlineWidth ?? 0) > 0) {
        ctx.lineWidth = (style.outlineWidth ?? 0) * 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = style.outlineColor ?? "#000000";
        ctx.strokeText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      }
      if (style.gradient?.enabled && state !== "active" && style.gradient.stops?.length >= 2) {
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, -fontPx / 2, tw / 2, fontPx / 2);
        for (const stop of style.gradient.stops) g.addColorStop(stop.offset, stop.color);
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
      } else if (state === "active" && highlightStyle === "shimmer") {
        const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tw / 2, 0, tw / 2, 0);
        const st = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, localT));
        sg.addColorStop(Math.max(0, st - 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        sg.addColorStop(st, "#FFFFFF");
        sg.addColorStop(Math.min(1, st + 0.2), style.highlightFill ?? "#F5C15A");
        ctx.fillStyle = sg;
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = fill;
      }
      ctx.fillText(token, -tw / 2, 0);
      ctx.restore();
      x += tw + fontPx * 0.28 + (style.wordSpacing ?? 0) + (style.letterSpacing ?? 0) * fontPx;
    }
  });

  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawFrame(
  ctx: FrameContext,
  project: Project,
  timeSec: number,
  assets: ResolvedAssets,
): void {
  const { width, height } = ctx.canvas;
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.filter = "none";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
  paintBackground(ctx, project, timeSec, assets);
  
  if (project.media?.background?.overlay && project.media.background.overlay.type !== "none") {
    renderProceduralOverlay(ctx, project.media.background.overlay, timeSec, assets);
  } else if (assets.lottieFrame) {
    ctx.drawImage(assets.lottieFrame, 0, 0, width, height);
  }

  paintIntro(ctx, project, timeSec);
  for (const caption of project.captions ?? []) {
    paintCaption(ctx, project, caption, timeSec);
  }
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Pause, Play, Repeat, Volume2, Maximize2 } from "lucide-react";
import { drawFrame, asFrameContext, type ResolvedAssets } from "@/render-engine";
import { LottiePlayer } from "@/lib/lottie-renderer";
import { formatTimecode } from "@/lib/time";
import { useStudio } from "@/store/studio-store";
import { Tooltip } from "../ui-kit";

export function PreviewCanvas({
  audioUrl,
  albumUrl,
}: {
  audioUrl: string | null;
  albumUrl: string;
}) {
  const studio = useStudio();
  const studioRef = useRef(studio);
  studioRef.current = studio;

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement>(null);
  const artRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const ctxClock = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const lottiePlayerRef = useRef<LottiePlayer | null>(null);

  const startedAt = useRef(0);
  const offset = useRef(0);
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const [fps, setFps] = useState(60);
  const [dropped, setDropped] = useState(0);
  const lastTs = useRef(0);
  const frames = useRef(0);
  const lastStateSync = useRef(0);

  const customBgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const analyserRef = useRef<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const freqDataRef = useRef<Uint8Array | null>(null);

  // Load Album Art
  useEffect(() => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = albumUrl;
    img.onload = () => {
      artRef.current = img;
    };
  }, [albumUrl]);

  // Load Custom Background Image from IDB
  useEffect(() => {
    const assetId = studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId;
    if (assetId && assetId.startsWith("bg-")) {
      import("@/lib/idb").then(({ getBlob }) => {
        getBlob(assetId).then((blob) => {
          if (blob) {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const img = new Image();
            img.src = url;
            img.onload = () => {
              customBgRef.current = img;
            };
          }
        });
      }).catch(() => undefined);
    } else {
      customBgRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [studio.project.media?.background?.imageAssetId]);

  // Manage Lottie Player
  useEffect(() => {
    const overlay = studio.project.media?.background?.overlay;
    if (overlay?.type === "lottie" && overlay.lottieJson) {
      if (!lottiePlayerRef.current) {
        lottiePlayerRef.current = new LottiePlayer(640, 360);
      }
      lottiePlayerRef.current.load(overlay.lottieJson);
    } else {
      if (lottiePlayerRef.current) {
        lottiePlayerRef.current.destroy();
        lottiePlayerRef.current = null;
      }
    }
  }, [studio.project.media?.background?.overlay?.type, studio.project.media?.background?.overlay?.lottieJson]);

  // Main 60fps Canvas Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const loop = (now: number) => {
      const s = studioRef.current;
      const audio = audioRef.current;
      let t = s.playhead;

      if (s.playing && ctxClock.current) {
        t = offset.current + ctxClock.current.currentTime - startedAt.current;
        if (t >= s.project.meta.durationSec) {
          if (s.loop) {
            t = 0;
            offset.current = 0;
            startedAt.current = ctxClock.current.currentTime;
            if (audio) audio.currentTime = 0;
          } else {
            s.setPlaying(false);
            t = s.project.meta.durationSec;
          }
        }
        // Throttled playhead state update to avoid React re-render thrashing
        if (now - lastStateSync.current > 66) {
          s.setPlayhead(t);
          lastStateSync.current = now;
        }
      }

      const draft = s.project.settings.previewQuality === "draft";
      const [rw, rh] = (s.project.meta.resolution || "1920x1080").split("x").map(Number);
      const w = draft ? Math.round((rw || 1920) / 2) : rw || 1920;
      const h = draft ? Math.round((rh || 1080) / 2) : rh || 1080;
      if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
      }

      // Render Lottie frame if active
      let lottieFrame: HTMLCanvasElement | undefined = undefined;
      if (lottiePlayerRef.current && lottiePlayerRef.current.isReady()) {
        const lottieCanvas = lottiePlayerRef.current.renderFrame(t);
        if (lottieCanvas) lottieFrame = lottieCanvas;
      }

      let spectrum: number[] | undefined = undefined;
      if (analyserRef.current && freqDataRef.current && s.playing) {
        (analyserRef.current as AnalyserNode).getByteFrequencyData(freqDataRef.current as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>);
        spectrum = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
          spectrum.push((freqDataRef.current[i] ?? 0) / 255);
        }
      }

      const assets: ResolvedAssets = {
        albumArt: artRef.current ?? undefined,
        backgroundImage: customBgRef.current ?? artRef.current ?? undefined,
        lottieFrame,
        spectrum,
      };

      drawFrame(asFrameContext(ctx), s.project, t, assets);

      frames.current += 1;
      if (lastTs.current && now - lastTs.current > 1000) {
        setFps(frames.current);
        setDropped(Math.max(0, Math.round((s.project.meta.fps || 60) - frames.current)));
        frames.current = 0;
        lastTs.current = now;
      } else if (!lastTs.current) {
        lastTs.current = now;
      }
      raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };

    raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
      if (lottiePlayerRef.current) {
        lottiePlayerRef.current.destroy();
        lottiePlayerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (audio) audio.volume = studio.volume;
  }, [studio.volume]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (studio.playing) {
      if (!ctxClock.current) ctxClock.current = new AudioContext();
      void ctxClock.current.resume();

      if (audio && !analyserRef.current) {
        try {
          const source = ctxClock.current.createMediaElementSource(audio);
          const analyser = ctxClock.current.createAnalyser();
          analyser.fftSize = 128;
          source.connect(analyser);
          analyser.connect(ctxClock.current.destination);
          analyserRef.current = analyser;
          freqDataRef.current = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
        } catch {
          // Audio node routing fallback
        }
      }

      startedAt.current = ctxClock.current.currentTime;
      offset.current = studioRef.current.playhead;
      if (audio) {
        audio.currentTime = studioRef.current.playhead;
        void audio.play().catch(() => undefined);
      }
    } else {
      audio?.pause();
    }
  }, [studio.playing]);

  const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    if (document.fullscreenElement) {
      void document.exitFullscreen();
    } else {
      void containerRef.current.requestFullscreen();
    }
  };

  const aspect = (studio.project.meta.aspectRatio || "16:9").replace(":", " / ");

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[#07080c]">
      <div className="relative grid flex-1 place-items-center overflow-hidden lf-grid">
        <div className="relative max-h-full max-w-full lf-safe shadow-2xl" style={{ aspectRatio: aspect, width: "min(100%, 1100px)" }}>
          <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="h-full w-full rounded-md shadow-2xl" />
        </div>
        {audioUrl ? <audio ref={audioRef} src={audioUrl} preload="auto" /> : null}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-4 py-2">
        <Tooltip label="Play / pause" shortcut="Space">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] text-[var(--ink)]" onClick={() => studio.setPlaying(!studio.playing)}>
            {studio.playing ? <Pause size={16} /> : <Play size={16} />}
          </button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip label="Loop">
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.loop ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}
            onClick={() => studio.setLoop(!studio.loop)}
          >
            <Repeat size={16} />
          </button>
        </Tooltip>
        <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-[var(--ink)]">{formatTimecode(studio.playhead)}</span>
        <span className="text-[var(--faint)]">/</span>
        <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-[var(--faint)]">{formatTimecode(studio.project.meta.durationSec)}</span>

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">
          <Volume2 size={14} className="text-[var(--muted)]" />
          <input
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={1}
            step={0.01}
            value={studio.volume}
            onChange={(e) => studio.setVolume(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-20 accent-[var(--accent)]"
          />
          <span className="tabular-nums font-mono">{fps} fps</span>
          <span className="tabular-nums font-mono">{dropped} drop</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-0.5 uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px] text-[var(--muted)] hover:border-white/20"
            onClick={() =>
              studio.commit((d) => {
                d.settings.previewQuality = d.settings.previewQuality === "draft" ? "full" : "draft";
              })
            }
          >
            {studio.project.settings.previewQuality}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={toggleFullscreen} className="text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]" title="Toggle Fullscreen">
            <Maximize2 size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      }
      if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "J") studio.setPlayhead(Math.max(0, studio.playhead - 2));
      if (e.key === "l" || e.key === "L") studio.setPlayhead(Math.min(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 9999, studio.playhead + 2));
      if (e.key === "k" || e.key === "K") studio.setPlaying(false);
      if (e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") studio.splitAtPlayhead();
      if (e.key === "m" || e.key === "M") studio.mergeSelected();
      if (e.key === "Home") studio.setPlayhead(0);
      if (e.key === "End") studio.setPlayhead(studio.project.meta.durationSec || 0);
      if (e.key === "[") {
        const prev = [...studio.project.captions].reverse().find((c) => c.startSec < studio.playhead - 0.01);
        if (prev) {
          studio.setPlayhead(prev.startSec);
          studio.select([prev.id]);
        }
      }
      if (e.key === "]") {
        const next = studio.project.captions.find((c) => c.startSec > studio.playhead + 0.01);
        if (next) {
          studio.setPlayhead(next.startSec);
          studio.select([next.id]);
        }
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? -10 : -1);
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") studio.nudge(e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1);
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.shiftKey) studio.redo();
        else studio.undo();
      }
      if (e.key === "?" || (e.shiftKey && e.key === "/")) setHelp((v) => !v);
      if (e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") studio.deleteSelected();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [studio]);

  const flagged = studio.project.captions.filter((c) => !c.instrumental && c.confidence < 0.6);
  const album = ART[studio.project.presetId ?? "seven-clouds"] ?? "/images/art-default.jpg";

  async function runExport() {
    const [w, h] = res.split("x").map(Number);
    const ok = await isWebCodecsSupported(w || 1920, h || 1080);
    if (!ok) {
      studio.notify("WebCodecs unavailable — trying FFmpeg fallback.");
      const response = await fetch("/api/export", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format: "mp4", width: w, height: h }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        studio.notify("FFmpeg fallback is not available in this environment.");
        return;
      }
      const blob = await response.blob();
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.mp4`);
      return;
    }
    setExporting(true);
    abort.current = new AbortController();
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = album;
    await img.decode().catch(() => undefined);
    let audioBuffer: AudioBuffer | null = null;
    if (audioUrl) {
      const buf = await fetch(audioUrl).then((r) => r.arrayBuffer());
      audioBuffer = await decodeAudio(buf);
    }
    try {
      const blob = await exportWebCodecsMp4(
        { ...studio.project, meta: { ...studio.project.meta, fps, resolution: res as Project["meta"]["resolution"] } },
        canvas,
        { albumArt: img, backgroundImage: img },
        audioBuffer,
        {
          width: w,
          height: h,
          fps,
          quality,
          signal: abort.current.signal,
          onProgress: (p) => {
            setExportPct(p.pct);
            setExportMsg(`Frame ${p.frame}/${p.total}`);
          },
        },
      );
      downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${res}_${fps}fps.mp4`);
      studio.notify("Export complete.");
      setExportOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      studio.notify(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Export failed.");
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  }

  async function sideExport(format: "srt" | "vtt" | "ass" | "json") {
    const res = await fetch("/api/export", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ project: studio.project, format }),
    });
    const blob = await res.blob();
    downloadBlob(blob, `${studio.project.meta.title}.${format}`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen min-w-[1280px] flex-col bg-[var(--bg)]">
      <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--line)] px-3">
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <img src="/images/mark.png" alt="" className="h-7 w-7 rounded" />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">LyricForge</span>
        </Link>
        <input
          value={studio.project.meta.title}
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.title = e.target.value; })}
          className="h-8 w-56 rounded-md border border-transparent bg-transparent px-2 text-sm font-medium hover:border-[var(--line)] focus:border-[var(--accent)]"
          title="Project Title"
        />
        <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--faint)]">{studio.dirty ? "Unsaved" : studio.saving ? "Saving" : "Saved"}</span>
        <Tooltip label="Undo" shortcut="⌘Z">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-30" disabled={!studio.canUndo} onClick={studio.undo}><Undo2 size={16} /></button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip label="Redo" shortcut="⇧⌘Z">
          <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-30" disabled={!studio.canRedo} onClick={studio.redo}><Redo2 size={16} /></button>
        </Tooltip>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={openLyricsModal}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#12161f] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
        >
          <FileText size={14} /> Paste / Edit Lyrics
        </button>

        <select
          value={studio.project.meta.aspectRatio}
          className="h-8 rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2 text-xs"
          onChange={(e) => studio.commit((d) => { d.meta.aspectRatio = e.target.value as Project["meta"]["aspectRatio"]; })}
        >
          {["16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "21:9"].map((a) => <option key={a}>{a}</option>)}
        </select>

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Tooltip label="Toggle Captions Panel">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] ${studio.leftOpen ? "text-[var(--accent)]" : "text-[var(--muted)]"}`}

            >
              <PanelLeft size={16} />

            >

              onClick={() => studio.setPanel("right", !studio.rightOpen)}
            >
              <PanelRight size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-[var(--line)] mx-1" />
          <Tooltip label="Shortcuts" shortcut="?">
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md p-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]" onClick={() => setHelp(true)}>
              <HelpCircle size={16} />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)] px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md hover:brightness-110"
            onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}
          >
            <Download size={14} /> Export
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        {studio.leftOpen && (
          <aside className="flex flex-col border-r border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]" style={{ width: studio.leftWidth }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--faint)]">
                Captions ({studio.project.captions.length})
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => studio.addCaption("New lyric line")}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-[var(--accent)]/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/25"
                  title="Add new lyric line at playhead"
                >
                  <Plus size={12} /> Add
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={openLyricsModal}
                  className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--muted)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]"
                  title="Paste / Import Sheet"
                >
                  <FileText size={13} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {flagged.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="mx-3 mt-2.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-400/15 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-400/25"
                onClick={() => {
                  const first = flagged[0];
                  if (!first) return;
                  studio.select([first.id]);
                  studio.setPlayhead(first.startSec);
                }}
              >
                Review {flagged.length} flagged low-confidence lines
              </button>
            )}

            <ul className="lf-scroll flex-1 space-y-1.5 overflow-auto p-2">
              {studio.project.captions.map((c) => {
                const isSelected = studio.selectedIds.includes(c.id);
                return (
                  <li
                    key={c.id}
                    className={`rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/10 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,193,90,0.1)]"
                        : "border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] hover:border-white/20"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="p-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">#{c.index + 1}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[var(--faint)]">
                          {formatTimecode(c.startSec)} → {formatTimecode(c.endSec)}
                        </span>
                        <span

              <Timeline peaks={peaks} />

          )}
        </div>

        {studio.rightOpen && (
          <aside className="border-l border-[var(--line)]" style={{ width: studio.rightWidth }}>
            <Inspector />
          </aside>
        )}
      </div>

      <Toast text={studio.toast?.text ?? null} />
      <Shortcuts open={help} onClose={() => setHelp(false)} />

      {/* Paste / Edit Full Lyrics Sheet Modal */}
      <Modal
        open={lyricsModalOpen}
        title="Paste / Edit Lyrics Sheet"
        onClose={() => setLyricsModalOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleApplyLyricsSheet}
        confirmLabel="Apply & Sync Lyrics"
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-white/5 pb-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--muted)]">
              Line breaks define captions. Headers like <code className="text-[var(--accent)]">## title:</code> supported.
            </span>

                type="button"

                  try {

                    if (text) setLyricsSheetText(text);

                className="rounded border border-red-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10"

                  const lines = studio.project.captions
                    .filter((c) => !c.instrumental)
                    .map((c) => c.text)
                    .join("\n");
                  const metaHeader = `## title: ${studio.project.meta.title}\n## artist: ${studio.project.meta.artist}\n\n`;
                  setLyricsSheetText(metaHeader + lines);
                }}
                className="rounded border border-[var(--accent)]/30 bg-[var(--accent)]/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--accent)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/20"
              >
                Reload Current
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <textarea
            value={lyricsSheetText}
            onChange={(e) => setLyricsSheetText(e.target.value)}
            rows={12}
            className="w-full resize-none rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#07090e] p-3 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
            placeholder={`## title: Song Title\n## artist: Artist Name\n\n[Verse 1]\nLine one lyrics\nLine two lyrics\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one`}
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Export Video Modal */}
      <Modal
        open={exportOpen}
        title="Export lyric video"
        onClose={() => setExportOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={() => void runExport()}
        confirmLabel={exporting ? "Exporting…" : "Render MP4"}
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Resolution
            <select value={res} onChange={(e) => setRes(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              <option>1280x720</option>
              <option>1920x1080</option>
              <option>2560x1440</option>
              <option>3840x2160</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Frame rate
            <select value={fps} onChange={(e) => setFps(Number(e.target.value))} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              {[24, 25, 30, 50, 60].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} fps</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm">
            Quality
            <select value={quality} onChange={(e) => setQuality(e.target.value as typeof quality)} className="mt-1 h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-2">
              <option value="high">High</option>
              <option value="balanced">Balanced</option>
              <option value="small">Small</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("srt")}>SRT</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("vtt")}>WebVTT</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("ass")}>ASS karaoke</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-md border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1" onClick={() => void sideExport("json")}>Project JSON</button>
          </div>
          {exporting && (
            <div>
              <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1c2230]">
                <div className="h-full bg-[var(--accent)]" style={{ width: `${exportPct * 100}%` }} />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs">{exportMsg}</p>
              <button type="button" className="mt-2 text-xs text-[var(--danger)]" onClick={() => abort.current?.abort()}>Cancel</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function StudioApp({ initial }: { initial: Project }) {
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>(() => Array.from({ length: 180 }, (_, i) => 0.2 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 6))));

  useEffect(() => {
    void (async () => {
      const blob = (await getBlob(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getBlob("draft-master"));
      if (blob) setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      const stored = (await getPeaks(`audio-${initial.id}`)) ?? (await getPeaks("draft-master"));
      if (stored) setPeaks(Array.from(stored));
    })();
  }, [initial.id]);

  const project = useMemo(() => initial, [initial]);
  return (
    <StudioProvider initial={project}>
      <StudioInner audioUrl={audioUrl} peaks={peaks} />
    </StudioProvider>
  );
}

  spectrum?: ArrayLike<number>;
}

export function fontString(family: string, weight: number, italic: boolean, px: number): string {
  const style = italic ? "italic" : "normal";
  return `${style} ${weight} ${px}px "${family}", system-ui, sans-serif`;
}

    settings: {

type LooseRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is LooseRecord {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/** v0 → v1 is a documented no-op so the migrate() chain exists and is tested. */
export function migrateV0ToV1(doc: unknown): unknown {
  if (!isRecord(doc)) return doc;
  const next: LooseRecord = { ...doc };
  if (next.version === 0 || next.version === undefined) {
    next.version = 1;
  }
  return next;
}

export function migrate(doc: unknown): Project {
  let current = doc;
  if (isRecord(current) && (current.version === 0 || current.version === undefined)) {
    current = migrateV0ToV1(current);
  }
  const parsed = ProjectSchema.safeParse(current);
  if (parsed.success) return parsed.data;
  if (isRecord(current)) {
    const fallback = defaultProject({
      id: typeof current.id === "string" ? current.id : undefined,
      meta: {
        title: typeof current.meta === "object" && current.meta && "title" in current.meta
          ? String((current.meta as LooseRecord).title ?? "Untitled")
          : "Untitled",
        artist: "Unknown Artist",
        durationSec: 0,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
    });
    return ProjectSchema.parse(fallback);
  }
  return defaultProject();
}

export const DOCUMENT_VERSION = CURRENT_VERSION;

import { StudioApp } from "@/components/studio/studio-app";
import { defaultProject, migrate } from "@/schema";
import { getProject } from "@/db/repository";
import { createId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { heuristicSync, parseLyrics } from "@/align-engine";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const DEMO_LYRICS = `## title: Midnight Atlas
## artist: Northline
[Verse 1]
City lights fold over the river
I keep your name in the back of my throat
Every red signal feels like a letter
I never found the courage to post

[Chorus]
If the night is a map then I'm lost on purpose
Pin every heartbeat to a borrowed sky
Say it slower so the dark can rehearse us
We only glow when we almost arrive
`;

export default async function StudioPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const existing = await getProject(id);

  let project;
  if (existing) {
    project = migrate(existing);
  } else {
    // Only compute demo lyrics when no saved project exists
    const parsed = parseLyrics(DEMO_LYRICS);
    const demo = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, 36);
    project = defaultProject({
      id: id === "demo" ? "demo" : id || createId("proj"),
      meta: {
        title: parsed.title ?? "Midnight Atlas",
        artist: parsed.artist ?? "Northline",
        durationSec: 36,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
      captions: demo.captions,
    });
  }

  return <StudioApp initial={project} />;
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";

const SAMPLE_LYRICS = `## title: Midnight Atlas
## artist: Northline
[Verse 1]
City lights fold over the river

Every red signal feels like a letter

[Chorus]

[Verse 2]

I would trade the whole constellation
