interface ClipMap {
  name: string;
  file: File;
  lineIndex: number;
}

export function Wizard() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [key, setKey] = useState("");
  const [persist, setPersist] = useState<"session" | "store">("session");
  const [keyOk, setKeyOk] = useState(false);
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [keyError, setKeyError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hasSessionKey, setHasSessionKey] = useState(false);
  const [audioFile, setAudioFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [vocalFile, setVocalFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const [audioMeta, setAudioMeta] = useState<string>("");
  const [lyrics, setLyrics] = useState("");
  const [clips, setClips] = useState<ClipMap[]>([]);
  const [log, setLog] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const vocalRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const clipRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetch("/api/session")
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((j: { configured?: boolean; defaultKey?: string }) => {
        if (j.configured) {
          setHasSessionKey(true);
          setKeyOk(true);
        }
        if (j.defaultKey) {
          setKey((prev) => prev || j.defaultKey || "");
        }
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  const parsed = useMemo(() => parseLyrics(lyrics), [lyrics]);
  const vocalCount = parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).length;

  async function validateKey() {
    setKeyError(null);
    setValidating(true);
    try {
      const activeKey = key.trim();
      if (!activeKey) {
        setKeyError("Please enter a Groq API key.");
        setKeyOk(false);
        setValidating(false);
        return;
      }
      const res = await fetch("/api/session", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ key: activeKey, persist }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok) {
        setKeyError(json.error ?? "Could not validate that key.");
        setKeyOk(false);
        return;
      }
      setKeyOk(true);
      setHasSessionKey(true);
      setKey(activeKey);
    } catch {
      setKeyError("Network error while validating key.");
      setKeyOk(false);
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  }

  async function onAudio(file: File, kind: "master" | "vocal") {
    try {
      const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const decoded = await decodeAudio(buf);
      if (kind === "master") {
        setAudioFile(file);
        setDuration(decoded.duration);
        const p = extractPeaks(decoded, 240);
        setPeaks(Array.from(p));
        setAudioMeta(`${file.name} · ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB · ${decoded.duration.toFixed(1)}s · ${decoded.sampleRate} Hz`);
        await putBlob("draft-master", file);
        await putPeaks("draft-master", p);
      } else {
        setVocalFile(file);
        await putBlob("draft-vocal", file);
      }
    } catch {
      setAudioMeta("Could not decode that file. Re-export as mp3 or wav.");
    }
  }

  async function generateWithoutAudio() {
    setRunning(true);
    setLog(["Parsing lyric sheet...", "Generating synchronized captions with heuristic rhythm timing..."]);
    setProgress(0.4);
    const estDuration = Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8);
    const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, estDuration);
    const project = defaultProject({
      id: createId("proj"),
      meta: {
        title: parsed.title ?? (parsed.lines.find((l) => !l.instrumental)?.text.slice(0, 32) || "Custom Lyrics"),
        artist: parsed.artist ?? "",
        durationSec: estDuration,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
      captions: sync.captions,
    });
    setProgress(0.8);
    const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
    });
    if (!saved.ok) {
      const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown error");
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error saving project: ${errText}`]);
      setRunning(false);
      return;
    }
    const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
    setProgress(1);
    setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Project ready. Opening Studio..."]);
    setRunning(false);
    startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
  }

  async function analyze() {
    if (!audioFile) {
      await generateWithoutAudio();
      return;
    }
    setRunning(true);
    setLog([]);
    setProgress(0);
    const form = new FormData();
    form.set("lyrics", lyrics);
    form.set("durationSec", String(duration));
    form.set("title", parsed.title ?? audioFile.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
    form.set("artist", parsed.artist ?? "Unknown Artist");
    form.set("language", "en");
    const decoded = await decodeAudio(await audioFile.arrayBuffer());
    const wav = encodeWavMono16(downsampleMono(decoded), 16000);
    form.set("audio", new File([wav], "master.wav", { type: "audio/wav" }));
    const res = await fetch("/api/analyze", { method: "POST", body: form });
    if (!res.body) {
      setLog(["The analyze stream failed to open."]);
      setRunning(false);
      return;
    }
    const reader = res.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buf = "";
    let captions: Caption[] = [];
    let flagged = 0;
    let title = parsed.title ?? "Untitled";
    let artist = parsed.artist ?? "Unknown Artist";
    let streamFailed = false;
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buf += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      const chunks = buf.split("\n\n");
      buf = chunks.pop() ?? "";
      for (const chunk of chunks) {
        const line = chunk.split("\n").find((l) => l.startsWith("data:"));
        if (!line) continue;
        try {
          const payload = JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim()) as {
            stage: string;
            label: string;
            progress: number;
            captions?: Caption[];
            flagged?: number;
            title?: string;
            artist?: string;
          };
          setProgress(payload.progress);
          setLog((curr) => [...curr, `${payload.stage}  ${payload.label}`]);
          if (payload.stage === "error") {
            streamFailed = true;
          }
          if (payload.captions) captions = payload.captions;
          if (payload.flagged !== undefined) flagged = payload.flagged;
          if (payload.title) title = payload.title;
          if (payload.artist) artist = payload.artist;
        } catch {
          // ignore malformed SSE line
        }
      }
    }

    if (streamFailed && captions.length === 0) {
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, "Whisper API unavailable. Falling back to heuristic timing sync..."]);
      const sync = heuristicSync(parsed.lines, duration || Math.max(30, vocalCount * 3.8));
      captions = sync.captions;
    }

    const project = defaultProject({
      id: createId("proj"),
      meta: {
        title,
        artist,
        durationSec: duration,
        fps: 30,
        resolution: "1920x1080",
        aspectRatio: "16:9",
        language: "en",
      },
      captions,
    });
    await putBlob(`audio-${project.id}`, audioFile);
    if (vocalFile) await putBlob(`vocal-${project.id}`, vocalFile);
    const saved = await fetch("/api/projects", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ project }),
    });
    if (!saved.ok) {
      const errText = await saved.text().catch(() => "Unknown error");
      setLog((curr) => [...curr, `Error saving project: ${errText}`]);
      setRunning(false);
      return;
    }
    const json = (await saved.json()) as { project: { id: string } };
    setLog((curr) => [...curr, flagged ? `Review ${flagged} flagged lines in the studio.` : "All lines scored confidently."]);
    setRunning(false);
    startTransition(() => router.push(`/studio/${json.project.id}`));
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]">
      <section className="lf-enter rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--bg-panel)]/90 p-8 shadow-[0_30px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.35)]">
        <ol className="mb-8 flex gap-2 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--faint)]">
          {["Key", "Audio", "Lyrics", "Clips"].map((label, i) => (
            <li key={label} className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 ${step === i + 1 ? "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)]" : "bg-[#0d1118]"}`}>
              {i + 1} {label}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>

        {step === 1 && (
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-3xl">Connect Groq</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Whisper large-v3-turbo timestamps every word. The key stays on the server — never written into the project, never logged, never sent back to the browser.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-6">
              <input
                type="password"
                autoComplete="off"
                placeholder="gsk_…"
                value={key}
                onChange={(e) => setKey(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-[var(--ink)] focus:border-[var(--accent)] focus:outline-none"
              />
              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-[var(--faint)]">{key ? "Custom key entered" : "Paste your Groq API key above"}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    void fetch("/api/session")
                      .then((r) => r.json())
                      .then((j: { defaultKey?: string }) => {
                        if (j.defaultKey) setKey(j.defaultKey);
                      })
                      .catch(() => undefined);
                  }}
                  className="text-[var(--accent)] hover:underline"
                >
                  Load server default key
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <label className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--muted)]">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={persist === "store"} onChange={(e) => setPersist(e.target.checked ? "store" : "session")} />
              Remember on this machine (encrypted-at-rest still recommended in production)
            </label>
            {keyError ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{keyError}</p> : null}
            {keyOk ? <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--ok)]"><Check size={16} /> Key active & verified. ASR (Whisper) + LLM models ready.</p> : null}
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={validating}
                onClick={() => void validateKey()}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--accent)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] shadow-md hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <KeyRound size={16} /> {validating ? "Validating..." : "Validate key"}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStep(2)}
                className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0d1118] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-[var(--ink)] hover:border-[var(--accent)] hover:text-[var(--accent)]"
              >
                Continue to Audio →
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 2 && (
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-3xl">Master audio</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--muted)]">
              mp3 / wav / flac / m4a / aac / ogg. Optional isolated vocal stem is used for ASR while the master plays back.
            </p>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()} className="mt-6 flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] bg-[#0b0e14] px-6 py-12 hover:border-[var(--accent)]">
              <Upload className="mb-3 text-[var(--accent)]" />
              <span className="text-sm">{audioFile ? audioFile.name : "Drop a 3–5 minute mix, or browse"}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">{audioMeta || "Waveform appears after decode"}</span>
            </button>
            <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="audio/*" hidden onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void onAudio(e.target.files[0], "master")} />
            {peaks.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 flex h-16 items-end gap-px rounded-xl bg-[#0b0e14] px-2 py-2">
                {peaks.map((p, i) => (
                  <span key={i} className="flex-1 rounded-sm bg-[var(--accent)]" style={{ height: `${Math.max(6, p * 100)}%`, opacity: 0.35 + p * 0.65 }} />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            <button type="button" onClick={() => vocalRef.current?.click()} className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--muted)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]">
              <Mic2 size={16} /> {vocalFile ? vocalFile.name : "Optional vocal stem"}
            </button>
            <input ref={vocalRef} type="file" accept="audio/*" hidden onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && void onAudio(e.target.files[0], "vocal")} />
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setStep(1)} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm">Back</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setStep(3)} className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--accent)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)]">
                {audioFile ? "Continue with audio" : "Continue with lyrics only"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 3 && (
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-3xl">Lyric sheet</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Line breaks are caption boundaries. Blank lines become instrumental gaps. Use [Chorus] markers and ## title: / ## artist: headers.
            </p>
            <textarea
              value={lyrics}
              onChange={(e) => setLyrics(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={`## title: Song Title\n## artist: Artist Name\n\n[Verse 1]\nFirst lyric line here\nSecond lyric line here\n\n[Chorus]\nChorus line one\nChorus line two`}
              className="mt-5 h-72 w-full resize-none rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] p-4 font-mono text-sm leading-6"
            />
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--faint)]">{vocalCount} lines · {parsed.title ?? "Untitled"} — {parsed.artist ?? "Unknown"}</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLyrics(SAMPLE_LYRICS)}
                className="text-xs text-[var(--accent)] hover:underline"
              >
                Load sample lyrics
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setStep(2)} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm">Back</button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={vocalCount === 0}
                onClick={() => setStep(4)}
                className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--accent)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {vocalCount === 0 ? "Paste lyrics to continue" : "Continue"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 4 && (
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-3xl">Split clips</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--muted)]">
              Optional. Drop 001.wav… per line. FFT cross-correlation pins each line to a sample-accurate offset in the master — the highest-quality signal we have.
            </p>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => clipRef.current?.click()} className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--line-strong)] px-4 py-8 text-sm text-[var(--muted)]">
              <FileAudio className="mx-auto mb-2" /> Add per-line clips
            </button>
            <input
              ref={clipRef}
              type="file"
              accept="audio/*"
              multiple
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => {
                const files = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []).sort((a, b) => naturalSort(a.name, b.name));
                setClips(files.map((file, i) => ({ name: file.name, file, lineIndex: i })));
              }}
            />
            {clips.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-4 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] lf-scroll">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                  <thead className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--faint)]">
                    <tr><th className="px-3 py-2">Clip</th><th>Line</th></tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {clips.map((c, i) => (
                      <tr key={c.name} className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">{c.name}</td>
                        <td>
                          <select
                            value={c.lineIndex}
                            className="bg-transparent"
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const next = [...clips];
                              next[i] = { ...c, lineIndex: Number(e.target.value) };
                              setClips(next);
                            }}
                          >
                            {parsed.lines.filter((l) => !l.instrumental).map((l) => (
                              <option key={l.index} value={l.index}>{l.text.slice(0, 48)}</option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setStep(3)} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm">Back</button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={running || pending}
                onClick={() => void analyze()}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--accent)] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--accent-ink)] disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <Sparkles size={16} /> {audioFile ? "Analyze & Generate" : "Generate Lyric Video"}
              </button>
            </div>
            {running || log.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--line)] bg-[#0b0e14] p-4">
                <div className="mb-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1c2230]">
                  <div className="h-full bg-[var(--accent)] transition-all" style={{ width: `${progress * 100}%` }} />
                </div>
                <ul className="space-y-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--muted)]">
                  {log.map((line, i) => <li key={`${line}-${i}`}>{line}</li>)}
                </ul>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <aside className="lf-enter">
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-[var(--line)]">
          <img src="/images/hero.jpg" alt="" className="h-64 w-full object-cover" />
          <div className="bg-[var(--bg-panel)] p-6">
            <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--accent)]">Vertical slice</p>
            <h3 className="mt-2 font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-2xl">Audio + lyrics in. Synced MP4 out.</h3>
            <ul className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm text-[var(--muted)]">
              <li className="flex gap-2"><AudioLines size={16} className="mt-0.5 text-[var(--accent)]" /> Needleman–Wunsch + Whisper word times</li>
              <li className="flex gap-2"><Sparkles size={16} className="mt-0.5 text-[var(--accent)]" /> Same drawFrame for preview and 1080p60 export</li>
              <li className="flex gap-2"><Mic2 size={16} className="mt-0.5 text-[var(--accent)]" /> Ripple / roll / relink timeline with 100-step undo</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}
